English: Goodbye.
Chinese: 再见。

English: Farewell.
Chinese: 告辞。

English: I must be off.
Chinese: 我该走了。

English: Good day to you.
Chinese: 祝你今天顺利。

English: Nevermind.
Chinese: 算了。

English: I should be going.
Chinese: 我该动身了。

English: Sorry to bother you.
Chinese: 打扰了。

English: Understood.
Chinese: 明白了。

English: I see...
Chinese: 原来如此……

English: Carry on.
Chinese: 你继续。

English: Long live the King.
Chinese: 国王万岁。

English: Shut up.
Chinese: 闭嘴。

English: [Leave them alone.]
Chinese: [别打扰他们。]

English: <<Three patrons huddle round the table, nursing hot mugs and discussing a news-sheet with hushed voices.>>##You see? It says she's from [[Alskop,]] but none of us remember any village by that name. I'm telling you, they've erased the whole –
Chinese: <<三位客人围着桌子，捧着热腾腾的杯子，压低嗓音议论一份新闻纸。>>##你看？上面说她来自[[阿尔斯科普]]，可我们谁都不记得有这个村子。我告诉你，他们把整个——

English: <<They notice you listening.>>##Oh, er, King's blessing, citizen! Don't mind us, we're just absorbing the latest Royal Dispatch. Good to know the [[Guild]] has it all in hand, eh?
Chinese: <<他们发觉你在偷听。>>##哦，呃，国王赐福，公民！别理我们，我们在学习最新一期《王室急报》呢。[[公会]]把一切都安排得妥妥的，对吧？

English: <<Three patrons huddle round the table, nursing hot mugs and discussing a news-sheet with hushed voices.>>##Of ((course)) there's nothin' about the summonin' outage. The [[Machinists]] would never admit that the [[Saboteur]] bloodied their noses like that –
Chinese: <<三位客人围着桌子，捧着热腾腾的杯子，压低嗓音议论一份新闻纸。>>##((当然))不会提召唤中断的事。[[机械师]]绝不会承认[[破坏者]]打得他们满地找牙——

English: <<They notice you listening.>>##Oh, er, King's favour, pal. Just a few old farts enjoyin' our weekly ration. Every day I thank my stars I live here and nowhere else.
Chinese: <<他们发觉你在偷听。>>##哦，呃，国王赐福，伙计。几个老家伙享用每周配给罢了。每天我都感谢星辰，让我住在这儿而不是别处。

English: <<Three patrons huddle round the table, nursing hot mugs and discussing a news-sheet with hushed voices.>>##Absolute bollocks. My cousin in [[Yansk,]] her daughter saw a [[Corrupt One]] in the forest just last week – it's spreading bloody everywhere –
Chinese: <<三位客人围着桌子，捧着热腾腾的杯子，压低嗓音议论一份新闻纸。>>##一派胡言。我表姐在[[扬斯克]]，她女儿上星期就在森林里看见一个[[腐化者]]——到处都在扩散——

English: <<They notice you listening.>>##Oh, er, King's grace, my dear! Isn't it nice to be safe and warm in [[Ferropolis]], where the [[Guild]] can look after us? No doubt the Corruption will be cleaned up soon...
Chinese: <<他们发觉你在偷听。>>##哦，呃，国王开恩，亲爱的！[[铁城]]又安全又暖和，[[公会]]照顾我们，多好呀？腐化很快就会被清理干净的……

English: Did you hear about the famine over in [[Hallowshire]]? They say the Inquisition's sittin' on a great stockpile of food, but hangin' anyone who talks about it.
Chinese: 听说[[哈洛郡]]闹饥荒的事了吗？据说宗教裁判所囤着一大批粮食，谁议论就绞死谁。

English: Knew it were trouble when the Union moved in over there. Bloody knew it.
Chinese: 联盟一开进那边，我就知道要有麻烦。我他妈早知道。

English: Where did you hear that rumour?
Chinese: 这传言你从哪听来的？

English: <<They look proud.>>##I read about it in the Royal Dispatch. Aye, I bloody well read it! Only learned my letters a few years ago, mind. My son still helps me with the technical words.
Chinese: <<他们一脸自豪。>>##《王室急报》上读的。对，我他妈真读了！不过认字也是几年前的事。术语还得我儿子帮我。

English: Who taught you to read?
Chinese: 谁教你认字的？

English: Guild class, weren't it? Machinists rounded up a bunch of us illiterates in an old god-botherers' temple.
Chinese: 公会的识字班嘛。机械师把我们这帮文盲圈到一个拜神的老庙里。

English: Never seen so many desks in one place. Gave us the month off work to learn too.
Chinese: 一辈子没见过那么多桌子排一起。还给我们放了一个月的假，专门学认字。

English: Grand thing, that was. My old folks never had letters, nor their old folks neither. If you'd asked my pa what a comma was, he'd ask if there was good eatin' on it.
Chinese: 了不起的事，真的。我爹娘不识字，我爹娘的爹娘也不识字。你要问我爸逗号是什么，他会问那玩意儿好不好吃。

English: Actually, I've recently been to Hallowshire.
Chinese: 其实，我最近去过哈洛郡。

English: You do look the travellin' type. Maybe you can confirm the news, then?
Chinese: 你瞧着就像跑江湖的。那你正好可以证实一下消息？

English: It's true. The Inquisition's laying waste to everything.
Chinese: 是真的。宗教裁判所正在那边祸害一切。

English: <<They nod sagely.>>##There you have it. Bloody power-hungry sods, they are.
Chinese: <<他们若有所悟地点头。>>##你听听。一群贪权的混账东西。

English: We'd barely moved our kingdom next to Hallowshire before they followed suit.
Chinese: 我们的王国刚搬到哈洛郡旁边，他们就跟了过来。

English: Couldn't have anyone showing the locals what ((real)) magic looks like, could they?
Chinese: 总不能让本地人见识见识((真正的))魔法长什么样，对吧？

English: I didn't hear anything about a stockpile.
Chinese: 我没听说什么囤粮。

English: <<They nod sagely.>>##I'll bet. Not worth anyone's neck to tell you, eh? That's the trouble with hangin' folks. Sooner or later you can't tell what anyone really thinks.
Chinese: <<他们若有所悟地点头。>>##我就说。说出来是要吊死的，谁肯告诉你？这就是绞刑的坏处。到头来，谁也看不出谁心里真正想什么。

English: That's not true. The Inquisition is doing its best over there.
Chinese: 不是这样的。宗教裁判所在那边已经尽力了。

English: <<They look perturbed by your stance, and hide it badly.>>##Oh aye? That's most interestin'...
Chinese: <<他们对你的立场很不安，又拙劣地掩饰。>>##哦是吗？有意思……

English: My, but would you look at the time? Sorry pal, I'm s'posed to be meetin' someone here.
Chinese: 哎呀，你看看都几点了？抱歉伙计，我约了人在这里见面。

English: The Inquisition's sittin' on a great stockpile of food, but hangin' anyone in [[Hallowshire]] who talks about it.##Bloody power-hungry sods, they are!
Chinese: 宗教裁判所在[[哈洛郡]]囤着一大批粮食，谁议论就绞死谁。##一群贪权的混账东西！

English: ...Sorry pal, I'm s'posed to be meetin' someone here.
Chinese: ……抱歉伙计，我约了人在这里见面。

English: <<This Machinist is leaning back in their seat, drumming their fingers on their teacup with an amused expression.>>
Chinese: <<这位机械师往椅背一靠，指节敲着茶杯，一脸玩味。>>

English: My opponent's knowledge of this game is undoubtedly superior. There's no move I can possibly make that they will not anticipate.
Chinese: 我的对手对这局棋的理解无疑在我之上。我走出的任何一步，都在其预料之中。

English: However, I know something my opponent does not:##I'm cheating.
Chinese: 然而，有一件事我知道而对手不知道：##我在作弊。

English: <<This Machinist's face betrays no emotion as they study the board intensely.>>
Chinese: <<这位机械师全神贯注地研究棋盘，脸上不露一丝情绪。>>

English: My opponent knows I have pondered every strategy ever played by man or god.
Chinese: 我的对手知道，我已参透了凡人与诸神下过的每一种开局。

English: What they don't know is that my tea is dosed with an amnesia potion of my own recipe.
Chinese: 他们不知道的是，我的茶里下了我自己调配的失忆药。

English: They are wholly unprepared to face a lunatic!
Chinese: 他们完全没有准备好对付一个疯子！

English: So I heard this story, right? A man and a woman, lovers they were, like two seeds in a pod.##You couldn't pry 'em apart with a crowbar. Lived in Ferropolis, though I can't say where they are now.
Chinese: 我听说这么个故事，你听好了？一男一女，一对恋人，好得像豆荚里的两粒豆。##撬棍都撬不开。住在铁城，不过现在人在哪我可说不上来。

English: Well, one night these two had an awful fight, and went back to their own families for a while.##Both of 'em prayed to the King to make them forget the other.
Chinese: 嗯，某天夜里这俩大吵一架，各自回娘家住了一阵。##俩人都向国王祈祷，求它让自己忘掉对方。

English: And d'you know what? The King answered.
Chinese: 你猜怎么着？国王应允了。

English: Granted their prayers, didn't it? The next morning, they both woke up with no memory of ever meeting. And they went on like this for years, searching for someone new, never quite finding the right one.
Chinese: 还真就满足了他们的祈愿，对吧？第二天早上，两人醒来，谁都不记得见过对方。就这样过了好些年，各自寻找新欢，却总也找不到对的人。

English: Then one day, they met again – in this very teahouse. And even though they didn't recognise each other, they were drawn together irresistibly.
Chinese: 后来有一天，他们重逢了——就在这家茶馆。虽然彼此认不出来，却身不由己地被吸引到一起。

English: They got married and had eighteen kids, or so I heard. Their love was so strong that not even the King could keep 'em apart.##They both got their memories back eventually, and swore never to make the same mistake again.
Chinese: 他们结了婚，生了十八个孩子，我听说啊。他们的爱太深了，连国王都拆不散。##后来两人的记忆都恢复了，并发誓再也不犯同样的错。

English: <<They glance to each side, as if someone is watching them.>>##... it's only a story, mate.
Chinese: <<他朝两边瞥了瞥，像有人在看。>>##……就是个故事而已，哥们。

English: What did the King do?
Chinese: 国王做了什么？

English: I'm afraid I don't have time for stories.
Chinese: 恐怕我没空听故事。

English: So how did it end?
Chinese: 那结局呢？

English: I've heard enough, thanks.
Chinese: 听够了，谢谢。

English: Can the King actually do that?
Chinese: 国王真能做到这种事？

English: Thanks for the story.
Chinese: 谢谢你的故事。

English: You heard Dmitri's story? He's full of shit.##If my husband forgot who I was, you wouldn't catch me dead reminding him.
Chinese: 听过德米特里的故事了？他满嘴跑火车。##要我丈夫忘了我是谁，打死我也不会去提醒他。

English: You heard Dmitri's story yet?
Chinese: 听过德米特里的故事没？

English: <<This stout woman has a maternal air and a voice full of pebbles. A hand-rolled cigarette droops from her mouth.>>
Chinese: <<这位壮实的妇人一身母性气场，嗓音像含着砂砾。嘴角叼着一支手卷烟。>>

English: King's favour, pet. Welcome to the [[Squeaky Wheel Teahouse]]. What can ol' [[Baba Xenia]] do for ye?
Chinese: 国王赐福，亲爱的。欢迎来到[[吱嘎轮茶馆]]。老婆子[[克塞尼娅]]能为您做点什么？

English: <<Xenia takes a drag on her cigarette.>> What else can I do for ye, pet?
Chinese: <<克塞尼娅吸了口烟。>>还能为您做点什么，亲爱的？

English: <<Xenia takes her cigarette out of her mouth and examines you dubiously.>>##A room? Afraid I'll need to see your bunkin' permit.
Chinese: <<克塞尼娅把烟从嘴里拿开，狐疑地打量你。>>##要客房？那得看看您的住宿许可了。

English: <<She cracks a grin.>>##Just a wee joke, pet.
Chinese: <<她咧嘴一笑。>>##开个玩笑，亲爱的。

English: The skyward suite's yours for [[5 coins]], if ye don't mind sleepin' there.
Chinese: [[5 枚硬币]]，阁楼套房就归你了，只要你不介意睡在那儿。

English: <<Xenia stubs out her cigarette and begins rolling another.>>##Right ye are, pet. The room's upstairs on the other end of a long metal gantry. It's the one that's floatin' in mid-air, like.
Chinese: <<克塞尼娅掐灭烟，又卷起一支。>>##好的亲爱的。房间在楼上，要走过一道长长的金属栈桥。就是悬浮在半空的那间。

English: We don't call it the skyward suite for nothin', pet. Only the blessed magic o' the [[Clockwork King]] keeps it off the ground.##Some outsiders don't trust it.
Chinese: 我们管它叫阁楼套房可不是白叫的，亲爱的。全靠[[发条王]]神圣的魔法才让它不落地。##有些外乡人不信这个。

English: Would ye now? Mind, if ye want alcohol, it'll be a mite costlier than ye're used to.##The King's no' too fond of it, so most people just take tea or [[bottled visions]] instead. ((Now if ye're sellin', I can give ye a good price...))
Chinese: 要喝的？先说好，酒可比您习惯的贵上一点。##国王不大待见酒，所以多数人只喝茶或[[瓶装幻象]]。（((您要是有酒要卖，我倒可以给个好价……))

English: Still want a drink, pet?
Chinese: 还想喝点吗，亲爱的？

English: The Kingdom's premier export, so I'm told. A real dream or fantasy, tapped an' corked for the buyer's pleasure. But if that's yer tipple, ye'd best find a licenced vision trader. <<You sense disapproval in Xenia's voice.>>
Chinese: 王国的头号特产，听说是。把真实的梦或幻想汲出来封进瓶子，供买家享用。不过那是您的爱好的话，最好去找持证的幻象商人。<<你听出克塞尼娅话里的不赞成。>>

English: Not that I'm judgin', mind. It's perfectly legal here, and I ken why it's so popular. Just not ol' Baba Xenia's personal cup of tea. Besides, I can't be arsed with the extra permits.
Chinese: 别误会，我不是在评判。在这儿完全合法，我也明白它为什么受欢迎。只是不合老婆子克塞尼娅个人的口味。再说，多办几张许可我可嫌麻烦。

English: <<Xenia blows a plume of smoke.>> Not from around here, are ye, pet? ##Don't fret. Nearly everyone in the Kingdom came here from somewhere else.
Chinese: <<克塞尼娅吐出一口烟。>>不是本地人吧，亲爱的？##别慌。王国里几乎人人都是从别处来的。

English: <<Smoke billows from Xenia's nose.>> More questions, pet?
Chinese: <<烟雾从克塞尼娅鼻孔里涌出。>>还有问题吗，亲爱的？

English: Snow, mostly...##[[The King]] – blessed be its name – controls our seasons, see? Used to give us nice long springs and summers. But this winter was scheduled to end months ago, and it's havok on our farmers.
Chinese: 雪，主要是雪……##[[国王]]——愿其名受颂——掌管我们的四季，知道吧？从前给我们长长的春天和夏天。可这个冬天按计划几个月前就该结束了，把庄稼人坑惨了。

English: Seems this winter is finally coming to a close.##Months behind The King's own schedule, mind you. It will take a long time for the farmers recover. Not that I'm complaining.
Chinese: 看来这个冬天总算快熬到头了。##比国王自己排的日程晚了好几个月，你懂的。庄稼人得缓好久。当然我不抱怨。

English: I'm sure Its Majesty must have some plan in mind, though.
Chinese: 不过我相信陛下一定有自己的打算。

English: And don't believe what you hear about the stockpiles running dry! Guild says it's just a rumour spread by the Saboteur, meant to make us all panic.
Chinese: 还有，别信那些说储备快见底的话！公会说了，那是破坏者散布的谣言，就想吓唬得我们人人自乱。

English: Some folk think we should reopen the Hallowshire border, but I dunno. The Apostatic Union's got it in for us. If ye ask me, it's no coincidence they started makin' trouble right after we arrived.
Chinese: 有人觉得该重开哈洛郡边境，可我说不好。叛教联盟存心跟我们过不去。要我说，我们一搬来他们就闹事，绝不是巧合。

English: Aye, we don't get too many outsiders these days...##<<Xenia draws on her cigarette.>>
Chinese: 是啊，如今外乡人不多了……##<<克塞尼娅吸了口烟。>>

English: Oh no, pet. We sailed here ten or fifteen year ago now, seekin' trade with Hallowshire. That was grand, 'til the Union started movin' more troops into Hallowshire too.
Chinese: 哦不，亲爱的。我们是十来二十年前航行来的，想跟哈洛郡做生意。那时候多好，直到联盟也开始往哈洛郡增兵。

English: <<Xenia checks no one is eavesdropping, then casually leans closer.>>##When I was a lass we called this island [[Kardova]]. A muddy wee Wikkan fiefdom, it was, bound to an old mother god whose name... <<(she glances around)>> is no' important.
Chinese: <<克塞尼娅确认没人在偷听，才随意地凑近。>>##我还是姑娘的时候，这座岛叫[[卡尔多瓦]]。一片泥泞的小维坎封地，听命于一位老母亲神，她的名字……<<她环顾四周>>不重要。

English: Wasn't all bad, mind. I remember Ma takin' me to a Wikkan wise woman when I got pregnant and didn't want it.##But that fickle old god asked a heavy price to see us through each winter. Good riddance, says I.
Chinese: 倒也不全是坏事。记得我怀了孕又不想要的时候，我妈带我去找过维坎的智慧女人。##可那位善变的老神，每年过冬都要收一笔重价。我算是解脱了，我说。

English: Oh, they flocked from all over to help us build the King. Slev, Lundel, Byonne, Venna – even Puria, or further. Lots of 'em fought for the Union in the God War, but didn't like where it was headin'.
Chinese: 哦，大家从四面八方赶来帮我们造国王。斯列夫、伦德尔、拜昂、维纳——甚至普利亚，或者更远。好多人神之战时为联盟打过仗，但看不惯它后来的走向。

English: Now old-school Kardovans like meself are almost a minority. Not that I'm complainin', mind. We get the brightest brains in all the Sky Realms hobnobbing in here.##That lah-de-dah Erudite Academy's got nothin' on the Squeaky Wheel!
Chinese: 如今像我这样的老卡尔多瓦人几乎成少数了。不过我也不抱怨。全天空领域最聪明的脑子都在这儿高谈阔论。##那酸溜溜的博识学院，可比不上咱吱嘎轮！

English: This city's nearly as tall as it is wide. The higher ye go, the richer it gets, see? Some say it's dangerous below, in the Conduits, but that's shite. Good bargains down there if ye ken where to look.
Chinese: 这座城高得快赶上宽了。越高越富，明白吧？有人说下面导管区危险，放屁。会找地方的话，下面有好买卖。

English: Those big metal kiosks ye'll see folk queuing for are royal [[summoning stations.]]##That's how we townsfolk get our daily bread – straight from the King, may its gears turn evermore.
Chinese: 你看到大家排队的那种大铁亭子，是王室[[召唤站]]。##我们镇上人的每日口粮就从那儿来——直接来自国王，愿它的齿轮永转。

English: The Machinists' Guild has a sayin': 'the squeaky wheel gets the grease'. To me it means good things go to whoever asks loudest, not always who needs 'em most.
Chinese: 机械师公会有句口头禅："吱嘎响的轮子有油吃"。对我来说，意思是好东西归喊得最响的人，不一定是需要的人。

English: Me late wife saw it differently. She said it was a motto: if ye want good things, ye've got to make noise. <<Xenia shrugs.>> We never did settle that argument.
Chinese: 我过世的太太想法不同。她说这是句格言：想要好东西，就得发出声音。<<克塞尼娅耸耸肩。>>这架我们吵了一辈子也没吵出结论。

English: <<Xenia's expression of genial indifference suddenly seems fixed in place. She busies herself cleaning a glass with expert nonchalance.>> ##Are they now? Can't say I'd noticed. Maybe that's me own memory goin' funny, eh?
Chinese: <<克塞尼娅那副随和淡然的神情忽然僵住了。她若无其事地专心擦起一只杯子。>>##是吗？我可没注意到。也许是我自己的记性出毛病了，嗯？

English: %% <<Xenia blinks, then checks for eavesdroppers and leans in close.>> ...aye, maybe. Maybe folk ((are)) a bit absent-minded lately. Can ye blame 'em? Tough times like these will do that to a mind.
Chinese: %% <<克塞尼娅眨眨眼，四下看看有没有人偷听，然后凑近。>>……嗯，也许吧。也许大家((最近))都健忘了些。能怪他们吗？这种苦日子，谁的心思都得乱。

English: Thing is, it's gettin' worse. I tried to keep a diary what I'd forgotten, but it just made me feel pure bonkers. It must be the Corruption – wormin' into our heads, twistin' things.
Chinese: 问题是，越来越严重了。我试着记日记，把忘掉的事写下来，结果只觉得自己彻底疯了。一定是腐化——钻进我们脑子，扭曲一切。

English: How do ye even talk about somethin' like that? How do ye ken something's wrong when ye can't remember how it was before? Those folks who ((do)) try to discuss it tend to get ((extra)) forgetful soon after.
Chinese: 这种事你怎么开口说？连以前是什么样都不记得了，你怎么知道现在不对劲？那些((敢))谈论这事的人，往往很快就变得((格外))健忘。

English: <<She sighs.>> Listen, pet. Maybe don't stay in this land any longer than ye need to, eh? I'm sure there's folks back home who'll be missin' ye.
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>听着，亲爱的。也许别在这片土地上多待，能走就走，嗯？我确信你家乡有人在想你。

English: && <<Xenia stops cleaning. The teahouse is suddenly silent. She sets the glass down and takes her cigarette out of her mouth.>> ##Now see here, ((pal)).
Chinese: && <<克塞尼娅停下擦杯。茶馆骤然安静。她放下杯子，把烟从嘴里拿开。>>##你给我听好了，((伙计))。

English: Baba Xenia won't have anyone sullyin' the name o' her late wife's teahouse with nonsense and scuttlebutt. Let alone some ((outsider)) talkin' shite about shite they don't know shite about.
Chinese: 老婆子克塞尼娅绝不容许任何人，用鬼话和流言玷污她亡妻的茶馆的名声。更别提一个((外乡人))，对他根本不懂的屁事大放厥词。

English: That kind o' claptrap helps one person: the Saboteur.##<<You hear murmurs of assent around the room.>>
Chinese: 那种鬼话只帮得了一个人：破坏者。##<<你听见满屋附和的低语。>>

English: I think we understand each other now, don't we pet?##<<Xenia smiles again.>>
Chinese: 我想我们现在互相理解了，对吧，亲爱的？##<<克塞尼娅又笑了。>>

English: <<Xenia nods, shedding ash from the end of her cigarette.>> King's blessin', pet.
Chinese: <<克塞尼娅点点头，弹掉烟头的烟灰。>>国王赐福，亲爱的。

English: Oh aye, it's been all over the Dispatch. That radge lady captain – Velma, was it? Viola? – is makin' all kinds of trouble for the Union. Good for her, I say.
Chinese: 哦对，《急报》上全是这事。那个疯疯癫癫的女船长——薇尔玛来着？还是薇奥拉？——正给联盟添各种乱子。要我说，干得漂亮。

English: Mind, if ye're lookin' for Dark Star sorts round ((here)), I'll have to disappoint ye. Although there was that adventurer fella who went over to their side, ten or fifteen year ago now...
Chinese: 不过你要在((这儿))找黑星那路人，可要失望了。虽然十来二十年前，倒是有个冒险家投了他们那边……

English: [[Frost]], that was it. [[Caxton Frost]].##Used to be a hero of the Kingdom. In the end, his own crewmates chibbed him dead in some kinda mutiny. Made the front page of that week's Dispatch. Lotta folk thought he got what he deserved.
Chinese: [[弗罗斯特]]，对，就叫这个。[[卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特]]。##曾经是王国的英雄。最后在一场什么哗变里，被自家船员捅死了。上了那星期《急报》的头条。好多人都觉得他活该。

English: <<She puffs on her cigarette.>>##I think it's a shame. Shame such a talented fella felt he'd be better off with a bunch of skyfarin' reprobates than here in the Kingdom.
Chinese: <<她吸了口烟。>>##要我说，挺可惜的。这么有本事的一个人，竟觉得跟着一群天上海上的亡命徒，比待在王国里强。

English: Still, play stupid games an' ye'll get stupid prizes.
Chinese: 不过，玩愚蠢的游戏，就得领愚蠢的奖品。

English: Do you have any rooms for rent?
Chinese: 有客房出租吗？

English: I'll take it.
Chinese: 我住下了。

English: Why wouldn't I want to sleep there?
Chinese: 为什么我不想睡在那儿？

English: I've decided to give it a miss, thanks.
Chinese: 我决定不住了，谢谢。

English: I'm all right for now, thanks.
Chinese: 现在不用了，谢谢。

English: Something to drink, please.
Chinese: 来点喝的。

English: Tell me about bottled visions.
Chinese: 给我讲讲瓶装幻象。

English: I'd like something to drink.
Chinese: 我想来点喝的。

English: Let's see what you've got.
Chinese: 看看你都有什么。

English: Actually, never mind.
Chinese: 其实，算了。

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗？

English: Nothing for now, thanks.
Chinese: 暂时不用了，谢谢。

English: What's new in the Clockwork Kingdom?
Chinese: 发条王国最近有什么新闻？

English: So this island wasn't always part of the Oneiric Isles?
Chinese: 所以这座岛不是一直属于梦幻群岛的？

English: You said lots of people used to come here. Why?
Chinese: 你说从前有很多人来这儿。为什么？

English: Let's discuss another matter.
Chinese: 换个话题吧。

English: What can I do in Ferropolis?
Chinese: 在铁城能做什么？

English: Is it just me, or are a lot of people here having memory problems?
Chinese: 是我的错觉吗，还是这里很多人都有记忆问题？

English: @@ Xenia, I already know something weird is happening. It's obvious you know something too.
Chinese: @@ 克塞尼娅，我知道有怪事在发生。很明显你也知道点什么。

English: ...I understand perfectly.
Chinese: ……我完全明白。

English: I'll just be leaving now.
Chinese: 我这就走。

English: Sure, that must be it.
Chinese: 行吧，肯定是这么回事。

English: Let's discuss something else.
Chinese: 聊点别的吧。

English: Why is this place called the Squeaky Wheel, anyway?
Chinese: 这地方为什么叫吱嘎轮？

English: Do you know anything about a Dark Star mercenary?
Chinese: 黑星佣兵的事，你知道些什么吗？

English: Do YOU think he deserved it?
Chinese: 那你觉得他活该吗？

English: Well, thanks for the tale.
Chinese: 好吧，多谢你讲这些。

English: <<The other patrons are giving this woman a wide berth, as if she carries a contagious disease.>>##What are you staring at? Waiting to see if I grow an extra head?
Chinese: <<其他客人都躲着这个女人远远的，像她带着传染病。>>##看什么看？等着我长出第二个脑袋？

English: Is that all?##No offense, but I might be dead soon, and I don't wanna spend my last hours with you.
Chinese: 就这些吗？##不是冒犯，可我可能快死了，不想把最后几个钟头浪费在你身上。

English: Is the tea here really that bad?
Chinese: 这儿的茶真有那么难喝？

English: <<She laughs, then doubles over as it becomes a heavy cough.>>##Almost. But this stuff tastes like heaven after seeing what I've seen.
Chinese: <<她大笑，笑到一半变成一阵剧烈的咳嗽。>>##差不多。不过见过我见过的那些东西之后，这玩意儿喝着跟天堂一样。

English: What have you seen?
Chinese: 你见过什么？

English: I'm intrigued. Tell me about yourself.
Chinese: 有点意思。跟我讲讲你自己吧。

English: I'll leave you alone.
Chinese: 先不打扰了。

English: I'd pay to see that.
Chinese: 我出钱看你长。

English: <<She scowls, then doubles over and coughs heavily.>>##Keep your money, ponce. The Kingdom pays me well. Not well enough to see what I've seen, though.
Chinese: <<她一皱眉，又弯下腰剧烈咳嗽。>>##留着你的钱吧，臭美公子。王国给我的报酬不薄。只是还不够我看那些东西的。

English: Sorry, I'll leave you alone.
Chinese: 抱歉，先不打扰了。

English: <<She coughs again, and drinks deeply from her mug.>>##Name's [[Doyle]]. I'm a royal [[cleanup worker]]. You know, fighting the [[Corruption]]? A hero of the Kingdom, they call me. More medals than you've had hot dinners.
Chinese: <<她又咳了一阵，灌了一大口茶。>>##我叫[[多伊尔]]。皇家[[清理工]]。就是打[[腐化]]的？他们管我叫王国英雄。勋章比你吃过的热饭还多。

English: And what's my reward? Children hide or stare at me wherever I go. Shopkeepers wipe down every surface I touch. When I'm done here, the landlady will bury my mug – so that I don't ((contaminate)) any other patrons.
Chinese: 那我的奖赏呢？无论走到哪，孩子们躲着我或者瞪着我。店主会擦遍我碰过的每个台面。我走之后，老板娘会把我用过的杯子埋掉——免得我((污染))别的客人。

English: <<She glares up at you.>>##So, what? Your friends dare you to talk to me? Come to stammer some shite about how grateful you are for my service? Or are you just tired of being human?
Chinese: <<她抬头瞪你。>>##所以呢？朋友打赌让你来跟我搭话？来结结巴巴说几句感谢我为国效力的屁话？还是说你活腻了想做个人？

English: Honestly, I don't know much. I'm new here.
Chinese: 说实话，我懂得不多。我是新来的。

English: Keep patronizing me and I'll kick your ass.
Chinese: 再拿腔拿调的我就踹你了。

English: <<She cough-laughs again.>>##Well, take my advice: if you ever get drafted into a cleanup crew, jump off a bridge so both your legs get broken.
Chinese: <<她又咳笑了一声。>>##听我一句：哪天你要是被征进清理队，先从桥上跳下去把两条腿摔断。

English: I'm not afraid. I was just curious.
Chinese: 我不怕。我就是好奇。

English: <<She cough-laughs again.>>##Not afraid of the Corruption, huh? Well, take my advice: you should be.
Chinese: <<她又咳笑了一声。>>##不怕腐化，嗯？听我一句：你就该怕。

English: Two more weeks of leave, then I'm back to the Corrupted Land. Damn the King, but it's never enough.
Chinese: 还剩两周假期，然后就得回腐化之地。该死的国王，假期永远不够。

English: Actually, I'd like to ask you some questions.
Chinese: 其实，我想问你几个问题。

English: Tell me again about yourself.
Chinese: 再讲讲你自己吧。

English: <<Doyle snorts.>> And I'd like a ride out of here on a magic carpet. So what?
Chinese: <<多伊尔嗤笑。>>我还想要条魔毯送我走呢。然后呢？

English: Now scram, will you? Or else I'll start wishing I was back in the Corrupted Lands already.
Chinese: 快走吧行吗？不然我都该怀念腐化之地了。

English: Did I really hear you curse the King earlier?
Chinese: 我刚才是不是听见你咒骂国王了？

English: <<She gives you a hollow smile.>> Let them execute me. From where I sit, that looks like a promotion. ##You'd be surprised what I can get away with, newbie. Not many folk can do my job.
Chinese: <<她对你露出空洞的笑。>>让他们枪毙我好了。在我看来，那跟升职差不多。##新人，你能干出什么事会让我惊讶。能干我这行的没几个。

English: Is that a threat?
Chinese: 这是威胁吗？

English: <<She shrugs, taking a sip of her tea.>> Just an observation.
Chinese: <<她耸耸肩，呷了口茶。>>就是随口一说。

English: I'll bear that in mind.
Chinese: 我记住了。

English: How worried should I really be about sitting with you?
Chinese: 跟你同桌，我到底该多担心？

English: <<She eyes you appraisingly.>>##We have procedures. One week's quarantine before re-entering Ferropolis. Three rounds of purifying rituals. All our clothes incinerated each month.
Chinese: <<她像估价一样打量你。>>##我们有规程。返回铁城前隔离一周。净化仪式做三轮。每月衣服全部焚毁。

English: But this is Corruption we're talking about. It never stays still. So I guess it depends how much you trust in the wisdom of the Machinists' Guild.
Chinese: 可这是腐化。它从不消停。所以嘛，就看你有多信机械师公会的智慧了。

English: How would someone get into the Corrupted Lands?
Chinese: 怎么才能进腐化之地？

English: <<She sets down her mug with a clunk and gazes at you.>>##Are you taking the piss? Is that what you came to my table for? Think it's all a lark, do you? One big ((adventure))?
Chinese: <<她把茶杯哐地放下，凝视你。>>##你在拿我寻开心？你来我这桌就为这个？觉得这全是场游戏，是吧？一场((大冒险))？

English: @@ Not at all. I may need to go there, and I take your expertise very seriously
Chinese: @@ 完全不是。我可能必须去那儿，你的经验对我非常重要。

English: %% <<She narrows her eyes.>>##Yeah? Well... damn right. ##Officially the Corrupted Lands are strictly forbidden. Unofficially, we couldn't give a boiling piss about stopping suicidal tourists.
Chinese: %% <<她眯起眼。>>##是吗？那……没错。##官方口径，腐化之地严格禁止入内。非官方口径，拦那些找死的观光客，我们才懒得管。

English: Most folks don't make it across the ravine southeast of here. But I've seen an old abandoned [[digging engine]] still lying around. If you had a [[Machinist insignia]], or a good head for tinkering, I reckon you could make your own bridge.
Chinese: 大多数人过不了东南边那条深谷。不过我见过一台废弃的旧[[挖掘引擎]]还扔在那边。你要是有[[机械师徽记]]，或者对机械有天赋，我猜你能自己搭座桥。

English: 'Course, you could always sign up for a life of excitement with us.##<<She grins.>>
Chinese: 当然，你也可以报名加入我们，过点刺激日子。##<<她咧嘴一笑。>>

English: && <<She narrows her eyes.>>##You know, there's a lot of treasures in the Corrupted Lands. Abandoned towns, empty houses. Some folk think to try their luck. They have no idea what they're dealing with.
Chinese: && <<她眯起眼。>>##腐化之地里宝贝可多了。废弃的城镇，空着的房子。有人想去碰碰运气。他们根本不知道自己在跟什么打交道。

English: Forget I said anything.
Chinese: 就当我没说。

English: I'll leave you alone now.
Chinese: 先不打扰了。

English: I'm an Interpreter. We study the King's commands and proclamations to understand its true wishes.
Chinese: 我是释经官。我们研读国王的命令与文告，参悟它的真实意愿。

English: Do you need something more? I have ((quite)) a lot of reading to get through.
Chinese: 还需要什么吗？我有((一大堆))材料要读。

English: Do you need something? I have ((quite)) a lot of reading to get through.
Chinese: 有事吗？我有((一大堆))材料要读。

English: Oh, you know her?
Chinese: 哦，你认识她？

English: Aphra's not bad, as bosses go. Very passionate. Works late. A lot of her ideas get blocked by [[Sunil]], but she has our back when other departments try to push us around.
Chinese: 阿芙拉当老板不算差。特别有干劲，常加班到深夜。她的很多构想都被[[苏尼尔]]卡住，但别的部门想欺负我们时，她总替我们撑腰。

English: Wait, that was ((you?)) <<They grab a parchment to take notes.>> ##What did Its Majesty say? Don't leave out any details – what may seem irrelevant to you is as gold to us!
Chinese: 等等，那((是))你？<<他们抓过一张羊皮纸记笔记。>>##陛下说了什么？一个细节都别漏——在你看来无关紧要的话，在我们眼里都是黄金！

English: The Sacramental Duty...? Huh. That's new. Or maybe it's a legacy component from one of the old political tracts that we consulted to build the King. ##Was there no further detail?
Chinese: 圣礼职责……？嗯。没听过。也可能是建造国王时参考的某份旧政治文献里的遗留条款。##没有更多细节吗？

English: Ha, of course. You really need a [[Cranial Moderator]] to even read most of its output. Even then, Its Majesty can be a little – well, cryptic.
Chinese: 哈，当然。想读懂它的输出，你真得装一台[[颅腔调节器]]才行。即便如此，陛下的话也常常有点——嗯，晦涩。

English: A magical clockwork device grafted onto your brain. See my mechanical eye? It lets me read the King's Sixfold cipher language as easily as a cheap ballad. Unfortunately Its Majesty's mysteries go deeper than mere language.
Chinese: 一种嫁接到你大脑上的魔法发条装置。看见我的机械眼了吗？它让我读国王的六重密文，就像读廉价小调一样轻松。可惜陛下的奥秘比语言更深。

English: Well... you could take the Guild entrance exams, score in the top sixth, pass a political audit, undergo three years of training, and swear a magically binding loyalty oath. Otherwise, I'm not sure.
Chinese: 嗯……你可以去考公会入学试，考进前六分之一，通过政治审查，受训三年，再宣誓一个魔法约束的效忠誓约。除此之外，我就不知道了。

English: Maybe [[Chief Interpreter Aphra]] could help, but we Interpreters aren't really supposed to talk with outsiders.
Chinese: 也许[[首席释经官阿芙拉]]能帮忙，但我们释经官原则上不跟外人交谈。

English: <<They look worried.>>## Sunil? As in, the King's Speaker...? Of course, of course, I apologize. Forget I asked.
Chinese: <<他们面露忧色。>>##苏尼尔？就是那位国王代言人……？当然当然，失礼了。就当我没问。

English: Sorry, citizen, this isn't a good time. The King has just appointed a new Chief Interpreter, and we're all scrambling to get in his good books. Apparently he's convinced our whole department is riddled with disloyalty...
Chinese: 抱歉公民，现在不是时候。国王刚任命了新首席释经官，我们都在忙着讨他欢心。据说他认定我们整个部门满是不忠……

English: It's strange, though. I can't seem to remember who the last Chief Interpreter ((was)). I suppose they must have been a forgettable sort of person.
Chinese: 不过很奇怪。我好像想不起来上任首席释经官((是谁))了。想必是个容易遗忘的人吧。

English: <<This Machinist looks completely terrified.>> ##Wait, you're saying ((I)) have a debug mode? Surely there must be some mistake – I'm just an incidental NPC1
Chinese: <<这位机械师吓得不轻。>>##等等，你是说((我))有调试模式？肯定搞错了——我只是个附带 NPC1

English: Of course! I'll get it done right away! Top priority! ##Er, is there anything else?
Chinese: 当然！马上办！最高优先级！##呃，还有别的事吗？

English: <<They seem to relax.>> Oh, thank the King. I won't remember any of this, right?
Chinese: <<他们似乎放松了。>>哦，感谢国王。这些我都不会记得了，对吧？

English: So you work for Chief Interpreter Aphra?
Chinese: 所以你为首席释经官阿芙拉工作？

English: I actually had an audience with the King myself.
Chinese: 其实我自己就觐见过国王。

English: It told me to perform the 'Sacramental Duty', whatever that is.
Chinese: 它让我执行"圣礼职责"，管那是什么。

English: Only a bunch of weird symbols.
Chinese: 只有一堆怪符号。

English: I think so, but I couldn't read it.
Chinese: 我想是吧，可我读不懂。

English: What's a Cranial Moderator?
Chinese: 颅腔调节器是什么？

English: Where would I get one?
Chinese: 上哪能装一个？

English: Thanks, I suppose.
Chinese: 谢谢，算是吧。

English: I don't think Sunil would want me to discuss it.
Chinese: 我想苏尼尔不会希望我谈这个。

English: I'm a Commitologist. We draft the petitions the Guild sends to the King and make sure they're in the correct cipher language.
Chinese: 我是提交学官。我们起草公会呈给国王的呈文，确保它们使用正确的密文语言。

English: Now, may I please get back to work?
Chinese: 现在，可以请我回去工作了吗？

English: Requests for action. You know – production orders, rule changes, alteration requests. We can't tell Its Majesty what to do, but we can ask. Sometimes it listens.
Chinese: 行动请求。你知道的——生产指令、法规修订、改造申请。我们不能命令陛下做什么，但可以请求。有时它会听。

English: Oh, anything. The wrong verb here, and we get a skating rink instead of a farm. A misplaced comma there, and the wrong house vanishes.
Chinese: 哦，什么都要小心。这里用错一个动词，我们得到的就是一个溜冰场而不是农场。那里点错一个逗号，消失的就是错误的一栋房子。

English: More importantly, I could lose out on Guild commendations for this year.
Chinese: 更重要的是，我可能因此错失今年的公会嘉奖。

English: <<They give you a queer look.>>## I'm no good at talking to layfolk. Besides, individual testimony is invariably clouded by partiality or bias. Most people can't see the big picture like we can.
Chinese: <<他们古怪地看着你。>>##我不擅长跟外行交谈。况且个人的证词总被偏心或偏见搅浑。大多数人看不到我们看到的全局。

English: Thanks.##<<They do not look enthusiastic.>>
Chinese: 谢谢。##<<他们看起来毫无热情。>>

English: What is a 'petition', exactly?
Chinese: 呈文到底是什么？

English: What happens if the language isn't correct?
Chinese: 语言不对会怎么样？

English: Do you ever consult with the people your petitions affect?
Chinese: 你们的呈文影响到的人，你们咨询过吗？

English: What a tragedy that would be.
Chinese: 那可真是悲剧啊。

English: Sounds important. Best of luck.
Chinese: 听着挺重要。祝你好运。

English: Can't you see I'm busy? Sunil wants this next petition locked down by the next starbright so he can check it over first.
Chinese: 看不见我在忙吗？苏尼尔要求下一份呈文在下次星耀前锁定，他要先审一遍。

English: Oh, ((I'm)) perfectly on schedule. But we're still waiting on the bloody Summoners. Less than a day to go before final commit and ((they're)) not even in rune lock. Amateurs.
Chinese: 哦，((我))的进度完全正常。但我们还在等那帮该死的召募官。距离最终提交不到一天，((他们))连符文锁都还没打。外行。

English: How's it going?
Chinese: 进展如何？

English: I'll leave you alone.
Chinese: 不打扰了。

English: <<This Machinist jumps when you disturb them.>>##Oh! It's only you again. That bastard Commitologist is still on the prowl for me...
Chinese: <<你一打扰，这位机械师就跳了起来。>>##哦！又是你。那个混蛋提交学官还在到处抓我……

English: <<This Machinist jumps when you disturb them.>>##Aaaagh!
Chinese: <<你一打扰，这位机械师就跳了起来。>>##啊啊啊！

English: YAAAAaagh!!
Chinese: 呀啊啊啊！！

English: <<They shudder but catch themself.>>##All right! King's toenails, no more, no more! Let's both... take a deep breath... and calm down.
Chinese: <<他们打了个哆嗦，稳住自己。>>##好了！国王的脚指甲，别喊了，别喊了！我们俩……深吸一口气……冷静下来。

English: <<They inhale deeply.>> Please. King's toenails, I'm jittery today...
Chinese: <<他们深吸一口气。>>求你了。国王的脚指甲，我今天神经绷得紧……

English: King's toenails, I ((told)) you not to creep up on me like... ##<<They examine you.>> Wait, you're not a Machinist.
Chinese: 国王的脚指甲，我((说过))别这样鬼鬼祟祟地……##<<他们打量你。>>等等，你不是机械师。

English: I thought you were one of the Commitologists. That bastard's been stalking me all day, trying to hurry my work. I'm working as fast as I can!
Chinese: 我以为你是提交学官。那混蛋追了我一整天，催我的活。我已经在以最快的速度干了！

English: I'm a Summoner. We maintain the cipher spells that transport goods throughout the Kingdom – from farm to stockpile to summoning station, or back again.
Chinese: 我是召募官。我们维护着把货物运遍全国的密文法术——从农田到仓库再到召唤站，或者反向运回。

English: Any further queries?
Chinese: 还有别的问的吗？

English: It's quite simple. Simply approach the machine, visualise what you want, and press 'use'. If you don't receive the right thing, you probably didn't visualise it correctly.
Chinese: 很简单。走近机器，在心里想象你想要的东西，然后按"使用"。如果你收到的不是想要的，多半是你没想象对。

English: These spells are invoked thousands of times per day. One small mistake in this room will ripple across the Kingdom. Now do you see why it can't be rushed?
Chinese: 这些法术每天要被调用成千上万次。这间屋子里一个小错，会波及整个王国。现在你明白为什么急不得了吧？

English: <<They shrug.>>##I leave that to the philosophers. We're busy changing the world.
Chinese: <<他们耸耸肩。>>##那是哲学家的事。我们忙着改变世界呢。

English: If anyone asks about me, tell them I'm with the King's Speaker. In a ((private)) meeting.
Chinese: 要是有人问起我，就说我在跟国王代言人开((私密))会。

English: Can you tell me about your work again?
Chinese: 再给我讲讲你的工作？

English: I'll disturb you no further.
Chinese: 不再打扰你了。

English: Aaaaaaagh!
Chinese: 啊啊啊啊！

English: AAAAAAAGH!!!
Chinese: 啊啊啊啊啊！！！

English: I'm sorry. Let's start again.
Chinese: 抱歉。我们重新开始。

English: Boo.
Chinese: 吓。

English: Sorry to startle you. Everything all right?
Chinese: 吓到你了，抱歉。还好吗？

English: What's the delay?
Chinese: 延误是怎么回事？

English: How do I use a summoning station?
Chinese: 召唤站怎么用？

English: That sounds very complicated.
Chinese: 听着很复杂。

English: Maybe you shouldn't have that power.
Chinese: 也许你们不该拥有这种力量。

English: I see what you mean.
Chinese: 我懂你意思了。

English: Don't talk to me. I'm in hell. Without a doubt, this is hell.
Chinese: 别跟我说话。我在地狱里。毫无疑问，这就是地狱。

English: Aye, this is hell.
Chinese: 是啊，这就是地狱。

English: <<They give you a withering look.>>##I'm in ((cipher)) hell, you swine. Charm hell. Invocation hell. Contagion hell. Transposition hell. You name the hell, I'm in it.
Chinese: <<他们白了你一眼。>>##我在((密文))地狱里，你个猪猡。魅惑地狱。调召地狱。传染地狱。换位地狱。你说得出名字的地狱，我就在里面。

English: <<They sigh.>>##My only surmise is that the last Machinist to work on this spell made a dread bargain with some foul power: my soul for their freedom.
Chinese: <<他们叹气。>>##我唯一的猜测是：上一个碰这道法术的机械师，跟某个邪污力量做了笔可怕的交易：用我的灵魂，换他们的自由。

English: Now I'm stuck with the mess they left behind, and none of it makes sense. It's like trying to untangle a ball of string when your only tool is another piece of string. Or a wet noodle.
Chinese: 现在我卡在他们留下的烂摊子里，处处说不通。就像解一团乱线，而你唯一的工具是另一根线。或者一根湿面条。

English: I don't know, can you re-conjugate a 274-line cipher charm for a low-contagion runeset while maintaining echoconsonance with a legacy canon written by a lazy moron who never took notes?
Chinese: 我不知道——你能做到吗？给一套低传染符文集重新变位一条 274 行的密文咒，同时维持它与一份懒鬼白痴写的从不记笔记的旧正典的回声谐和？

English: Then bog off and leave me to my torment.
Chinese: 做不到就滚开，别烦我受苦。

English: Oh, go and boil your head.
Chinese: 哦，滚去烧你的脑袋吧。

English: I thought we were in Ferropolis.
Chinese: 我以为我们在铁城。

English: What in hell does that mean?
Chinese: 这他妈到底是什么意思？

English: Forget I asked.
Chinese: 就当我没问。

English: Anything I can do to help?
Chinese: 有什么我能帮上的吗？

English: No.
Chinese: 没有。

English: <<[Lie]>> Yes.
Sorry to hear that. Farewell.
Chinese: 听到这些很遗憾。再会。

English: <<This dishevelled citizen is muttering to themself as they rake through the mud and muck underneath the town.>>
Chinese: <<这位衣衫不整的公民边在镇子底下的泥泞里扒拉，边自言自语。>>

English: <<They startle.>> Oh, 'allo mate. Don't mind me, I'm jus' scratchin' out a living'. ##You'd be surprised what flushes down 'ere from those cosy folks in Ferropolis. Some may call it junk, but me? I calls it treasure.
Chinese: <<他吓了一跳。>>哦，你好啊伙计。别理我，我就是刨点生计。##你会吃惊的，铁城那些舒服人家冲下来的东西可不少。有人管这叫垃圾，我？我管这叫宝贝。

English: <<They shoot you a withering look.>> Don't be stupid. It's bloody ((junk)).##I just say that so townie sorts'll give me the time of day. Everyone likes to see a peasant with ((enterprise)).
Chinese: <<他白了你一眼。>>别说傻话。这就是他妈的((垃圾))。##我那么说是为了让镇上人肯搭理我。人人都爱看有((进取心))的农民，对吧。

English: Hello there.
Chinese: 你好啊。

English: Do you actually call it treasure?
Chinese: 你真管这叫宝贝？

English: Good hunting to you.
Chinese: 祝你满载而归。

English: <<[Leave them alone]>>
Chinese: <<[别打扰他]>>

English: Welcome to the end of the world, citizen. The food's terrible, but you can't beat the view.
Chinese: 欢迎来到世界尽头，公民。伙食很差，但风景无敌。

English: The last outpost of normal reality. Or at least – ##<<Their words are drowned out by a deafening metallic voice from the main building.>>
Chinese: 常态现实的最后前哨。或者说——##<<主楼方向一声震耳欲聋的金属嗓音盖过他的话。>>

English: Yep. The last outpost of normal reality. Or at least – ##<<Their words are drowned out by a deafening metallic voice from the main building.>>
Chinese: 对。常态现实的最后前哨。或者说——##<<主楼方向一声震耳欲聋的金属嗓音盖过他的话。>>

English: <<CLEANUP WORKER FLOREZ, REPORT TO MY OFFICE. REPEAT, FLOREZ TO MY OFFICE. HUANG OUT.">> ##...normal for us, anyway."
Chinese: <<清理工弗洛雷斯，到我办公室来。重复，弗洛雷斯到我办公室。黄完毕。">> ##……至少，对我们来说是常态。"

English: I've got to go. If you need something, ask someone else.
Chinese: 我得走了。有事问别人去。

English: What is this place, exactly?
Chinese: 这地方到底是什么？

English: Is this the cleanup camp?
Chinese: 这是清理营地吗？

English: Thanks, I think.
Chinese: 谢谢，算是吧。

English: Scrape your damned boots, will you? The mud here can chew through wrought iron.
Chinese: 把你那该死的靴子刮干净，行吗？这里的泥能啃穿熟铁。

English: <<This cleanup worker is tearing hungrily at a hunk of black bread like a rabid dog. They do not respond except to make an obscene gesture at you.>>
Chinese: <<这名清理工像疯狗一样狼吞虎咽一块黑面包。除了冲你比了个下流手势，他毫无反应。>>

English: You might not wanna go upstairs, mate. The chief's in an awful mood... ##<<They glance up suddenly as a metallic voice booms from above.>>
Chinese: 你最好别上楼，伙计。队长的心情糟透了……##<<上方传来金属嗓音的轰鸣，他猛地抬头。>>

English: <<ATTENTION ALL HANDS. ROLL CALL IN 36 MINUTES. REPEAT, 36 MINUTES. NO DAWDLING THIS TIME! HUANG OUT.">> ##...then again, ain't he always...?"
Chinese: <<全体人员注意。36 分钟后点名。重复，36 分钟。这次谁也别磨蹭！黄完毕。">> ##……话说回来，他哪天不这样……？"

English: You might not wanna go upstairs, mate. The chief's in an awful mood...
Chinese: 你最好别上楼，伙计。队长的心情糟透了……

English: <<This cleanup worker is carrying a strange apparatus at their side.>> ##Whoah there, pal. No one sees the chief without a check-over. Open your mouth, please.
Chinese: <<这名清理工腰间挂着一件奇怪的装置。>>##站住，伙计。没做检查谁也见不着队长。请张嘴。

English: Back again, are we? Well, let's see how lucky you've been. You know the drill... ##<<They waggle their probe cheerfully at you.>>
Chinese: 又来了？好，看看你运气如何。规矩你懂的……##<<他欢快地朝你挥着探针。>>

English: Well, well, if it ain't the curse-dodger in the flesh! Chief not gotten tired of you yet? Or have you come back just to see me?
Chinese: 嚯嚯，躲诅咒的活人本尊！队长还没嫌弃你？还是专程回来看我的？

English: You've been outside. What do you think?
Chinese: 你去过外面。你觉得呢？

English: <<They poke a long thin probe inside your mouth, then wave it all up and down your body. The connected apparatus emits little chirps and warbles.>> ##All right, you're clean. For now.
Chinese: <<他把一根细长的探针伸进你嘴里，又沿身体上下挥舞。相连的装置发出细细的啾鸣。>>##好了，你是干净的。暂时。

English: You're clean. For now.##Go on ahead.
Chinese: 你是干净的。暂时。##过去吧。

English: Ugh, if you say so...
Chinese: 呃，你说了算……

English: How nice to see you again.
Chinese: 又见面真开心。

English: We really must stop meeting like this.
Chinese: 我们真得别再这样见面了。

English: Is this truly necessary?
Chinese: 这真有必要吗？

English: You make a fair point.
Chinese: 你说得有道理。

English: I don't think I need to see the chief after all.
Chinese: 我想我到底还是不必见队长了。

English: <<Their voice is metallic and distorted through their helmet.>> ##Anyone or anything could be Corrupted out here. So you better keep your distance, tourist.
Chinese: <<隔着头盔，他的嗓音带着金属的失真。>>##在外面，任何人都可能被腐化。所以离远点，游客。

English: <<Their distorted voice clangs from inside their helmet.>> ##Wandering in the Corrupted Lands? Sure hope you've made out your will.
Chinese: <<失真的嗓音在头盔里嗡嗡作响。>>##在腐化之地闲逛？真希望你已经立好遗嘱。

English: <<The cleanup worker's faceless helmet regards you silently. For a wild moment, you wonder if there's even a person in there.>>
Chinese: <<清理工那张没有五官的头盔静静地对着你。恍惚间，你怀疑里面到底有没有人。>>

English: <<A metallic sigh issues from within their helmet.>> ##Reality ain't what it used to be around here.
Chinese: <<头盔里传出一声金属质地的叹息。>>##这一带，现实早不是从前的样子了。

English: <<Their panicked voice is metallic and distorted through their helmet..>> ##Oh no no no ((no)), you can't fool me. I know what you are. You stay back, you hear? ((All)) of you, stay back!
Chinese: <<头盔里的声音惊慌而失真。>>##哦不不不((不))，你骗不了我。我知道你是什么。你退后，听见没？((你们全都))退后！

English: <<The cleanup worker mutters to themselves, as if you're not even there.>> Be a hero, they said. Save the Kingdom, they said. And you had to go and listen, didn't you?
Chinese: <<清理工自顾自地嘀咕，仿佛你根本不存在。>>他们说，当英雄吧。他们说，拯救王国吧。你偏偏听了，是不是？

English: <<Their voice is metallic and distorted through their helmet.>> ##Don't try anything funny or you're toast. And I mean the blackened, charcoally kind.
Chinese: <<隔着头盔，他的嗓音带着金属的失真。>>##别耍花招，不然你就熟了。我指的是烤焦的那种熟。

English: <<They give you a rough whack on the shoulder, perhaps intended as a companionable pat.>> ##Don't worry, pal. If you're here without protection, you're already dead.
Chinese: <<他在你肩上重重拍了一下，也许想表达友好。>>##别担心，伙计。你要是没防护就站在这儿，其实已经死了。

English: <<Even through their helmet, you can hear the panic in their voice.>> ##I'm telling you. I knew that face. I know it's impossible but I ((knew)) that face.
Chinese: <<隔着头盔都能听出他声音里的惊惶。>>##我跟你说。我认得那张脸。我知道不可能，可我就是((认得))那张脸。

English: <<The cleanup worker speaks tenderly to their crewmate>> ##Easy, lad, easy. It's just a trick of the mind. First month jitters, we all get 'em.
Chinese: <<清理工温柔地对工友说>>##放松，小子，放松。只是心理把戏。头一个月都会这样，我们都经历过。

English: <<Their voice comes through harsh and commanding through their helmet.>> ##Gawked enough, have you? Had your fill? If you'd any respect you'd piss off right back to Ferropolis.
Chinese: <<头盔里传出的声音又凶又硬。>>##看够了吗？过足瘾了吗？要是还有点尊重，就滚回铁城去。

English: <<You see a scarred man with several days' stubble, chewing an unlit cigar as he scans over a map. He curses and leans over to a trumpet-like apparatus sprouting from the wall.>>
Chinese: <<你看到一个满脸伤疤、胡茬数日未刮的男人，嚼着一支没点的雪茄，正扫视一张地图。他咒骂一声，俯身对着墙上伸出的一只喇叭状装置。>>

English: Attention reserve shift. Zeta patrol is late. I want a relief party ready in 36 minutes. Huang out.##<<As he speaks, you can faintly hear his magically amplified words booming across the camp outside the window.>>
Chinese: 预备班注意。泽塔巡逻队迟到了。我要一支替换小队 36 分钟内就绪。黄完毕。##<<他说话时，你能隐约听见他被魔法放大的声音在窗外营地上空轰鸣。>>

English: <<He turns to you with a scowl.>>##What's this now? A tourist? Afraid we'll have to skip the grand tour. Or are you gonna tell me you took a wrong turn?
Chinese: <<他阴沉地转向你。>>##这是哪位？游客？那恐怕盛大的参观得取消了。还是说你要告诉我你拐错了弯？

English: Are ye now? Well, lucky us. Forgive me if I don't genuflect. My knee's pure buggered from all the times I nearly died cleaning up after you geniuses.
Chinese: 是吗？那我们真是三生有幸。恕我不行跪拜大礼了。给你们这些天才收拾烂摊子、几次三番差点送命，我的膝盖早废了。

English: <<He snorts.>> You're a wee bit off course. I s'pose ye've never even heard of all the 'treasures' in the Corrupted Lands?
Chinese: <<他嗤笑。>>你可偏得离谱。我猜腐化之地那些"宝藏"你听都没听过吧？

English: <<He eyes you dubiously.>> Are ye now? I've got bad news. If your friend ended up in the Corrupted Lands, odds are there's not much left of 'em.
Chinese: <<他狐疑地打量你。>>是吗？那有个坏消息。你朋友要是进了腐化之地，八成剩不下什么了。

English: Let's get one thing straight, sunshine. I'm [[Cleanup Leader Huang]], and this is my cleanup camp. That means every cunt here follows my rules and obeys my orders, no matter what some shite-for-brains tinker from Ferropolis says. Clear?
Chinese: 咱们先把话说清楚，小太阳。我是[[清理队长黄]]，这个清理营是我的。也就是说，这里每一个混账都守我的规矩、听我的号令，不管铁城哪个脑残工匠说什么。清楚了吗？

English: <<Cleanup Leader Huang looks up from his maps with a scowl, cigar perched in his mouth.>> ##Talk fast or get out, sunshine. The Corruption waits for no one.
Chinese: <<清理队长黄从地图上抬起头，一脸阴沉，雪茄叼在嘴上。>>##长话短说，否则滚蛋，小太阳。腐化可不等任何人。

English: Now, why the hell are you in my office?
Chinese: 那么，你他妈进我办公室干什么？

English: Wonderful. Now, why are you still in my office?
Chinese: 好极了。那么，你怎么还杵在我办公室？

English: Y'know, every day I sit here thinking: 'See if only some daft cunt would waltz into my office and start asking pointless questions, that'd just make my day.'
Chinese: 你知道吗，我每天坐在这儿都在想："要是哪个傻冒混账晃进我办公室，净问些没头没脑的问题，那我这一天可就值了。"

English: Now, will that be all, your highness?
Chinese: 那么，就这些了吗，殿下？

English: Comparing patriotism, are we? Look out that window, sunshine. This is the end of the line. All your clever spells and words, all those clever wee articles in the Dispatch. This is where they lead, and where they end.
Chinese: 比爱国心是吧？看看窗外，小太阳。这就是终点线。你那些精妙的法术和辞令，急报上那些精巧的小文章。通向的是这里，终结在这里。

English: Once you're done here, you'll fuck off back to Ferropolis and requisition yourself a nice warm bath. But our fight doesn't stop. Each day we put our very souls on the line for our King. What have you done?
Chinese: 等你在这儿办完事，你就会溜回铁城，给自己安排一个暖烘烘的热水澡。可我们的仗没停。每一天，我们都把灵魂押给国王。你做过什么？

English: See, I bet Its Majesty could replace you in a heartbeat. I bet you know it, too. So if you'd like to arrest me, I'll come quietly. Sooner or later they'll run out of people to send here instead of you.
Chinese: 瞧，我打赌陛下随时能换掉你。我打赌你自己也清楚。所以你想逮捕我，我会乖乖跟你走。早晚他们会把该派来的人都派光了，轮到换你上场。

English: Funny, I was hoping you'd tell me. Ain't you whizkids at the Guild figured it out? 'Course, last time one of your colleagues graced us with his presence, he wasn't too keen on my ((frankness)).
Chinese: 好笑，我还指望你告诉我呢。你们公会的神童还没搞明白？当然，上次你们哪位同事大驾光临，就不太欣赏我的((直言))。

English: All I know is it spreads like a fungus, whispers in your dreams like a vengeful lover, and kills five of my people every month.
Chinese: 我只知道它像真菌一样扩散，像复仇的情人一样在梦里低语，每个月杀死我五个人。

English: Corruption's unpredictable, see. Doesn't move in straight lines, or follow rules.##Infection methods change every year. New mass patterns and creatures every month or so. Tricksy, too. Got a mind of its own. Signs of coordination, even planning.
Chinese: 腐化这东西没谱。不走直线，不守规矩。##传染方式年年变。新的团块形态和生物，一个月一换。还很狡猾。有自己的心智。有协同的迹象，甚至有规划。

English: Few months ago it lured one of my workers into an old stable by mimicking a crying baby.##Last week it got another one by mimicking ((my voice))...
Chinese: 几个月前，它模仿婴儿啼哭，把我一个工人引进一座旧谷仓。##上星期，它又靠模仿((我的声音))弄走了另一个……

English: Bottom line is, don't trust anything you see or hear out there. Including yourself.
Chinese: 底线是：在外面，别信你看到的任何东西、听到的任何声音。包括你自己。

English: I've not got time to bother about every two-bit grave robber or sorcerer's stooge who 'gets lost' in a restricted area.##You'll find out whether you're dead or not when you go back through the checkpoint in Ferropolis.
Chinese: 我可没工夫操心每个"迷路"闯进禁区的小毛贼或法师走狗。##你是死是活，回铁城过检查站的时候就知道了。

English: City? You mean [[Progress]]? Wish I could forget it.
Chinese: 城？你说[[进步城]]？真希望我能忘了它。

English: Famous place, once. Used to be a shipyard during the God War. The King had a big factory there, and lots of smaller workshops. Good jobs. Good people.
Chinese: 从前的名地。神之战的时候是造船厂。国王在那里有一座大工厂，还有许多小作坊。好工作。好人。

English: Far as we can tell, that was ground zero. Until the outbreak in Progress, Corruption was a minor problem. The cogs – sorry, the ((blessed Guild of Machinists)) – quarantined everyone inside.##You can see how much good that did.
Chinese: 据我们所知，那里就是零号疫源地。进步城爆发之前，腐化只是个小问题。齿轮佬——抱歉，是((尊贵的机械师公会))——把所有人都隔离在城里。##效果如何，你也看到了。

English: <<Huang takes his cigar out of his mouth and squints at you.>>##Are ye fucking ((daft)), sunshine? Nobody gets into Progress. Nobody gets out either. Whole town's sealed up tighter than my ex-wife's purse. And you know who sealed it?
Chinese: <<黄把雪茄从嘴里拿出来，眯眼看你。>>##你他妈((傻))吗，小太阳？没人能进进步城。也没人能出来。整座镇子封得比我前妻的钱包还紧。你知道是谁封的吗？

English: <<He jabs the neck of his cigar towards his heart.>> Yours fucking truly!##I don't even let my cleanup workers go there anymore. Lost too many good folk to that fucking deathtrap. So if ye think I'm giving ((you)) the password, forget it.
Chinese: <<他用雪茄头戳了戳自己的心口。>>正是你他妈的真爷们！##我现在连自己的清理工都不放去了。那座该死的死亡陷阱吞了我太多好人。所以你要是以为我会把((密码))给你，死了这条心。

English: See this whole area?.<<He circles his cigar over the map, indicating a chain of broken islands to south of here.>> ##No go. Do not enter, do not linger, do not even ((look)). Clear? Good.
Chinese: 看见这整片区域了吗？<<他用雪茄在地图上画圈，指着南边一串碎裂的岛屿。>> ##禁地。不许进，不许留，连((看))都不许。清楚了吗？好。

English: <<Huang listens to your story, shaking his head.>>##I'm sorry you came all this way for nothing. Finding a single person among the Corrupted? Let alone their ((name))? It's pure bonkers.
Chinese: <<黄听你讲完，连连摇头。>>##让你白跑一趟，我很遗憾。在腐化者里找一个人？更别说还知道他们的((名字))？纯属发疯。

English: Corruption warps most things beyond recognition. If this kid got absorbed into a canker mass, they've not even got a body anymore.##Sometimes individual Corrupted Ones have traces of their old selves – clothes, tattoos, and the like – but that's rare.
Chinese: 腐化会把大多数东西扭曲得面目全非。这孩子要是被吸进一团癌块，他们连身体都不剩了。##有时个别腐化者会带着旧日的痕迹——衣服、刺青之类——但那很罕见。

English: <<Huang takes his cigar out of his mouth.>>##You're a real specimen, aren't ye? Be my guest, if your life's that cheap. [[Cleanup Worker Cohen]]'s our resident monster expert, so if you've got other questions, ask them.
Chinese: <<黄把雪茄从嘴里拿出来。>>##你可真是朵奇葩。请便吧，如果你的命就这么不值钱。[[清理工科恩]]是我们的驻营怪物专家，还有别的问题就问他。

English: <<Huang leans over to the speaking trumpet again.>> ##Attention, Cleanup Worker Cohen! Attention Cohen! Let this weird-looking scunner into the cage, will ye? Huang out.
Chinese: <<黄又俯身对着传话喇叭。>> ##注意，清理工科恩！科恩注意！放这个长得古怪的讨厌鬼进笼子，好吗？黄完毕。

English: You telling me you've not heard the tales? Priceless heirlooms in forgotten cellars? Sky pirate loot, buried where no one dare dig for it? Beings from outside reality that'll grant your heart's desire?
Chinese: 你告诉我你没听过那些传说？被遗忘的地窖里的无价传家宝？天上海盗的宝藏，埋在没人敢挖的地方？来自现实之外的、能实现你心愿的存在？

English: Go look, if you like. You'll find nothing out there but ruins and nightmares. Once the Corruption has its way with you, we'll be happy to burn you like the rest.
Chinese: 想去就去吧。你在外面找到的只会是废墟和梦魇。等腐化把你玩够了，我们很乐意把你像其他人一样烧掉。

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> I'm from the Guild, here on official business.
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>我是公会的人，来执行公务。

English: I'm just an explorer. I won't get in your way.
Chinese: 我就是个探险的。不会碍你的事。

English: I'm looking for someone who might have come through here.
Chinese: 我在找一个可能路过这里的人。

English: Ah, so this ISN'T the way to Ferropolis?
Chinese: 啊，原来这里不是去铁城的路？

English: I'm looking for a missing child.
Chinese: 我在找一个失踪的孩子。

English: Do you know anything about the ruined city?
Chinese: 关于那座废城，你知道些什么？

English: I just have a few quick questions.
Chinese: 我就快问几个问题。

English: I guess I'll be leaving now.
Chinese: 那我这就走。

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Doesn't the King deserve your full cooperation, Mr Huang?
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>国王不配得到你的全力配合吗，黄先生？

English: Indulge me. You won't be punished.
Chinese: 就当陪我聊聊天。你不会被处罚的。

English: I'm afraid that's forbidden information.
Chinese: 恐怕这属于禁止打探的信息。

English: What do you mean, 'a mind of its own'?
Chinese: 什么叫"有自己的心智"？

English: If it's infectious, don't you need to quarantine me?
Chinese: 既然会传染，你不该把我隔离吗？

English: What was it you said earlier about 'treasures'?
Chinese: 你刚才说的"宝藏"是什么意思？

English: That's all my questions.
Chinese: 我的问题问完了。

English: What can you tell me about Progress?
Chinese: 关于进步城，你能告诉我些什么？

English: How do I get inside the city?
Chinese: 我怎么进城？

English: The King?
Chinese: 国王？

English: Your ex-wife?
Chinese: 你前妻？

English: You?
Chinese: 你？

English: That's all I needed to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就是这些。

English: Could I get a closer look at those Corrupted Ones in the cage?
Chinese: 能让我近距离看看笼子里那些腐化者吗？

English: Thanks for trying, I suppose.
Chinese: 多谢尽力，算是吧。

English: What exactly IS the Corruption?
Chinese: 腐化到底是什么？

English: What exactly IS this 'Corruption'?
Chinese: 这个"腐化"到底是什么？

English: Doesn't the King deserve your full cooperation, Mr Huang?
Chinese: 国王不配得到你的全力配合吗，黄先生？

English: Let's talk about something else.
Chinese: 聊点别的吧。

English: <<This guard is holding some kind of long, thin metal wand, connected by wires to the machine beside him. They point it at you as you approach.>>
Chinese: <<这名卫兵手持一根细长的金属魔杖，用导线连着身旁的机器。你走近时，他把魔杖对准你。>>

English: You there, citizen! Stay where you are. Anyone entering Ferropolis must be assayed for Corruption, by order of the King. ##Now, say 'aaaah'.
Chinese: 那边那位，公民！站在原地别动。奉国王之命，凡进入铁城者必须接受腐化检测。##现在，说"啊——"。

English: <<The guard deftly pokes the wand inside your mouth, holding it there for a few seconds, then waves it up and down your body, while the machine emits little chirps and warbles.>>
Chinese: <<卫兵熟练地把魔杖伸进你嘴里，停了几秒，又沿你的身体上下挥动，机器发出细细的啾鸣与颤音。>>

English: <<They give you the hairy eyeball.>> ##You're free to pass, citizen. Get moving before I arrest you for gross impudence.
Chinese: <<他们嫌弃地瞪你。>>##您可以过了，公民。快走吧，别等我把你按"厚颜无耻罪"抓起来。

English: <<The guard pokes the wand inside your mouth, then waves it up and down your body while the machine emits little chirps and warbles.>> ##All right, you're good to go.
Chinese: <<卫兵把魔杖伸进你嘴里，又沿身体上下挥动，机器发出细细的啾鸣与颤音。>>##好了，您可以走了。

English: <<The guard waves you through.>>##Please clear the way.
Chinese: <<卫兵挥手放行。>>##请让让通道。

English: The lift is closed due to investigation.##I'm afraid I can't say more.
Chinese: 升降机因调查关闭。##恕我无可奉告。

English: Aaaah.
'Aaaah'?
Excuse me, I'll do no such thing –
Chinese: 不好意思，这种事我可不做——

English: What the hell was that?
Chinese: 刚才那是什么鬼东西？

English: How DARE you poke that thing inside me?
Chinese: 你竟敢把那玩意伸进我身体里？

English: You folks really know how to give a warm welcome.
Chinese: 你们这儿真会欢迎客人。

English: Ugh, not again...
Chinese: 唉，又来……

English: Could we talk about this?
Chinese: 能谈谈吗？

English: <<The guard salutes.>> Long live the King, your honour. I can assure you our armoury is safe and secure.
Chinese: <<卫兵敬礼。>>国王万岁，长官。我向您保证，我们的军械库固若金汤。

English: Remember our bargain, mate, and this could be the start of a beautiful partnership.
Chinese: 记住我们的交易，伙计，这可以是一段美好合作的开端。

English: Nothing to see here, mate. Just a few incorruptible defenders of the realm restin' for a tick or two.
Chinese: 没什么好看的，伙计。就是几个廉洁护国的卫士在歇上一小会儿。

English: <<Something about you catches the guard's attention. They examine you, then lean closer and lower their voice.>> ##You look like the daredevil sort. Swellsword, am I wrong? Explorer, maybe?
Chinese: <<你身上有什么东西引起了卫兵的注意。他们打量你，然后凑近压低声音。>>##你瞧着就是个亡命徒。玩剑的，我没说错吧？探险家？

English: Plenty of spare equipment in the Royal Militia. Military stuff. And we ain't been paid for three weeks running.##[[50 coin]] would get you into that [[armoury]] over there. How about it?
Chinese: 皇家民兵有的是闲置装备。军用货。而我们已经有三个星期没发饷了。##[[50 枚硬币]]就能让你进那边的[[军械库]]。怎么样？

English: <<The guard's face falls abruptly.>> ##Your honour! I, er, it's not what it looks like. We're... conducting a sting operation, see? If you'd agreed, I'd have arrested you on the spot.
Chinese: <<卫兵的脸色骤变。>>##长官！呃，不是您看到的那样。我们这是……在钓鱼执法，明白吗？您要是答应了，我就当场逮捕您。

English: <<You hand them the coins in your purse. While it's obviously less than you'd offered, the guard pretends not to notice. >>
Chinese: <<你把钱包里的硬币递过去。虽然明显比说好的少，卫兵装作没注意。>>

English: <<They gawp at you for few seconds, clearly unsure if you're serious.>> ##((Now)) I see. You're one of the ((flexible)) ones. You see how it ((is)) down here. I admire that.
Chinese: <<他们瞪了你几秒，显然拿不准你是不是认真的。>>##((这下))我懂了。你是那种((能屈能伸))的人。你懂这儿((的规矩))。我佩服。

English: As you wish, your honour. Long live the King.
Chinese: 如您所愿，长官。国王万岁。

English: Of course, your honour. I'll set a guard day and night. Not even a bug will get into that armoury, you mark my words.
Chinese: 当然了，长官。我白天黑夜都派人守着。连只虫子都爬不进军械库，您记着我的话。

English: %% <<The guard grins.>> ##Now I get it. You're an ((entrepreneur)). Very well; it's a deal. Just remember our bargain.
Chinese: %% <<卫兵咧嘴笑。>>##这下我明白了。您是位((企业家))。好；成交。记住我们的交易。

English: && <<The guard scoffs.>> ##Maybe so, but a worm in the hand is worth two in the ground. Times like this, I'll stick to reimbursement I can see and touch.
Chinese: && <<卫兵嗤笑。>>##也许吧，但一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。这种年月，我只认看得见摸得着的进项。

English: <<You hand the guard 50 coins>>##Pleasure doing business. I'll unlock the supply house for you.
Chinese: <<你递给卫兵 50 枚硬币>>##合作愉快。我这就去给你开补给房。

English: <<As soon as the corrupt guard realizes the you don't have enough gold, he loses interest in you.>>##Get the money together and come back. If you take too long, I might sell to someone else.
Chinese: <<腐败卫兵一发现你没有足够金币，立刻对你失去了兴趣。>>##把钱凑齐再来。拖太久的话，我可就卖给别人了。

English: [Pay 50 coins] You've got yourself a deal.
Chinese: [付 50 枚硬币] 成交。

English: @@ I come across all kinds of treasures on my travels.##Me owing you a favour would be far more valuable.
Chinese: @@ 我出门在外，什么奇珍异宝没见过。##我欠你一个人情，可比这值钱多了。

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia] >>Corruption in the Militia? How very disappointing.
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记] >>民兵队伍里的腐败？真叫人失望。

English: Make it 20 coins and the King never needs to hear about this.
Chinese: 二十枚，国王就永远不必听说这件事。

English: Then the operation is over. Don't let me catch you selling royal equipment again.
Chinese: 那这次行动就到此为止。别让我再抓到你倒卖王室装备。

English: Sorry, no deal.
Chinese: 抱歉，不成交。

English: Ach, these barracks are colder than a Slevan's dangly bits.
Chinese: 唉，这兵营冷得跟斯列夫人的裤裆似的。

English: If only we still had [[Wikkans]] left to burn. Hehehe...
Chinese: 要是还有[[维坎教团]]剩下的能拿来烧就好了。嘿嘿嘿……

English: <<This guard is carefully rolling himself a pungent cigarette. They do not look up.>> ##I ain't on duty for another hour. So sod off, or I'll arrest you for aggravated pestering.
Chinese: <<这名卫兵正细心地卷一根气味刺鼻的烟。他们头也不抬。>>##我还有一小时才当值。滚吧，不然我以"骚扰加重罪"抓你。

English: Every time, every bloody time. I swear by the King, I spend more ticks waiting than actually hauling. Don't they know we've got targets to meet?
Chinese: 每次，每次都他妈这样。我对国王起誓，我等的时间比干活的时间还长。他们不知道我们有指标要赶吗？

English: Last week it was the cipher assay gone kaputt. The week before, a spilled wagonful of dead sky-squid. What's next? Rains of piss?
Chinese: 上星期密文检测仪坏了。上上星期，一整车死掉的飞天鱿鱼洒了一路。下一个是什么？天上下尿雨？

English: Ach, this is always the worst part.
Chinese: 唉，这一关永远最难受。

English: Even an adept of the [[Machinists' Guild]] must be assayed like anyone else.##The commands of our King are enforced without fear or favour.
Chinese: 就算是[[机械师公会]]的高手，也得跟平民一样接受检测。##我们国王的命令，执法无惧亦无私。

English: <<They look at you warily.>> King's blessing, your honour. I'm sure today Its Majesty will grant me what I need.
Chinese: <<他们警惕地看着你。>>国王赐福，长官。我相信今天陛下会赐我所需。

English: These summoning glitches have me at my wit's end. I've been the first one here every morning for two weeks running, even when it snows, and there's still no ((bread)).##What's the King playing at?
Chinese: 这些召唤故障把我逼疯了。连续两个星期，每天早上我都是头一个到，下雪也不例外，可还是没有((面包))。##国王到底在搞什么？

English: <<They shake their head.>> I'd love to give the bastard who maintains these a piece of my mind...
Chinese: <<他们摇头。>>真想揪住维护这套东西的混蛋，好好说道说道……

English: You're not from here, are you? This is a royal summoning station. It's how we common folk get most of our food and goods. Only I don't remember the last time I got what I asked for.
Chinese: 你不是本地人吧？这是座王室召唤站。我们平民的大部分吃穿用度都靠它。只是我不记得上一次要什么来什么是什么时候了。

English: Damned if I know. Guild says it's the Saboteur making trouble.##Last week I tried asking for a baguette", in case it made a difference. No chance. I got some kind of flute, made of actual jade. My neighbour says it's a clarinet."
Chinese: 我怎么知道。公会说是破坏者捣乱。##上星期我试着要一条法棍"，想着会不会有点不一样。没戏。给了我一只笛子，还是真玉做的。我邻居说那叫单簧管。"

English: Aye? To who? Listen, pal, nobody round here is buying luxuries right now. Makes no difference if you're a clarinet player or a bloody privy cleaner. Food and fuel are what matters, and there ain't enough of either.
Chinese: 是吗？卖给谁？听着伙计，这一带现在没人买奢侈品。你会吹单簧管还是掏茅厕，没区别。要紧的是吃的是烧的，两样都不够。

English: I try to make the best of it, but if the Guild catches you selling summoned goods they flog you in the street. What do they expect us to do?
Chinese: 我尽量往好处想，可公会要是抓到你倒卖召唤品，会拉到大街上鞭打。他们想让我们怎么办？

English: <<They snort, clearly sceptical.>> Very kind, but I already sold it for pennies. Makes a nice toy for my mate's daughter, at least.
Chinese: <<他们嗤之以鼻，明显不信。>>好意心领，可我几个子儿就把它卖了。起码给我伙计家的闺女当了个玩具。

English: <<They gawp for a moment, then their mouth snaps closed.>> Er, no, your honour, not at all! I was talking about the ((Saboteur)). Heh, if I could only get my hands on them...
Chinese: <<他们瞪了你片刻，嘴巴立刻闭紧。>>呃，不，长官，完全没有！我说的是((破坏者))。嘿嘿，要能亲手逮住他们才好呢……

English: <<They swallow nervously.>> Of c-course not, your honour! I've ((never)) sold anything I summoned, not me – I swear by the King.
Chinese: <<他们紧张地咽了口唾沫。>>当、当然没有，长官！我((从来))没卖过召唤品，不是我——我对国王起誓。

English: Oh! Um, yes, these aren't mine anyway – somebody else gave them to me to look after, and I meant to report it, but you know how life is... here, please take it.
Chinese: 哦！呃，对，这本来也不是我的——是别人交给我保管的，我正打算上报呢，可你知道的，生活嘛……喏，请您收下。

English: <<They look immensely relieved.>> I will, your honour, I swear I will.
Chinese: <<他们如释重负。>>我会的，长官，我对天发誓。

English: Just another day. King's blessing to you.
Chinese: 又是一天。国王赐福。

English: What is this machine, exactly?
Chinese: 这台机器，确切说是干什么的？

English: What's the source of these 'glitches'?
Chinese: 这些"故障"的根源是什么？

English: A jade clarinet sounds quite valuable.
Chinese: 玉单簧管听着挺值钱的。

English: I'd buy the clarinet from you.
Chinese: 单簧管我买了。

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Is it too much to ask that you follow the law, citizen?
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>要求你守法，公民，很过分吗？

English: I hope your luck improves.
Chinese: 愿你的运气好起来。

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Do you have a complaint to make, citizen?
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>有要投诉的事吗，公民？

English: King's favour to you.
Chinese: 国王赐福。

English: I hope you haven't been engaging in black market activity?
Chinese: 希望你没有参与黑市交易？

English: Hand over the proceeds of any illegal activities, and we'll say no more about it.
Chinese: 交出一切非法所得，我们就不再追究。

English: Very well, citizen. See that you keep it that way.
Chinese: 很好，公民。保持下去。

English: Very well, citizen. Your patriotism will be noted.
Chinese: 很好，公民。你的爱国之心会被记下的。

English: How did you keep from going hungry?
Chinese: 你们是怎么熬过饥荒的？

English: King's blessing, your honour. I don't suppose you can explain this teapot? Sorry, sorry, it's none of my business...
Chinese: 国王赐福，长官。不知您能不能解释一下这只茶壶？抱歉抱歉，不该我多嘴……

English: The King gives us tadpoles when we ask for tea, but now it puts a teapot in the sky? It's like some kind of sick joke...
Chinese: 我们要茶，国王给蝌蚪，现在它又把茶壶挂天上？像某种变态的玩笑……

English: Oi, no cutting in line!##I was here first.
Chinese: 喂，不许插队！##我先来的。

English: I 'eard the [[Saboteur]] submits 'undreds of petitions every day, all in different names, tellin' the King to make more bootlaces or wind-up dolls or matchin' sets o' teacups.
Chinese: 我听说[[破坏者]]每天递交几百份呈文，全用不同的名字，让国王造更多靴带、发条娃娃，还有成套成套的茶杯。

English: That's why the summons are always such shite!
Chinese: 难怪召唤出来的净是些破烂！

English: They say the Saboteur's got an 'ole dungeon full of [[bonsai gods]] scribblin' away at it, chained an' bound since they was only [[godlets]]...##Interestin' theory, anyway.
Chinese: 他们说破坏者有"一整个地牢"的[[盆景神]]在替他写呈文，从[[稚神]]时期就被锁着绑着……##反正这个说法挺有意思。

English: <<They nod at the sky.>> ##Can't blame me for that. I never asked for no teapots.
Chinese: <<他们朝天上点点头。>>##那可赖不着我。茶壶可不是我要的。

English: Have we met before? I'm sorry, what a mad question. It's just, I'm sure I know your face from somewhere.
Chinese: 我们以前见过吗？抱歉，这问题真疯。只是我肯定在哪儿见过你的脸。

English: <<This citizen is staring at the sky in wonder.>> ##I don't know where, I don't know when, but I ((know)) I've seen that teapot before. King's gears, how is that possible?
Chinese: <<这位公民出神地望着天空。>>##我不知道在哪，不知道什么时候，可我((知道))我见过那只茶壶。国王的齿轮，这怎么可能？

English: Food shortage... border blockade... Apostatic bloody Union... Corruption... and now this damned winter!##Why can't we just have one problem at a time, eh?
Chinese: 粮食短缺……边境封锁……该死的叛教联盟……腐化……现在又是这个见鬼的寒冬！##为什么不能一次只来一个麻烦，啊？

English: <<They sigh.>>##No, I s'pose not. Me mam always said they come in threes. Only now I've lost count.
Chinese: <<他们叹气。>>##嗯，我想是不能。我娘总说祸不单行。只是现在我都数不清了。

English: <<They sigh.>>##Thanks. I'm just tired is all...
Chinese: <<他们叹气。>>##谢谢。我就是累了……

English: <<They look crestfallen.>>##I... I was thinkin' of tryin' to get to Hallowshire. If things got really bad, I mean.
Chinese: <<他们一脸颓丧。>>##我……我在想要不要去哈洛郡。我是说，如果这里实在撑不下去的话。

English: <<They scowl at you.>>##You're a right cheery sod, you are.
Chinese: <<他们冲你皱眉。>>##你可真会安慰人。

English: Food shortage... border blockade... Apostatic bloody Union... Corruption...!##Why can't we just have one problem at a time, eh?
Chinese: 粮食短缺……边境封锁……该死的叛教联盟……腐化……！##为什么不能一次只来一个麻烦，啊？

English: I don't think that's how problems work.
Chinese: 我觉得麻烦不是这么个来法的。

English: Don't give up.
Chinese: 别放弃。

English: If it makes you feel any better, Hallowshire is the same.'
Chinese: 要是能让你好受点：哈洛郡也一样。'

English: It could be worse. It could be the World Rend.
Chinese: 还可能更糟呢。可能是世界撕裂。

English: Word to the wise, pal. Once you walk away from this board, forget everything you saw.##The Militia seem to be under orders to let people read freely, but they sure don't like us asking questions about it.
Chinese: 给你个忠告，伙计。离开这块告示板以后，忘了你看到的一切。##民兵似乎奉命让人随便看，但他们可不喜欢我们就此多问。

English: You really are new here, huh? This is the [[missing persons noticeboard]].##As you can see, there's no shortage of notices. A lot of people go missing in this kingdom. People, and other things.
Chinese: 你真是新来的，嗯？这是[[失踪人口告示板]]。##你也看到了，告示不缺。这个王国失踪的人可不少。人，还有别的东西。

English: Honestly, if you're not staying long, maybe you shouldn't read it at all. What you don't know can't hurt you, right?
Chinese: 说真的，你要是不久留，也许压根别看。不知道的事伤害不了你，对吧？

English: What is this board?
Chinese: 这板子是什么？

English: Cheers, I'll be careful.
Chinese: 谢了，我会小心的。

English: <<This woman is scanning the noticeboard, murmuring under her breath as she reads.>>##Doyle... Aziz... little girl... old woman... Chen... Krupke... no, no, no...
Chinese: <<这位女士正逐行扫描告示板，边看边小声念叨。>>##多伊尔……阿齐兹……小女孩……老妇人……陈……克鲁普克……不，不，不……

English: Ach! Nothing again!? Five bloody months...
Chinese: 唉！又没有！整整五个月……

English: <<The woman is comforting her companion in a low soft voice.>>##There now, don't give up. You never know if someone might spot him. Why don't I take you down the Wheel and we'll check again next week?
Chinese: <<这位女士正低声柔气地安慰同伴。>>##好了好了，别放弃。说不定哪天就有人看见他了。要不我带你去吱嘎轮坐坐，下星期再来看？

English: I know it sounds bonkers, but I'd swear this city used to be bigger.##Not just more people, I mean ((bigger)) – more streets, more houses.
Chinese: 我知道听起来很疯，但我敢发誓这座城市从前更大。##不只是人更多，我是说((地方))更大——街道更多，房子更多。

English: Or maybe I was just smaller? My memory must be playing tricks on me...
Chinese: 还是说我那时候更小？一定是我的记忆出问题了……

English: If anyone can make sense of this teapot, it's [[Reza.]]##They really helped me out last time I had trouble with the King...
Chinese: 要论谁能看懂这只茶壶，那得是[[雷扎]]。##上次我被国王的破事缠住，是他们真帮了我……

English: If you're having trouble with the King, talk to [[Reza.]]##They really helped me out when the [[Guild]] kept insisting I should be able to grow two acres of potatoes in my bathtub.
Chinese: 你跟国王的麻烦缠上了，去找[[雷扎]]。##上次[[公会]]死咬着我该在我家浴缸里种出两亩土豆，是他们帮我摆平的。

English: They showed me how to file a petition that would pause any goods targets laid on my property. Turns out you have to file it under safety", not "targets". All the target petitions go into one big pile that never gets read."
Chinese: 他们教我怎么递呈文，可以暂停我房产上的任何产出指标。原来得归到安全"类，不能归"指标"类。所有指标类呈文都堆进一个大堆，从来没人看。"

English: Oh, they're down in the Conduits somewhere. Look for a market trader in brightly-coloured clothing. Just mind yourself – it's a weird place.
Chinese: 他们就在导管区某处。找一个穿花衣服的市场摊贩。自己当心点——那地方邪门。

English: How did Reza help you?
Chinese: 雷扎怎么帮你的？

English: Where can I find them?
Chinese: 去哪找他们？

English: Where can I find this Reza?
Chinese: 这位雷扎在哪找？

English: How did they help you?
Chinese: 他们怎么帮的你？

English: Thanks. King's favour to you.
Chinese: 谢谢。国王赐福。

English: <<They gesture dramatically up at the teapot in the sky.>> It's an omen, I tell you! A sign from the King! Didn't I tell you all? None of us are free of fault, not one!
Chinese: <<他们夸张地指着天上的茶壶。>>这是征兆，我告诉你！国王的启示！我不是跟你们都说过了吗？我们无人无罪，一个都没有！

English: Our sovereign is not pleased with us, friend. The signs are everywhere if you know where to look.
Chinese: 我们的君主对我们不满了，朋友。征兆随处可见，只要你知道往哪看。

English: Only by redoubling our efforts and rooting out the disloyal among us may we win back Its Majesty's trust.##Long live the King!
Chinese: 唯有加倍努力、铲除我们中间的不忠之徒，才能重获陛下的信任。##国王万岁！

English: <<This citizen is steadfastly avoiding looking at the sky while they wait at the summoning station.>> ##You en't gonna make me look.
Chinese: <<这位公民在召唤站排队时，坚定地避望着天空。>>##你休想让我抬头看。

English: Nope. Don't care. En't got time. Lots to do today.
Chinese: 不看。不关心。没工夫。今天活多着呢。

English: Not looking. ((Not looking.)) Everything's ((fine.))
Chinese: 不看。((不看。))一切都((好得很。))

English: <<This citizen steadfastly avoids looking at you as they wait at the summoning station.>> I en't summoning nowt for yer, so don't even bother.
Chinese: <<这位公民在召唤站排队时，坚定地避望着你。>>我不会替你召唤任何东西，趁早死心。

English: <<She squints at you.>> You daft? Always some arsehole hanging round the stations offering coins or food to use yer daily summon. Well, I don't give a runny shite. I need onions and I'm damn well getting onions.
Chinese: <<她眯眼看你。>>你傻吗？总有些混蛋围着召唤站转，又是给钱又是给吃的，就为借你每天一次的召唤。哼，老子一泡稀屎都不给他们。我要洋葱，今天就非要洋葱不可。

English: I en't answerin' any questions neither, so piss off.
Chinese: 也别想我问你任何问题，滚吧。

English: Is it? Could've fooled me.
Chinese: 是吗？我可看不出来。

English: But there's a teapot...
Chinese: 可是那儿有只茶壶……

English: But what if it...
Chinese: 可万一它……

English: Oh, never mind.
Chinese: 哦，算了。

English: If you say so.
Chinese: 你说了算。

English: Why would I want you to summon for me?
Chinese: 我为什么要你替我召唤？

English: Can I ask you a question while you wait?
Chinese: 你排队的时候我能问个问题吗？

English: Good luck.
Chinese: 祝你好运。

English: Actually, I wanted to ask you a question.
Chinese: 其实我是想问你个问题。

English: Good day to you.
Chinese: 祝你今天顺利。

English: <<This person is peering up at the floating teapot, shaking their head.>> Mark my words, this is just a mirage summoned by the Saboteur to frighten us. ##I confess, it's working on me.
Chinese: <<这个人抬头望着悬浮的茶壶，直摇头。>>记住我的话，这只是破坏者召唤出来的海市蜃楼，想吓唬我们。##不瞒你说，还真有点吓着我了。

English: I heard the Saboteur hides out in disused royal pipes down in the Conduits. I'm usually too scared to go down there, though...
Chinese: 听说破坏者就藏在导管区废弃的王室管道里。不过我平时怂得根本不敢下去……

English: <<This resident's accent is rather well-heeled compared to their neighbours.>> ##Perhaps you've already met the redoubtable [[Citizen Kaur]]? They get a little fierce sometimes, but don't take it personally. They're just trying to do the right thing.
Chinese: <<这位居民的口音比邻居们讲究得多。>>##说不定你已经见过那位威名远扬的[[考尔公民]]了？他们有时候凶了点，别往心里去。他们只是想把事做对。

English: It's an awful shame about poor [[Nadja]]. My heart breaks for her mother. I hope she gets through it; we're all rooting for her.
Chinese: 可怜的[[娜佳]]，真是造孽。她妈妈的心都要碎了。希望她能挺过去；我们都盼着她好。

English: Oh, I'm sorry, I... are you a friend? Nadja's very sick. Can't even get out of bed.
Chinese: 哦，抱歉，我……你是她的朋友？娜佳病得很重。连床都下不了。

English: If you dropped by to wish her well, I'm sure her mother would appreciate it.
Chinese: 你要是顺路去问候她，她妈妈一定很感激。

English: What's wrong with Nadja?
Chinese: 娜佳怎么了？

English: I hope so too.
Chinese: 我也希望如此。

English: When Uncle Yosip's room split off the building, we got no warning – none whatsoever!
Chinese: 约西普大叔的房间从楼体上裂出去的时候，我们一点预警都没有——半点都没有！

English: Now I have to winch up supplies to 'im in a bucket. You wouldn't ((believe)) the bribes you have to pay for a ladder round here...
Chinese: 现在我要用滑轮把补给吊进桶里送给他。你((想象))不到在这附近弄一把梯子要塞多少好处费……

English: The boiler's a deathtrap, but will they let my son look at it? Noooo, that'd be 'tampering with royal property' and three days in the stocks.
Chinese: 那台锅炉就是个死亡陷阱，可他们肯让我儿子看一眼吗？不——那叫"擅动王室财产"，要在颈手枷里枷三天。

English: Only a bona fide Machinist with a work order from the King is authorised to fix it.##But how do you get one of those? That's right, another bloody petition!
Chinese: 只有持国王工单的正牌机械师才有资格修。##可那玩意儿怎么弄？没错，又是一道该死的呈文！

English: We'll all be frozen solid by the time they get to us.
Chinese: 等轮到我们，全家都冻成冰雕了。

English: Mind, the lady in Number 12 snores like a sky-barge engine. I should know – I fix 'em.
Chinese: 对了，12 号那位女士打鼾像飞艇引擎。我懂——飞艇就是我修的。

English: In my day, a pair of trousers would last you a decade, two or three if you were lucky. Now they just rip apart like wet paper after a year.
Chinese: 我们那时候，一条裤子能穿十年，运气好能穿二三十年。现在一年就烂得跟湿纸似的。

English: I mean... not that I'm complainin'. O' course I'm glad to have such things at all. Half this stuff we never even ((had)) before the King. ##Still, I miss havin' ((good)) trousers.
Chinese: 我意思……也不是在抱怨。有这些用我当然高兴。这些东西有一半，国王来之前我们((见都没见过))。##只是，我还是想念((结实))的裤子。

English: Clothes don't fit. Lamps don't last. Machines don't work. Food ain't filling. Water ain't clean. Guild don't listen. Everythin' just falls apart and there's nothin' you can do.
Chinese: 衣服不合身。灯泡不耐用。机器不好使。吃了不顶饱。水不干净。公会不听人话。什么都在散架，而你毫无办法。

English: How's a person supposed to live, eh? Who the hell ever ((asked)) for this?
Chinese: 这让人怎么活，啊？这一切到底是谁((要求))的？

English: <<This woman is knitting something long and cosy-looking.>> ##You look like you've seen a ghost, dear. Anything you want to talk about?
Chinese: <<这位女士正织着一件长长的、看着很暖和的东西。>>##孩子，你脸色像是见了鬼。有什么想聊聊的吗？

English: <<She looks genuinely concerned.>> ##King's wheels, dear, that sounds horrific. Why don't you tell me all about it?
Chinese: <<她是真心关切。>>##国王的齿轮，孩子，这也太吓人了。都跟我说说吧？

English: <<You spend a long while talking about your highly unusual troubles. You're not sure whether she believes you, but it helps.>>
Chinese: <<你花了好长时间，讲述你那些极不寻常的遭遇。你不确定她信不信，但说出来好受多了。>>

English: Well, if you say so, dear. Come back if you'd ever like to chat.
Chinese: 嗯，你说了算，孩子。想聊天随时回来。

English: Be gentle with yourself, dear.##No one can do everything at once.
Chinese: 对自己温柔点，孩子。##没人能一口气扛下所有事。

English: I'm being forced to hunt down a lunatic sky pirate.
Chinese: 我被迫去追捕一个疯癫的天上海盗。

English: The King is forcing me to perform a task it won't explain.
Chinese: 国王逼我执行一项任务，还不肯解释是什么。

English: I'm searching for a child who's not supposed to exist.
Chinese: 我在找一个按理不该存在的孩子。

English: I really miss my family.
Chinese: 我真的很想家。

English: No, I'm fine.
Chinese: 没有，我没事。

English: Penny for a song, friend? I know all the royal anthems, and the God War battle hymns, an' the old Kardovan lays, an' more besides... 5 coin a pop, no fairer price.
Chinese: 点一首歌吧，朋友？王室的颂歌、神之战的战歌、卡尔多瓦的古谣，还有更多……一首 5 枚硬币，价钱公道。

English: Whew. Wasn't sure I'd hit that note at the end there. ##Another song, friend? 5 coin a pop, no fairer price.
Chinese: 呼。还担心最后那个音上不去呢。##再来一首，朋友？一首 5 枚硬币，价钱公道。

English: Let's hear a royal anthem.
Chinese: 来一首王室颂歌。

English: <<They sing an official song of the Clockwork Kingdom, stirring and pious. Though it must be impressive with an orchestra behind it, somehow their cracked voice cuts to your heart.>>
Chinese: <<他们唱起发条王国的官方颂歌，激昂而虔诚。配上管弦乐队想必蔚为壮观，可不知为何，他们沙哑的嗓音直插你的心底。>>

English: <<The royal anthem tells of the long night of humanity, a despair that covered the world. But, it vows, this is not all there is.>>
Chinese: <<这首王室颂歌唱的是人类漫长的黑夜，一场覆盖世界的绝望。但它立誓：这并非一切的终点。>>

English: <<Today, yes, the sacrifice; today the struggle and toil. Old ways, old thoughts, must be washed away; everyone must pull together. Yet nigh is the dawn when the world shall bloom and mortals be delivered from want.>>
Chinese: <<今日，是牺牲；今日，是奋斗与辛劳。旧习与旧思必须涤荡；人人必须同心协力。黎明将至，世界将绽放，凡人将脱离匮乏。>>

English: <<You want to believe it, and you almost do.>>
Chinese: <<你愿意相信它，而且几乎就信了。>>

English: Something from the God War, please.
Chinese: 来一首神之战的曲子。

English: <<They sing a song of proud apostacy, set to a brisk beat.>>
Chinese: <<他们唱起一首骄傲的背教之歌，节奏明快。>>

English: <<It's bold and cocky and funny and rude, meant to make you ready to march up to a nightmare the size of a mountain and spit in its face. Ready to die.>>
Chinese: <<它大胆、张狂、滑稽又粗野，专为让你敢于冲向山一样高的噩梦，朝它脸上啐一口。随时准备赴死。>>

English: <<Here and there you can sense that it used to be a Wikkan hymn, or maybe a ballad about some divine champion.>>##<<Shorn of their gods, in freefall through history, the apostates had to make up new myths and heroes as they went along.>>
Chinese: <<字里行间你听得出，它原本是维坎的圣咏，或是一首歌颂某位神圣勇士的谣曲。>>##<<神明被剪除后，背教者在历史中自由坠落，只好边走边编造新的神话与英雄。>>

English: Sing me a tune from old Kardova.
Chinese: 来一首古卡尔多瓦的调子。

English: <<They sing a weird and ancient song, earthy and caked with blood.>>
Chinese: <<他们唱起一首古老怪异的歌，土腥味里糊着血。>>

English: <<It tells of a plucky and cunning mortal who tries to swindle a god, and is full of unfamiliar musical motifs and references to vanished customs.>>
Chinese: <<它讲的是一个机智胆大的凡人试图诈骗一位神明，曲调里满是陌生的乐句和对消逝风俗的指涉。>>

English: <<In the end, the mortal is caught and transformed into a silkslug.>>
Chinese: <<最后，那个凡人被抓住，变成了一只丝蛞蝓。>>

English: <<He is punished for imagining that he could ever be more than he was. This is how things are, and they cannot be otherwise. No future, forever.>>
Chinese: <<他受罚，是因为妄以为自己可以超越生来的身份。事情从来如此，也绝无可能不是如此。没有未来，永远。>>

English: Not just now, thank you.
Chinese: 今天不用了，谢谢。

English: <<You don't have enough gold ...>>##Ah, sorry, friend, I know how it is, but a singer's gotta eat. Come back when you've dough to spare.
Chinese: <<你没有足够的金币……>>##唉，抱歉朋友，我懂，可唱歌的也得吃饭。等你手头宽裕再来。

English: No one is gonna remember us, pal. There ain't gonna be any memorials.##Not for me, not for you.
Chinese: 没人会记得我们的，伙计。不会有任何纪念碑。##不为我不为你。

English: Ever tried to petition for a home in the upper city? Pointless. The King rejected me 'cos my comity score" was too low. What does that even mean?"
Chinese: 试过申请上城的房子吗？白费劲。国王拒绝了我，理由是我的礼洽分"太低。这到底是个什么鬼？"

English: I swear, they just make up a number and pretend there's some wizardry behind it. Then if you ask how to increase it, they say it's too complicated to explain.
Chinese: 我敢说，他们就是随手编个数字，再假装背后有什么高深算法。你要问怎么提高，他们就说太复杂解释不清。

English: <<You see an old beggar wrapped up in rags against the cold.>> ##Pal? Scuse me, pal? Do you know where my house is?
Chinese: <<你看见一个裹着破布御寒的老乞丐。>>##伙计？打扰一下，伙计？你知道我的房子在哪吗？

English: <<The beggar looks confused, like they didn't expect you to actually stop.>> Erm? Oh. Aye, aye I did!
Chinese: <<乞丐一脸茫然，似乎没料到你真会停下。>>嗯？哦。对，对，我有过！

English: I'm ((so)) sorry to bother a fine citizen such as yersel. Only I can't seem to find it anywhere...
Chinese: 真((不好意思))打扰您这样体面的公民。只是我怎么也找不着它……

English: <<They look abashed.>> King's truth, pal, I've no clue. I know I had one, somewhere in the upper city. I just can't seem to recall any o' the details...
Chinese: <<他们面露窘色。>>国王作证，伙计，我一点头绪都没有。我知道我有过一栋，就在上城某处。可细节我怎么也想不起来……

English: <<The beggar delves into the rags around their neck and produces an ornate key on a string, holding it up in their blackened fingernails like a talisman.>>##Because I've got ((this)).
Chinese: <<乞丐从脖子上围的破布里掏出一把系着绳的华丽钥匙，像护身符一样举在乌黑的指甲间。>>##因为我有((这个))。

English: <<The beggar clings to the key, like a childhood doll.>>##Gotta be around here somewhere...
Chinese: <<乞丐紧紧攥着钥匙，像攥着童年的布娃娃。>>##一定就在这附近……

English: It's mine, I swear by the King! I've always had it. Had it in my pocket. And I remember, see – I remember my first night on the streets.
Chinese: 它是我的，我对国王起誓！我一直带着它。装在口袋里。而且我记得，你看——我记得我流落街头的第一晚。

English: It was like a nightmare. I ((knew)) I'd had a house only the night before. I didn't know shite about sleepin' rough. I kept thinkin' – tomorrow I'll surely find it. Tomorrow this'll be over.
Chinese: 那像一场噩梦。我((明明知道))前一晚自己还有房子。露宿的苦我一窍不通。我一直在想——明天我肯定能找到家。明天这一切就会结束。

English: Well, that was two years ago.
Chinese: 唉，那都是两年前的事了。
