English: Oh, I tried plenty. Turns out nobody likes ye doin' that without askin' first, and if you ((do)) ask first  then nobody lets ye. They all just thought I was mad...
Chinese: 哦，我试过好多次。结果发现，不先打招呼就住进去，没人乐意；可你((真))先打招呼吧，又没人肯让。他们都当我疯了……

English: Now the Militia know my face, so it's tough for me to leave the Conduits. At least it's warmer down here, where the steam pipes are.
Chinese: 如今民兵队都认得我这张脸，想离开导管区都难。好在下面有蒸汽管道，还算暖和。

English: Oh, no, don't bother yerself. All I need's to find my house, and I'll be grand. Get me old job back, get back on me feet...
Chinese: 哦，不，别为您自己费心。我只要找到我的房子，就万事大吉了。找回我那份老工作，重新站起来……

English: Wait, but... <<Their eyes well up, torn between shame and gratitude.>> ...thank ye, pal. I promise, when I find my house I'll repay ye double. Triple! I'll give ye a bed whenever ye need it, pour ye a dram any time...
Chinese: 等等，可是……<<他们眼眶湿了，在羞愧与感激之间挣扎。>>……谢谢你，朋友。我发誓，找到房子我一定加倍还你。三倍！你什么时候需要床铺，我随时给你腾；什么时候想喝一口，我随时给你倒……

English: Wait, but... <<Their eyes well up, torn between shame and gratitude.>> ...thank ye.
Chinese: 等等，可是……<<他们眼眶湿了，在羞愧与感激之间挣扎。>>……谢谢你。

English: <<You do not have enough coins.>>##It's alright mate I understand, trust.
Chinese: <<你的硬币不够。>>##没事伙计，我懂，信你。

English: [Keep walking.]
Chinese: [继续赶路。]

English: ...sorry, did you just ask me where ((your)) house is?
Chinese: ……抱歉，你刚才是问我((你的))房子在哪？

English: Don't you know where your own house is?
Chinese: 你连自己家在哪都不知道？

English: How do you know you had one, then?
Chinese: 那你怎么知道自己有过房子？

English: Where did you get that key from?
Chinese: 那把钥匙你从哪弄来的？

English: Could you just try it on some doors?
Chinese: 你就不能挨家试试那把钥匙吗？

English: I must go, but I can give you some coin.
Chinese: 我得走了，不过可以给你几个硬币。

English: [Give 3 coins]
Chinese: [给 3 枚硬币]

English: [Give 10 coins]
Chinese: [给 10 枚硬币]

English: [Give 20 coins]
Chinese: [给 20 枚硬币]

English: You need to lay off the mushrooms, friend.
Chinese: 朋友，蘑菇你可得少吃点。

English: <<This woman is guarding a bucket of water, set down on the ground near the machinery. When she sees you she tenses up.>>
Chinese: <<这个女人守着一只水桶，桶就放在机器旁的地上。看见你，她绷紧了身子。>>

English: ...King's grace to ye, citizen. Don't mind me, I've nothin' worth stealin'.
Chinese: ……国王赐福，公民。别理我，我身上没什么值得偷的。

English: I'm not ((hidin')). I'm warmin' it, en't I? These pipes run right into the Machinarium, and... here, look. ##<<She grabs your hand and holds it against the metal pipe for a few seconds. It's hot.>>
Chinese: 我不是((躲着))。我这是在加热水，不是吗？这些管道直通机械殿，还有……喏，你看。##<<她抓起你的手，按在金属管道上按了几秒。管道是热的。>>

English: Wouldn't be right to refuse a gift from the King, now would it? I'm just makin' sure nothin' is wasted.
Chinese: 国王的赏赐，拒绝了不合适，对吧？我只是不想浪费罢了。

English: <<This woman warms a bucket of water using heat from the pipes.>> ##Wouldn't be right to refuse a gift from the King, now would it? I'm just makin' sure nothin' is wasted.
Chinese: <<这个女人正借着管道的热量给一桶水加温。>>##国王的赏赐，拒绝了不合适，对吧？我只是不想浪费罢了。

English: Why are you hiding here with a bucket of water?
Chinese: 你躲在这儿守着一桶水做什么？

English: Sorry to bother you. Wrong turn.
Chinese: 抱歉打扰了。走错路了。

English: Weapon? Weapon! Fuck are ye, ye gleikit wee scrote? Oi! Weapon!
Chinese: 武器？武器！你他妈算哪根葱，你个傻了吧唧的小瘪三？喂！武器！

English: <<They squint at you, unsure of your intentions.>>##Weapon? Weapon's my pet. So called cos he's a pure spanner, like.
Chinese: <<他们眯眼打量你，拿不准你的来意。>>##武器？武器是我养的宠物。叫这名儿是因为他纯是一把活扳手，嘿嘿。

English: ((Weapon!)) C'mere ye wee dobber...
Chinese: ((武器！))过来你这小混球……

English: Why are you shouting 'weapon'?
Chinese: 你喊"武器"干什么？

English: Looking to buy a weapon, are you?
Chinese: 想买武器是吧？

English: [Leave them alone]
Chinese: [别招惹他们]

English: I heard there's a [[sky sailor]] in the eastern countryside who smuggles people out of the [[Clockwork Kingdom.]]
Chinese: 听说东边乡下有个[[飞天水手]]，专门把人偷渡出[[发条王国]]。

English: They say his ship's invisible unless you know its true name.
Chinese: 他们说，不知道他那条船的真名，就看不见那条船。

English: I saw a flying ship touch down the other night in the wilds just //INSERT DIRECTION// of here.##It looked like it came from the [[Clockwork Kingdom]]...
Chinese: 前几天夜里，我看见一艘飞船降落在离这儿//INSERT DIRECTION//的荒野里。##看着像是从[[发条王国]]来的……

English: I reported it, o' course – I value me neck. But these Inquisitors didn't seem interested.
Chinese: 我当然上报了——惜命嘛。可那些宗教裁判所探员似乎不感兴趣。

English: What if it's a spy for the Clockwork King? What if we're about to be invaded?
Chinese: 万一那是发条王的探子呢？万一咱们马上要被入侵了呢？

English: I've got a source for bottled visions. The Clockwork Kingdom may have closed its borders, but there's ways in and out for someone in the know.
Chinese: 我有瓶装幻象的货源。发条王国虽说是闭了关，可对懂行的人来说，进出的门道多着呢。

English: %% Sure you are, sweetheart. How else would you be down here? ##Look for [[Mikhail the sky sailor]] near this island's north-eastern edge. He often lands his boat in the wilderness.
Chinese: %% 是嘛，亲爱的。不然你怎么会流落到这条街？##去找这岛东北边的[[飞天水手米哈伊尔]]。他常把船停在荒郊野外。

English: && Nice try, sweetheart. You may have found the Lost Purse, but I don't know who your real friends are.
Chinese: && 想得美，亲爱的。失包黑店你是找到了，可你真正的朋友是谁，我可不知道。

English: @@ Care to share your wisdom? I'm VERY good at keeping secrets.
Chinese: @@ 能否分享一点您的见闻？我嘴特别严。

English: I'm good for now, thanks.
Chinese: 暂时不用了，谢谢。

English: [Leave it alone.]
Chinese: [别碰它。]

English: <<The control console is caked with dirt and dust. A spider skitters away into the hole where an indicator light has been torn out. Nobody has been here in a long time.>>
Chinese: <<控制台积满尘土。一只蜘蛛窜进指示灯被拔掉的孔洞里。很久没有人来过这里了。>>

English: <<However, you see a socket that might fit a [[Machinist's Guild Insignia]]...>>
Chinese: <<不过，你看见一个插座，尺寸似乎正好能插进[[机械师公会徽记]]……>>

English: <<All around you the titanic machine rumbles to life.##You can feel the thrum of its engine through your feet, and the crackle of magic in the air.>>
Chinese: <<四周，巨型机器轰隆隆地苏醒。##透过脚底你能感到引擎的震颤，空气里满是魔法的噼啪声。>>

English: [Insert your insignia]
Chinese: [插入你的徽记]

English: <<The pulse continues at regular intervals, singing a song that only your bones can hear, broadcasting a monarch's lonely cry down into the Underlands.>>
Chinese: <<脉冲以固定的间隔持续跳动，唱着一首只有骨头才听得见的歌，把一位君主孤独的呼喊广播进地下之地。>>

English: <<The control panel is a dizzying array of levers, dials, and buttons, many smashed or corroded. Among them is a slot-like entry port, waiting for input.>> ##<<A howling wind whips snow and ash across your face.>>
Chinese: <<控制面板上是令人眼花的杠杆、旋钮和按钮，许多已被砸烂或锈蚀。其中有一个卡槽状的输入口，静候输入。>>##<<狂风卷着雪和灰烬扑在你脸上。>>

English: <<The card jams in the slot, but you give it a good shove. For a moment, nothing happens...>>
Chinese: <<卡片卡进了槽口，你用力一推。有那么一瞬，毫无动静……>>

English: <<The whole tower begins to vibrate.>>
Chinese: <<整座塔开始震动。>>

English: <<Needles jump back and forth along their dials.>>
Chinese: <<指针沿着表盘来回跳动。>>

English: <<A transistor bursts in a shower of glass.>>
Chinese: <<一只晶体管爆裂，玻璃四溅。>>

English: <<One by one, indicator lights go green as the beacon reconnects with its long-lost King.>>
Chinese: <<指示灯一盏接一盏变绿，信标重新连上了它失散已久的国王。>>

English: <<Above you, the giant antenna crackles into life and emits a pulse of silent sound, felt in your belly rather than heard...>>
Chinese: <<你头顶上，巨型天线噼啪启动，发出一记无声的声脉冲，与其说是听见，不如说是在腹腔里感到了……>>

English: <<Suddenly the control panel crackles and squeals, before emitting a familiar voice...>> ##...gods-damned thing even work? Hey, asshole! Are you hearing this?
Chinese: <<突然，控制面板噼啪尖啸起来，随后传出熟悉的声音……>>##……这鬼东西到底能不能用？喂，混蛋！你听见了吗？

English: Misha? Noooo, this is ancient mummified queen of the Underlands here to tell you that you have stupid nose. Pinhead! Nincompoop! Fucking <<skkrrrsshhh>>!
Chinese: 米沙？不——不不，我是地下之地古老木乃伊女王，专程来告诉你，你的鼻子蠢得很。针头脑！笨蛋蛋！他妈的<<嗞啦啦>>！

English: Nooo, Misha is just broadcasting potentially treasonous machine signal into clockwork nightmare land to see if anyone wishes to chat about weather. Pinhead! Nincompoop! Fucking <<skkrrrsshhh>>!
Chinese: 不不不，米沙只是在往发条噩梦之国广播可能叛国的机器信号，看看有没有人想聊聊天气。针头脑！笨蛋蛋！他妈的<<嗞啦啦>>！

English: Oooh, you are big scary cog now? Misha knows ((exactly)) where you got that brooch, so cut the shit. Pinhead! Nincompoop! Fucking <<skkrrrsshhh>>!
Chinese: 哦哟，你现在是大个头吓人齿轮啦？米沙((清清楚楚))知道你那枚徽记哪来的，别装了。针头脑！笨蛋蛋！他妈的<<嗞啦啦>>！

English: Listen. We do not have long with this <<skrrsshh>> device, so pay attention. ##Misha has some friends who have been watching you, through the King's eyes.
Chinese: 听着。这台<<嗞啦>>机器上我们待不了太久，所以竖起耳朵。##米沙有几个朋友，一直在透过国王的眼睛观察你。

English: They know all about [[Chief Interpreter Aphra]] and her big plan. Enough to <<sssskrrssshhhh>> cannot be trusted.
Chinese: 他们把[[首席释经官阿芙拉]]和她的大计划摸得一清二楚。多到足以说明<<嘶嘶嗞啦>>不可信。

English: Go down <<sssskrrsssshhh>> in [[Ferropolis]], and find a market trader called [[Reza]]. Ask them <<shhhhhkkkkrrrrrr>> the [[seventh letter]]. ##Do this ((before)) you <<ssskkrrshhh>> Aphra's punchcard – understand?
Chinese: 去<<嘶嘶嗞啦>>下面的[[铁城]]，找一个叫[[雷扎]]的市场摊贩。问他们<<嘶嘶咔啦>>"[[第七个字母]]"。##要在你<<嘶咔啦>>阿芙拉的打孔卡((之前))——明白吗？

English: <<It appears Mikhail can no longer hear you.>>
Chinese: <<看来米哈伊尔已经听不见你了。>>

English: You and I, I believe we have seen each other's souls. We have <<sssshhhskrrssssshhh>> and discussed philosophy. Nothing matters <<ssssskrrsssssshhhhhh>> this. Misha is asking you as a [[friend]].
Chinese: 你和我，我想我们见过彼此的灵魂。我们<<嘶嘶嗞咔>>过，还一起讨论过哲学。没有什么比<<嘶嘶嗞嗞>>更重要的了。米沙是以[[朋友]]的身份求你的。

English: <<Suddenly the control panel crackles and squeals, before emitting a distorted voice...>> ##YOU. STOP WHAT YOU ARE <<skrrrsshhh>> AND LISTEN.
Chinese: <<突然，控制面板噼啪尖啸起来，随后传出扭曲的声音……>>##你。停下你手上的<<嗞啦>>事，给我听好。

English: <<The voice is unnaturally deep and toneless, as if it's been modified to disguise its owner.>> ##NEVER MIND WHO WE ARE. YOU MAY CONSIDER US AN INTERESTED PARTY.
Chinese: <<那声音不自然地低沉平板，像是经过处理来掩饰原主。>>##别管我们是谁。你可以把我们当作一方关切人士。

English: <<The voice is unnaturally deep and toneless, as if it's been modified to disguise who it belongs to.>> ##HA HA HA. NO, THIS IS NOT APHRA. CONSIDER US AN INTERESTED PARTY.
Chinese: <<那声音不自然地低沉平板，像是经过处理来掩饰原主。>>##哈哈。不，这不是阿芙拉。把我们当作一方关切人士即可。

English: WE HAVE BEEN WATCHING YOU THROUGH KING'S EYES. WE KNOW ABOUT APHRA AND HER <<skrrrsshhh>>. ((DO NOT TRUST HER)). HER PUNCHCARD MUST NOT <<skkkkrrrrrrssssssshhh>>.
Chinese: 我们一直在透过国王的眼睛观察你。阿芙拉和她的<<嗞啦>>我们都清楚。((不要信任她))。她的打孔卡绝不能<<咔啦啦啦嘶嘶>>。

English: WE CANNOT MAINTAIN <<skrrrsshhh>> MUCH LONGER. IF YOU WISH TO <<sssdddkkrrtttttrsddddhh>> FIND A MARKET TRADER NAMED [[REZA]] DOWN <<skkkrrssshhh>> IN [[FERROPOLIS]] AND ASK <<skkrrssshhh>> THE [[SEVENTH LETTER]]"."
Chinese: 我们无法再维持<<嗞啦>>多久了。如果你想<<嘶嗞咔啦嗞嘶嘶>>，去<<咔啦嘶嘶>>[[铁城]]找市场摊贩[[雷扎]]，问<<咔啦嘶嘶>>[[第七个字母]]"。"

English: <<There is no answer, save for the roar of static.>>
Chinese: <<再没有回答，只剩静电的轰鸣。>>

English: <<There is nothing more, save for the roar of static.>>
Chinese: <<再没有别的了，只剩静电的轰鸣。>>

English: <<The royal beacon's control panel hums and crackles with magic. An indicator light beside the label DEBUG MODE" is flashing red.>>"
Chinese: <<皇家信标的控制面板在魔法中嗡鸣作响。调试模式"标签旁的指示灯闪着红光。>>"

English: <<There is a mechanical thunk. Something seems to have changed, at any rate.>>
Chinese: <<咔的一声机械闷响。不管怎样，似乎有什么变了。>>

English: <<The indicator light next to 'DEBUG MODE' winks out.>>
Chinese: <<"调试模式"旁的指示灯熄灭了。>>

English: [Insert the punchcard with the King's message]
Chinese: [插入载有国王讯息的打孔卡]

English: ...Mikhail? Is that you?
Chinese: ……米哈伊尔？是你吗？

English: Sorry, are you talking to me?
Chinese: 抱歉，你在跟我说话？

English: This is Guild business, Mikhail. Don't interfere.
Chinese: 这是公会公务，米哈伊尔。别掺和。

English: What was that about the seventh letter?
Chinese: 刚才说的第七个字母是怎么回事？

English: Wait, where exactly do I find Reza?
Chinese: 等等，雷扎到底在哪找？

English: Hello? Who's there?
Chinese: 喂？谁在那儿？

English: ...Aphra? Is that you?
Chinese: ……阿芙拉？是你吗？

English: Why shouldn't I trust her?
Chinese: 为什么我不能信任她？

English: What's wrong with her punchcard?
Chinese: 她的打孔卡有什么问题？

English: That's rich coming from someone who won't reveal their identity.
Chinese: 连身份都不敢亮的人，说这话可真有意思。

English: <<You are confronted by a middle-aged man with piercing eyes and a bushy, well-kept salt-and-pepper beard.>> ##Halt in the name of the King!
Chinese: <<拦住你的是个中年男子，目光锐利，蓄着修剪整齐的花白络腮胡。>>##以国王之名，站住！

English: Traveller, you are hereby detained in the name of Its Majesty the [[Clockwork King]]. Please don't do yourself a mischief by resisting.
Chinese: 旅人，你现已被[[发条王]]陛下扣留。请勿抵抗，免得自讨苦吃。

English: Irrelevant. You are here and you have an appointment. Call it fate, if you believe in such primitive things.
Chinese: 无关紧要。你人在这里，而且有预约。称之为命运吧，若你信这种原始东西的话。

English: <<He narrows his eyes at you.>> Silence! That is of no import to me.
Chinese: <<他眯眼看你。>>闭嘴！那与我无关。

English: I am [[Sunil]], the King's Speaker, first among equals of the [[Machinists' Guild]]. In its ever-advancing wisdom, Its Majesty has requested your presence in the audience chamber at the [[Machinarium]]. This is not optional.
Chinese: 我是[[苏尼尔]]，国王代言人，[[机械师公会]]同侪之首。以陛下日进弥新的智慧，已传召你前往[[机械殿]]觐见厅。此事无可商量。

English: That is a mystery even my wit has yet to penetrate. Be that as it may, I serve the King's will; it is not necessary that I understand it. ##Militia, if you please...?
Chinese: 这连我的机智也无从参透。尽管如此，我奉行国王的意志；我无需理解它。##民兵队，请吧……？

English: %% <<Sunil studies you like a pinned butterfly. You can almost see cogs turning in his mind as he weighs his scepticism against the cost of potential disloyalty.>> ##...I see. Well then, citizen, follow me to the Machinarium.
Chinese: %% <<苏尼尔像端详针插上的蝴蝶一样打量你。你几乎能看见他脑中的齿轮在转动，权衡着怀疑与不忠的代价。>>##……我明白了。那么，公民，跟我去机械殿吧。

English: && <<Sunil studies you like a pinned butterfly. Then he snorts.>> Militia, arrest this nitwit. No need to be gentle. ##<<The guards close in...>>
Chinese: && <<苏尼尔像端详针插上的蝴蝶一样打量你，随即嗤笑。>>民兵队，拿下这个蠢货。不必客气。##<<卫兵们围了上来……>>

English: What? Why?
Chinese: 什么？为什么？

English: But I haven't done anything.
Chinese: 可我什么都没干啊。

English: All right, all right, I'll give back all the treasure.
Chinese: 好好好，我把宝藏全还回来。

English: What does the King want with me?
Chinese: 国王找我做什么？

English: @@ Ah yes, of course! I have important information for Its Majesty, for its ears only. Convey me thither, my good man.
Chinese: @@ 啊对，当然！我有要事启奏国王陛下，只可入其尊耳。引路吧，好人。

English: I will not ask what passed between you – it is enough for me that the King's will is done. However, Its Majesty has given no further instructions regarding your presence. I trust you'll see yourself out.
Chinese: 你们之间谈了什么，我不会过问——国王的意志得以贯彻，于我足矣。不过，陛下对你的去留再无进一步指示。请自行告退吧。

English: There, wasn't that exciting? Now begone. I have better uses for my thoughtpower than to expend any more of it on you.
Chinese: 好了，是不是很刺激？现在请走吧。我的思力还有更好的去处，不必再浪费在你身上。

English: <<Sunil's nostrils flare.>> No, you do not. Its Majesty is quite capable of appraising me of its concerns directly, and my staff will review the logs of your audience. Begone; I will not ask you again.
Chinese: <<苏尼尔鼻孔一张。>>不，你没有。陛下完全有能力直接向我垂询，我的属员会审阅你觐见的日志。请便；我不会再请你。

English: <<Sunil waves his hand, and a cipher sigil shines in the air. You suddenly find you cannot move or speak.>>
Chinese: <<苏尼尔一挥手，一道密文符印在空中亮起。你忽然发现自己动弹不得，也说不出话。>>

English: ((Enough.)) Hear me, traveller: Its Majesty's edicts are complex, and easily misunderstood by one such as you. Any task of true import will be noted and addressed.##You are finished here.
Chinese: ((够了。))听着，旅人：陛下的敕令深奥复杂，你这类人极易误解。任何真正要紧的差事自会被记录、被处理。##你可以走了。

English: Its Majesty's edicts are complex, and easily misunderstood by one such as you. Any task of true import will be noted and addressed.##You are finished here.
Chinese: 陛下的敕令深奥复杂，你这类人极易误解。任何真正要紧的差事自会被记录、被处理。##你可以走了。

English: Wait! I need to tell you the King's message!
Chinese: 等等！我得把国王的讯息告诉你！

English: Fine, I'm going...
Chinese: 好吧，我走……

English: But the King chose me for the Sacramental Duty! It said there'd be a critical reality –
Chinese: 可国王亲选我执行圣礼职责！它说会有个关键的现实——

English: Mmmh mmmphh mmmh MMPH!!
Chinese: 唔唔姆唔姆唔姆 MMPH！！

English: Mrrrmh mrrr mmmph...
Chinese: 姆唔姆唔唔唔……

English: Fine, I'm going.
Chinese: 好吧，我走。

English: Do not keep Its Majesty waiting.
Chinese: 莫让陛下久候。

English: Make all proper obeisances upon entry. Do not speak until spoken to. You may address Its Majesty aloud, with your voice. Once dismissed, walk backwards to the door. ((Never)) turn your back on Its Majesty.
Chinese: 入内时行全套觐见礼。未蒙垂询，不得开口。你可以出声觐见，用自己的嗓音。一旦获准退下，倒退至门边。((切莫))以背向君。

English: Speak quickly, citizen; my time is in high demand.
Chinese: 长话短说，公民；我的时间千金难买。

English: <<Sunil eyes you with barely suppressed fury.>> ##The only reason you are not in manacles is because Its Majesty wills it so. Now be off with you, and let the adults work.
Chinese: <<苏尼尔看你时压着满腔怒火。>>##你没戴镣铐，唯一的原因是陛下愿意如此。现在请便吧，让大人们办正事。

English: Are we finished here?
Chinese: 我们的事办完了吗？

English: By thwarting Aphra's treason you have ensured the Clockwork Kingdom will advance into a new era of prosperity. Well done.
Chinese: 你挫败了阿芙拉的叛国图谋，确保发条王国迈向繁荣的新纪元。干得漂亮。

English: Although standard barometers of common good are as yet unchanged, our projections assume some delay in reporting. Long is the way, and hard, that out of hell leads up to the light.
Chinese: 虽然公共善业的各项常规指标尚无变化，但我们的预测模型假定上报存在时滞。出地狱而向光明之路，其修远，其多艰。

English: As predicted, we are seeing a reduction in fault reports and improvement in our standard barometers of common good. Evidently we were correct to stay the course. Although there have been some rather unusual invocations...
Chinese: 正如所料，故障报告正在减少，公共善业各项常规指标向好。坚持航向显然是正确的。尽管也出现了一些相当……不寻常的调用。

English: Pester me not, citizen. Concerning reports reach us from all corners of the realm. Doubtless these stem from misunderstandings or temporary epiphenomena, but nevertheless they require my utmost attention.
Chinese: 别来烦我，公民。来自王国四面八方的报告令人忧心。无疑这些不过是误解或暂时的伴随现象，但它们仍需我全力以赴。

English: No need to be alarmed. Our best minds are investigating the apparition. In the meantime, carry on with your business.
Chinese: 不必惊慌。我们最优秀的头脑正在调查那 apparition。其间，各安其业即可。

English: The one I told you not to mention to me again?
Chinese: 就是那个我不许你再跟我提的人？

English: As I told you: in the [[underpass]] at the foot of the [[Machinarium]]. Next time you want directions, ask the Militia.
Chinese: 正如我说过的：在[[机械殿]]脚下那条[[地下通道]]里。下回想问路，找民兵队去。

English: Have you considered reading a book?
Chinese: 你考虑过读书吗？

English: Is that all? My patience is remarkable, but not infinite.
Chinese: 就这些？我的耐心非同一般，但并非无穷无尽。

English: Take notes this time; you will remember it better. ##I am [[Sunil]], the King's Speaker, first among equals of the [[Machinists' Guild]]. We are servants of Its Majesty and therefore, axiomatically, servants of the people.
Chinese: 这次记好笔记，你会记得更牢。##我是[[苏尼尔]]，国王代言人，[[机械师公会]]同侪之首。我们是陛下的仆人，因而公理使然，也是人民的仆人。

English: As a being of unimaginable thoughtpower, the King's will is not always easy to fathom. Hence, at this stage, the people depend on us to deduce and explain Its Majesty's wishes.
Chinese: 身为思力无可想象的存有，国王的意志并非总能为人所测。所以在这个阶段，人民要靠我们去推演、阐释陛下的意愿。

English: The King also has many enemies. Wreckers, god worshippers, Apostatic Union spies, and the vile [[Saboteur]]... all exploit the complexity of these matters to mislead our people, offering simple lies in place of the subtle truth.
Chinese: 国王亦树敌众多。破坏分子、神信徒、叛教联盟的间谍，还有卑劣的[[破坏者]]……全都利用这些事务的复杂性蒙骗我们的人民，以浅白的谎言顶替精微的真相。

English: They stop at nothing to destroy what we have built, and so the Guild will stop at nothing to stamp them out. Take care you do not aid them, wittingly or otherwise.
Chinese: 他们为摧毁我们的成就无所不用其极，因此公会也将无所不用其极地根除他们。你可当心，莫要有意无意助纣为虐。

English: You will refer to Its Majesty properly as 'the King' or 'Its Majesty'.
Chinese: 称呼陛下时，应当用"国王"或"国王陛下"。

English: Correct, albeit a gross understatement. Our King is the greatest assembly of cipher magic made by mortal hands since the days of ancient Emberia.
Chinese: 没错，尽管这说法保守得离谱。我们的国王是自古余烬时代以来，凡人之手所造的最宏大的密文魔法集合体。

English: After the God War, this land was mired in factional disagreements. The people needed one leader with wisdom, justice, and unquestionable authority. Traditional methods of selecting such a ruler had demonstrably failed. And so we made our monarch with our own hands.
Chinese: 神之战后，这片土地深陷派系纷争。人民需要一位兼具智慧、正义与无可置疑权威的唯一领袖。而选举这类统治者的传统办法已被证明失灵。于是我们亲手造出了自己的君主。

English: The King has unlocked safety and plenty not seen for centuries. Every day ordinary people invoke its magic to summon goods or improve their lives. Yes, there are glitches, mistakes even. Those are potholes on the path to a living paradise.
Chinese: 国王解锁了几百年来无人得见的安宁与丰饶。每天都有普通民众invoke它的魔法召唤货物、改善生活。是的，有小故障，甚至有过错。那是通往活体天堂路上的坑洼。

English: <<Sunil smirks.>> I see you are familiar with Union propaganda. But your statement is disproven by basic principles of theology.
Chinese: <<苏尼尔嘿嘿一笑。>>看来你对联盟的宣传挺熟。可惜你这论断，连神学的基本原理都过不了。

English: A god's desires are alien; the King's desires mirror our own. Gods dictate their contracts; the King's terms were set by us.
Chinese: 神的欲望是异己的；国王的欲望映照我们自己。神单向制定契约；国王的条款由我们拟定。

English: The Union likes to say that they 'liberated' magic from gods and their Wikkan flunkies. Yet when some of us proposed to liberate it further – into common hands – their zeal suddenly deserted them.
Chinese: 联盟爱说，是他们把魔法从神和维坎走狗手里"解放"了出来。可当我们中有人提议把它进一步解放——解放到平民手中——他们的热忱忽然就没了。

English: In truth, the Union's elite saw the God War as a means to greater power. They ((liked)) controlling access to land and sorcery, and baulked at following their ideas to the logical end. So be it. We will obsolesce them by example.
Chinese: 实际上，联盟的权贵把神之战当成攫取更大权力的工具。他们((喜欢))垄断土地与法术的准入，不肯把自家理念推到逻辑的终点。那就随他们去。我们会用榜样的力量让他们过时。

English: That is a myth, spread by the [[Saboteur]] and other foreign agents. While some regions are experiencing temporary shortages in specific items, all our measurements of overall supply are within acceptable bounds.
Chinese: 那是[[破坏者]]等外国特工散布的谣言。虽然个别地区确有特定物资的暂时短缺，但我们所有总体供应的测量数据都在可接受范围之内。

English: The facts, if you care about such things, show that Its Majesty has been forced to undertake a controlled and ((temporary)) climactic realignment in order to offset the effects of previous sabotage and increase the long-term fertility of our soil.
Chinese: 事实——假如你在乎事实的话——表明：为抵消此前破坏行为的后果、提高我国土壤的长期肥力，陛下不得不进行一次受控且((暂时))的气候重整。

English: By the way, have you visited Hallowshire lately? How equitably would you say the famine is being dealt with by their nobles, their Polymaths, their Inquisition?
Chinese: 顺便问一句，你最近去过哈洛郡吗？你觉得那边的饥荒，他们的贵族、博学家、宗教裁判所处理得有多公平？

English: When goods are in shortage, ((our)) ruler apportions them rationally, based on unshakeable principles of fairness. It is the Saboteur who disrupts this fair distribution by damaging Its Majesty's functions and hoarding its gifts to profit on the black market.
Chinese: 物资短缺时，((我们的))统治者依据颠扑不破的公平原则进行理性配给。破坏这一公平分配的正是破坏者——他们损毁陛下的职能、囤积陛下的恩赐，好在黑市牟利。

English: Your zeal is commendable, but we have adequate resources. Although...##Perhaps there is one thing. Less a job than an indulgence. No reward; just an ageing man's thanks.
Chinese: 你的热忱值得称赞，但我们的资源足够。不过……##倒是有件事。与其说是差事，不如说是一点私心。没有报酬；只有一位老人的一声谢谢。

English: Your zeal is commendable, but we have adequate resources. For now. ##Come back [[in future]], and perhaps I shall have something fit for you.
Chinese: 你的热忱值得称赞，但我们的资源足够。目前而言。##[[日后]]再来，说不定我会有些适合你的差事。

English: There is a [[missing persons noticeboard]] in the underpass at the foot of the Machinarium. Citizens mourning their loved ones, sadly lost to the Corruption or... other factors.
Chinese: 机械殿脚下的地下通道里有一块[[失踪人口告示板]]。哀悼挚亲的公民留在上面——他们的亲人不幸被腐化夺走，或……因其他因素失踪。

English: Technically much of it is treasonous, but we allow it to remain as a... pressure valve, if you will.
Chinese: 严格来说，上面不少内容属于叛国言论，但我们容许它留着，算是……一个泄压阀吧。

English: On my last visit I saw a message from a grieving father. [[Olaf]], I think, or perhaps [[Omar]], seeking his missing child. Call it sentiment, but it moved me.
Chinese: 我上次去时，看到一位丧子的父亲留下的讯息。叫[[奥拉夫]]，或许叫[[奥马尔]]，在寻找他失踪的孩子。算是人之常情吧，它打动了我。

English: If you choose to help him, do not tell me the result. The King's Speaker should not exhibit bias or partiality to any one citizen.
Chinese: 你若决定帮他，结果不必告诉我。国王代言人不应表现出对任何单一公民的偏向或偏袒。

English: <<Sunil fixes you with an intense gaze.>> ##((Is)) she now?
Chinese: <<苏尼尔目光如炬地盯住你。>>##((现在))是吗？

English: <<Sunil fixes you with an intense gaze.>> Well?
Chinese: <<苏尼尔目光如炬地盯住你。>>哦？

English: <<You tell Sunil about Aphra's plan to reform the King. He listens intently, without visible emotion.>>
Chinese: <<你向苏尼尔和盘托出阿芙拉改造国王的计划。他凝神听完，不形于色。>>

English: It is good that you came to me. To enact such a speculative and radical spell behind her colleagues' backs – without safeguards, and in grave defiance of royal protocol – would endanger everything we have worked for; the entire Kingdom and the lives of everyone in it.
Chinese: 你来找我，很好。背着她的同僚施展如此投机而激进的法术——没有防护措施，还严重违反王室规程——将危及我们的一切成就；危及整个王国和其中每一个人的性命。

English: But... I will need proof. Aphra does have allies within the Guild. A romantic like her would never have made it this far otherwise. ##Once upon a time, I would have considered myself among them.
Chinese: 但是……我需要证据。公会给阿芙拉内应不少。她这样的浪漫主义者若没有帮衬，走不到今天。##曾几何时，我自己也算其中之一。

English: My, my, aren't we enterprising? Yes, that will do.
Chinese: 哎呀呀，真是能干。好，这就够了。

English: Go along with her little scheme, and once you have [[her spell]], bring it to me. If nothing else, I'm curious to see what she's written.
Chinese: 配合她的小把戏，等你拿到[[她的法术]]，带给我。至少，我很好奇她写了些什么。

English: Do this, citizen, and your reward shall be great. The King provides for those who demonstrate their loyalty.
Chinese: 办成此事，公民，你的赏赐不会少。国王庇佑展现忠诚之人。

English: %% Oh, everyone could. Her talents were not in question; her judgement was. I fought for her when others doubted her ability to see the bigger picture. It seems that they were right and I was wrong.
Chinese: %% 哦，谁都看得出来。她的才干从无人质疑；遭质疑的是她的判断。别人怀疑她看不到大局时，是我为她力争。如今看来，他们是对的，我错了。

English: && What I saw in her is no longer relevant. If what you say is true, she is a traitor and an existential threat to this kingdom.
Chinese: && 我曾看好她什么，已无关紧要。若你所说属实，她就是叛徒，是这个王国的存亡之患。

English: The Kingdom thanks you, citizen. We'll take it from here.
Chinese: 王国感谢你，公民。接下来交给我们。

English: Was there something more?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗？

English: <<Sunil stares directly into your soul; your eyes are merely in the way.>> ##Now the ((other)) punchcard, if you please. The one you picked up down in the bazaar. Rather a fruitful shopping trip, wouldn't you say?
Chinese: <<苏尼尔直直看进你的灵魂；你的眼睛不过是碍事。>>##现在，请拿出((另一张))打孔卡。你在市场淘到的那张。这一趟购物收获颇丰，不是吗？

English: We'd long hoped that keeping [[Reza]] under surveillance, rather than in irons, would lead us to the other Saboteurs. This plot of Aphra's forced them to take risks, and we have already been able to identify several of their comrades.
Chinese: 我们一直期盼，对[[雷扎]]只监视不上铐，能顺藤摸瓜找到其他破坏者。阿芙拉这场图谋逼他们铤而走险，我们已确认了好几名同伙。

English: By tomorrow they will have joined Reza in custody, and the Kingdom will be far safer for it. You have my gratitude.
Chinese: 明天他们就将与雷扎一同收押，王国也将因此安全许多。感谢你。

English: Reza is known to us. They are ((not)) the Saboteur, merely another figurehead. Doubtless they will already be gone. Still, you are to be commended for your... candour.
Chinese: 雷扎我们早有备案。((他们))不是破坏者，不过是又一个台前人物。想必早已溜之大吉。不过，你的……坦率，仍值得称道。

English: She won't be killed, if that's what you mean. What a waste that would be. This spell is incredible – treasonous, but incredible. We will make some adjustments to her outlook, so that her talents are better directed in future.
Chinese: 她不会被处死，如果你问的是这个。那多浪费。这个法术妙不可言——叛国，但妙不可言。我们会微调一下她的观念，让她的才干今后有更好的用场。

English: You shall have it, with one proviso. Knowledge of these events is best kept within the Guild, for future analysis. It would serve no end to let them fester in the thousand mouths of rumour, or feed our still hungrier enemies.
Chinese: 赏赐照给，只有一个条件。这些事件的知情范围最好留在公会内部，以备日后分析。若让它们在千万张传谣的嘴里发酵，或喂饱我们更饥饿的敌人，毫无益处。

English: <<Sunil unfurls a scroll covered in a dizzying latticework of cipher symbols, then offers you a sharp pin.>> ##You will drop your blood on this page, and bind yourself to silence on these matters in perpetuity.
Chinese: <<苏尼尔展开一卷写满令人眼花缭乱的密文符号的卷轴，递给你一枚尖针。>>##你将在这页纸上滴血，就此立誓对这些事务永守缄默。

English: Then your reward is forfeit. Surely it is not so great a price, considering what you have done already?
Chinese: 那你的赏赐就取消了。想想你已经做过的事，这点代价不算大吧？

English: <<As your blood hits the parchment, an electric shiver passes through you. Something tightens in your throat, then swallows itself.>> ##<<You somehow know you can never speak of this again.>>
Chinese: <<血珠落在羊皮纸上，一阵电流般的战栗掠过你的全身。喉咙里有什么东西收紧，随即咽了下去。>>##<<你莫名确知：此事你此生再不能提起。>>

English: Now, tell me, for what task are you being rewarded?
Chinese: 那么说说看，你因何差事受赏？

English: Excellent. Best of luck in your life ahead, citizen. A more comfortable life, thanks to your good deeds.
Chinese: 好极了。愿你往后的日子顺遂，公民。托你的善行，日子会更舒坦。

English: <<He looks at you like you're a weird insect he's caught, then snorts.>> ##As you wish. May your pride prove worthy of the price you have set on it.
Chinese: <<他看你像看一只落网的怪虫，随即嗤笑。>>##随你的便。愿你的骄傲，配得上你给它开的价钱。

English: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have work to do.
Chinese: 那么，恕不奉陪，我还有正事。

English: Speak no more; it is not my business.
Chinese: 别再提了；与我无关。

English: <<Sunil narrows his eyes at you.>> ##Am I meant to recognise that name?
Chinese: <<苏尼尔眯眼看你。>>##你以为我该认得这个名字？

English: <<Sunil narrows his eyes at you.>> ##As I told you, the things recorded in the Library of Untruths are fictions; they never happened. With that proviso...
Chinese: <<苏尼尔眯眼看你。>>##正如我说过的：虚言图书馆里的记录皆是虚构；那些事从未发生。在此前提下……

English: <<Sunil looks at you with a hint of surprise, the first time you've seen him off-balance.>> ##How did you...?
Chinese: <<苏尼尔看着你，眼里掠过一丝惊讶——这是你头一次见他乱了阵脚。>>##你是怎么……？

English: <<You tell Sunil what you discovered about Oleg's daughter, Aphra. When you're finished, he sighs.>> ##I suppose it ((was)) I who set you on this trail.
Chinese: <<你向苏尼尔讲出你在奥列格女儿阿芙拉身上的发现。你讲完时，他叹了口气。>>##把这条路指给你的人，想来((正是))我。

English: <<You tell Sunil what you discovered about Oleg's daughter, Aphra. When you're finished, he sighs.>> ##My, you ((have)) been inquisitive. Were your loyalties not so obviously suspect, you might even have made a good Interpreter.
Chinese: <<你向苏尼尔讲出你在奥列格女儿阿芙拉身上的发现。你讲完时，他叹了口气。>>##哎呀呀，你倒((真是))好奇得很。要不是你的忠诚如此可疑，你本可以成为一名称职的释经官。

English: So? What is it you imagine you will get from me?
Chinese: 那么？你以为能从我这里得到什么？

English: The things recorded in the Library of Untruths are fictions; they never happened. We are discussing imaginary hypotheticals. Do you understand?
Chinese: 虚言图书馆里记录的都是虚构；那些事从未发生。我们讨论的是假想的假设。明白吗？

English: <<Oddly, Sunil smiles.>> ##'In a certain land, in a certain kingdom, very far away from here...' Yes. Quite so.
Chinese: <<奇怪的是，苏尼尔笑了。>>##"在很远很远的地方，有一片国土，有一个王国……"是了。正是如此。

English: In a certain land, there was a king with magical powers. One day the King's retainers asked if he could use his magic to transform people into their best selves. The King agreed, but first ordered a test.
Chinese: 在某一国度，有一位身负魔法之力的国王。一日，国王的臣仆问，可否用他的魔法把人改造成最好的自己。国王应允了，但下令先行试验。

English: The King's retainers would scour the land to find six people who between them embodied all its variation in character and temperament. The King would then multiply each candidate sixfold, changing every copy in a different way.
Chinese: 国王的臣仆会走遍全国，找到六个人，让他们合起来囊括了国民性情气质的一切差异。然后国王把每位候选者复制六份，以不同的方式改造每一个副本。

English: The original candidates would remain unchanged, to see what happened when the King did nothing. And, to keep the test pure, the King would make all 36 subjects forget they were ever part of it.
Chinese: 原初候选者保持原样，以观察国王无所作为时会怎样。而且，为保证实验纯粹，国王让全部 36 名受试者忘掉自己曾参与其中。

English: The sixth candidate, [[Aphra]], was wild and disobedient, showing little promise. Yet it was one of their copies – the sixth, in fact – who proved wisest of all. And so the King was satisfied, and began using his magic to create many more good and faithful subjects.
Chinese: 第六位候选者[[阿芙拉]]，狂野不服管教，看不出什么前程。然而，他们众多副本中的一个——恰好也是第六个——却被证明是最有智慧的。于是国王心满意足，开始用他的魔法批量创造更多善良忠顺的臣民。

English: The sixth candidate, [[Aphra]], was wild and disobedient, showing little promise. Yet it was one of their copies – the sixth, in fact – who proved wisest of all.
Chinese: 第六位候选者[[阿芙拉]]，狂野不服管教，看不出什么前程。然而，他们众多副本中的一个——恰好也是第六个——却被证明是最有智慧的。

English: And so the King was satisfied, and began using his magic to create many more good and faithful subjects.
Chinese: 于是国王心满意足，开始用他的魔法批量创造更多善良忠顺的臣民。

English: It was a great sorrow when the original Aphra was consumed by a plague unleashed by the King's enemies. But eventually the plague was defeated, and everyone – or almost everyone – lived happily ever after.
Chinese: 原初的阿芙拉死于国王的敌人释放的一场瘟疫，令人痛惜。但瘟疫终被战胜，所有人——或几乎所有人——从此幸福地生活下去。

English: So. There ends the fairy tale. And there ends your telling of it, if you wish for a happy ending of your own.
Chinese: 如此。童话讲完了。你的讲述也到此为止——如果你还想给自己讨个好结局的话。

English: %% I... recognised his name, yes. My hope was that you might, at most, help him trace her fate. I never imagined you would also unearth her past.
Chinese: %% 我……确实认出了他的名字。我的期望是，你至多帮他查清她的下落。我从未想过你还会把她的过去也挖出来。

English: Project Horoscope laid the foundation of our current prosperity, but its nature always precluded rewarding the participants as I would have liked. Steering you towards Citizen Myshkin was the least I could do for one who has given so much to this kingdom.

Chinese: 我们没工夫耗着。

English: I have another question about Project Horoscope.
Chinese: 关于星象计划，我还有个问题。

English: Chief Interpreter Aphra sent me. We got your message.
Chinese: 首席释经官阿芙拉派我来的。我们收到了你的讯息。

English: You know, the message in the graveyard?
Chinese: 你知道的，墓场里那条讯息？

English: <<[Hum the tune from the graveyard.]>>
Chinese: <<[哼唱墓场里的那段曲调。]>>

English: But weren't you trying to reach out to us? Tell us the problem?
Chinese: 可你不是在设法联系我们吗？告诉我们问题所在？

English: I know about Project Horoscope. Why is that relevant?
Chinese: 我知道星象计划。这有什么相干？

English: Ugh, never mind.
Chinese: 唉，算了。

English: Last time you mentioned my 'purpose'. What did you mean?
Chinese: 上次你提到我的"目的"。什么意思？

English: But before that, what was my purpose?
Chinese: 可在那之前，我的目的是什么？

English: What do you mean, 'uproot reality'?
Chinese: 什么叫"动摇现实"？

English: But I'm still seeking Vela. She's still dangerous.
Chinese: 可我还在追薇拉。她仍然危险。

English: Great, thanks. That clears everything up.
Chinese: 好极了，谢谢。全都清楚了。

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Your majesty, the Guild has sent me to give you a new spell.
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>陛下，公会派我来向您呈献一道新法术。

English: Sunil, the King's Speaker.
Chinese: 苏尼尔，国王代言人。

English: Aphra, the Chief Interpreter.
Chinese: 阿芙拉，首席释经官。

English: It's necessary for the Sacramental Duty.
Chinese: 这是圣礼职责所必需的。

English: <<[Insert Aphra's punchcard, and reform the King.]>>
Chinese: <<[插入阿芙拉的打孔卡，改造国王。]>>

English: <<[Insert Reza's punchcard, and kill the King.]>>
Chinese: <<[插入雷扎的打孔卡，杀死国王。]>>

English: Actually, wait. We need to discuss something else.
Chinese: 其实，等等。我们得先谈点别的。

English: <<[Enact Aphra's spell]>> Commit.
Chinese: <<[施行阿芙拉的法术]>>执行。

English: <<[Enact Reza's spell]>> Commit.
Chinese: <<[施行雷扎的法术]>>执行。

English: No, cancel that.
Chinese: 不，取消。

English: <<[Dispose of Reza's spell.]>>
Chinese: <<[销毁雷扎的法术。]>>

English: <<[Dispose of Aphra's spell.]>>
Chinese: <<[销毁阿芙拉的法术。]>>

English: I'm not giving you anything.
Chinese: 我什么都不会给你。

English: <<[Slice it out with your blade.]>>
Chinese: <<[用刀刃把它削出来。]>>

English: <<[Tear it out with your hands.]>>
Chinese: <<[用手把它撕出来。]>>

English: Who or what am I talking to right now?
Chinese: 我现在是在跟谁、跟什么东西说话？

English: Tell me about your purpose again.
Chinese: 再讲讲你的目的。

English: You know what, forget I said anything.
Chinese: 算了，就当我没说。

English: Are you saying you created Chief Interpreter Aphra to fix yourself?
Chinese: 你是说，你创造首席释经官阿芙拉是为了修好你自己？

English: But you made Aphra who she is, which led her to write that spell...
Chinese: 可阿芙拉之所以是她，是你塑造的，这才让她写出了那个法术……

English: Did ((you)) send that 'secret message'? Or was it already in her head?
Chinese: 那条"密讯"是((你))发的？还是本来就存在于她脑子里？

English: Fine, I get it.
Chinese: 好吧，我懂了。

English: What kind of peril are you meant to stop?
Chinese: 你被造出来防范的是哪种危难？

English: How did Project Horoscope help your purpose?
Chinese: 星象计划怎么帮到你的目的？

English: I'm done. Let me speak to the King again.
Chinese: 我问完了。让我再和国王说话。

English: But what does Aphra have to do with any of this?
Chinese: 可这一切和阿芙拉有什么关系？

English: ...INVOCATION TRIUMPHANT. [[DEBUG INCARNATION I]] IS NOW MANIFEST. ##THEREFORE, [[QUERY]]: HOW WOULDST THOU PROCEED?
Chinese: ……调召告捷。[[调试化身一号]]现已显现。##因此，[[问询]]：你当如何 proceed？

English: ...INVOCATION TRIUMPHANT. [[DEBUG INCARNATION II]] IS NOW MANIFEST. ##THEREFORE, [[QUERY]]: HOW WOULDST THOU PROCEED?
Chinese: ……调召告捷。[[调试化身二号]]现已显现。##因此，[[问询]]：你当如何 proceed？

English: [[EDICT]]: IT IS SO. ALL HAIL ITS MAJESTY MACHINUS REX, THE CLOCKWORK KING!
Chinese: [[敕令]]：事既如此。万岁，陛下，机械王，发条之王！

English: <<Out of nowhere, you get the random urge to check your pocket...>>##<<Inside, you find a [[scrap of paper]]<< that you've never seen before. >>
Chinese: <<不知从哪来的一阵冲动，你想检查一下口袋……>>##<<里面有一张你从未见过的[[纸条]]。>>

English: <<The enigmatic note reads:>>##We must speak, but hostile eyes are watching.
Chinese: <<神秘字条上写着：>>##我们得谈谈，但敌意在盯着。

English: Meet me after [[nightfall]] in the [[park]] in [[Upper Ferropolis]]. I'll be waiting under the [[gazebo]]. ##Come alone. TRUST NO ONE.##- A Friend
Chinese: [[入夜]]后到[[上铁城]]的[[公园]]来见我。我在[[凉亭]]下等你。##独自前来。谁也别信。##——一位朋友

English: <<The woman smiles at you with a spark in her sea-green eyes that seems truly without malice. Her mechanical arm gives a fluid salutation, while her brooch marks her as a member of the Machinists' Guild.>>
Chinese: <<那女人朝你微笑，海绿色的眼睛里闪着光，那光看起来真的没有恶意。她的机械臂流畅地行了个礼，胸针表明她是机械师公会成员。>>

English: Hello, stranger. Come to escape the world for a bit?
Chinese: 你好呀，陌生人。来躲一躲这个世界？

English: <<Aphra smiles hopefully at you.>> Hello again, stranger. Did you find the mirror?
Chinese: <<阿芙拉满怀希望地朝你微笑。>>又见面了，陌生人。镜子找到了吗？

English: Oh, I'm simply a citizen of Ferropolis, letting my boiler cool. ##<<She sighs.>> Look at this place. They still trust it to run a little wild, you see?
Chinese: 哦，我只是个铁城市民，来给我的锅炉降降温。##<<她叹了口气。>>看看这地方。他们仍然信得过它，任由它撒点野，明白吧？

English: <<She smiles again, oddly melancholy.>> Please, enjoy them.
Chinese: <<她又笑了，笑意里透着奇异的忧郁。>>请慢慢欣赏。

English: Please try, friend. You can't know how important this is.
Chinese: 拜托试试，朋友。你不知道这有多重要。

English: <<Her smile widens.>> So you got my note. Thank you for coming. ##Sorry for the cloak and dagger dance. The Machinarium is... tense right now. Being seen with me would put you in danger.
Chinese: <<她的笑容舒展开来。>>原来你收到我的字条了。谢谢你来。##抱歉搞这么神神秘秘的。机械殿现在……风声很紧。被人看到跟我在一起会给你招来危险。

English: My name is [[Aphra]]. I'm the Chief Interpreter of the [[Machinists' Guild]]. And I am ((very)) excited to meet you.
Chinese: 我叫[[阿芙拉]]。[[机械师公会]]的首席释经官。见到你，我((非常))兴奋。

English: Tell me, friend: which part of yourself do you like the least? If you could change something today, what would it be?
Chinese: 告诉我，朋友：你自己最不喜欢哪一部分？如果今天就能改变一样东西，你会改什么？

English: Oh, honey. I know ((exactly)) how you feel.
Chinese: 哦，亲爱的。我((完全))明白你的感受。

English: By recognising the problem, you've won the first battle.
Chinese: 认识到了问题，你就已经赢了第一仗。

English: If it's any comfort, a lot of those people feel the same way.
Chinese: 如果能让你好受点：很多人也这么觉得。

English: <<She gives you a knowing smile.>> Good for you, sweetie. ##Well, do me a favour and ((imagine)) for a moment. Imagine you're imperfect like the rest of us.
Chinese: <<她心照不宣地朝你微笑。>>有志气，宝贝儿。##嗯，帮我个忙，((想象))一下。想象你跟我们其他人一样有缺憾。

English: Everything. Humour a girl, won't you?
Chinese: 全部。就迁就我一个女孩，好吗？

English: But why should you have to accept that? Why ((shouldn't)) you be able to change it? We live in an age of marvels, increasing every year. Magic is abundant, fizzing in the air and in the stones and in our blood. Why not ((use)) it?
Chinese: 可凭什么你就得接受？凭什么你((不))该有能力改变它？我们活在一个奇迹迭出的时代，年年都有新 marvels。魔法遍地都是，在空气里、石头里、我们的血液里噼啪作响。为什么不用((它))？

English: True, but its dangers can be managed, its costs shared. And what about the cost of leaving things as they are? The... yawning ((abyss)) of suffering that we just call ordinary life? <<She is talking very quickly now.>>
Chinese: 没错，但它的危险可以管理，它的代价可以分摊。可维持现状的代价呢？那种……我们管它叫"普通生活"的、张着大口的((苦难深渊))？<<她语速越来越快。>>

English: And the world as it is contains magic, with its vast power for good. You must acknowledge that, else your 'wisdom' is a fairytale peddled by the powerful to keep us in chains. <<She is talking very quickly now.>>
Chinese: 再说，现实世界里本来就有魔法，有造福众生的伟力。这一点你必须承认，否则你那套"智慧"不过是权贵兜售的童话，好让我们安于枷锁。<<她语速越来越快。>>

English: Yes! Yes, exactly. You understand. So the same question pertains: why should we accept that only the rich and powerful may share in the joy of transfiguration? <<She is talking very quickly now.>>
Chinese: 对！对，正是。你懂了。那么同样的问题依然成立：凭什么只有有钱有势的人才配分享蜕变的喜悦？<<她语速越来越快。>>

English: Ah, you're a magician too? Then you understand. People have this rigid idea of what's possible and what's not, but it's all just make-believe! People have ((no idea)) what is possible. <<She is talking very quickly now.>>
Chinese: 啊，你也是法师？那你就懂了。人们对可能与不可能抱着一套死板的成见，可那全是装神弄鬼！人们对自己能做到什么((毫无概念))。<<她语速越来越快。>>

English: <<She blinks.>> Oh! Yes, of course, the note. Um... ##Listen. You already know something is deeply wrong with this kingdom, don't you? ##You needn't pretend. Anyone can see it, even if they're afraid to say so.
Chinese: <<她眨眨眼。>>哦！对，对，字条。呃……##听着。你已经知道这个王国深处有什么东西非常不对劲了，对吧？##不必装。谁都看得见，哪怕不敢说出口。

English: It's not just the shortages, or this awful winter, or even the Corruption. The King's alterations to reality have lost all rhyme or reason. And things are going ((missing)): people, houses, towns, words, even memories.
Chinese: 不只是物资短缺，不只是这场可怕的寒冬，甚至不只是腐化。国王对现实的改造已经完全乱了章法。而且东西正在((消失))：人、房屋、城镇、词语，甚至记忆。

English: Many people blame the Machinists, but the truth is that even we no longer understand our King's actions. ##Hence, I suspect that all these problems are just different sides of one problem...
Chinese: 很多人怪罪机械师，但事实是，连我们也不再理解我们国王的所作所为。##所以，我怀疑这些问题都只是同一个问题的不同侧面……

English: <<Aphra sighs.>> Really? I suppose I can't blame you. 'He who punishes truth shall never hear it...' ##Let me be the one to speak heresy. This brooch I wear has to be good for something.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉叹了口气。>>是吗？我想我也不能怪你。"惩罚真理者，永远听不见真理……"##那就让我来说这句异端的话吧。我戴的这枚胸针，总得有点用处。

English: Bluntly, the Clockwork King is going mad, and nobody has any idea why. ##That is, nobody except me.
Chinese: 直说了吧：发条王正在发疯，而没有人知道为什么。##准确地说，除了我。

English: As Chief Interpreter, my sacred duty is to analyse Its Majesty's wishes. I've become convinced that the King is trying to tell us something huge – something we don't want to hear.
Chinese: 作为首席释经官，我的神圣职责是解析陛下的意愿。我已深信：国王正试图告诉我们一件大事——一件我们不想听的事。

English: What ((exactly)) did the King say to you?##[[Speaker Sunil]] won't let me read the logs until he's redacted any confidential" information. But that'll take months, and we may not ((have)) months."
Chinese: 国王((究竟))跟你说了什么？##[[代言人苏尼尔]]要先把机密"信息涂黑才让我看日志。可那要好几个月，而我们可能((没有))几个月。"

English: The Sacramental Duty? I've never heard of such a thing. Didn't it explain what that means?
Chinese: 圣礼职责？我从没听说过这种东西。它没解释那是什么意思吗？

English: <<Aphra blinks.>> A critical...? Oh ((no)). It's happening even faster than I thought. ##Did the King say how to avert it?
Chinese: <<阿芙拉眨眨眼。>>一个关键……？哦((不))。事态恶化得比我想的还快。##国王有没有说怎么避免？

English: Of course. Those symbols the King spits out are Sixfold cipher language. I could read them easily, if only I could access the logs. Damn it all, Sunil, why won't you ((listen))?
Chinese: 当然。国王吐出的那些符号是六重密文语言。我要是能访问日志，轻轻松松就能读懂。都怪苏尼尔，你为什么就是不肯((听))？

English: Friend, this confirms my worst fears. <<Her speech quickens.>> Because don't you see? It's all connected! If cipher is the true language of reality, and cipher magic is powered by cognition, that means we must account for ((all)) relevant cognition within a defined thaumospace...
Chinese: 朋友，这印证了我最坏的担忧。<<她语速加快。>>因为你还不明白吗？这一切都连在一起！如果密文是现实的真语言，密文魔法的动力是认知，那就意味着，我们必须把一个确定的秘法空间内((所有))相关认知都纳入核算……

English: ...which in this case is a whole ((kingdom)). Now, Karak's Law states that the cumulative cipheric interactions of ((n)) cognitive entities may be expressed as a six-dimensional vermiform manifold according to the function –
Chinese: ……而在这个例子里，秘法空间是((整个王国))。根据卡拉特定律，((n)) 个认知实体的密文交互累积，可以按函数表达为一个六维蠕虫状流形——

English: <<She stops and takes a deep breath.>> I'm sorry. This... isn't going how I imagined. It's all just so ((damnably)) tangled up together. ##If only...
Chinese: <<她停下，深吸一口气。>>抱歉。这……跟我预想的不一样。这一切((可恨地))纠缠在一起。##要是……

English: There is a house here in Ferropolis. It's scheduled for... removal, but I've ensured a delay. Long enough for you to visit. ##Take this [[key]]. Inside the house, you'll find a [[mirror]]. Walk through it.
Chinese: 铁城有一栋房子。它被排进了……拆除计划，但我设法让它推迟了。足够你进去看看。##拿上这把[[钥匙]]。在房子里，你会找到一面[[镜子]]。穿过去。

English: <<Aphra smiles cryptically.>> Correct.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉高深莫测地一笑。>>正确。

English: The house is tucked away on the lowest level of the city – what locals call the [[Conduits]]. It's rather a warren down there, so you might have to search a bit.
Chinese: 那栋房子藏在城市最低层——本地人叫它[[导管区]]。下面七弯八绕的，你可能得找一阵子。

English: The Conduits are hardly a savoury place, but you do meet such ((interesting)) people. I used to love visiting the bazaar, back when I was just a Junior Interpreter.
Chinese: 导管区算不上什么高雅地方，但你会遇到很多((有趣))的人。当年我还只是个初级释经官的时候，就爱逛那里的集市。

English: Alas, with my present rank, it would be most unwise for me to be seen there.
Chinese: 唉，以我如今的职级，被人看到在那儿就太不明智了。

English: Quite dangerous, yes. But then again, only a little more so than simply being in the Kingdom in the first place. ##Dress warmly, don't linger in one place for too long, and try not to ((touch)) anything.
Chinese: 相当危险，是的。话说回来，也不过比待在王国里危险那么一点点。##穿暖和点，别在一个地方久留，尽量别((碰))任何东西。

English: <<She snaps her mechanical fingers.>> That's it. You need to see it for yourself.
Chinese: <<她打了个机械响指。>>就是这个。你需要亲眼看看。

English: <<Aphra leaps between apparently unrelated topics at dizzying speed, growing increasingly flustered as she struggles to express the contours of some vast structure inside her head. Sometimes you glimpse details, but the overall shape eludes you.>>
Chinese: <<阿芙拉以令人目眩的速度在看似不相关的话题间跳跃，越来越慌乱，拼命想描摹出她脑中某个庞大结构的轮廓。有时你能瞥见一些细节，但整体形状始终抓不住。>>

English: Might I ask your name?
Chinese: 能请教您的名字吗？

English: Are you 'a friend', by any chance?
Chinese: 您该不会就是"一位朋友"吧？

English: I'll just enjoy the trees, then.
Chinese: 那我就欣赏欣赏树好了。

English: Are you... 'a friend'?
Chinese: 你是……"一位朋友"吗？

English: Don't mind me, I'm just enjoying the trees.
Chinese: 别管我，我就是来欣赏树的。

English: Tell me again how to reach this mirror.
Chinese: 再讲一遍怎么去那面镜子。

English: Not yet.
Chinese: 还没有。

English: Charmed, I'm sure.
Chinese: 幸会幸会。

English: Why?
Chinese: 为什么？

English: I don't like the sound of that.
Chinese: 这听着可不妙。

English: My body. I've always struggled to look my reflection in the eye.
Chinese: 我的身体。我一直不敢直视镜中的自己。

English: My heart. I wish I were kinder, slower to anger, quicker to trust.
Chinese: 我的心。真希望我能更善良，更不容易动怒，更容易信任人。

English: My charisma. It feels like everyone is sharing a joke I don't get.
Chinese: 我的魅力。感觉所有人都在分享一个我听不懂的笑话。

English: [Lie] Nothing. I'm happy with myself.
Chinese: [撒谎] 没什么。我对自己很满意。

English: What does this have to do with anything?
Chinese: 这跟任何事情有什么关系吗？

English: Magic is dangerous, and it always has its price.
Chinese: 魔法很危险，而且总伴随着代价。

English: Wisdom lies in accepting the world as it is.
Chinese: 智慧在于接受世界的本来面目。

English: Because I'm not rich or powerful. It's that simple.
Chinese: 因为我既没钱也没势。就这么简单。

English: I plan to. I just haven't figured out how yet.
Chinese: 我打算改。只是还没想清楚怎么改。

English: But what does this have to do with your note?
Chinese: 可这跟你的字条有什么关系？

English: Just tell me why you brought me here.
Chinese: 直说吧，你带我到这儿来干什么。

English: Go on...
Chinese: 说下去……

English: I don't know what you mean.
Chinese: 我不明白你的意思。

English: Get to the point.
Chinese: 说重点。

English: It told me to perform the 'Sacramental Duty'.
Chinese: 它让我执行"圣礼职责"。

English: It said there might be a 'critical reality exception'.
Chinese: 它说可能出现"关键现实异常"。

English: Yes, but it was in some weird language I'd never seen.
Chinese: 对，但那是一种我从没见过的怪语言。

English: No, just a bunch of nonsense symbols.
Chinese: 不，就是一堆莫名其妙的符号。

English: <<[Listen intently.]>>
You've completely lost me.
Chinese: 你已经把我彻底绕晕了。

English: I didn't come here for a university lecture!
Chinese: 我又不是来听大学讲课的！

English: You want me to walk through a mirror?
Chinese: 你要我走进一面镜子？

English: Where exactly would I find this house?
Chinese: 那栋房子到底在哪找？

English: Is it dangerous?
Chinese: 危险吗？

English: I'll see what I can do.
Chinese: 我尽力试试。

English: <<Aphra's breath mists in the air as she gives you a wry smile.>> ##You know, we must stop meeting like this.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉朝你露出一个无奈的笑，呼出的气在冷空气里凝成雾。>>##你看，我们总得别再这样见面了。

English: Very well. Shall we depart?
Chinese: 很好。出发？

English: <<Aphra's breath mists in the air as she gives you a wry smile.>> ##Well, fancy seeing you here.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉朝你露出一个无奈的笑，呼出的气在冷空气里凝成雾。>>##哟，真巧，在这儿碰上你。

English: This is all just speculation, you understand.
Chinese: 你要明白，这些全都是推测。

English: The same way you did. I discovered this place by chance about a year ago, and I've been studying it ever since. As far as I can tell, no other living Machinists even know about it.
Chinese: 跟你一样。大约一年前我偶然发现了这个地方，从那时起一直在研究它。据我所知，其他在世的机械师甚至不知道它的存在。

English: My best guess is that we're in a pocket dimension created or repurposed by the King. Alternatively, it could be the very beginning of our cosmos, before the neuron stars were born – or the end, after they've died.
Chinese: 我最好的猜测是：我们在国王建造或改造的一个口袋维度里。另一种可能，这里是宇宙的起点——神经元星诞生之前；或者终点——它们死绝之后。

English: Have you tried to cast spells here? I think the bedrock cipher syntax is ((broken)) somehow, or different. That would mean the clauses defining material objects are left incomplete and loop back into the Void, dumping their energy as they go. And heat is just energy, really.
Chinese: 你在这里试过施法吗？我觉得基础的密文句法((坏))掉了，或者不一样。那就意味着，定义物质对象的子句不完整，回环进了虚空，途中把能量倾泻一空。而热量嘛，说白了就是能量。

English: This hypothesis would be quite heretical in the Apostatic Union, but suffice it to say that the existence of this place calls orthodox cosmology into question.
Chinese: 这个假说在叛教联盟里相当离经叛道，不过这么说吧：这个地方的存在，足以让正统宇宙观打上一个大问号。

English: Yes. ((This)) is what the King has been doing. Everything you see here was vanished from our world by the King's magic. When they vanish, reality adjusts around them as if they were never there.
Chinese: 是的。((这))就是国王一直在干的事。你在这里看到的一切，都是被国王的魔法从我们的世界抹除的。被抹除之后，现实会自行弥合，仿佛它们从未存在过。

English: There are ((hundreds)) of people here. Houses, streets, towns. It's a silent massacre no one's allowed to think about... ##...and it's speeding up.
Chinese: 这里((有几百))人。房屋、街道、整座城镇。这是一场无人被允许去想的静默屠杀……##……而且正在加速。

English: Let's not chat too long, lest we become permanent residents.
Chinese: 咱们别聊太久，免得变成这里的永久居民。

English: Years ago, before I joined the Machinists, we gave the King the power to alter people by magic.##The idea was that a new society would need a new kind of citizen, with new virtues and skills.
Chinese: 多年前，我还没加入机械师公会时，是我们赋予了国王用魔法改造人的权柄。##当时的构想是：新社会需要新型公民，具备新的美德与技能。

English: Before long, my colleagues began using this power to rewrite troublesome personalities, or even erase them from existence. I wish I'd paid closer attention – it wasn't my department, you understand.
Chinese: 没过多久，我的同僚们就开始用这种权柄改写棘手的性格，甚至把人从存在中抹去。真希望我当时多留个心眼——那不归我管，你明白的。

English: But this... this is beyond anything we ever asked for. I've scoured the logs, and almost everything here was vanished by the King on its own initiative. In other words, we've lost control.
Chinese: 可这个……这已经远超我们当初请求的一切。我翻遍了日志：这里几乎所有东西都是国王自行其是抹掉的。换句话说，我们失控了。

English: <<Aphra winces.>> Perhaps. I should have asked more questions, raised more objections. But please believe me: most of my colleagues are not evil people. No one wanted this.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉面露苦色。>>也许吧。我本该多问几句、多提几次异议。但请相信我：我的大多数同僚并不是恶人。没人想要这一切。

English: In fact, I've found evidence of at least twelve missing Machinists from my own department whom nobody remembers. Did any of them try to raise the alarm? Am I ((really)) the first to find this place?
Chinese: 其实，我找到了证据：至少十二名本部门的机械师失踪了，而没有人记得他们。他们中可有人试图示警？找到这个地方的，我((真是))第一个吗？

English: No wonder we always feel so understaffed.
Chinese: 难怪我们总觉得人手不够。

English: Suppose you have two sporemites, and they breed. Then you have four sporemites, and ((they)) breed. So then you have eight sporemites, and ((they)) breed...
Chinese: 假设你有两只孢子螨，它们繁殖了。于是你有四只孢子螨，((它们))又繁殖了。于是你有八只孢子螨，((它们))又繁殖了……

English: <<She waves her hand in mild irritation.>> It's a metaphor. I'm not a farmer.
Chinese: <<她略带恼意地摆摆手。>>这是个比喻。我又不是种地的。

English: Indeed.
Chinese: 确实。

English: <<Aphra looks pained.>> Anything that stays here more than about six and a half hours becomes irrevocably Void-touched, and would disintegrate upon returning to our world. The best we can do is try to stop the inflow.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉神情痛苦。>>任何东西在这里待超过六个半小时左右，就会无可挽回地被虚空浸染，回到我们的世界便会崩解。我们能做到的，只有设法堵住源头。

English: <<Aphra twists up the corner of her mouth in a mirthless smile.>> I was hoping you'd ask that. ##We've lingered here long enough. If you're willing to help, step through this mirror and meet me back in [[Unison Park]], after [[nightfall]].
Chinese: <<阿芙拉嘴角勉强牵出一丝没有笑意的笑。>>我就盼着你问这个。##我们在这儿待得够久了。如果你愿意帮忙，穿过这面镜子，[[入夜]]后到[[合鸣公园]]与我会合。

English: A reasonable stance. But understand: without your aid, there may not be much of a Kingdom left for the rest of us.
Chinese: 情有可原。但你要明白：没有你的相助，等这一切过去，留给我们的王国可能就不剩什么了。

English: Do you know what 'exponential' means?
Chinese: 你知道"指数增长"是什么意思吗？

English: <<The mirror is sealed to you.>>
Chinese: <<镜子对你封闭了。>>

English: <<You recall Aphra telling you to find her in the park at night.>>
Chinese: <<你想起阿芙拉嘱咐过你，夜里去公园找她。>>

English: <<Dust has settled across the glass.##Aphra is gone.>>
Chinese: <<玻璃上落满了尘埃。##阿芙拉已经不在了。>>

English: I have a question about this place.
Chinese: 关于这个地方，我有个问题。

English: I have a question about the vanishings.
Chinese: 关于抹除之事，我有个问题。

English: Let's get out of here.
Chinese: 我们离开这儿吧。

English: How did you get here?
Chinese: 你是怎么到这里来的？

English: What is this place?
Chinese: 这是什么地方？

English: Why is it so cold?
Chinese: 这里怎么这么冷？

English: So this was what you wanted to show me.
Chinese: 原来这就是你想给我看的东西。

English: That's all I needed to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就是这些。

English: How is this possible?
Chinese: 这怎么可能？

English: It sounds like you got your wish.
Chinese: 听起来你如愿以偿了。

English: Let me ask you something else.
Chinese: 我问点别的。

English: What do you mean, it's speeding up?
Chinese: 什么叫正在加速？

English: No.
Chinese: 不知道。

English: Oh shit.
Chinese: 我靠。

English: That's... not how sporemites work.
Chinese: 孢子螨……好像不是这么算的。

English: Can't we help these people? Bring them back somehow?
Chinese: 我们救不了这些人吗？想办法把他们带回来？

English: How can this be stopped?
Chinese: 这要怎么才能阻止？

English: I have another question first.
Chinese: 我先还有个问题。

English: I don't want anything to do with this.
Chinese: 这事儿我不想沾。

English: Let's get out of here.
Chinese: 我们离开这儿吧。

English: That's all I needed to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就是这些。

English: How else can I empower you?
Chinese: 还有什么我可以帮上你的？

English: <<Aphra's mechanical arm gives you a fluid salutation.>>
Chinese: <<阿芙拉的机械臂向你流畅地行了个礼。>>

English: So, friend. Now you've seen the cost of the King's madness. Will you help me? ##I'll compensate you, of course, as best a humble engineer can...
Chinese: 那么，朋友。你已经见识过国王疯狂的代价了。你愿意帮我吗？##报酬自然是有的，一个卑微工程师能给多少算多少……

English: Oh, King's mercy, ((thank you)). You cannot know how grateful I am that someone understands.
Chinese: 哦，国王开恩，((谢谢你))。有人能理解这一切，我的感激你无法想象。

English: <<You see the refusal sting her.>> Of course. You barely know me, after all. ##Let me know if you change your mind, won't you? And if not... please don't linger in this kingdom. For your sake.
Chinese: <<你看得出拒绝刺痛了她。>>当然。毕竟你我素不相识。##如果你改变主意，请告诉我，好吗？如果不……请尽快离开这个王国。为你自己好。

English: How goes our task, friend?
Chinese: 我们的事办得如何了，朋友？

English: <<She looks around.>> Oh dear, ((again))? I'm afraid I had my nose in my notes on the way here. ##The King's affection for silkslugs is a longstanding mystery, but not our most pressing.
Chinese: <<她环顾四周。>>哎呀，((又来))？恐怕我来这一路只顾埋首笔记了。##国王对丝蛞蝓的偏爱是个悬而未决的谜，但还不是我们最要紧的谜。

English: Splendid! You're practically one of us now, eh? I promise, you won't regret it.
Chinese: 好极了！你简直快成我们中的一员了，嗯？我保证，你不会后悔的。

English: All the luck in the world.
Chinese: 祝你好运连连。

English: Oh, and friend? Please don't breathe a word of our plan to anyone, especially [[Speaker Sunil]]. I shudder to think what he'd do to us if he found out.
Chinese: 哦对了，朋友？我们的计划千万一个字都别向任何人透露，尤其是[[代言人苏尼尔]]。一想到被他知道的下场，我就不寒而栗。

English: <<Aphra peers up into sky, her brows furrowed in contemplation.>>
Chinese: <<阿芙拉抬头凝望天空，眉头因思索而紧锁。>>

English: <<She tears her eyes away from the celestial teapot.>> Please, go ahead. We may not get another chance.
Chinese: <<她把目光从天上那把茶壶上移开。>>请讲。我们未必还有下次机会。

English: I've been working on a [[spell]]. It would stop the vanishings and reform the King's power so that it can only alter people at their own request, with their consent. Just like we talked about, see?
Chinese: 我在钻研一个[[法术]]。它能终止抹除，并改造国王的权柄，使它只能在本人请求、本人同意的前提下改造人。就像我们说过的那样，明白吗？

English: Gosh, I hope that all made sense! I think you're the first person who's ever heard the whole thing out loud. ##Back to the task at hand...
Chinese: 天哪，但愿我把话说清楚了！我想你是头一个听我完整讲出来的人。##回到眼前的事……

English: Unfortunately, my spell must be enacted [[inside the King's audience chamber]], and these days only [[Speaker Sunil]] and his inner circle are allowed in. They're all so paranoid about the Saboteur...
Chinese: 可惜，我的法术必须在[[国王的觐见厅]]内施展，而如今只有[[代言人苏尼尔]]和他的核心圈子获准入内。他们对破坏者神经过敏得很……

English: But ((you)) – the King summoned you ((specifically)). Do you realise how rare that is? Its Majesty doesn't make mistakes, only decisions we don't understand yet. And Its Majesty has decided you are important.
Chinese: 可((你))——国王((特意))召见了你。你知道这有多罕见吗？国王陛下从不犯错，只会做出我们尚未理解的决断。而国王陛下已经判定你很重要。

English: If we can induce the King to summon you again, Sunil would ((have)) to let you in – he'd never disobey a royal command! Then you can input my spell. ##Does that all make sense?
Chinese: 如果我们能设法让国王再次召见你，苏尼尔就((不得不))放你进去——他绝不敢违抗王命！到时你就能输入我的法术。##这些都说得通吗？

English: Whatever is clouded, I shall strive to illumine.
Chinese: 凡有晦暗不明处，我必竭力照亮。

English: What else can I make lucid?
Chinese: 还有什么要我讲明白的？

English: Then I'll try to find another way. But I fear our clock is short. The King is giving us a million warnings and we're ignoring all of them. There may not be another chance before the situation becomes... irretrievable.
Chinese: 那我就另想办法。但恐怕我们的时间不多了。国王给了我们一万个警告，我们却全当耳旁风。等局面变得……无可挽回之前，未必还有下一次机会。

English: The best case scenario is that Sunil is right and I am wrong. The King's madness will self-correct over time, and everything will balance out.
Chinese: 最好的情形，是苏尼尔对了我错。国王的疯狂会随时间自我修正，一切终将归于平衡。

English: In the middling scenario, everyone in the Kingdom vanishes and this entire island is consumed by the Corruption. ##As for the worst case scenario...
Chinese: 中等的情形，是全国民众尽数被抹除，整座岛被腐化吞噬。##至于最坏的情形……

English: According to my analysis, there is an outside chance we would suffer a catastrophic arcane event akin to a miniature World Rend. The fact that it would ((probably)) be limited to this island is cold comfort to those of us that live here.
Chinese: 据我分析，存在一个渺茫的可能：我们会遭遇一场堪比小型世界撕裂的灾变秘法事件。它((多半))只会波及这座岛——对我们这些住在岛上的人来说，这算不上什么安慰。

English: It's actually something I've been working on for years. Cipher magic allowed me to become who I am today, and I believe everyone should have that power. So why not let the King alter anyone who asks for it?
Chinese: 其实这是我钻研多年的成果。密文魔法成就了今天的我，我认为人人都该拥有这种力量。那为何不让国王改造每一个主动请求的人呢？

English: Once I understood the scale of the vanishings, however, I realised that my spell might be the only way to halt them quickly enough without introducing some other potentially catastrophic new fault.
Chinese: 然而，当我了解到抹除的规模之后，我意识到我的法术也许是唯一能足够快地止住它、又不会引入其他潜在灾难性缺陷的办法。

English: If my analysis is correct, this would begin to heal the King's madness, while improving the lives of everyone in the Kingdom. ##Alas, Speaker Sunil has not been receptive to these ideas.
Chinese: 倘若我的分析无误，这将开始治愈国王的疯狂，同时改善全国民众的生活。##可惜，代言人苏尼尔对这些想法并不买账。

English: Yes. He told me that I was mistaken, that it was all just a mirage of the Corruption, that this wasn't my department. Even questioned whether I might be falling prey to Corruption myself. I've been under surveillance ever since.
Chinese: 是的。他说我搞错了，说那不过是腐化的海市蜃楼，说这不归我管。甚至质疑我是不是自己也染上了腐化。从那以后我就一直被监视。

English: Well, the Machinists' Guild is empowered to act with the King's own authority. My colleagues use their insignia to investigate crimes, requisition goods, and generally compel obedience...
Chinese: 这么说吧，机械师公会被授权以国王本人的权威行事。我的同僚们用徽记侦查罪案、征调物资，总之就是强制服从……

English: <<She frowns.>> I must stress, this brooch is a privilege, not a toy. I trust you won't do anything untoward with it?
Chinese: <<她皱眉。>>我必须强调，这枚胸针是一种特权，不是玩具。你不会拿它干出格的事吧？

English: <<She looks relieved.>> Good. After all, if the Guild were to find out... ##Well, no matter. I'll break a thousand rules if that's what it takes to save the Kingdom.
Chinese: <<她松了口气。>>好。毕竟，要是被公会发现了……##算了，无所谓。只要能救王国，一千条规矩我也照破不误。

English: First, we must catch the King's attention. ##About a month ago, strange phenomena were reported in a [[graveyard]] outside Ferropolis. My analysis suggests these phenomena are a secret message from Its Majesty.
Chinese: 第一步，我们得引起国王的注意。##大约一个月前，铁城郊外的一处[[墓场]]报告了怪异现象。我的分析表明，这些现象是国王陛下发出的一条密讯。

English: Take my [[Machinists' Guild Insignia]] and investigate the graveyard. The [[graveyard keeper]] may be able to assist you. ##Use it carefully, friend. These insignia command great power throughout the Kingdom.
Chinese: 带上我的[[机械师公会徽记]]去调查那座墓场。[[守墓人]]也许能帮上你。##务必小心使用，朋友。这些徽记在全王国都意味着莫大的权柄。

English: Now, I could be wrong, but I suspect the message will begin with music – like this. ##<<She hums a haunting tune, somehow familiar and ethereal all at once, like a lullaby from time's own beginning.>>
Chinese: 嗯，我可能猜错，但我怀疑这条讯息会以一段音乐开头——就像这样。##<<她哼起一段萦绕心头的曲调，既熟悉又缥缈，仿佛时间源头的摇篮曲。>>

English: So, is your mission clear?
Chinese: 那么，你的任务清楚了吗？

English: <<She looks genuinely pleased.>> How kind! Well, perhaps if this whole Machinist business doesn't pan out, I can make a living as a troubadour.
Chinese: <<她由衷地高兴。>>真会夸人！嗯，倘若机械师这行当干不下去，我还可以去当个游吟诗人谋生呢。

English: Outside Ferropolis, to the [[northwest]]. If you leave via the main causeway, you'll see [[broken ley pylons]] running downhill to your left. Follow them until you come to the graveyard.
Chinese: 在铁城外的[[西北]]方向。走主堤道出城，你会看到[[断裂的地脉塔]]顺着坡地向你左侧延伸。沿着它们走到头就是墓场。

English: Really? <<She reads the transcript excitedly.>> ##Let's see... hmmm. Could it...? No... wait. ##Oh! ((Oh!))
Chinese: 真的？<<她兴奋地读着抄本。>>##让我看看……嗯。难道……？不……等等。##哦！((哦！))

English: <<She beams up at you.>> Stars aflame, so I ((wasn't)) imagining it. ##This confirms my analysis. The King is speaking to us, and we must show that we've heard.
Chinese: <<她满面光彩地望着你。>>群星燃烧，所以我((不是))在胡思乱想。##这证实了我的分析。国王在向我们说话，我们必须表明我们听到了。

English: <<She looks embarrassed.>> Oh, well, it was just a guess. The King outputs so much information every day, and I just look for patterns... ##Ah, but I mustn't bore you.
Chinese: <<她面露赧色。>>哦，呃，那只是猜的。国王每天输出的信息浩如烟海，我只是从中找规律……##啊，不过我不该拿这些烦你。

English: && <<She smiles thinly.>> There's no need to humour me simply to be polite. Let's move on to the matter at hand, shall we?
Chinese: && <<她勉强一笑。>>不必为了客气而恭维我。我们还是谈正事吧，如何？

English: %% <<She seems surprised.>> Oh, well... to tell the truth, I had a dream about it. I saw myself walking in a graveyard, following that tune, and then finding...
Chinese: %% <<她似乎有些惊讶。>>哦，这个嘛……说实话，我为它做过一个梦。梦里我走在墓场中，循着那段曲调，然后找到了……

English: ...Now listen, I don't want you to think I'm some sort of... crazed mystic! I spend so long buried in royal output logs I sometimes fall asleep on the parchment. I think the dream was only my mind's way of pointing out a pattern I'd missed.
Chinese: ……听着，我可不想你把我当成什么……疯疯癫癫的神秘主义者！我埋首王室输出日志太久，有时趴在羊皮纸上就睡着了。我想那个梦不过是我的脑子在提醒我漏掉了一个规律。

English: The King speaks a dialect of cipher language known as [[Sixfold cipher]]. It's tremendously difficult for human brains to parse. ##So, for your audience, you'll need a [[Cranial Moderator]] installed into your skull.
Chinese: 国王说的是密文语言的一种方言，称为[[六重密文]]。人脑极难解析它。##所以，要觐见国王，你得在颅骨里装一台[[颅腔调节器]]。

English: Anyway, back to the matter at hand. ##The King speaks a dialect of cipher language known as [[Sixfold cipher]]. It's tremendously difficult for human brains to parse
Chinese: 总之，回到正事。##国王说的是密文语言的一种方言，称为[[六重密文]]。人脑极难解析它

English: So, for your audience, you'll need a [[Cranial Moderator]] installed into your skull.
Chinese: 所以，要觐见国王，你得在颅骨里装一台[[颅腔调节器]]。

English: Don't worry, it's quite safe! All new Machinists receive one when we pass our exams. ##There's only one cranial engineer still alive who is qualified to install them. Luckily, she has a soft spot for me.
Chinese: 别担心，非常安全！所有新机械师通过考核后都会装一台。##如今在世且有资格安装它的颅腔工程师只剩一位。幸好，她对我素来偏爱。

English: Seek out [[Morozov]] in the mountains north of Ferropolis. Tell her I sent you – mention the 'Sydovski Problem' – and she'll fix you up. ##Any questions?
Chinese: 去铁城以北的群山里找[[莫罗佐夫]]。告诉她是我派你去的——提一句"希多夫斯基难题"——她就会给你装好。##还有什么问题吗？

English: Any further questions?
Chinese: 还有别的问题吗？

English: What's so alarming? Would you hesitate to enhance your eyes with spectacles, or replace a rotten tooth with gold? You must understand, the royal language opens many doors here. Most people would give their left hands to speak it.
Chinese: 这有什么好惊慌的？戴副眼镜改善视力、镶颗金牙换掉蛀牙，你会犹豫吗？你要明白，王室语言在这里能打开许多扇门。大多数人不惜代价也想学会说它。

English: Morozov and I are old friends, though I haven't seen her in forever. These days she communicates only via letters and parcels. You'll spot her [[tower]] easily enough, [[high on a mountaintop to the north]].
Chinese: 莫罗佐夫和我是老朋友，虽然我好久没见过她了。如今她只靠书信和包裹与人往来。她的[[塔]]很好认，[[在北边的山顶上]]。

English: As for how to reach it, I'm afraid she has not deigned to share the route with me, despite my entreaties. She's not fond of visitors, you see.
Chinese: 至于怎么上去，恐怕尽管我一再恳求，她也不屑告诉我路线。你知道的，她不喜欢访客。

English: Ah, how I miss that madwoman.
Chinese: 唉，我真想念那个疯女人。

English: I'm... fairly sure. Our bond was too deep to be shattered by mere distance. Yes, we were very close.
Chinese: 我……相当确定。我们的情谊深厚，绝非区区距离能冲淡。是的，我们曾非常亲密。

English: Our other cranial engineers were victims of...academic disagreements. The Guild ((has)) tried to use less qualified engineers, with messy results. Alas, Morozov is too smart to train any replacements.
Chinese: 我们的其他颅腔工程师都是……学术分歧的牺牲品。公会((确实))试过用资历浅些的工程师，结果一团糟。唉，莫罗佐夫太精明了，从不肯培养接班人。

English: <<Aphra blinks, squints at you, then tilts her head back, as if she is seeing you in a new light.>> ##((Really?)) You got that from ((Morozov))?
Chinese: <<阿芙拉眨眨眼，眯眼打量你，然后仰起头，仿佛重新认识了你一遍。>>##((真的？))这话是((莫罗佐夫))说的？

English: Your initiative is commendable. Well then...
Chinese: 你能主动办事，值得称赞。那么……

English: I've been studying the message you retrieved from the graveyard. I think Its Majesty wants us to pass it on elsewhere – but not by the usual channels.
Chinese: 你从墓场取回的讯息我一直在研究。我想，国王陛下是要我们把它转送到别处——但不能走常规渠道。

English: In the Corrupted Lands there is a [[royal broadcast beacon]], formerly used to send signals down to the Underlands. It was abandoned when Corruption overtook the area, and has since fallen into disrepair. However, the King has not forgotten it.
Chinese: 腐化之地有一座[[皇家广播信标]]，从前用于向地下之地发送信号。腐化吞噬那一带后它遭废弃，此后日渐荒废。然而，国王没有忘记它。

English: Unfortunately the beacon is no longer answering remote commands, which means you – and I am truly sorry for this – must deliver the message in person.
Chinese: 遗憾的是，信标已不再响应远程指令，也就是说，你必须亲自去送讯——对此我实在抱歉。

English: <<She hands you a weighty folder of forest green leather.>> ##This is what we Machinists call a 'punchcard'. It's a way of recording information so the King can understand – in this case, music.
Chinese: <<她递给你一个沉甸甸的森林绿皮革夹。>>##这就是我们机械师所说的"打孔卡"。它是一种记录信息的方式，让国王能够读懂——这里记录的是音乐。

English: Use the [[punchcard]] to open the tower door, then insert it into the apparatus at the [[top of the beacon]].
Chinese: 用[[打孔卡]]打开塔门，然后把它插入[[信标顶部]]的装置里。

English: Anything else?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗？

English: Entirely fair.
Chinese: 完全合理。

English: Very much so. Ordinarily I wouldn't contemplate such a journey, and I truly wish I could go myself. But if Sunil notices I'm absent for too long, our whole plan will be sunk.
Chinese: 非常危险。换作平时我根本不会考虑这趟行程，我多希望能亲自去。但若苏尼尔察觉我离开太久，我们的整个计划就全泡汤了。

English: My advice: Try not to enter any structure not fixed to the ground. Cleanup workers are your friends. If you taste lilac, turn back immediately. And if you see an eyeball, do ((not)) meet its gaze.
Chinese: 我的忠告：尽量不要进入任何不与地面相连的建筑。清理工人是你的朋友。若尝到丁香花味，立刻回头。若看见眼球，切((莫))与它对视。

English: If you need respite, I believe there's a royal [[Cleanup Camp]] in that area, although I've never been there myself.
Chinese: 如果你需要歇脚，那一带似乎有一处皇家[[清理营地]]，虽然我自己没去过。

English: We asked the King that same question. Its Majesty was adamant that someone or something might be alive down there, and that contacting them was somehow critical to the Kingdom's future. Alas, no response ever came.
Chinese: 我们问过国王一模一样的问题。国王陛下坚称，下面可能有某人或某物还活着，与他们取得联系对王国的未来至关重要。唉，始终没有等到任何回应。

English: The Corrupted Lands are [[southeast]] of here, across a great chasm carved out by the King's machines. Officially there's no way in, but I've found records of an old abandoned [[digging engine]] in the area that ((might)) offer you a path.
Chinese: 腐化之地在[[东南]]方，隔着一条国王的机器开凿出的巨壑。官方口径是无路可进，但我查到档案记载，那一带有台废弃的旧[[挖掘引擎]]，((也许))能给你提供一条路。

English: I'll have the King conjure the [[access code]] directly into your Cranial Moderator. Just picture me in your mind's eye, with as much detail as you can, and it'll come to you.
Chinese: 我会让国王把[[通行码]]直接显现到你的颅腔调节器里。只要在脑海中想象我，细节越丰富越好，通行码自然会浮现。

English: <<She smiles mischievously.>> Why not try it anyway? With all that new plumbing in your skull, you might be surprised.
Chinese: <<她狡黠一笑。>>那何不试试呢？你颅骨里装了那么多新管路，说不定会有惊喜。

English: <<She tears her eyes away from the celestial teapot.>> No, I would certainly say this is new.
Chinese: <<她把目光从天上那把茶壶上移开。>>不，我敢说这是新出现的。

English: I confess, I'm struggling. Is it a sign? An instruction? A response to our broadcast? But then why a ((teapot))?
Chinese: 不瞒你说，我也一头雾水。这是征兆？是指令？是对我们广播的回应？可为什么会是((茶壶))？

English: If the King's malfunctions are worsening, then yes. If it's supposed to be a message, maybe not. But then why a ((teapot))?
Chinese: 如果国王的故障在恶化，那算是。如果这是条讯息，那可能不算。可为什么会是((茶壶))？

English: Possibly. I just can't work out what a ((teapot)) has to do with it. Perhaps Its Majesty is inviting us for refreshments?
Chinese: 有可能。我只是想不通((茶壶))和这有什么关系。也许国王陛下是请我们去喝茶？

English: <<She shrugs helplessly.>> I've checked and re-checked my calculations; all we can do is stick to the plan.
Chinese: <<她无奈地耸耸肩。>>我的演算反复核过；我们能做的只有按计划行事。

English: ...oh! Yes! I almost forgot. The King has summoned you for another audience, just as we hoped.
Chinese: ……哦！对了！差点忘了。国王又召你觐见了，正如我们所盼。

English: <<Aphra hands you a leather folder, far heavier than the last.>> ##Here it is, friend. Eight years of my life, and the hopes of a kingdom, now rest in your hands.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉递给你一个皮革夹，比上次那个沉得多。>>##就是它，朋友。我八年的心血，和整个王国的希望，如今都交在你手里了。

English: Friend, I don't know what will happen after this, so if you have any concerns, now is the time to voice them.
Chinese: 朋友，我不知道这之后会发生什么，所以你若还有任何疑虑，现在就说。

English: Anything else? This may be your last chance.
Chinese: 还有别的吗？这可能是最后的机会了。

English: When you return to the [[Machinarium]], the [[audience chamber]] will be open. Insert my punchcard into the King's petition port, and my magic will do the rest.
Chinese: 你回到[[机械殿]]后，[[觐见厅]]会开放。把我的打孔卡插入国王的陈情端口，余下的事交给我的魔法。

English: Oh, Misha? He's a dear, isn't he? I'd be so forgetful without his medicines. You can't import them without a letter from the King – one of those little perks of my job. ##Why do you ask?
Chinese: 哦，米沙？他是个好人，不是吗？没有他的药，我这记性早不行了。那些药没有国王的信函是进不了关的——这正是我职务的些许便利之一。##你问这个做什么？

English: It's hard to tell, isn't it? The man is like a deep river, all iced over. You skate on the surface thinking it'll never break, then suddenly you plunge into this other world. But the next day, it's all ice again.
Chinese: 很难说，不是吗？那人像一条深河，全封了冻。你在冰面上滑行，以为它永远不会破，然后忽然之间你就坠入了另一个世界。可到了第二天，一切又冻得严严实实。

English: I know he was born in Slev. His family came here after the God War seeking a better life, when he was just a boy. ##It's people like them that this kingdom should be working for.
Chinese: 我知道他生在斯列夫。神之战后，他们一家来此讨生活，那时他还只是个孩子。##这个王国真正该效力的，正是他们这样的人。

English: How sweet! Please don't tell him anything about our plan. If even a hint of it reaches the wrong ears, we could both be vanished – or worse.
Chinese: 真暖心！但请千万别向他透露我们计划的任何风声。哪怕一丝口风传进不该听的耳朵，我们俩都可能被抹除——或者更糟。

English: Hijack them...? Yes, theoretically that is entirely possible. All royal installations run on cipher, magic and like any language cipher can be twisted. Why do you ask?
Chinese: 劫持它们……？嗯，理论上完全可能。所有王室设施都运行在密文与魔法之上，而密文同任何语言一样，是可以被扭曲的。你问这个做什么？

English: But who could possibly....? ##<<Her eyes widen.>> ((Oh.)) That's not good at all.
Chinese: 可谁做得到呢……？##<<她瞪大了眼睛。>>((哦。))这可大大不妙。

English: Listen, you're clearly an intelligent person. It's no doubt crossed your mind that much of the Guild's bluster about the Saboteur is merely a convenient fiction.
Chinese: 听着，你显然是个聪明人。你心里想必也嘀咕过：公会关于破坏者的那些大话，多半只是顺手的托词。

English: But the output logs indicate that there really is someone – or some group – who's been subverting the King's magic in just the way you describe. We suspect one of them is a former Machinist, embittered by dismissal for some past crime.
Chinese: 但输出日志表明，确实有人——或某个团伙——一直在用你描述的那种方式颠覆国王的魔法。我们怀疑其中一人是前机械师，因昔日罪行被革职而怀恨在心。

English: Now, I don't believe for one tick that they're the primary cause of the King's madness. But they certainly aren't helping, and it's ordinary people – rather than us Machinists – who pay the price.
Chinese: 不过，我一秒都不信他们是国王疯狂的主因。但他们肯定在帮倒忙，而买单的是普通民众——不是我们这些机械师。

English: Thank you for reporting this, friend. If you have any doubts about my spell, I'll do my best to assuage them. Otherwise, I urge you to focus on our task.
Chinese: 谢谢你报告此事，朋友。你若对我的法术还有疑虑，我会尽力打消。否则，请把心思放在我们的任务上。

English: <<Aphra smiles, failing to conceal her anxiety.>> I'm counting on you, friend.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉笑着，却掩不住焦虑。>>我可全指望你了，朋友。

English: I'll explain everything I can, as many times as you need.
Chinese: 凡是我能解释的，你要听几遍我就讲几遍。

English: Does that all make sense?
Chinese: 这些都说得通吗？

English: Initially, a defined set of about a hundred qualities can be changed, with hard limits on things like height or density. The King won't do anything that directly endangers your life or another's – so you can't become an 80-foot giant with no lungs.
Chinese: 最初，可改造的特质是一套既定的、约一百种，身高、密度之类设有硬性上限。国王不会做任何直接危及你或他人生命的事——所以你没法变成八十尺高、没长肺的巨人。

English: Other qualities will become changeable in time, once the spell has proved its worth. Most of these rules can be modified by a vote of more than half the Kingdom.
Chinese: 待法术证明了自己的价值，其他特质也会逐步开放改造。这些规则大多可由王国过半民众投票修改。

English: Wherever possible, I have favoured incentives over hard limits. After a trial period, you'll be stuck with your changes for a year – so you'll have to think carefully. Other incentives will ensure an optimal distribution of qualities for the whole Kingdom.
Chinese: 凡可行处，我都以激励取代硬性限制。试用期结束后，你的改造将锁定一年——所以你得三思。其余激励措施将确保全王国的特质分布保持最优。

English: All individuals must be free to choose their fate. But from society's point of view, you don't want ((everyone)) to be an artist, or indeed a carpenter.
Chinese: 每个人都必须能自由选择自己的命运。但从社会角度看，总不能((人人))都去当艺术家，或者都去当木匠。

English: Past kingdoms solved this through conscription, slavery, or rigid social rank – brutal methods for a brutal age. Under my system, the King will monitor the overall balance of qualities and provide incentives for those that are in shortage.
Chinese: 昔日的王国靠征兵、奴役或森严的等级解决这个问题——那是给野蛮时代的野蛮手段。在我的体系下，国王将监测全社会的特质平衡，并为短缺的特质提供激励。

English: So, if too many people have made themselves mercurial and creative, the King may offer rewards for constancy and pragmatism. If too few have the temperament for farm work, the King may incentivise that temperament.
Chinese: 于是，若太多人把自己改得善变而富于创意，国王可以奖励恒心与务实。若具备务农心性的人太少，国王可以激励那种心性。

English: I don't believe so. There's nothing wrong with asking people to compromise with the needs of their community. What's important is that they're free to say no.
Chinese: 我不这么认为。请人们为社区的需要做出让步，并没有错。关键在于，他们有权说不。

English: The current faults demonstrably stem from specific errors in our previous spells, born from wishful neglect of fundamental principles. That Sunil denies this does not make it false.
Chinese: 如今的故障显然源于我们先前法术中的具体错误，源于对基本原理一厢情愿的忽视。苏尼尔否认这一点，改变不了事实。

English: There is a saying within the Guild, which would be seditious if repeated in public: 'dreck in, dreck out'. It means that if you give the King faulty input, you'll get a faulty result.
Chinese: 公会有句行话，公开复述就算煽动罪："垃圾进，垃圾出"。意思是，你给国王输入错误的东西，就会得到错误的结果。

English: Yet the reverse is also true. With properly enumerated powers and properly specified goals, the errors you describe will never arise in the first place.
Chinese: 但反过来也成立。只要权力罗列得当、目标界定清晰，你说的那些错误根本就不会出现。

English: My spell will create a self-balancing, self-correcting equilibrium capable of adapting itself to new circumstances. I've spent eight years planning this; I'm certain it is sound.
Chinese: 我的法术将创造一种能自我平衡、自我修正、自我适应新环境的均衡态。这个方案我筹划了八年；我确信它无懈可击。

English: Heavens, you sound just like the Saboteur. I admit, I've asked myself the same question, when the hour is late and sleep eludes me.
Chinese: 天哪，你的口吻活像破坏者。不瞒你说，夜深人静、睡意全无时，我也问过自己同样的问题。

English: But I've seen the power of cipher magic to save a life. Without it, I would have been locked forever inside the person I used to be. How can we just walk away from that?
Chinese: 但我亲眼见过密文魔法拯救一条生命的力量。若没有它，我将永远被困在从前的那个自己体内。这种东西，我们怎么能一走了之？

English: We don't chew our meat raw because fire can raze our towns. We don't renounce the axe because it chops necks as well as trees. We don't spurn the wheel when it crushes a child's hand.
Chinese: 火能焚城，我们也没有因此生嚼生肉。斧头既砍树也断颈，我们也没有因此弃斧。车轮碾过孩童的手，我们也没有因此拒用车轮。

English: I refuse to accept abstention as our only choice. I will not surrender to the hunger and despair that have hitherto plagued all history. I will not relinquish the dream of the first Machinists to those who have forgotten it.
Chinese: 我拒绝接受"袖手旁观"是我们唯一的选项。我不会向迄今为止折磨着全部历史的饥饿与绝望投降。我绝不会把初代机械师的梦想拱手让给那些遗忘它的人。

English: <<Aphra's brows wrinkle.>> My... past? What do you mean?
Chinese: <<阿芙拉眉头微皱。>>我的……过去？什么意思？

English: You Unionites have a strange sense of humour...
Chinese: 你们联盟人的幽默感可真怪……

English: <<Aphra listens intently, with growing horror. For the first time since you met her, she seems at a loss for words.>>
Chinese: <<阿芙拉凝神听着，恐惧越来越深。自你们相识以来，她头一次无言以对。>>

English: I... Gods alive. That's... ((horrible)).
Chinese: 我……诸神在上。这……((太可怕了))。

English: <<Aphra listens intently, with growing horror. For the first time since you met her, she seems at a loss for words.>>
Chinese: <<阿芙拉凝神听着，恐惧越来越深。自你们相识以来，她头一次无言以对。>>

English: All those Aphras. They could have been me, and I could have been them. They ((were)) me, and I ((was)) them.
Chinese: 那些阿芙拉们。她们本可以是我，我也本可以是她们。她们((就是))我，我((就是))她们。

English: Why me? Why did I deserve to flourish, and they to die? ##I never knew I had so many sisters.
Chinese: 为什么是我？凭什么我得以绽放，而她们只配死去？##我从不知道自己有这么多姐妹。

English: I thought I was changing the King, changing the system. But the King... made me? Yet it also made my sisters; left them to die. So all of us were expressions of Its Majesty's will.
Chinese: 我以为自己在改变国王、改变体制。可国王……造就了我？却也造出了我的姐妹们；然后任她们死去。这么说，我们全都是国王陛下意志的产物。

English: <<She gazes past you, to somewhere far away.>> ##All my life I wondered why I was here, in this broken world. What I was ((for)). Through all my days as a young engineer, all the... indignities I bore.
Chinese: <<她的目光越过你，望向遥远的地方。>>##我一辈子都在想，我为什么在这个破碎的世界上。我到底((为何))而造。整个青年工程师的岁月，我忍受的种种……屈辱。

English: Now I know. There was a reason.
Chinese: 现在我知道了。一切自有缘由。

English: <<She meets your eyes with a look of intense determination.>> ##Not many people have the privilege of such a purpose. What happened to my sisters must never happen again.
Chinese: <<她迎着你的目光，眼神无比坚定。>>##能有如此使命的人，寥寥无几。我姐妹们的遭遇，绝不能重演。

English: Please, friend. Help me finish this. Help me wake the kingdom from this nightmare.
Chinese: 拜托了，朋友。帮我完成这件事。帮我把这个王国从噩梦中唤醒。

English: Now, um... where were we?
Chinese: 那么，呃……我们刚说到哪了？

English: <<She looks relieved.>> Well, as long as one of us does...
