Chinese: <<她松了口气。>>嗯，只要我们中有一个明白就行……

English: <<Aphra looks concerned.>> Really? But surely he can't know about our plans... ##...and how could he possibly have subverted the King's magic? Misha is a fine sailor, but he's no magician.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉面露担忧。>>真的？可他绝不可能知道我们的计划……##……他又怎么可能颠覆国王的魔法？米沙是个好水手，但他可不是魔法师。

English: Hmm. There ((are)) reports of people seeing or hearing phantoms in the Corrupted Lands. Long-dead loved ones, or even their own self. Some say the Corruption can read your memories – the better to lure you to your doom.
Chinese: 嗯。确实((有))报告说，有人在腐化之地看见或听见幻影。死去多年的挚爱，甚至他们自己。有人说腐化能读取你的记忆——好把你诱向死亡。

English: I'm glad you're alive, friend. Pay it no mind; our task requires your full attention.
Chinese: 你还活着就好，朋友。别把这事放在心上；我们的任务需要你全神贯注。

English: <<Aphra looks around in wonderment.>> Stars aflame, I didn't even know I ((had)) a [[debug mode]]. It's amazing what one learns about oneself even in one's thirties, isn't it? ##Well then, since we're here, how can I be of aid to you?
Chinese: <<阿芙拉惊异地环顾四周。>>群星燃烧，我竟不知道自己还((有))[[调试模式]]。人到了三十几岁还能这样认识自己，真叫人称奇，不是吗？##那么，既然我们都在这儿，我能为你效什么劳？

English: Ooh, it's just like magic, isn't it? Poof, and it's done!
Chinese: 哦，简直像魔法一样，不是吗？噗，就成了！

English: Splendid! Er, will I remember this conversation after we're done? No matter; it's been a pleasure either way. ##Now, without further ado...
Chinese: 好极了！呃，事情办完后我还记得这次对话吗？无所谓；不管怎样都很愉快。##那么，闲话少叙……

English: <<[Gesture skywards]>> Is this normal?
Chinese: <<[指向天空]>>这正常吗？

English: We need to talk.
Chinese: 我们得谈谈。

English: <<[Leave without disturbing her]>>
Chinese: <<[不打扰她，离开]>>

English: You have my attention.
Chinese: 我听着呢。

English: I'm not interested.
Chinese: 我没兴趣。

English: Why is the city full of silkslugs?
Chinese: 城里怎么到处都是丝蛞蝓？

English: Aphra, I have something important to tell you about your past.
Chinese: 阿芙拉，有件关于你过去的重要的事要告诉你。

English: What do you need me to do first?
Chinese: 你要我先做什么？

English: I found the King's message in the graveyard.
Chinese: 我在墓场找到国王的讯息了。

English: Tell me again where to get a Cranial Moderator.
Chinese: 再说说去哪装颅腔调节器。

English: <<[Tap your cranium]>> Head full of gears, as requested.
Chinese: <<[敲敲自己的脑袋]>>满脑齿轮，如你所愿。

English: Tell me again about this beacon you want activated.
Chinese: 再说说你要激活的那座信标。

English: I have questions about this plan of yours.
Chinese: 关于你的计划，我有几个问题。

English: Just wish me luck.
Chinese: 祝我好运就行。

English: Just tell me what you need me to do.
Chinese: 直接告诉我你要我做什么。

English: What happens if I don't input your spell?
Chinese: 要是我不输入你的法术会怎么样？

English: Tell me more about what your spell does.
Chinese: 再多讲讲你的法术能干什么。

English: What does that mean, 'irretrievable'?
Chinese: 什么叫"无可挽回"？

English: I think I get the idea.
Chinese: 我想我懂了。

English: Haven't you tried to tell Sunil about the mirror-world?
Chinese: 你没试着把镜中世界的事告诉苏尼尔吗？

English: Let me ask you about something else.
Chinese: 我问点别的。

English: What can I do with your Machinist insignia?
Chinese: 你的机械师徽记能派上什么用场？

English: No, I'll be careful with it.
Chinese: 不会，我会小心保管的。

English: <<[Lie]>> Of course, I'll use it only for our mission.
Chinese: <<[撒谎]>>当然，我只用于我们的任务。

English: That's all my questions for now.
Chinese: 我暂时就问这些。

English: You have a good voice, you know.
Chinese: 你知道吗，你嗓音很好听。

English: Where will I find this graveyard?
Chinese: 墓场在哪找？

English: I think I understand.
Chinese: 我想我明白了。

English: How did you know about that weird tune?
Chinese: 那段怪调子你是怎么知道的？

English: @@ Truly, I'm interested. I get the sense there was some spark of inspiration.
Chinese: @@ 真的，我很好奇。我感觉那是灵光一现。

English: Very well. How do we talk to the King?
Chinese: 好吧。我们怎么和国王谈？

English: How do we do that?
Chinese: 怎么做？

English: Sorry, installed into my ((what?))
Chinese: 抱歉，装进我的((什么))里面？

English: Absolutely not.
Chinese: 绝对不行。

English: <<[Skip conversation]>> Actually, funny story: I already have a Moderator.
Chinese: <<[跳过对话]>>其实，说来好笑：我已经有调节器了。

English: I have some concerns about this skull-machine.
Chinese: 对这个颅骨机器我有些顾虑。

English: How do I find this Morozov?
Chinese: 莫罗佐夫上哪找？

English: Are you sure you're still friends?
Chinese: 你确定你们还是朋友？

English: Can't someone else install the Moderator?
Chinese: 不能找别人装调节器吗？

English: All right, I get the picture.
Chinese: 行，我明白了。

English: Actually, funny story: I already have a Moderator.
Chinese: 其实，说来好笑：我已经有调节器了。

English: Fine, I'll look for Morozov. But no promises.
Chinese: 好吧，我去找莫罗佐夫。但不打包票。

English: I made it worth her while.
Chinese: 我让她觉得划算了。

English: All it took was a little persuasion.
Chinese: 只费了一点小口舌。

English: Her security systems weren't as strong as she thought.
Chinese: 她的安保系统没有她自己以为的那么强。

English: Fine, that's all. But if I become a monster, I'll eat you first.
Chinese: 好吧，就这些。但如果我变成怪物，我先吃了你。

English: This sounds incredibly dangerous.
Chinese: 这听起来危险透顶。

English: Why would you want to send signals to the Underlands?
Chinese: 你为什么想往地下之地发信号？

English: How do I get to the Corrupted Lands?
Chinese: 怎么去腐化之地？

English: I'm not very good at picturing things in my head.
Chinese: 我不太擅长在脑子里想象画面。

English: If you say so.
Chinese: 你说了算。

English: What does it mean?
Chinese: 那是什么意思？

English: Are we in danger?
Chinese: 我们有危险吗？

English: Did we do this?
Chinese: 这是我们自己造成的吗？

English: What do I do with this punchcard?
Chinese: 这张打孔卡我该拿来做什么？

English: What do I do with this punchcard, exactly?
Chinese: 这张打孔卡具体该怎么用？

English: I still have questions about your spell.
Chinese: 关于你的法术，我还有问题。

English: Do you happen to know a sky pilot called Mikhail?
Chinese: 你认不认识一个叫米哈伊尔的天上飞行员？

English: How well do you really know him?
Chinese: 你到底跟他有多熟？

English: Would you say he's a friend?
Chinese: 你会说他是你的朋友吗？

English: Don't worry, I was just curious.
Chinese: 别担心，我就是好奇。

English: I happened to bump into him, and he mentioned you. That's all.
Chinese: 我碰巧遇见他，他提起了你。就这样。

English: He somehow spoke to me through the beacon. Warned me not to help you.
Chinese: 他不知怎么通过信标跟我说话了。警告我别帮你。

English: Is it possible for someone to hijack the King's machines?
Chinese: 有人可能劫持国王的机器吗？

English: Someone spoke to me through the beacon. Warned me not to help you.
Chinese: 有人通过信标跟我说话了。警告我别帮你。

English: I have what I need. I'll let you know how it goes.
Chinese: 我需要的东西都有了。有进展我会告诉你。

English: How much freedom to change will your spell really allow?
Chinese: 你的法术到底允许多大的改造自由？

English: What do you mean by 'optimal for the whole kingdom'?
Chinese: 对整个王国最优是什么意思？

English: Won't that lead to the same kind of mass rewriting the Machinists already do?
Chinese: 那不会导致机械师现在就在搞的那种大规模改写吗？

English: I see. I have another question...
Chinese: 明白了。我还有个问题……

English: What about mistakes? If your new King goes mad too, how will anyone stop it?
Chinese: 那出错怎么办？如果你的新国王也疯了，谁能阻止它？

English: What if a good King isn't possible? What if that much power can't ever be just?
Chinese: 如果好国王根本不可能呢？如果那种程度的权力永远不可能公正呢？

English: That's all the answers I wanted.
Chinese: 我想听的答案都有了。

English: Sorry, only jesting.
Chinese: 抱歉，只是开玩笑。

English: <<[Tell her what you discovered about Project Horoscope]>>
Chinese: <<[告诉她你发现的星象计划的事]>>

English: You gave me your spell to insert into the King.
Chinese: 你的法术我拿去插进国王了。

English: We're seeking a second audience with the King.
Chinese: 我们正在谋求第二次觐见国王。

English: Don't worry, I remember what to do next.
Chinese: 放心，我记得接下来做什么。

English: <<Aphra looks at you numbly.>> ##I... pardon me, friend. I... need to be alone for a while. Please leave me to my thoughts.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉木然地看着你。>>##我……抱歉，朋友。我……需要一个人静一静。让我自己待着吧。

English: <<Aphra looks despondent.>> ##The King is dying. Nobody else can see the signs yet, but I can. People have ((no)) idea what's coming. Honestly, neither do I.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉一脸沮丧。>>##国王正在死去。别人还没看见征兆，但我看见了。人们((毫无))概念接下来会怎样。说实话，我也是。

English: I can't thank you enough, friend. You've saved this Kingdom, and delivered a world where nobody will be shackled by their origins. ##The changes have already begun – I can feel it.
Chinese: 我对你感激不尽，朋友。你拯救了这个王国，带来了一个没有人会被出身束缚的世界。##改变已经开始——我能感觉到。

English: <<You find Aphra humming to herself. It's a haunting tune, somehow familiar and ethereal all at once, like a lullaby from time's own beginning.>>
Chinese: <<你发现阿芙拉在自顾自哼歌。那是一段萦绕心头的曲调，既熟悉又缥缈，仿佛时间源头的摇篮曲。>>

English: <<At the sight of you, hope and anxiety blossom on her face.>> ##Is it done? I heard the bells...
Chinese: <<一见到你，希望和焦虑一齐涌上她的脸。>>##办完了吗？我听见钟声了……

English: <<At first Aphra seems unsure whether to believe you. Then you see a tension that has been there since long before your first meeting lift from her shoulders.>>
Chinese: <<起初阿芙拉似乎不敢相信你。然后你看见，一股从你们初见之前就压在她肩头的紧张，终于卸下了。>>

English: %% <<For a moment you think she'll see through your lie. But she really wants to believe you, and so she does.>>
Chinese: %% <<有那么一瞬，你以为她看穿了你的谎。但她是真心想信你，于是她就信了。>>

English: && <<She wants to believe you, and almost does. But as she scans your face, her brows knit....>> ##...you didn't do it, did you? Somehow I already knew.
Chinese: && <<她想信你，也差点信了。可她扫过你的脸，眉头拧了起来……>>##……你没做，对吧？不知怎么，我早就知道了。

English: You really did it. ((We)) did it. Oh gods, this is real. ##<<She closes her eyes to take a long, deep breath, then exhales.>>
Chinese: 你真的做到了。((我们))做到了。诸神在上，这是真的。##<<她闭上眼，长长地深吸一口气，然后缓缓吐出。>>

English: Well now. I promised a reward, didn't I? You can keep my [[Machinists' Guild Insignia]]; I'll pretend I lost it. And please take this, too – I suspect you can find a use for it.
Chinese: 好了。我答应过报酬的，对吧？[[机械师公会徽记]]你留着；我会装作弄丢了。这个也请拿上——我猜你用得着。

English: We're still here, which means I wrote the spell correctly. The vanishings should stop immediately, and some memories of the vanished will return over time. Within a few months, my other reforms will take effect.
Chinese: 我们还在，说明我把法术写对了。抹除应该立刻停止，被抹除者的部分记忆会随时间恢复。几个月内，我的其他改革将陆续生效。

English: I expect there may be rather a commotion once people realise how much has been stolen from them. And without the power to erase their critics, my colleagues will struggle to suppress it.
Chinese: 我预计，等人们意识到自己被偷走了多少东西，会有一场不小的风波。而没有抹除批评者的能力，我的同僚们想压也压不住。

English: So perhaps we will have a new Speaker, or a new Guild, or something entirely different. Who knows? The future is open again.
Chinese: 所以，也许我们会有一位新代言人，或一个新公会，或完全不同的东西。谁知道呢？未来重新敞开了。

English: Thank you again, friend. I can't tell you... ##<<Aphra blinks, then looks up at the sky.>> ##...well, fancy that. Do you see it? The snow...
Chinese: 再次谢谢你，朋友。我不知该怎么说……##<<阿芙拉眨眨眼，抬头望天。>>##……哎呀，你看。雪……

English: <<Aphra smiles like she's recalling a cherished memory.>> ##Yes. Our long winter is finally ending.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉笑了，像在回忆一段珍藏的记忆。>>##是啊。我们的漫长冬天终于要结束了。

English: <<For a long moment she stares at you, aghast. You can see her decades of practice controlling her emotions slowly taking effect.>> ##....I see. If I may ask... why?
Chinese: <<她久久地瞪着你，惊骇万分。你能看见她几十年控制情绪的修养在慢慢起效。>>##……我明白了。冒昧问一句……为什么？

English: I suppose it was a fantasy to think anyone would see it the way I do. How long do we have?
Chinese: 我以为会有人跟我看法一致，可能只是幻想吧。我们还有多久？

English: <<She nods.>> An uncontrolled shutdown could annihilate the Kingdom. Assuming the Saboteur doesn't want that, I'd say we have weeks, perhaps a month or two.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>不受控的关机会湮灭整个王国。假如破坏者不想要那种结果，我猜我们有几个星期，或者一两个月。

English: So that's it. The King will die, and we shall see suffering, starvation, disease, and violence unlike anything since the God War. Why did I imagine it could ever be otherwise?
Chinese: 就这样了。国王会死，我们将目睹神之战以来未曾有过的苦难、饥荒、疫病和暴力。我怎么会以为结局会不同？

English: Please, friend, don't rub more salt in my wounds. I think I need to be alone.
Chinese: 求你了朋友，别再往我伤口上撒盐了。我需要一个人待着。

English: I hope you're right – I truly do. 'Hope for the best, prepare for the worst', isn't that what they say? We should make that our new national motto.
Chinese: 我希望你是对的——真心的。"抱最好的希望，做最坏的打算"，人们不是这么说的吗？我们应该把它定为新的国训。

English: Reza? You spoke to Reza? ##<<You can almost see the gears turning in her head.>> ((Oh.)) Now I see. Well, Reza, my dear, you've decisively won our argument.
Chinese: 雷扎？你跟雷扎谈过了？##<<你几乎能看见她脑中的齿轮在转。>>((哦。))我明白了。好吧，雷扎，亲爱的，我们的争论你赢定了。

English: But... help them? No, no. They don't want to see me. Anyway, what use would I be? The King's magic is all I know. I can't even cast basic spells on my own.
Chinese: 可是……帮他们？不，不。他们不想见我。再说，我能有什么用？国王的魔法是我唯一会的东西。我连基本的法术都独立施不出来。

English: %% Truly? Perhaps... you're right. One of the last things they ever told me was: 'You're wasted here. The Guild doesn't care about you.'
Chinese: %% 真的吗？也许……你是对的。他们对我说的最后几句话里有一句是："你在这里是大材小用。公会根本不在乎你。"

English: Yes, I will seek out Reza. Maybe there's still some good I can do in their... new world. ##<<She does not look very happy about it.>>
Chinese: 好，我会去找雷扎。也许在他们的……新世界里，我还能做点好事。##<<她看起来并不太情愿。>>

English: && Truly, that is kind. But you didn't hear the words we spat at each other before we parted. ##<<She sighs.>> A fool like me would only get in their way.
Chinese: && 你真善良。可你没听到我们分别时互掷的那些话。##<<她叹了口气。>>像我这样的傻瓜，只会碍他们的事。

English: <<Aphra blinks, then looks up at the sky.>> Oh. The snow has stopped... ##Our long winter is finally ending. Alas, I fear spring will be cruel indeed.
Chinese: <<阿芙拉眨眨眼，抬头望天。>>哦。雪停了……##我们的漫长冬天终于要结束了。只是我怕，春天会非常残酷。

English: Once I dreamed that this kingdom could be a paradise. In the end, though, we all have to wake up.
Chinese: 曾经我梦想这个王国能成为天堂。可到头来，我们终究都得醒来。

English: <<Aphra listens intently, with growing horror.>> ##I... Gods alive. That's... ((horrible)).
Chinese: <<阿芙拉凝神听着，惊骇越来越深。>>##我……诸神在上。这……((太可怕了))。

English: I thought I was changing the King, changing the system. But the King... made me? Yet it also made my sisters; left them to die. So I am an expression of the system that killed my sisters.
Chinese: 我以为自己在改变国王，改变体制。可国王……造就了我？却也造出了我的姐妹们；任她们死去。这么说，我就是害死我姐妹的那个体制的产物。

English: Were all my hopes and dreams just part of its plan? Have I ever had a desire or a thought that the King didn't put there? Which parts of me are even ((mine))?
Chinese: 我全部的希望和梦想，都只是它计划的一部分吗？我有过一个欲望、一个念头是国王没放进我脑子里的吗？我身上到底还有哪些部分是((我自己的))？

English: <<She seems on the verge of tears, her decades of practice controlling her emotions finally nullified.>> ##Oh, Gods, what have I done?
Chinese: <<她濒临崩溃，几十年控制情绪的修养终于失效。>>##哦，诸神啊，我都做了什么？

English: <<She laughs hopelessly.>> Maybe it's all for the best, then. I just don't know anymore.
Chinese: <<她绝望地笑。>>也许这样反而是最好的。我已经不知道了。

English: Best of luck, Aphra.
Chinese: 祝你好运，阿芙拉。

English: It's done.
Chinese: 办完了。

English: @@ <<[Lie]>> It's done. I inserted your punchcard.
Chinese: @@ <<[撒谎]>>办完了。你的打孔卡我插进去了。

English: Someone offered me a different punchcard. The Saboteur.
Chinese: 有人给了我另一张打孔卡。破坏者。

English: What happens now?
Chinese: 接下来会怎样？

English: Glad I could help. Farewell, Aphra.
Chinese: 很高兴能帮忙。再会，阿芙拉。

English: The snow has stopped falling.
Chinese: 雪停了。

English: I'll be damned. The spell actually worked.
Chinese: 我真是服了。法术居然真的管用。

English: No system will ever be perfect enough to trust with people's lives.
Chinese: 任何系统都不可能完美到值得托付人命。

English: Your spell would only become another means of control.
Chinese: 你的法术只会变成另一种控制手段。

English: I'm through with grand visions and master plans. Burn it all down.
Chinese: 宏大愿景和宏伟蓝图我都受够了。全都烧光吧。

English: Long enough for people to prepare.
Chinese: 够人们做好准备的时间。

English: Long enough for me to get out of here.
Chinese: 够我脱身的时间。

English: You're wrong, Aphra. People will be better off without the King.
Chinese: 你错了，阿芙拉。没有国王，人们会过得更好。

English: Maybe you should seek out Reza. Ask if you can help.
Chinese: 也许你该去找雷扎。问问能不能帮忙。

English: @@ They spoke fondly of you. I believe they'd welcome your aid. And no one knows better than you what will happen next.
Chinese: @@ 他们很惦记你。我相信他们会欢迎你的帮助。而且没人比你更清楚接下来会发生什么。

English: @@ I really think you should talk to Reza. They spoke fondly of you, and your knowledge would be invaluable to them.
Chinese: @@ 我真觉得你该去和雷扎谈谈。他们很惦记你，你的知识对他们来说是无价之宝。

English: You're right. Forget I said anything.
Chinese: 你说得对。就当我没说。

English: You've done nothing. I didn't input your spell.
Chinese: 你什么都没做成。我没输入你的法术。

English: I'm sorry.
Chinese: 对不起。

English: <<[Say nothing.]>>
Aphra, wait. Before I go, there's something important I need to tell you about your past.
Chinese: 阿芙拉，等等。走之前，有件关于你过去的重要事情要告诉你。

English: Take care of yourself, all right?
Chinese: 照顾好自己，好吗？

English: Sorry it had to be this way, Aphra. Farewell.
Chinese: 抱歉只能这样了，阿芙拉。再会。

English: <<She shakes her head incredulously.>> You Unionites have a strange sense of humour.
Chinese: <<她难以置信地摇头。>>你们联盟人的幽默感可真怪。

English: <<You step out the other side of the mirror.>> ##<<For a moment you think you're still in Ferropolis, until you look up and see that the sky is gone.>>
Chinese: <<你从镜子的另一面走出来。>> ##<<一时间你以为自己还在铁城，直到抬头一看，天空不见了。>>

English: <<Instead of the Oneiric Isles' familiar red neuron star, there is only blackness – save for a swirling gyre of dim blue light, staring down at you like a malevolent eye.>>
Chinese: <<梦幻群岛那颗熟悉的红色神经元星不见了，只剩漆黑——除了一团暗蓝色光的旋涡，像一只恶毒的眼睛俯视着你。>>

English: <<A tenement drifts overhead, unmoored from the earth, tumbling slowly end over end. All around you the city twists up impossibly into the air, houses piled upon houses, pipes and drains and gutters spreading like tree branches, as far as the eye can see.>>
Chinese: <<一栋公寓楼从头顶漂过，脱离了大地，缓缓翻滚。四周的整座城市不可思议地向空中扭去，房屋摞着房屋，管道、下水道和檐槽像树枝一样铺开，一望无际。>>

English: <<It's just a mirror now, reflecting everything except you.>>
Chinese: <<如今它只是一面普通的镜子，映出一切，唯独映不出你。>>

English: <<It's freezing here. Frost crunches under your feet, and every surface is hung with icicles. You see statues in naturalistic poses cluttering the street, but no people. From somewhere nearby there is the sound of discordant music.>>
Chinese: <<这里冷极了。霜在你脚下嘎吱作响，所有表面上都挂着冰凌。街上杂乱地立着姿态逼真的雕像，却不见人影。附近某处传来不和谐的音乐声。>>

English: <<You shiver. Why the hell did Aphra bring you here?>>
Chinese: <<你打了个寒战。阿芙拉到底为什么把你带到这儿来？>>

English: <<There is no answer, save the echo of your own voice.>>
Chinese: <<没有任何回答，只有你自己声音的回响。>>

English: <<Your stomach twists as you realise this 'statue' was once a living person. Their mouth is open and their fist is raised in the air, as if they were frozen solid in the midst of a screaming argument.>>
Chinese: <<你的胃一绞——你意识到这座"雕像"曾是一个活人。他大张着嘴，拳头举在空中，仿佛在一场尖叫的争吵中被冻僵了。>>

English: <<As you explore, you find another frozen person lying tucked up in bed in the middle of the street, wearing a nightcap with a pom-pom on the end. Then a family sitting around a dinner table, forks and cups suspended halfway to their mouths.>>
Chinese: <<你四处探索，又发现一个被冻住的人，就躺在街心，盖着被子，睡帽上还带着绒球。然后是一家子围坐餐桌，叉子和杯子举到嘴边，悬停在半空。>>

English: <<The music verges on random noise. Every time you think you've figured out the structure, it changes and slips from your grasp. Sometimes it stops for several minutes and all you can do is wait, shivering.>>
Chinese: <<那音乐近乎随机的噪声。每次你以为摸清了结构，它就变卦，从你指间溜走。有时它停上好几分钟，你只能发着抖干等。>>

English: <<In the deserted remnants of an old plaza you find a grand piano, its keys plinking and plonking on their own. No other living soul is visible.>>
Chinese: <<在一座荒废的旧广场上，你发现一架三角钢琴，琴键自己在叮叮咚咚地响。四下不见任何活人。>>

English: <<Time seems to work differently here. You feel like you're wandering for hours, but it could be minutes. At some point you realise you are now upside-down in relation to where you started. A rowing boat with two petrified passengers spins in the air.>>
Chinese: <<这里的时间似乎不按常理走。你觉得自己游荡了好几个小时，但可能只有几分钟。某一刻你意识到，自己已经上下颠倒了。一艘坐着两个石化乘客的划艇在空中打转。>>

English: <<Finally, leaning on the railings of a catwalk that goes nowhere, clad in a well-worn fur coat, you spot Aphra. She waves at you.>>
Chinese: <<终于，你看见阿芙拉倚在一截通向虚无的栈桥栏杆上，穿着一件穿旧了的皮大衣。她朝你挥手。>>

English: <<You summon the mnemonic mandala in your mind's eye, and begin to mouth the well-practiced syllables...>>
Chinese: <<你在脑海中唤起记忆曼陀罗，开始默诵练得滚瓜烂熟的音节……>>

English: <<...but all you get is a sudden, splitting headache. It feels like your brain is trying to climb a vast featureless black surface, without even a crack for a handhold.>>
Chinese: <<……但换来的只是一阵骤然的、撕裂般的头痛。感觉像你的大脑在攀一面广阔无物的黑墙，连一条可供抓握的裂缝都没有。>>

English: <<Through thick and thin, you've come to rely on the cipher magic answering your call. To suddenly be without it is utterly terrifying.>>
Chinese: <<一路风雨，你早已习惯了密文魔法随叫随到。突然间失去它，太可怕了。>>

English: <<Just an ordinary mirror...>>
Chinese: <<只是一面普通的镜子……>>

English: <<The mirror is sealed to you.>>
Chinese: <<镜子对你封闭了。>>

English: <<[Try to get back through the mirror]>>
Chinese: <<[设法从镜子穿回去]>>

English: <<[Cast your 'Return Home' spell to get out of here]>>
Chinese: <<[施放"归乡"法术离开这里]>>

English: <<[Look around]>>
Chinese: <<[四处看看]>>

English: Hello? Aphra? Anyone?
Chinese: 喂？阿芙拉？有人吗？

English: <<[Examine one of the statues]>>
Chinese: <<[检查一尊雕像]>>

English: <<[Look for the source of the music]>>
Chinese: <<[寻找音乐的来源]>>

English: <<[Ignore the scenery and search for a way out]>>
Chinese: <<[别管风景，找出路]>>

English: <<They sniff the air.>>##You have the stink of the countryside about you, if I'm any judge. Dangerous place. Well, citizen, you've come to the right shop. Name's <<Jaczemir>>; I sell things that kill.
Chinese: <<他嗅了嗅空气。>>##要是我没闻错，你身上有一股乡下的味道。危险的地方啊。好了公民，你来对铺子了。我叫<<雅采米尔>>；我卖能杀人的东西。

English: <<They tap a large ledger on their counter.>> ##What do you need it for? I have to keep records, see, in case the King comes knocking.
Chinese: <<他敲着柜台上的一本大账册。>> ##买它做什么？我得留记录的，万一国王来敲门呢。

English: <<They scribble in the ledger.>>##Had a good few of your lot in here over the years. Not all of them come back. King bless and protect you, eh?
Chinese: <<他在账册上涂写。>>##这些年你这种人来过不少。不是人人都回得来。国王保佑你，嗯？

English: <<They scribble in the ledger.>> You work the landships? You're braver than I am, citizen. If you ask me, buildings should stay still. You watch out for saboteurs, eh?
Chinese: <<他在账册上涂写。>>你在陆行巨舰上干活？你可比我勇敢，公民。要我说，房子就该待在原地不动。破坏分子你可得留神，嗯？

English: <<They scribble in the ledger.>>##Long live the King! Can't say I see many of your lot in here. Most are content to rely on your – sorry, I mean the ((King's)) magic.
Chinese: <<他在账册上涂写。>>##国王万岁！你们这路人我店里倒不常见。大多数人都满足于靠你——抱歉，我是说((国王的))魔法。

English: <<They give you the hairy eyeball.>>##Always nice to have a bit of levity in here. Just tell me what to write, won't you?
Chinese: <<他嫌弃地瞪你。>>##店里来点轻松气氛总是好的。告诉我怎么写就行，好吗？

English: Now I just need your name, occupation, and place of residence. ##<<You invent some plausible fake details. Something tells you it would be unwise to tell the truth.>>
Chinese: 现在我只需要你的名字、职业和住址。 ##<<你编了一套像样的假信息。某种直觉告诉你，说实话是不明智的。>>

English: <<Jaczemir sniffs the air deeply.>> Aha, the farmer! You ain't dead, so I guess I didn't sell you a duff weapon. What can I do you for?
Chinese: <<雅采米尔深深嗅了嗅空气。>>啊哈，农夫！你没死，看来我没卖你劣质武器。今天要点什么？

English: <<Jaczemir sniffs the air deeply.>> Aha, the landship guard! You ain't dead, so I guess I didn't sell you a duff weapon. What can I do you for?
Chinese: <<雅采米尔深深嗅了嗅空气。>>啊哈，陆行巨舰卫兵！你没死，看来我没卖你劣质武器。今天要点什么？

English: <<Jaczemir sniffs the air deeply.>> Welcome back, your honour! You ain't dead, so I guess I didn't sell you a duff weapon. What can I do you for?
Chinese: <<雅采米尔深深嗅了嗅空气。>>欢迎回来，长官！你没死，看来我没卖你劣质武器。今天要点什么？

English: So, what can I do you for?
Chinese: 那么，要点什么？

English: What else can I do you for?
Chinese: 还要点什么？

English: Its Majesty understands that folk need protection sometimes. But with that Saboteur creeping about, we can't be too careful. He could be secretly buying up weapons and building his own army, or smuggling them out to the Apostatic Union for coin.
Chinese: 陛下明白，民众有时需要防身。但那个破坏者到处鬼鬼祟祟，我们不能不防。他可能偷偷囤积武器组建私军，也可能把武器偷运给叛教联盟换钱。

English: Truth be told, if the Saboteur needs weapons, I'm sure he can get 'em elsewhere. Still, rules are rules.
Chinese: 说实话，破坏者真要武器，他自有别的门路。但规矩就是规矩。

English: I'm just glad I ain't having supply problems, like poor old Quarshie the clothier. For whatever reason, the King's churning out more weapons than we know what to do with.
Chinese: 我倒是庆幸自己没有供货问题，不像可怜的裁缝夸尔希老兄。不知为什么，国王生产的武器多到我们不知道怎么消化。

English: <<They raise their eyebrows at you, then consult their ledger.>>##Hmm... Setting Sun Company... Clockwork Lancers... did you say Dirk Starr? No, I remember him. He's a wainwright, not a sellsword.
Chinese: <<他朝你扬扬眉，然后翻查账册。>>##嗯……落日商社……发条枪骑队……你是说迪克·斯塔尔？不，我记得他。他是造车匠，不是卖命的。

English: Sorry. If any Dark Star ever bought weapons here, they used a false identity. Hard to believe anyone would do something like that, I know.
Chinese: 抱歉。要真有黑星在这儿买过武器，那用的也是假身份。难以相信有人会干那种事，我知道。

English: Maybe try [[Vidal]] the [[vision trader]]? He fought in the God War as lad, and of all the merchants in town it's him who deals most often with outsiders.
Chinese: 要不试试[[幻象商人]][[维达尔]]？他小时候打过神之战，镇上的商人里他跟外人打交道最多。

English: I'm interested in buying some weaponry.
Chinese: 我想买些武器。

English: I'm a farmer. I need it for my own protection.
Chinese: 我是农夫。买来防身。

English: I'm a guard for one of those big roaming workshops.
Chinese: 我是那些会走动的大工坊的卫兵。

English: [Show Machinist insignia] I'm on royal business.
Chinese: [出示机械师徽记] 我在办王室公务。

English: Murder. Manslaughter. You know, crimes in general.
Chinese: 谋杀。过失杀人。你知道的，各种罪行。

English: Actually, this isn't where I need to be.
Chinese: 其实，这里不是我要来的地方。

English: Let's see what you've got for sale.
Chinese: 看看你都卖些什么。

English: Why do you have to keep all those records?
Chinese: 你为什么要留那些记录？

English: You ever see a former Dark Star mercenary around here?
Chinese: 这附近你见过前黑星佣兵吗？

English: Nothing else for now, thanks.
Chinese: 暂时没了，谢谢。

English: <<This shopkeeper appears very anxious and harried by many problems.>>##No, and for the sixth time no, we do ((not)) yet have any sky-blubber coats in stock! I ((have)) petitioned, I ((am)) petitioning, I ((will)) petition...
Chinese: <<这位店主一脸焦虑，被各种问题折腾得够呛。>>##不，第六次说不，我们((还))没进到天鲸脂外套！我((呈文))过了，我((正在))呈文，我((还会))呈文……

English: <<They look at you properly for the first time.>>##Oh, King's mercy. Forgive the impromptu grammar lesson, citizen – I mistook you for a regular. Everything's in such a whirl today.
Chinese: <<他这才正经打量了你一遍。>>##哦，国王开恩。原谅我刚才的即席语法课，公民——我把你当成常客了。今天忙得团团转。

English: I am [[Quarshie]], clothier and armourer to the citizens of Ferropolis. Right now I've more orders than I can fill, but if you want something that's ((not)) out of stock...
Chinese: 我是[[夸尔希]]，铁城公民的裁缝兼甲胄师。眼下我手里的订单多到做不完，不过如果你想要((没))缺货的东西……

English: <<Quarshie appears as nervous as ever.>>##No, no, no, no, that's no good. Perhaps if I stitched them together? Three or four layers? But then...
Chinese: <<夸尔希还是那副紧张样。>>##不行不行不行，这样不行。要不我把它们缝在一起？三四层？可是……

English: Oh! Forgive me, citizen. Busy as always. What can I do for you today?
Chinese: 哦！失礼了，公民。老是这样忙。今天能为您做点什么？

English: Is there anything else you need? Only I've a lot to get done today...
Chinese: 还有别的需要吗？我今天活儿多着呢……

English: Dark Stars? Good heavens, no. I've served barely any mercenaries since the border closed. Half my takings used to come from exports – our weapons and equipment make the Union's look primitive, or so I'm told.
Chinese: 黑星？老天爷，没有。边境一关，佣兵我几乎没接过。我以前一半的进项靠出口——据说咱们的武器装备，拿去跟联盟的一比，跟原始人似的。

English: Of course, that's probably why the Union became so belligerent. Couldn't have their own merchants being put out of business, could they? Its Majesty had no choice but to retaliate in kind.
Chinese: 当然，联盟后来那么好斗，多半就是这个缘故。总不能眼睁睁看着自家的商人被挤垮吧？陛下也就只好以其人之道还治其人之身了。

English: Perhaps you should speak to [[Baba Xenia]] at the [[Squeaky Wheel]]? She gets all sorts coming through that teahouse.
Chinese: 要不您去[[吱嘎轮]]找[[克塞尼娅大娘]]？各种各样的人都从她那茶馆过。

English: A natural consequence of this accursed winter. Even the ((animals)) need fur coats. There doesn't seem to be enough fuel, and I've heard of people freezing to death in their houses.
Chinese: 都是这场遭天谴的寒冬闹的。连((牲口))都得穿皮袄。燃料眼见不够，我听说有人在家里活活冻死了。

English: But... well, just look at what the King sends me. ##<<They run various beautiful garments through their hands: fine, diaphanous robes and lacy blouses, silk scarves and thin cotton pantaloons. Perfect summer wear.>>
Chinese: 可是……唉，您看看国王都给我送来些什么。##<<他们手里拂过一件件华服：轻薄透亮的袍子、蕾丝罩衫、丝绸围巾、细棉布长裤。地道的夏装。>>

English: Are you joking? All the animals here are earmarked for agriculture, and under the King's protection. And imports require a royal permit. Either way, if you dumped a pile of pelts on my counter, I'd have to call the Militia.
Chinese: 您说笑呢？这儿的牲口全划归农用，受国王保护。进口皮货要王室许可。总之，您要真抱一堆生皮堆我柜台上，我只能叫民兵了。

English: <<Quarshie sighs.>> We all see the problem. Except, apparently, Its Majesty.
Chinese: <<夸尔希叹气。>>问题大家都看得见。唯独陛下，显然看不见。

English: Let's see what you've got for sale.
Chinese: 看看你都卖些什么。

English: You ever see a former Dark Star mercenary around here?
Chinese: 这附近你见过一个前黑星佣兵吗？

English: Why is there so much demand?
Chinese: 怎么需求这么大？

English: Maybe I could go skin some furry animals for you?
Chinese: 要不我去给你剥几张毛皮？

English: I think I see your problem.
Chinese: 你的难处我明白了。

English: Nothing more for now, thanks.
Chinese: 暂时没了，谢谢。

English: <<These two citizens are poring over a pile of papers.>> ##Wait, so am I meant to fill out this part or not? Do you count as a 'dependant'? What the hell is a 'domicile'?
Chinese: <<两位公民埋头研究一堆文件。>>##等等，这一栏我到底填不填？我算"受养人"吗？"住所"到底是个什么玩意儿？

English: Why do we have to claim a reimbursement? Why don't they just give us what we're entitled to? Ugh, and to think I learned to read for ((this)).
Chinese: 为什么非得我们申报返还？该给我们直接发不就完了？呃，想当年我学认字，就是为了((这个))。

English: <<These two citizens are poring over a pile of papers.>> ##No no, I think that part's only for if you've been evacuated. Wait, but it says we should already have a case number?
Chinese: <<两位公民埋头研究一堆文件。>>##不对不对，那一栏只有被疏散的人才填。等等，这上面说我们早该有案号了？

English: <<The man naps, awaiting his place in the queue.>>
Chinese: <<那人打着盹，等他的号叫到。>>

English: <<You gently ease the ticket out of their grip. On one side is printed a cogwheel coat of arms and the other with the number 115. You pocket it.>>
Chinese: <<你轻轻从他手里抽出号牌。一面印着齿轮纹章，另一面写着 115。你揣进了兜里。>>

English: [Steal the ticket for yourself.]
Chinese: [把号牌偷走。]

English: We just got here from [[Cloudpine Oblast.]]##Held on as long as we could, but this winter finally did us in. Lot of folks like us in this town, or so I heard.
Chinese: 我们刚从[[云杉州]]逃过来。##能撑的都撑了，可这个冬天终究把我们撂倒了。听说城里像我们这样的人还有不少。

English: We just got here from [[Cloudpine Oblast.]]##Held on as long as we could. Even with the winter ending, it's still too cold to farm. Lot of folks like us in this town, or so I heard.
Chinese: 我们刚从[[云杉州]]逃过来。##能撑的都撑了。寒冬就算过去，天还是冷得没法种地。听说城里像我们这样的人还有不少。

English: I'm just hoping the Factor can sort us out.
Chinese: 我就指望事务官能给我们安排了。

English: <<This citizen has a baby swaddled up and nestled inside their voluminous coat, and is singing them a soft lullaby in a language you don't know.>>
Chinese: <<这位公民的大衣里裹着襁褓中的婴儿，正用一种你听不懂的语言轻轻哼着摇篮曲。>>

English: You hungry?##Somehow I've got enough supplies with me for two people, even though I'm travellin' alone.
Chinese: 饿吗？##说来也怪，我一个人赶路，包里的口粮却够两个人吃。

English: It's weird, there's stuff in me pack I don't remember packing...
Chinese: 怪就怪在，包里有些东西我根本不记得装过……

English: Are you here to see the Factor too? You're in for quite a wait, I fear.
Chinese: 你也是来找事务官的？那你可要等上一阵子了，我看。

English: <<This citizen is remonstrating with a guard, waving a scrap of pink paper.>> ##You don't understand, it's these new numbers, see? My ticket says 144, but now they're telling us every ten is a six...
Chinese: <<这位公民正向卫兵申辩，挥着一张粉色的纸条。>>##你不懂，是这些新数字闹的，你听我说？我的号牌写着144，可现在他们跟我说，逢十要按六算……

English: So is it actually 144, or... what? 36 plus 44? 70, is it? Oh, and count the bloody zero! See, only a wizard could make sense of it. Now I've been waiting for two hours already to see the Factor and I just want to know –
Chinese: 那到底是 144，还是……啥？36 加 44？70，对吧？哦对，还有那个该死的零也要算！你瞧，除了法师谁搞得懂。我等事务官都等了两个钟头了，我就想知道——

English: <<This guard is occupied trying to stop the waiting room descending into chaos.>> ##Citizen, I've told you, the Royal Factor is very busy. Your ticket will be called in the order it was –
Chinese: <<这名卫兵正忙于阻止候见室陷入混乱。>>##公民，我说过了，皇家事务官很忙。您的号会按顺序——

English: <<They jerk their head around to yell at someone across the room.>> ##Oi! You over there! I told you to sit down! I've got my eyes on you. Now, citizen, like I was saying –
Chinese: <<他们猛地扭头朝屋里另一头喊。>>##喂！说你呢！让你坐下！我盯着你呢。好了公民，我刚说到——

English: If your number's been called, you may speak to the Factor. If not, you must stay downstairs. ##Now please stop bothering me, won't you?
Chinese: 叫到您的号，您就可以跟事务官谈。没叫到，就请在楼下待着。##现在请别再来烦我了，行吗？

English: <<They eye you up and down suspiciously.>> ##Ain't seen you around here before. Not a resident, I'll warrant.
Chinese: <<他们狐疑地上下打量你。>>##这附近没见过你。不是这儿的住户吧。

English: <<They narrow their eyes at you.>>##Right. Well, I'm [[Kaur]]. I solve problems round here and I look after folk. If I hear you've been botherin' anyone without good cause, I'll chuck you off a walkway.
Chinese: <<他们眯起眼。>>##行。我叫[[考尔]]。这一片有了麻烦归我摆平，人归我照应。要我听说你无缘无故招惹谁，我就把你从步道上扔下去。

English: && <<They narrow their eyes at you.>> A likely story. Go on, get out of here before I chuck you off a walkway. We don't need strangers poking their noses around.
Chinese: && <<他们眯起眼。>>编，接着编。趁我没把你从步道上扔下去，赶紧滚。我们不需要生人在这一带探头探脑。

English: %% <<They appraise you cautiously.>> Right. Welcome to the icebox, then. My condolences. ##Name's [[Kaur]]. I solve problems round here and I look after folk. Guess that includes you.
Chinese: %% <<他们谨慎地打量你。>>行。那就欢迎来到冰箱，节哀。##我叫[[考尔]]。这一片有了麻烦归我摆平，人归我照应。估计也包括你了。

English: Let's see: boilers are busted right now. Maebh in Number Four's got extra blankets if you need 'em. You get hold of anything to burn, you share it around, and we'll do the same for you. Folks here look after each other.
Chinese: 这么说吧：锅炉眼下全坏了。四号房的梅芙那儿有富余毯子，需要就去拿。你弄到什么能烧的，大家分着用，我们也会这么对你。这地方的人互相照应。

English: Last thing – we don't want any ((problems)) in this buildin'. Things are hard enough without the King's wrath comin' down on us. You get involved with anything ((funny)), you keep it to yourself.
Chinese: 最后一件事——这栋楼里((不许))出乱子。国王的怒火压下来之前，日子已经够难了。你在外面((沾))上什么破事，别带进这栋楼。

English: These are good people, you understand? They don't deserve no trouble. Don't make none and we'll get on just fine.
Chinese: 这些都是好人，明白吗？他们不该摊上麻烦。你不去惹事，咱们就相安无事。

English: You want somethin' more from me?
Chinese: 还想从我这里打听什么？

English: <<Kaur snorts.>>##I'm just an ordinary resident like anyone else. A little thing called bein' a good neighbour – you might try it sometime.
Chinese: <<考尔嗤笑。>>##我就是个普通人，跟谁一样。这就叫做好邻居——你哪天也可以试试。

English: Yasmeen's kid, right? Number 21, top o' the building. Keep climbin' stairs until they run out. ##Don't you be causin' her any grief, now. That family's had more than their share as it is.
Chinese: 亚斯敏家的孩子，对吧？21 号房，楼顶。楼梯走到头就到了。##你可别给她添堵。那家人受的罪已经够多了。

English: Can't complain. But I'm worried about Yosip in Number 28. Cold's bad enough in the main building, let alone in the floaters. You come across any spare fuel, you let me know.
Chinese: 没什么可抱怨的。但我担心 28 号房的约西普。主楼已经够冷了，更别说浮空层。你碰到谁有富余燃料，给我递个信。

English: Weird? Like what? Like newcomers askin' funny questions?
Chinese: 怪事？什么怪事？比如新来的净问些古怪问题？

English: <<They pause to digest this. It's clear they haven't thought about it before.>> ##Huh. Now that you mention it, that ((is)) weird.
Chinese: <<他们顿了顿，消化这句话。显然从没想过。>>##嘿。经你一说，((确实))怪。

English: <<They shrug.>> ##Probably just another little royal whoopsie. Assigning room numbers that don't make no sense? Typical.
Chinese: <<他们耸耸肩。>>##八成又是王室哪次手滑。房间编号排得没头没脑？老毛病了。

English: No, I have business with someone here.
Chinese: 不，我来这儿找人有事。

English: No, I'm just visiting a friend.
Chinese: 不，我来看个朋友。

English: @@ Actually, I just moved in.
Chinese: @@ 其实，我刚搬进来。

English: Who put you in charge here? I don't see a Machinist brooch.
Chinese: 谁让你负责这里的？我可没见你戴机械师胸针。

English: Is there a Nadja in this building?
Chinese: 这栋楼里是不是有个叫娜佳的？

English: @@ I really am a resident. I just got assigned here by the King.
Chinese: @@ 我真是住户。国王刚把我分派到这儿。

English: How is everyone doing here?
Chinese: 大家都还好吗？

English: Hey, don't you notice something weird about this building?
Chinese: 嘿，你不觉得这栋楼有点怪吗？

English: The room numbers go up to 28, but there's only five rooms.
Chinese: 房间号排到 28，可整层只有五个房间。

English: Never mind, it's just a feeling.
Chinese: 没什么，就是有点感觉。

English: I'll do my best.
Chinese: 我会尽力的。

English: Any advice for a new neighbour?
Chinese: 对新邻居有什么建议吗？

English: King's favour to you, Kaur.
Chinese: 国王赐福，考尔。

English: <<This unsavoury-looking character tilts his chin up at you from the shadows in an effort to get your attention.>> ##Evening, pal. Got anythin' nice fer me?
Chinese: <<这个贼眉鼠眼的家伙从阴影里朝你扬扬下巴，想引起你的注意。>>##晚上好啊，伙计。有什么好货要给我吗？

English: Happens to the best of us. Sorry, pal – no goods, no coin. Maybe try again tomorrow, eh? I'll be here.
Chinese: 谁都有走背字的时候。抱歉了伙计——没货就没钱。明天再试试？我在这儿等你。

English: <<This unsavoury-looking character tilts his chin up at you from the shadows in an effort to get your attention.>> ##Evening, pal. Ye looking for some easy coin?
Chinese: <<这个贼眉鼠眼的家伙从阴影里朝你扬扬下巴，想引起你的注意。>>##晚上好啊，伙计。想挣点轻松钱不？

English: Oh, nothin' much. Just lend us yer summon when mornin' comes.##Payment on delivery, in cash or in goods. Nice an' clean, see?
Chinese: 也没什么大不了的。明早召唤的时候，把你的召唤借我们用用就行。##一手交货一手交钱，现金物资都行。干干净净，明白？

English: So how about it, pal? Easy money.
Chinese: 怎么样，伙计？轻松钱。

English: Simple. See when ye go to the summonin' station tomorrow? Ask the King for the item ((I)) tell ye. Bring it back to me and you're quids in. Same the next day if ye like.
Chinese: 简单。你明天去召唤站，照((我))说的东西向国王许愿。拿回来交给我，钱就进你兜了。愿意的话，天天来。

English: Why use up yer daily summon like a bampot beggin' the King for some shite ye might never get? This way it's money in yer pocket, food on yer table, coal in yer fire, no fuss.
Chinese: 何必把每天一次的召唤浪费掉，跟个傻子似的求国王赐你些八辈子要不着的破烂？我这套，钱进兜、饭上桌、炉子里有煤，省心。

English: Oh, and if you get down there first thing, there's a bonus. Sometimes the good stuff goes early, see.
Chinese: 哦对，你要是一早头一个下去，还有奖金。好货总是先到先得，你懂的。

English: A [[void diode.]] Got that? [[Void diode.]]##Never you mind what it does. Far as ye're concerned, it's a meal ticket.
Chinese: 一枚[[虚空二极管]]。记住了？[[虚空二极管]]。##它干什么用的你别管。对你来说，它就是一张饭票。

English: Who wants to know? Right now all I see's another common bawbag pokin' their nose in other people's business.
Chinese: 谁打听呢？我现在只看见又一个多管闲事的蠢货。

English: Yer a ((cog))? Shit, shit, shit. Listen, ye don't want to waste yer time with me – I'm just the small fry, see?
Chinese: 你是((齿轮佬))？完了完了完了。听着，你犯不上在我身上浪费工夫——我就是个小虾米，明白？

English: [[Mac]] is the one ye want. Least, that's what he calls himself. Hangs around down in the Conduits, at the bazaar, see? Only there at night.
Chinese: 你们要找的是[[麦克]]。至少他自称这个。在导管区的集市一带转悠。只在夜里出现。

English: && Sorry, pal, my clients are confidential. Maybe once we've worked together a spell.
Chinese: && 抱歉了伙计，客户信息保密。等我们合作过一阵子再说吧。

English: %% Aha, I knew you were no common roaster. Well now, if it's ((business))...
Chinese: %% 啊哈，我就知道你不是一般的愣头青。好嘛，既然是谈((生意))……

English: O' course, yer honour, o' course.
Chinese: 当然了长官，当然了。

English: I'm just going about my business, yer honor...
Chinese: 我只是做点小买卖，长官……

English: What did you want me to do again?
Chinese: 你刚说让我做什么来着？

English: I tried to get your item, but the King gave me something else.
Chinese: 你的货我试着要了，可国王给了我别的。

English: Tell me where to find your client again.
Chinese: 再说一遍你那客户在哪找？

English: I'll keep you posted.
Chinese: 有消息我告诉你。

English: Maybe. What do you want for it?
Chinese: 也许吧。你出什么价？

English: Sorry, not interested.
Chinese: 抱歉，没兴趣。

English: How does it work?
Chinese: 具体怎么操作？

English: What items do you need?
Chinese: 你需要什么物品？

English: Who exactly are these items for?
Chinese: 这些东西到底是给谁的？

English: I'll think about it.
Chinese: 我考虑考虑。

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Only your king, citizen. Or must we do this the hard way?
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>我身后站着的是国王，公民。还是说，非得来硬的？

English: @@ I represent a buyer who could greatly burnish your fortunes.
Chinese: @@ 我代表一位买家，能让你的日子风生水起。

English: No offence meant. Let's drop it.
Chinese: 没有冒犯的意思。翻篇吧。

English: I don't want to see you around here again, understand? Your little scam is over.
Chinese: 我不想再在这儿见到你，明白吗？你这套小把戏到头了。

English: Very good. Carry on.
Chinese: 很好。继续吧。

English: About the [[void diode]]...
Chinese: 关于那枚[[虚空二极管]]……

English: <<The trader looks nervous, and keeps one protective hand on their stall.>> ##King's blessing, citizen. Don't often see new faces down here. Or have we met before?
Chinese: <<商贩神色紧张，一只手护着摊位。>>##国王赐福，公民。下城少见到生面孔。还是说咱们见过？

English: I've not much in S-T-O-C-K just now, but if you've got wee mouths to feed, mebbe I can set something aside next time I do.
Chinese: 我手头"'货'"不多，你要是有小嘴要喂，下回有货我给你留点。

English: You mean the Conduits? It's not posh, and it's far from pretty, but it's warm and it's cheap and the Militia don't bother us, so I s'pose that makes it home. This wee bit here is what we call the bazaar.
Chinese: 你说导管区？不算体面，也谈不上好看，但暖和、便宜，民兵也不来烦我们，所以就当个家吧。这一小块就是我们说的集市。

English: There's no summoning stations down here, and it's harder to invoke the King's magic. Some folk see that as a blessing, though. To the cogs, it seems to be out of sight, out of mind.
Chinese: 下面没有召唤站，国王的魔法也更难借动。不过有人倒把这当福气。在齿轮佬眼里，眼不见心不烦嘛。

English: Anyhow, it is what it is.
Chinese: 总之，就这个样子吧。

English: I used to have an S-H-O-P in the upper city, until my licence got revoked with no explanation. I'm meant to have broken a law, but Its Majesty didn't see fit to tell me which one.
Chinese: 我原先在上城有间"'铺'"，后来执照被吊销了，也不给个说法。说是我犯了法，可陛下懒得告诉我是哪条。

English: I petitioned 17 times for a new licence. Every single petition got rejected, and the reasons never made any sense. Eventually I gave up.
Chinese: 我申请了十七次新执照。每一次都被驳回，理由从来没有一条说得通。最后我死心了。

English: No one really knows. Some S-A-L-E-S are technically allowed as long as you follow certain rules, but they won't tell you the rules, and anyway it's always changing.
Chinese: 谁也说不准。有些"'买卖'"按理是允许的，只要你守某些规矩，可他们不告诉你规矩是什么，而且规矩还老变。

English: Other stuff is technically banned except for special cases, only it seems like everything is a special case 'cos no one ever gets punished.
Chinese: 另一些东西按理是禁止的，特殊情况除外——可什么都能算特殊情况，反正从来没人真被罚过。

English: When the Machinists do arrest someone, they don't explain why. We just have to guess what they did wrong and try not to do the same thing.
Chinese: 机械师真抓人的时候，也不解释为什么。我们只能猜自己哪里做错了，然后尽量别再犯。

English: Lotta folk think you can escape the King's notice by avoiding certain words. Like B-U-Y, or C-O-S-T. No idea if it works, but it can't hurt. So I don't S-E-L-L anything. I un-possess" it."
Chinese: 好多人以为，避开某些字眼就能躲开国王的眼睛。比如 G-E-N，或者 Q-I-A-N。管不管用不知道，反正没坏处。所以我不“售出”任何东西。我只是“转让”。

English: Don't get it twisted, mind. The Machinists ain't against commerce, or making money. You've seen all those fancy shops up top, aye? They just hate anything they can't track and measure. That's how they stay in control.
Chinese: 别搞错了。机械师不反对买卖，也不反对挣钱。上城那些气派铺子你见过了吧？他们只是恨一切他们追踪不到、度量不了的东西。他们就是这么掌权的。

English: What can you tell me about this place?
Chinese: 关于这地方，你能给我讲讲吗？

English: How come you're down here, and not up there?
Chinese: 你怎么在下面待着，不上头去？

English: Is what you're doing illegal or something?
Chinese: 你干的这个，违法吗？

English: Why do you keep spelling out words?
Chinese: 你怎么老把字拆开说？

English: Well, King's blessing to you.
Chinese: 好吧，国王赐福。

English: King's blessing to you.
Chinese: 国王赐福。

English: The Conduits are beautiful in the rain, you know. All that water running down from the upper city, rivers and curtains of it, down the pipes and gutters and cascading off all the odd bits of machinery.
Chinese: 下雨天的导管区可美了，你知道吗。上城的水全流下来，河一样的、帘子一样的，顺着管道和檐槽淌，从那些奇形怪状的机器边上层层跌落。

English: Maybe you'll get to see it too, if spring ever returns.
Chinese: 要是春天能回来，你也能见着。

English: The long winter is finally coming to and end. Oh how I've been longing to see the rain again.
Chinese: 漫长的冬天总算快到头了。唉，我多想再看一眼下雨啊。

English: Hmm, what's that now? My dear, let me find my looking glass... why is your face so ((small))?
Chinese: 嗯，什么？亲爱的，让我找找我的窥镜……你的脸怎么这么((小))？

English: <<She fishes among the charms dangling at her neck and produces a large glass lens, which has the disconcerting effect of magnifying her eye to enormous size.>>
Chinese: <<她在脖子上挂着的一堆护符里翻找，掏出一片大玻璃镜片，效果骇人：她的一只眼睛被放大到巨大无比。>>

English: Much better, yes! You see, my dear, I must read your lips, for my ears cannot hear your words. ##<<Her one giant pupil dances back and forth like a fish in a bowl as she examines you.>>
Chinese: 好多了，好！你看，亲爱的，我得读你的唇语，我的耳朵听不见你的话。##<<她打量你时，那只巨大的瞳孔像碗中的鱼一样来回游动。>>

English: You seek alchemical aid, do you not? Eye of wyrm and hair of slug, and all that? I am [[Madame Lascaux]], and in the roiling mists of your future I sense a most fruitful relationship for both of us.
Chinese: 你是来求炼金术的吧？蠕龙之眼、蛞蝓之发，诸如此类？我是[[拉斯考夫人]]，在你未来翻滚的迷雾里，我预见了一段对我们俩都大有裨益的缘分。

English: <<Madame Lascaux examines you through her looking glass, one huge pupil dancing back and forth like a fish in a bowl.>>
Chinese: <<拉斯考夫人透过窥镜打量你，巨大的瞳孔像碗中的鱼一样来回游动。>>

English: My dear, alas my dear! If only I could bottle a happier fate for you. Still, perhaps there's something I ((can)) do?
Chinese: 唉，我的天哪，亲爱的！真希望我能给你装瓶一个好点的命运。不过，也许我((还是))有办法的？

English: Now, my dear, what more would you ask of me?
Chinese: 好了亲爱的，你还想问什么？

English: My dear, let us not be so ((mercenary)). Ours is a bond of comity, of mutual benefit, hmm? Of course, I'd be delighted to show you my latest brews...
Chinese: 亲爱的，咱们别这么((满身铜臭))。我们之间是交情，是互利，嗯？当然，我很乐意给你看看我新酿的几样……

English: Must an art older than any kingdom answer to the transient diktats of mortals? Ah, who can say. But let us not talk of clauses and codicils, which do so befuddle my old mind.
Chinese: 一门比任何王国都古老的技艺，难道要听凭凡人朝令夕改的摆布？唉，谁说得清呢。不过咱们别谈什么条款附录了，太伤我这颗老脑筋。

English: Think instead of your future, and your heart. I sense a burning thirst for what I can supply, and a great fear of chains and fetters. I also sense a ((complicated)) relationship with our dearest King.
Chinese: 不如想想你的前程，想想你的心。我感觉得到，你对我能提供的东西渴得冒火，而你对枷锁镣铐怕得要死。我还感觉得到，你跟咱们最亲爱的国王之间，关系有点((复杂))。

English: Fell, O, most fell are the omens for you, should you try to play the goody two-shoes!
Chinese: 凶，哦，你要是还想当什么正人君子，凶兆对你可就太凶了！

English: <<She begins to sing in a reedy voice.>>##Ah! Farewell and adieu to you fair Slevan ladies... farewell and adieu to you ladies of Slev...
Chinese: <<她用尖细的嗓子唱了起来。>>##啊！再见了，斯列夫的俏姑娘们……再见了，斯列夫的姑娘们……

English: Let's see what you've been brewing.
Chinese: 看看你酿了些什么。

English: Let's see what you have for sale.
Chinese: 看看你都卖些什么。

English: Is this stuff legal? I notice you're not in the upper city.
Chinese: 这些东西合法吗？我注意到你没在上城开店。

English: Adieu, madame.
Chinese: 再会，夫人。

English: Wotcher, cock. You look like a cove with an eye for the finer things. And if you're down in the Conduits, I'll warrant you're not afraid of walkin' the wild side.
Chinese: 哟，老铁。瞧你这样子，就是个识货的。而且既然你下到导管区来了，我敢说你也不怕在刀口上走路。

English: Upon my name, these are the finest curiosities in all this blessed land, going for a song. Just don't ask where they came from and we'll get along just fine.
Chinese: 以我的名义起誓，这儿全是全城最精的稀罕玩意儿，贱卖。别问来路，咱们的交情就长久。

English: <<The man gives you a conspiratorial nod.>>##Wotcher, cock. Back to sample the finest curiosities in Ferropolis?
Chinese: <<那人冲你心照不宣地点点头。>>##哟，老铁。回来品鉴铁城最精的稀罕玩意儿？

English: <<Mac gives you a conspiratorial nod.>>##Wotcher, cock. Back to sample the finest curiosities in Ferropolis?
Chinese: <<麦克冲你心照不宣地点点头。>>##哟，老铁。回来品鉴铁城最精的稀罕玩意儿？

English: Now, did you want something or are you just wastin' my time?
Chinese: 那么，你是要买东西，还是纯耽误我工夫？

English: Ah, ah, ah. There's no need for foul language, thank you very much. Let's call it perusing my ((collection)), shall we?
Chinese: 哎，哎，哎。犯不着说粗话，多谢好意。咱们就说是"品鉴"我的((藏品))，如何？

English: <<They grin.>>##You can try.
Chinese: <<他咧嘴笑。>>##你试试呗。

English: Oi, what did I say about questions?
Chinese: 喂，我说过不许问问题吧？

English: That all? Or can we get back to the matter at hand?
Chinese: 就这些？还是说，咱们谈正事？

English: <<He shrugs noncommittally.>>##Ah, you know. Stuff. Things. Items. Tools for special purposes. Gear wot's a little queer. Objects of note, you might say. Or you might not. The less said, the better, right me old cock?
Chinese: <<他不置可否地耸耸肩。>>##呃，你懂的。货。东西。物件。有特殊用途的工具。有点那么不上台面的装备。你可以说是" notable "的物件，也可以不这么说。说得越少越好，对吧老铁？

English: Ah, we have a cunnysewer! With these devils, you'll never need a locksmith again. They used to make 'em by the hundred in the big factory up in [[Progress.]] Strictly export only, banned for domestic use.
Chinese: 哦嗬，来了个行家！有这批小宝贝，锁匠都省了。当年[[进步城]]的大工厂，一批批地造。只准出口，国内禁用。

English: Now that [[Progress]] is history, they're in short supply. Best snap one up while you can, old cock – who knows if we'll ever get another batch?
Chinese: 如今[[进步城]]成了历史，这东西就紧俏了。趁有货赶紧收一把，老铁——谁知道下一批什么时候有？

English: You mean that bunch of outlaws the Union's been chasin'? You must be barmy. The Guild would never let a rabble like that in here. At least, not on purpose.
Chinese: 你说联盟追捕的那伙法外之徒？你疯了吧。公会绝不可能放那种乌合之众进来。至少，不会是故意的。

English: Though actually, I wouldn't put it past the King to be hostin' 'em on the sly. Give 'em a safe haven, like, so they can raid Union shippin' then scurry back here. Enemy of my enemy, innit?
Chinese: 不过话说回来，要是国王偷偷收留着他们，我也不意外。给他们个安身处，好让他们劫了联盟的商船再溜回这儿嘛。敌人的敌人就是朋友，不是吗？

English: <<He squints at you for a few seconds.>> ##Mac. There, you happy?
Chinese: <<他眯眼盯了你几秒。>>##麦克。满意了吧？

English: <<Mac glances around, then lowers his voice.>> ##So, that plonker at the summoning station can't keep a secret. But you and I are smarter than that, aren't we?
Chinese: <<麦克环顾四周，压低声音。>>##这么说，召唤站那个蠢货嘴上把不住门。可你我可比他聪明，是不是？

English: My supply chain is very sensitive, and if the others... ##Look, I'm a fair man.
Chinese: 我的货源链非常敏感，要是那些人……##听着，我是个讲道理的人。

English: Ah ((fucksake)), I shoulda known ye was a cog. All right, look – I'm a patriot. The Clockwork King? Big fan. An' to prove it, I'll give you the Saboteur on a silver plate. No, a gold plate!
Chinese: 搞((什么))鬼，早知道你是个齿轮佬。行，这样——我是爱国者。发条王？我的偶像。为了证明，我把破坏者用银盘子端给你。不，金盘子！

English: Everyone thinks the Saboteur is just one person, right? But I'm tellin' you, there's ((two)) of 'em – a man and a woman.
Chinese: 大家都以为破坏者就是一个人，对吧？可我告诉你，他们是((两个))——一男一女。

English: They give me a list of items to get summoned, and basic goods to give out as payment for the summoners. Where they get it all, I don't know. Smuggled in, I'd guess.
Chinese: 他们给我一张清单，列着要召唤的物品，再给一些基础物资，用来付给替他们召唤的人。东西从哪来我不知道。估计是走私进来的。

English: Thing is, they come to me, I don't go to them. Never both at once – the man one week, the woman another. Always hooded, or wearin' some big scarf so you can't see their faces in the dark. That's all I know, I swear!
Chinese: 问题是，都是他们来找我，我不去找他们。从来不同时露面——这周男的那个，下周女的那个。总兜着兜帽，或者围条大围巾，黑灯瞎火看不清脸。我就知道这些，我发誓！

English: && I've got no idea what you mean. You shouldn't go throwing around accusations like that.
Chinese: && 我不明白你在说什么。这种罪名可不能乱扣。

English: %% <<Mac gives you a wide eyed look, as if realizing he had underestimated you>>##You're...
Chinese: %% <<麦克瞪大眼睛看着你，像是意识到自己低估了你>>##你是……

English: I'll tell you what I know, but you didn't hear it from me.
Chinese: 我知道的都告诉你，但别说是我讲的。

English: Sod off cog. I've got nothing else to tell you.
Chinese: 滚蛋吧齿轮佬。我没什么可说的了。

English: Like I said, keep it between us. Fair's fair, right?
Chinese: 我说了，这事就你知我知。公平交易，对吧？

English: Actually, 'Mac', I'm here about your little summoning scam.
Chinese: 其实"麦克"，我是为你那点召唤骗局来的。

English: Sure, let's see your 'collection'.
Chinese: 行啊，看看你的"藏品"。

English: Sure, let's see what you have for sale.
Chinese: 行啊，看看你卖些什么。

English: Let me ask you something first.
Chinese: 我先问你点事。

English: About your little summoning scam...
Chinese: 关于你那点召唤骗局……

English: Catch you later, 'old cock'.
Chinese: 回头见，"老铁"。

English: What kind of 'curiosities' do you have?
Chinese: 你都有些什么"稀罕玩意儿"？

English: Those mechanical lockpicks look interesting.
Chinese: 那些机械开锁器看着挺有意思。

English: If you say so.
Chinese: 你说了算。

English: Do you know anything about a former Dark Star mercenary?
Chinese: 前黑星佣兵的事，你知道些什么吗？

English: What IS your name, by the way?
Chinese: 话说，你到底叫什么名字？

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Better idea: Tell me who these 'others' are and I'll consider letting you go.
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>换个法子：告诉我那些"同伙"是谁，我就考虑放你走。

English: @@ This is about [[The Saboteur]], isn't it?
Chinese: @@ 这是关于[[破坏者]]的事，对吧？

English: Very well. We have a deal.
Chinese: 很好。成交。

English: Fine, fine, that's all.
Chinese: 好好好，就这些。

English: <<They do not look up from their work.>> ##Stay where ye are. Don't move. Not one more inch!
Chinese: <<他们头也不抬。>>##站在原地。别动。一寸都不许多挪！

English: Patterns, resonances. All wrong. Very delicate, easily disturbed. Order in chaos, chaos in order. No good, no good. Must I really explain the basics?
Chinese: 图案，共振。全不对。极其精微，动辄崩坏。乱中有序，序中有乱。不行，不行。真要我把基本功给你讲一遍吗？

English: This landship runs on precise cipher mathematics. Magic numbers, infinitely multiplied. Any contradiction can throw the balance. As long as ye're aboard, ye're part of it. Does a cogwheel leave its post and go strollin' off through the engine?
Chinese: 这座陆行巨舰靠精密的密文数学驱动。魔法数字，无限相乘。任何一点矛盾都能打破平衡。你在船上，你就是它的一部分。齿轮会离开自己的位置、跑去引擎里闲逛吗？

English: <<They seem to suddenly realise something, then glance up at you sharply.>> ##No.
Chinese: <<他们忽然想起什么，猛地抬头瞪你。>>##不行。

English: Speak only in even numbered words. When walking, only step on every second floorboard – no more, no less. Do ((not)) tread on the cracks. Do not envision the colour mauve.
Chinese: 只许说双数个字的句子。走路时只踩第二块地板——不多不少。((千万))别踩缝。不许想紫红色。

English: And only turn your body left, never right. If ye really must turn right, just turn left 'til ye face the way ye want.
Chinese: 还有，身子只许向左转，不许向右。实在要向右，就向左转，转到脸朝你想去的方向为止。

English: Even numbers, damn yer eyes! Even!
Chinese: 双数！你个瞎眼的东西！双数！

English: Very funny. You keep messin' around. Overflow the omen buffer. Poison the cipher nucleus. Entire landship instantly compresses into the space of a thimble. Won't be laughin' then. Must I really explain this stuff?
Chinese: 很好笑。你就闹吧。撑爆征兆缓冲区。毒化密文核心。整艘陆行巨舰一瞬压进一个顶针大的空间里。到时候可就没这么好笑了。真要我把这些给你讲明白吗？

English: <<They finally look up.>>##Oi now! Aren't ye listenin', ye damned vandal?
Chinese: <<他们终于抬起头。>>##喂！你聋了吗，你个该死的破坏分子？

English: Why not? What's wrong?
Chinese: 为什么不行？怎么了？

English: I'm afraid I really don't understand.
Chinese: 恐怕我是真没听懂。

English: What should I do?
Chinese: 那我该怎么做？

English: I'll just leave you alone.
Chinese: 我还是不打扰了。

English: [Waggle your finger]
Chinese: [摇摇手指]

English: [Walk away]
Chinese: [走开]

English: <<This worker shouts at you at the top of their lungs.>> ##RIGHT, LET'S GET TO WORK! HAND ME THAT THAUMIC LANCE AND THEN YE'RE GOIN' UNDER THE FLOOR.
Chinese: <<这名工人扯着嗓子朝你吼。>>##好了，干活了！把那把奇术长矛递给我，然后你给我钻到地板底下去。

English: EH? WHAT DID YE SAY?!?
Chinese: 嗯？你说啥？！

English: WHAT?!? SPEAK UP, WILL YE?
Chinese: 什么？！大点声行不行？

English: <<They wince.>>##KING'S GEARS, THERE'S NO NEED TO SHOUT!
Chinese: <<他们一缩脖子。>>##国王的齿轮，用不着喊！

English: What are you talking about?
Chinese: 你在说什么？

English: I'm not going anywhere.
Chinese: 我哪儿也不去。

English: WHAT?!
Chinese: 什么？！

English: I SAID, I DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU'RE TALKING ABOUT!
Chinese: 我说了，我不知道你在说什么！

English: I SAID, I'M NOT DOING IT!
Chinese: 我说了，我不干！

English: I SAID, WHAT?!
Chinese: 我说了，什么？！

English: I! DON'T! WORK! HERE!
Chinese: 我！不！在！这！干！活！

English: Bugger this, I'm leaving.
Chinese: 去他的，我走了。

English: <<This worker is cradling a hand-rolled cigarette as they gaze out at the farmlands. Their voice is slow and hollow.>> ##Beautiful, ain't it? From this distance, you can barely even tell.
Chinese: <<这名工人捧着一支手卷烟，望着远处的农田。声音缓慢而空洞。>>##很美，不是吗？隔这么远，你几乎看不出来。

English: <<They sigh deeply.>> You're weeks late, you know. Not that it matters. We need twenty people to run this thing properly, so what difference does one more or less make?
Chinese: <<他们深深叹气。>>你知道你来晚了好几个星期了吧。倒也无所谓。这东西正常运转要二十个人，多一个少一个有什么区别？

English: You're not the new crew member? Then you must be from Ferropolis. We asked for a real Machinist, someone qualified to meddle with the King's magic. I suppose I shouldn't be surprised they sent you. No offence.
Chinese: 你不是新来的船员？那你一定是铁城来的。我们申请的是真正的机械师，有资格摆弄国王魔法的人。他们派你来，我倒也不意外。别介意。

English: Oh, well, never mind. You're not really allowed to be here, but they reassigned our last Militia last month. Said he was needed in the city in case of unrest. So I can't be bothered to stop you.
Chinese: 哦，好吧，算了。其实你不该出现在这儿，但他们上个月把最后一个民兵调走了。说城里恐怕要出乱子，需要人手。所以我也懒得拦你。

English: <<They look unfazed.>>##So you ((are)) a cog. They must be scraping the bottom of the barrel. Again, no offence, your honour.
Chinese: <<他们神色不动。>>##所以你((是))个齿轮佬。他们真是病急乱投医了。再次声明，没有冒犯长官的意思。

English: Well, feel free to start whenever you like. I can hardly stop you.
Chinese: 嗯，想什么时候开工随你。我反正拦不住你。

English: Anyway, can't complain. I have to believe the King is working on it. ##<<They sound distinctly unpersuaded of their own words.>>
Chinese: 总之，没什么可抱怨的。我愿意相信国王正在想办法。##<<听那语气，他自己都不太信。>>

English: Anyway, what does it matter? Nothing to be done.
Chinese: 总之，有什么要紧？反正无能为力。

English: I suppose I'm the captain here, at least since Bogdan's clock ran out. Technically his title was Senior Crew Chief, Landship IV". Though I still haven't officially been promoted to replace him. "
Chinese: 我想我现在算这里的船长了，至少自从博格丹的钟停摆之后。严格说他的头衔是四号陆行巨舰高级船员长"。不过至今也没人正式提拔我接他的班。"

English: Honestly, I'm not even sure the King knows he's dead.
Chinese: 说实话，我都怀疑国王知不知道他死了。

English: <<They smile without mirth.>>##Landship. One of those mechanical marvels our kingdom is so famous for. Think of it as a portable workshop or factory. The King sends us wherever we're most needed.
Chinese: <<他们干笑。>>##陆行巨舰。我们王国闻名遐迩的机械奇观之一。你可以把它想成一座会走路的工坊或工厂。国王把我们派到最需要的地方。

English: For the last year we've been helping with food production. Threshing, winnowing, packaging, all that.##Not that there's much to be done as long as this winter keeps going.
Chinese: 过去一年我们一直在帮忙搞粮食生产。脱粒、扬场、打包，诸如此类。##只要这冬天不结束，其实也没多少活可干。

English: For the last year we've been helping with food production. Threshing, winnowing, packaging, all that.##Of course, agriculture has been in shambles since the Great Winter. The snow finally let up, but we're only just beginning to put seed to soil.
Chinese: 过去一年我们一直在帮忙搞粮食生产。脱粒、扬场、打包，诸如此类。##当然，大寒冬以来农业一塌糊涂。雪总算停了，但我们才刚开始把种子下进土里。

English: But if you imagine we can relax... ha, you don't know this kingdom. No, we still have targets to meet, and drills to run, and meaningless make-work to perform. Sometimes I think the King just hates to see us not looking busy.
Chinese: 可你要以为我们能歇口气……哈，你就是不了解这个王国。不，我们还有指标要赶，有演练要跑，有毫无意义的瞎活要干。有时我觉得国王就是见不得我们闲着。

English: Ah, so you've noticed. Yes, at this point we're not even a skeleton crew; just bone meal. They never did replace Bogdan after he fell onto the tracks and went under.
Chinese: 啊，你注意到了。是啊，如今我们连"残缺班子"都算不上；就是一堆骨渣。博格丹摔到轨道上卷进车底之后，他们压根没补人。

English: I used to have nightmares about it, but now I don't dream at all. ##<<They sigh mournfully.>> Problem solved, I suppose.
Chinese: 我从前会做噩梦梦到那事，现在干脆不做梦了。##<<他们哀伤地叹气。>>问题解决了吧，我想。

English: Even before, it wasn't enough. How we ever managed with just four people I don't know. Still, we must have done it.
Chinese: 就算从前，人手也不够。当年就四个人我们是怎么撑下来的，我都不知道。可我们居然撑下来了。

English: <<They sound inconsolably maudlin.>>##Oh no, don't mind me. I'm as happy as a cloudsquid, your honour. My greatest joy is to serve the Kingdom.
Chinese: <<他们的声音听上去哀毁得无可救药。>>##哦不，别管我。我快活得像朵云里的鱿鱼，长官。为王国服务就是我最大的快乐。

English: Do what you like. It won't make any difference.
Chinese: 随你的便。反正不会有任何区别。

English: Sorry, what am I late for?
Chinese: 抱歉，我来晚的是什么？

English: You're mistaking me for someone else.
Chinese: 你认错人了。

English: Actually, I'm trying to get TO Ferropolis.
Chinese: 其实，我是想(去)铁城。

English: I'm not from this region.
Chinese: 我不是这个区域的。

English: Wrong again. Want to try a third time?
Chinese: 又错了。要试第三次吗？

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Real enough for you, citizen?
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>这够真了吧，公民？

English: Who are you, anyway?
Chinese: 话说，你是谁？

English: Who did you say you were?
Chinese: 你刚说你是谁来着？

English: What is this... place? Building? Machine?
Chinese: 这个……地方？建筑？机器？到底是什么？

English: Tell me about this great machine again.
Chinese: 再给我讲讲这台大机器吧。

English: Why are there so few crew aboard?
Chinese: 船上的人怎么这么少？

English: I'm detecting a distinct lack of morale, citizen.
Chinese: 我怎么闻到一股士气低落的味道，公民。

English: I'll leave you to your thoughts.
Chinese: 不打扰你思考了。

English: Welcome cousin.##I'm glad to see you well.
Chinese: 欢迎，教友。##很高兴见到你平安。

English: So, what'll it be?
Chinese: 那么，想要点什么？

English: <<She raises her eyebrows as if something about you has caught her attention>>##Welcome cousin. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Chinese: <<她扬起眉，仿佛你身上有什么引起了她的注意。>>##欢迎，教友。幸会。

English: You came here to buy [[spells]], I presume?##I can tell you're not with the [[King]], so I don't mind doing business. ((He)) can't hear us here.
Chinese: 你来这里是想买[[法术]]的吧？##我看得出你不是[[国王]]的人，那我不介意做你的生意。((他))在这儿听不见我们。

English: They think they can stop ((me)) selling magic.##Imagine? Me of all people! I'm older than the King and I'm better at magic too.
Chinese: 他们以为能拦住((我))卖魔法。##想想看？偏偏是我！我比国王年长，魔法也比他强。

English: <<Seeing your insignia, they immediately tense up.>>##Oh...Well then... what are you here for then?
Chinese: <<一看见你的徽记，她立刻绷紧。>>##哦……那好……那你来做什么？

English: Ah, I see. This machinist act you're putting on... it's a disguise isn't it? I can tell that you only came to these lands recently...##Anyhow, the King can't see what happens in this house, so no need to act the part around me.
Chinese: 啊，我懂了。你这套机械师的做派……是装的，对吧？我看得出你刚来这片土地不久……##反正，国王看不见这栋房子里发生什么，在我面前不用演了。

English: <<The sage gives you the nastiest glare you have ever received in your life.>>##You sneaked your way to this island just to play the part of royal boot? Disgusting.
Chinese: <<贤者给了你此生最恶毒的一记瞪视。>>##你偷偷摸到这座岛上来，就为了当王室的一条走狗？恶心。

English: The other machinists' minds are warped to hell by the King's magic, but you actually ((chose)) this, of your own volition!
Chinese: 其他机械师的心智早被国王的魔法扭曲进了地狱，可你居然是((自愿))的，凭自己的意志！

English: <<You wonder, for an instant, how she knows all these details of your background.>>
Chinese: <<有一瞬间，你在想她怎么对你的底细知道得这么清楚。>>

English: Are you listening to me, swine? Cross me again and I'll kill you.#Now get out of my house and never come back.
Chinese: 你在听吗，猪猡？再冒犯我一次，我就杀了你。#滚出我的房子，永远别回来。

English: Ah, the King's dog has returned. But I don't believe you've been invited in.
Chinese: 啊，国王的狗回来了。不过我记得没人请你进来。

English: Here to arrest me?##<<She smirks as she says this, as if begging you to be so stupid.>>
Chinese: 来抓我的？##<<她笑着说这话，仿佛在盼着你蠢到这个地步。>>

English: <<The sage spits in your face.>>##Shut up and leave.
Chinese: <<贤者啐在你脸上。>>##闭嘴，滚。

English: Save your breath. You've wasted too much of my time already.##<<She begins to turns away from you, but then abruptly perks up, as if she has suddenly gleaned something hidden inside you.>>
Chinese: 省点力气吧。你已经浪费了我太多时间。##<<她转身要背对你，忽然像突然从你身上窥见了什么隐藏的东西，精神一振。>>

English: <<The sage tries to hold in a chuckle. She seems remarkably unbothered.>>##Alright, come arrest me then.
Chinese: <<贤者忍住笑。她看上去毫无惧色。>>##好啊，那你来抓呀。

English: <<She bursts out laughing.>>##No, I suppose it wasn't a very good idea was it? Even a dumb dog like you can sense danger.
Chinese: <<她放声大笑。>>##不，我想这主意不太高明，是吧？连你这样的蠢狗都闻得出危险。

English: <<She smiles a very unsettling smile as you move towards her.>>
Chinese: <<你朝她走近时，她露出一丝令人极不安的微笑。>>

English: <<As you reach to grab her, she touches her finger to your palm with a single precise motion.##<<In a split second, she sends a magical pulse into your palm, directly through your veins.>>
Chinese: <<你伸手去抓她，她以一个精准的动作把手指点在你的掌心。##<<一瞬间，一股魔法脉冲顺着你的血管直贯手掌。>>

English: <<The burst of energy painfully liquidizes your skeleton and causes your brain swell, exploding out from the viscous goop which was recently your skull.>>
Chinese: <<那股能量剧痛地液化你的骨骼，让你的大脑肿胀，从你那滩曾是头骨的黏浆中爆出来。>>

English: <<The sage then casts another spell to effortlessly clean up the mess you've left, banishing your remains (and all associated viscera) to the Planes of Agony.>>
Chinese: <<贤者随即又施展一个法术，毫不费力地清理掉你留下的这摊烂账，把你的残骸（连同全部内脏）放逐到苦难位面。>>

English: <<You die...>>
Yes, let's!##I'm very proud of my selection.
Chinese: 好，来吧！##我对我的存货很自豪。

English: A question? Of course, cousin, I don't mind.#This building is enchanted, so we can speak freely here.
Chinese: 有问题？当然可以，教友，我不介意。#这栋房子施过魔法，在这里我们可以畅所欲言。

English: A question? Very well...##But don't share nothing I tell you outside this house. The King will know, and your cover will be blown.
Chinese: 有问题？好吧……##但我说的东西出了这扇门一个字都别提。国王会知道的，你的伪装也就毁了。

English: I don't want to be the reason you get erased.
Chinese: 我不想成为你被抹除的原因。

English: Was that all you wanted to know?
Chinese: 你想知道的就这些？

English: The King? I supposed you could think of him like... a sort of cluster of powerful curses and seals.##That kind of magic used to be banned, back when this land was known as [[Kardova]].
Chinese: 国王？我想你可以把他理解成……一大团强大诅咒与封印的集合体。##这类魔法从前是被禁止的，那时这片土地还叫[[卡尔多瓦]]。

English: I am a high sage, the last of a long line of heredity.##My father sat council with the highest leaders of old [[Kardova]]... But perhaps I'm revealing my age a bit too much.
Chinese: 我是高阶贤者，一条漫长血脉的最后一人。##我父亲曾与古[[卡尔多瓦]]的最高领袖们共议国事……不过，也许我有点太暴露年纪了。

English: I have no name.##My father was the same, and his mother before. The second born was always the successor.
Chinese: 我没有名字。##我父亲没有，他母亲也没有。次子永远继承衣钵。

English: Without a name, I can't be written into runes. And as a result I'm immune to a great many curses and spells – particularly [[cipher magic]].##So unlike most idiots on this island, my memories have never been fucked with.
Chinese: 没有名字，我就无法被写进符文。因此我对大量诅咒与法术免疫——尤其是[[密文魔法]]。##所以不像这岛上大多数蠢货，我的记忆从来没被动过手脚。

English: I can tell if someone has had their memories forgotten, you know. ((That's why I took an interest in you))...
Chinese: 你知道吗，我能看出一个人是不是被抹掉了记忆。((所以我才对你产生了兴趣))……

English: Ah, the stories I could tell of this land as it was in my youth... I don't know where to begin.##The entire landscape changed after that accursed city dropped anchor. Even the weather.
Chinese: 唉，关于我年轻时这片土地的故事，我能讲上三天三夜……都不知道从哪说起。##自从那座受诅咒的城市抛锚驻扎，整片地貌都变了。连天气都变了。

English: Things were slower back then. Whenever there was a shortage of food, families would band together to produce the necessary offering to the mother goddess. Everyone knew each other.
Chinese: 那时候日子慢。每当粮食短缺，家家户户就会聚在一起，向母亲女神献上必需的祭品。那时人人相识。

English: The King erased almost all memory of the mother goddess and her two daughters. But when I was younger, their names commanded an unrivalled power and respect.
Chinese: 国王抹去了关于母亲女神和她两个女儿的记忆，几乎抹得干干净净。可在我年少时，她们的名字拥有无可匹敌的威仪与尊崇。

English: The legend goes that the goddess became pregnant of the mind, and birthed her two twins out of her ears.
Chinese: 传说女神以心灵受孕，从双耳诞下双生女儿。

English: To her elder daughter, who was born of the moon, she gave the mountains in the North East.##And to her younger daughter, who was born of the sun, she gave the bluffs of the South, where the Corruption now runs rampant.
Chinese: 她的长女生于月亮，得封东北群山。##幼女生于太阳，得封南方峭壁——如今腐化在那里肆虐。

English: When the King arrived, the mother goddess suffed a slow death, emaciated and forgotten by all but a handful. Our sacrifices could only slow her decline.##We buried her in secret, and her twins scattered into hiding.
Chinese: 国王驾临之后，母亲女神便开始了漫长的死亡，形销骨立，被所有人遗忘，只剩寥寥数人。我们的祭品只能减缓她的凋零。##我们悄悄安葬了她，她的双生女四散隐匿。

English: Be safe, cousin.
Chinese: 保重，教友。

English: Anything else?
Chinese: 还有别的吗？

English: Yes, I'd like to do business
Chinese: 好，我想做买卖

English: No, I came about something else
Chinese: 不，我另有事情

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Actually, I ((am)) in the King's service.
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>其实，我((确实))在为国王效力。

English: I came to do business.
Chinese: 我是来做买卖的。

English: I came to ask you something.
Chinese: 我是来请教你一些事的。

English: Selling magic is illegal. I came to stop you.
Chinese: 贩卖魔法是违法的。我是来阻止你的。

English: No, I came to do business.
Chinese: 不，我是来做买卖的。

English: No, I came to apologize.
Chinese: 不，我是来道歉的。

English: Yes, I'm here to arrest you.
Chinese: 对，我就是来抓你的。

English: Actually, I'd better not...
Chinese: 其实，我还是算了……

English: <<[arrest her]>> By authority of the King!
Chinese: <<[逮捕她]>>以国王之名！

English: Let's trade.
Chinese: 做买卖吧。

English: May I ask a question?
Chinese: 我能问个问题吗？

English: What ((is)) the Clockwork King
Chinese: 发条王((到底))是什么

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: What is your name?
Chinese: 你叫什么名字？

English: Tell me of old Kardova.
Chinese: 给我讲讲古卡尔多瓦。

English: Tell me of the old gods
Chinese: 给我讲讲旧神

English: That's all I needed to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就是这些。

English: Five days I've been kipping here now...
Chinese: 我在这儿睡了两晚了……

English: They say I'm accused of stealing my True Name, that I can't enter [[Ferropolis]] 'til the [[King]] has resolved my case.##But I don't ((know)) about any case. I've lived here all my life!
Chinese: 他们说我涉嫌盗窃我的真名，在[[国王]]厘清我的案子之前不能进[[铁城]]。##可我根本((不知道))什么案子。我在这儿住了一辈子！

English: They won't tell me anything else because they can't be sure I'm really me.
Chinese: 他们什么都不肯告诉我，因为他们无法确定我就是我。

English: They want me to file a petition, but I can't do that until they let me in.##It's madness...
Chinese: 他们要我递呈文，可他们不放我进去，我怎么递？##疯了……

English: Oh, it's you again. Remember me? Camped out underneath the city because they said I'd stolen my True Name?
Chinese: 哦，又是你。还记得我吗？睡在城墙底下、被说我偷了自己真名的那位？

English: Pardon me if I look a little haggard. I've just spent King knows how long trapped outside the city on account of some royal misunderstanding.
Chinese: 恕我形容憔悴。我被一场王室的乌龙困在城外，天知道多久。

English: Don't ask me how or why, but suddenly the King resolved my case. One minute I was a non-person freezing outside the walls, the next I was welcomed in without any questions.
Chinese: 别问怎么怎么回事，总之国王突然把我的案子销了。前一分钟我还是冻在城墙外的"无籍之人"，下一分钟就畅通无阻地进了城，一个问题都没问。

English: King's wheels, it's good to be home.
Chinese: 国王的齿轮，回家的感觉真好。

English: <<Their eyes go wide as they see you, and they make some kind of occult sign with their hand.>> ##King's mercy, how did you get past the wards?!
Chinese: <<他们一看见你，双眼瞪圆，用手结了个奥术的手势。>>##国王开恩，你是怎么破过结界的！

English: <<They grab a frying pan from a nearby shelf and brandish it unconvincingly.>> ##Stay b-back! In the name of Its M-m-majesty, I abjure thee! You have no p-p-p-power here!
Chinese: <<他们从旁边架子上抓起一只平底锅，有气无力地挥舞。>>##退、退后！以陛——陛下之名，我驱斥你！你在这里没有力——力量！

English: <<They slowly lower the pan.>> ##You're... not one of them, are you? You're actually travelling out here. Oh please, your majesty, please watch over this brave soul.
Chinese: <<他们慢慢放下平底锅。>>##你……不是它们一伙的吧？你居然真的在外面赶路。哦，求陛下保佑这个勇敢的人。

English: <<They close their eyes and mumble.>> Your majesty, I beg you, watch over this brave soul. Guard them from Corruption. And please, ((please)) grant my petition to relocate.
Chinese: <<他们闭上眼喃喃。>>陛下，求您庇佑这个勇敢的人。护他们免受腐化。还有，((求求))您批准我搬迁的呈文。

English: <<They grimace.>> Just mind yourself out there, all right?
Chinese: <<她做了个鬼脸。>>在外头自己当心，好吗？

English: Perhaps a rogue [[Myrmidon]], bewitched by the Saboteur to disobey the King.
Chinese: 也许是一台失控的[[斯堤兵]]，被破坏者蛊惑违抗国王。

English: Or perhaps even a [[Corrupted One]]...##One of the landship workers told me it's spreading hereabouts.
Chinese: 又或者是一个[[腐化者]]……##有个陆行巨舰的工人告诉我，这一带也在扩散。

English: I hear them, you know. Clawing and hammering at my door every other night.##Sometimes it's like they're knocking. Sometimes they say things. But I don't listen; I know it's all lies.
Chinese: 我听得见它们，你知道吧。隔一晚上就挠我的门、砸我的门。##有时像在敲门。有时它们会说话。但我不听；我知道全是谎。

English: It's a foul curse, caused when foolish or treacherous behaviour conflicts with the King's magic. At least that's what the Machinists' Guild says.
Chinese: 那是一种污秽的诅咒，当愚蠢或背叛的行为与国王的魔法冲突时就会降临。至少机械师公会是这么说的。

English: I'm at a loss, though. The people round here make every sacrifice, meet every quota. We honour the King every bright and dim.##There must be something we're missing, something more we can do...
Chinese: 可我一筹莫展。这一带的人献上一切祭品，完成一切配额。光暗交替，我们事事尊崇国王。##一定有什么我们漏掉了，一定还有什么能做的……

English: I'm one of the few farmers left out here. I mind the machines, parse the orders from Ferropolis, clean the crystal heads, and watch out for thaumic spillage.##Only the machines have gone haywire, and we can't plant for all the snow.
Chinese: 我是这片仅剩的几个农户之一。我照看机器，解析铁城的指令，擦拭水晶头，提防奇术泄漏。##只是机器全疯了，雪又大得没法下种。

English: Its Majesty must have a reason for this winter. I only wish someone would tell us what it is.
Chinese: 陛下的这场冬天必有用意。我只盼有人肯告诉我们那是什么。

English: At least the snow is starting to melt. I'll take any wins I can.##It's all incremental. Sure the machines are still trying to kill us, but they're a bit less aggressive lately. It's not a solution but at least it's an improvement.
Chinese: 至少雪开始化了。能赢一点是一点。##一切都在渐进。机器当然还想弄死我们，但最近凶得轻了些。算不上解决，至少算改善。

English: Lately the machines have been attacking each other. This kingdom is falling apart at the seems.##At least the snow is starting to melt.
Chinese: 最近机器们在互相攻击。这个王国正在从缝线上崩开。##至少雪开始化了。

English: Calm down. I'm not here to hurt you.
Chinese: 冷静。我不是来害你的。

English: Drop the kitchenware, or you'll regret it.
Chinese: 把厨具放下，不然你后悔莫及。

English: Tremble, mortal, for your doom is upon you!
Chinese: 颤抖吧凡人，你的末日到了！

English: Who did you think I was, back there?
Chinese: 你刚才把我想成什么了？

English: What do you know of the Corruption?
Chinese: 关于腐化，你知道些什么？

English: What do you do here?
Chinese: 你在这里做什么？

English: Best of luck to you.
Chinese: 祝你好运。

English: <<This old peasant is murmuring and muttering to themself, occasionally crying out. As you approach they suddenly fall silent, and apprehension creases their weathered face.>>
Chinese: <<这位老农正自言自语地嘟囔，偶尔喊出一声。你走近时，他忽然安静下来，饱经风霜的脸上爬满惊惧。>>

English: Hello? Who's that there? What manner of thing are you? Come closer, if you're not Corrupted... ##...or is it my lares, back again to show this old fool mercy?
Chinese: 喂？谁在那儿？你是什么东西？走近点，只要你不是腐化的……##……还是说，是我家的守护神又回来了，来向这老糊涂施舍慈悲？

English: <<They contemplate this, their eyes roving over and past you. Evidently they are blind.>> ##Not many travellers these days, no. Border's barred and locked like a barn door. So either you're a criminal or something worse.
Chinese: <<他思索着，双眼在你身上游移，又越过你。显然他是瞎的。>>##近来旅客可不多，没有。边境封得跟谷仓门似的。所以你要么是逃犯，要么是更糟的东西。

English: <<They contemplate this, their eyes roving over and past you. Evidently they are blind.>> ##An outsider, yes? But what possessed you to travel ((here)), quite the mystery.
Chinese: <<他思索着，双眼在你身上游移，又越过你。显然他是瞎的。>>##外乡人，是吧？可你到底中了什么邪要跑来((这儿))，真是桩谜案。

English: <<They reach out to touch the insignia, feeling its sharp edges. Evidently they are blind.>> ##So you are, and so you must be. Well, there's an honour for Old Yod. Long live the King, yes, yes.
Chinese: <<他伸手触摸徽记，感受它锐利的边缘。显然他是瞎的。>>##哦，是这样，那就必然是这样了。这可是老约德天大的荣耀。国王万岁，是，是。

English: Old Yod's had no visitors for many a month, no. None like you, at least. Perhaps there are none left... ##Ah cruel winter, why dost thou mock thy sovereign? O lares, wither have thou flown?
Chinese: 老约德好几个月没来过客人了，是啊。像你这样的更没有。也许一个都不剩了……##啊，残忍的寒冬，你为何嘲弄你的君王？哦守护神啊，你们飞去了何方？

English: ...soft now, O moonlight, pool thyself in poor Yod's hands. Have I not been good to thee? What, wisp! Not scared of a little rime...
Chinese: ……温柔些吧，哦月光，请把你自己盈进可怜约德的掌心。我可曾亏待过你？什么，小精灵！不怕那点霜……

English: <<The old farmer lapses into silence, occasionally muttering something inscrutable.>>
Chinese: <<老农再度陷入沉默，偶尔嘟囔几句莫名其妙的话。>>

English: To bright lamps and warm fires, yes, to lock and key and warding sign. [[Ferropolis]], that's where they went. Stilted and guarded, not to be Corrupted, safe in the arms of our King.
Chinese: 明亮的灯，温暖的火，是的，还有锁、钥匙和辟邪的符。[[铁城]]，他们都去了那里。架在高桩上，有人守卫，不被腐化，安卧在国王的臂弯里。

English: But old Yod's stubborn, see? Stubborn as a rock. Worked this farm since year zero, or thereabouts. What cares I for sleet or snow, monsters or machines? The King shall protect this house, or all's for nought.
Chinese: 可老约德倔啊，你瞧？倔得像块石头。从元年前后就在这个农场干活。雨夹雪也好，雪也好，怪物也好，机器也好，关我什么事？国王自会守护这座房子，否则一切皆是虚无。

English: Dark Star, eh? Surely a creature of the night.##Beware, O thrice beware those who follow such heavenly sirens. Star-crossed are they, sailing for a fate that's written on the sky for all save them to read.
Chinese: 黑星，嗯？想必是夜里的造物。##千万当心，千万、千万当心那些追随天上塞壬的人。他们的星象相克，他们的航向写在天空上，人人读得见，唯独他们自己读不见。

English: The name rings a bell, but the temple's ruined. Come back last year, or last decade, when the spire still gleamed and songs of joy still echoed under the garlands.
Chinese: 这名字听着耳熟，可神庙早塌了。等去年再来吧，或者上个十年，那时塔尖还闪着光，欢歌还在花环下回荡。

English: Day after day it snows, week after week and month after month. Poor Yod can't sow, can't reap, can't grow. Someone ought to tell the King, but who hears Yod? Only winds and wisps have been his guests, since the lares fled.
Chinese: 日复一日地下雪，一周又一周，一月又一月。可怜的约德播不了种，收不了割，长不出粮。该有人告诉国王，可谁听得见约德？自打守护神们逃走，只有风和小精灵肯做他的客。

English: Months of snow and it only recently broke. Poor Yod can't sow, can't reap, can't grow. We'll starve before the next harvest.##Someone ought to tell the King, but who hears Yod?
Chinese: 下了好几个月的雪，最近才停。可怜的约德播不了种，收不了割，长不出粮。下一季收成之前我们就得饿死。##该有人告诉国王，可谁听得见约德？

English: <<They reach out to touch the insignia, feeling its sharp edges, then grimace.>> ##A Machinist, then, and so you must speak truth. Well, there's an honour for Old Yod. Long live the King, yes, yes...
Chinese: <<他伸手触摸徽记，感受它锐利的边缘，然后做了个鬼脸。>>##是个机械师，那你说的必是真话。这可是老约德天大的荣耀。国王万岁，是，是……

English: Taxes, you say? Untaxed old Yod? Ach, bugger and thrice bugger. O most derelict Yod, to beg the King's forgiveness... ##<<They begin rummaging in their belongings.>>
Chinese: 税？老约德没交税？唉，该死，该死三遍。哦最怠慢的约德，这就去求国王宽恕……##<<他开始在自己的家当里翻找。>>

English: They don't call me Rich Old Yod, no, no. But Yod the Debtor? Never! ##<<They press a few coins into your hands.>>
Chinese: 人家可不叫我"富老约德"，不不。可"欠债的约德"？绝没有的事！##<<他往你手里塞了几枚硬币。>>

English: Now look here, your honour. You tell Its Majesty humbly that it ought to end this winter.##Maybe nobody's told you what it's like out here. But now you see, don't you?
Chinese: 那么听好了，长官。请你恭恭敬敬地告诉陛下，这场冬天该结束了。##也许没人跟你讲过外面是什么光景。可现在你亲眼见了，不是吗？

English: Now look here, your honour. You tell Its Majesty humbly that we're still starving.##Maybe nobody's told you what it's like out here. But now you see, don't you?
Chinese: 那么听好了，长官。请你恭恭敬敬地告诉陛下，我们还在挨饿。##也许没人跟你讲过外面是什么光景。可现在你亲眼见了，不是吗？

English: So soon, so soon, to leave old Yod on his tod? Ah, but you've been here before, and here you'll be back again. Not long, not long, no, no...
Chinese: 这就走，这就走，把老约德一个人丢下？唉，可你从前也来过，往后还会再来的。不会太久，不会太久，是，是……

English: <<The old farmer's hand finds your own and gives it a gentle squeeze. You leave Yod murmuring to themself, or to something you can't see.>>
Chinese: <<老农的手摸索着找到你的手，轻轻握了握。你离开时，约德还在喃喃自语——或者在对某个你看不见的东西说话。>>

English: No need to fear. I'm just a traveller.
Chinese: 不用怕。我只是个旅客。

English: Corrupted?
Chinese: 腐化？

English: [Show Machinist insignia] I'm on official business.
Chinese: [出示机械师徽记] 我在执行公务。

English: Where did all the people here go?
Chinese: 这里的人都去哪了？

English: Was there ever a former Dark Star mercenary around here?
Chinese: 这一带以前有过前黑星佣兵吗？

English: How long has winter been going on now?
Chinese: 冬天到现在持续多久了？

English: [Show Machinist insignia] Citizen, I'm afraid you have unpaid taxes.
Chinese: [出示机械师徽记] 公民，恐怕你有欠税未缴。

English: You take care, old one.
Chinese: 您保重，老人家。

English: <<A dull mechanic voice booms out through the great machine's visor.>> ##[[EDICT]]: HALT & BESHRIVE THYSELF, CITIZEN, FOR THOU STANDEST BEFORE A SERVANT OF THE CLOCKWORK KING.
Chinese: <<巨兽般的机器面甲后轰出一个沉闷的机械嗓音。>>##[[敕令]]：止步并自省己罪，公民，因你立于发条王仆从之前。

English: PONDERING... ##[[ALAS]], THY QUERY EXCEEDS THE REMIT OF THIS INCARNATION. PETITIONS TO ITS MAJESTY MAY BE SUBMITTED AT THE MACHINARIUM.
Chinese: 思虑中……##[[哀哉]]，你的问询超出本化身的职权。向陛下提交申请，请至机械殿。

English: [[APPRAISAL]]: THOU ART A VAGABOND OF UNKNOWN LOYALTY. THEREFORE,##[[EDICT]]: TRESPASS NOT AGAINST THE KING'S PEACE, FOR THOU ART WATCHED & THRICE-WATCHED.
Chinese: [[鉴定]]：你乃来历不明的流民。因此，##[[敕令]]：勿犯国王之安宁，因你正被监视，且被三重监视。

English: ALL HAIL ITS MAJESTY MACHINUS REX, THE CLOCKWORK KING.
Chinese: 万岁，陛下，机械王，发条之王。

English: Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Chinese: 幸会。

English: You look more like a heap of scrap to me.
Chinese: 我看你更像一堆废铁。

English: Sorry, how exactly does one 'beshrive oneself'?
Chinese: 抱歉，"自省己罪"到底要怎么做？

English: Fearsome thing, ain't it? Don't worry, this one's on our side. But one word from me and it'll go at you like a wild beast – so get in line like everyone else.
Chinese: 挺吓人的玩意儿，是吧？放心，这台是咱们这边的。但只要我一句话，它就会像野兽一样扑向你——所以像大家一样排队去。

English: One of the Clockwork King's most fearsome servants – a [[Clockwork Myrmidon]]. Meant to be more loyal than any human soldier. But if you've been in the countryside, you know how that turned out.
