Chinese: 发条王最可怕的仆从之一——一台[[发条斯堤兵]]。本该比任何人类士兵都忠诚。可你要是去过乡下，就知道结果如何了。

English: <<The guard grins.>> Guess you'll be dealing with muggins here for a wee bit longer, eh?
Chinese: <<卫兵咧嘴笑。>>看来还得再委屈你跟本大爷多待一阵子，嗯？

English: What is that machine?
Chinese: 那台机器是什么？

English: I'll be going now.
Chinese: 我走了。

English: <<The border guard is working on some kind of word puzzle. He does not look up.>>##Yes?
Chinese: <<边防兵正在做某种字谜。头也不抬。>>##嗯？

English: <<The guard goes back to his puzzle, apparently ignoring you.>>
Chinese: <<边防兵回去继续做他的字谜，显然把你晾在一边。>>

English: <<The guard goes back to his puzzle, apparently ignoring you.>> ##<<Evidently you'll need to find some other way into Clockwork Kingdom.>>
Chinese: <<边防兵回去继续做他的字谜，显然把你晾在一边。>>##<<显然你得另想办法进发条王国。>>

English: <<He examines your permit through a magnifying glass, then punches commands into a machine. You notice tufts of cotton protruding from his ears...>>
Chinese: <<他用放大镜检查你的许可，然后往一台机器里敲指令。你注意到他耳朵里塞着棉花……>>

English: <<Suddenly the machine screeches like a god's nail being dragged across the chalkboard of your soul, and your stomach twists as if you are falling from a great height.>>
Chinese: <<机器突然尖啸起来，像神的指甲刮过你灵魂的黑板，你的胃一阵绞痛，仿佛从高处坠落。>>

English: <<After several minutes, the guard removes his earplugs.>> ##Its Majesty says you may pass. Long live the Clockwork King.
Chinese: <<几分钟后，边防兵摘下耳塞。>>##陛下说你可以过了。发条王万岁。

English: No.
Chinese: 不行。

English: Indeed, no.
Chinese: 确实不行。

English: It means you cannot cross.
Chinese: 意思是你不能过。

English: <<The man glances up. He sounds bored, as if reciting from memory.>>##To the most glorious [[Clockwork Kingdom]], a land of marvels and plenty beyond any other mortal realm, thanks to the ever-advancing wisdom of the [[Clockwork King]].
Chinese: <<那人抬眼，语气厌倦得像在背书。>>##去往最光荣的[[发条王国]]——多亏[[发条王]]日益精进的智慧，这是一片奇观与丰饶远超凡俗诸国的土地。

English: <<He peers at you, brows furrowed in genuine confusion.>> You are mistaken. I have no child.
Chinese: <<他盯着你，眉头因真实的困惑而皱起。>>你搞错了。我没有孩子。

English: <<He glances up at you, his expression unreadable.>> You are mistaken. I have no child.
Chinese: <<他抬眼看你，表情难以解读。>>你搞错了。我没有孩子。

English: Entry is forbidden, by order of the Clockwork King.
Chinese: 奉发条王之令，禁止入内。

English: Such documents are no good in the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 这种文件在发条王国不好使。

English: You would call it the 'Apostatic Union'.
Chinese: 你们管它叫"叛教联盟"。

English: Because we do not recognise the Defeatist Entity.
Chinese: 因为我们不承认失败主义实体。

English: Irrelevant. We do not recognise the Defeatist Entity or its methods of identification.
Chinese: 无关紧要。我们不承认失败主义实体，也不承认它的身份证明。

English: Because it is a defeatist excrescence of greed and privilege, run by a cabal of fossilised sophists and jealous aristocrats. ##<<He sounds as bored as ever, and still does not look up.>>
Chinese: 因为它是贪婪与特权的失败主义毒瘤，由一帮僵化的诡辩家和嫉妒的贵族把持。##<<他的语气依旧厌倦，头也不抬。>>

English: Exceptions are permitted only by specific order of the King.
Chinese: 例外必须凭国王的具体敕令。

English: Petitions to Its Majesty may be submitted via the Machinists' Guild in Ferropolis.
Chinese: 向陛下的呈文可通过铁城的机械师公会递交。

English: Cross this bridge, follow the road. Then ask someone else. I am a border guard, not a mapmaker.
Chinese: 过了这座桥，沿着路走。然后问别人去。我是边防兵，不是制图的。

English: Correct.
Chinese: 正确。

English: Not anymore.
Chinese: 现在不是了。

English: <<The guard does not look up.>>##You cannot.
Chinese: <<边防兵头也不抬。>>##你不能。

English: && <<The guard does not look up.>> Good to know.
Chinese: && <<边防兵头也不抬。>>好消息。

English: Letters of complaint may be submitted to the gatebridge officer. All complaints will be handled within three to six years. ##However, you must first exhaust the usual channels by requesting an entry exception.
Chinese: 投诉信可递交关卡桥值班官。所有投诉将在三至六年内处理。##不过，你必须先走正规渠道，申请入境例外。

English: <<He waves you through.>>
Chinese: <<他挥手放行。>>

English: %% <<The guard glances up at you, then does a double take. Caught in the incandescent beam of your sublime charisma, he stares helplessly into your eyes like he's falling into them.>>
Chinese: %% <<边防兵抬头看了你一眼，然后愣了一下。沐浴在你超凡魅力的耀眼光芒中，他无助地凝视你的双眼，像坠入其中。>>

English: ...um. Stay right there. ##<<He retreats from view for a minute. You hear the frantic turning of pages, many muttered curses, and then a series of mechanical clunks and pings.>>
Chinese: ……呃。站住别动。##<<他躲开视线一分钟。你听见疯狂的翻页声、许多句低声咒骂，然后是一连串机械的咔嗒与叮响。>>

English: <<The guard returns.>> ##Your, um, liturgical number?
Chinese: <<边防兵回来了。>> ##你的，呃，教历编号？

English: Rank?
Chinese: 军衔？

English: Tribunal?
Chinese: 法庭？

English: Very well. You will proceed immediately to [[Ferropolis]] and report to the [[Machinarium]] to explain your mission.
Chinese: 很好。你将立即前往[[铁城]]，到[[机械殿]]报到并说明你的使命。

English: But know this. The most glorious Clockwork King has been made aware of your presence. Every step will be recorded by machinery of ((terrifying)) capability. Your actions, your thoughts, your very ((dreams)) will be predicted and accounted for.
Chinese: 但记住这一点。最光荣的发条王已知晓你的到来。你的每一步都将被((能力骇人))的机器记录。你的行动、你的思想、乃至你的((梦))，都将被预测并备案。

English: Any deviation from these instructions will result in... how did you put it? ((Serious)) diplomatic consequences.
Chinese: 任何偏离这些指示的行为都将导致……你怎么说的来着？((严重))的外交后果。

English: <<He pauses, staring into your eyes as if forgetting what he was doing>>##I... er... Long live the King!
Chinese: <<他顿住，盯着你的眼睛，忘了自己在干什么>>##我……呃……国王万岁！

English: Long live the King!
Chinese: 国王万岁！

English: <<The guard swallows your spit, blushing bright red. He looks at you like a gentle breeze would shatter him.>>##Th...thank you...
Chinese: <<边防兵咽了口唾沫，脸涨得通红。他看着你，仿佛一阵微风就能把他吹碎。>>##谢……谢谢……

English: <<[Hand over your travel permit for inspection]>>
Chinese: <<[递交你的通行许可接受检查]>>

English: I'd like to cross the gatebridge, please.
Chinese: 我想过关卡桥。

English: No?
Chinese: 不行？

English: What does that mean?
Chinese: 什么意思？

English: Why not?
Chinese: 为什么不行？

English: Says who?
Chinese: 谁规定的？

English: Excuse me, where does this gatebridge lead?
Chinese: 打扰一下，这座关卡桥通向哪里？

English: Haven't we met? The noticeboard in Ferropolis. Your missing child.
Chinese: 我们见过吗？铁城的告示板。你失踪的孩子。

English: Good luck with the puzzle.
Chinese: 祝你字谜顺利。

English: But I have a valid passport right here.
Chinese: 可我这儿就有有效护照。

English: What if I had a valid Apostatic Union passport?
Chinese: 要是我有一本有效的联盟护照呢？

English: What if I had a letter from a Union dignitary?
Chinese: 要是我有联盟要人写的信呢？

English: Oh, forget it.
Chinese: 哦，算了。

English: So what ((do)) you accept?
Chinese: 那你们((到底))认什么？

English: Why not?
Chinese: 为什么不行？

English: Everyone else accepts Union passports.
Chinese: 别人都认联盟护照。

English: How come?
Chinese: 为什么？

English: Sorry, the WHAT entity?
Chinese: 抱歉，你说的是什么实体？

English: Why do you call it that?
Chinese: 你们为什么这么叫它？

English: So why don't you recognise it?
Chinese: 那你们为什么不承认它？

English: Are there no exceptions to the entry ban?
Chinese: 入境禁令没有例外吗？

English: How  can I secure an order from the King?
Chinese: 我怎么才能拿到国王的敕令？

English: How do I get to Ferropolis?
Chinese: 怎么去铁城？

English: So it's across the bridge, which I can't cross because entry is forbidden?
Chinese: 所以要先过桥，而我过不了桥，因为禁止入境？

English: Is there any other way into the Clockwork Kingdom?
Chinese: 进发条王国还有别的路吗？

English: <<[Offer 30 coins]>> Perhaps I can make it worth your while...?
Chinese: <<[递上 30 枚硬币]>>也许我能让您觉得划算……？

English: @@ I'm with the Inquisition. Let me through or there will be serious diplomatic consequences.
Chinese: @@ 我是宗教裁判所的人。放行，否则会有严重的外交后果。

English: I'd like to make a complaint.
Chinese: 我要投诉。

English: What if I could get ((you)) a Union passport?
Chinese: 要是我能弄到一本给((你))的联盟护照呢？

English: How do I request an entry exception?
Chinese: 怎么申请入境例外？

English: XVII.
Chinese: 十七。

English: None of your business.
Chinese: 不关你的事。

English: Confessor.
Chinese: 忏悔者。

English: Higher than yours.
Chinese: 比你高。

English: The Twelfth.
Chinese: 第十二庭。

English: You don't need to know.
Chinese: 你不需要知道。

English: Long live the King.
Chinese: 国王万岁。

English: We'll see...
Chinese: 走着瞧……

English: <<[Spit in his mouth]>>
Chinese: <<[朝他嘴里吐唾沫]>>

English: The border is closed.
Chinese: 边境已关闭。

English: [[He throws the passport back to you]]##We don't accept these.
Chinese: [[他把护照丢回给你]]##我们不认这种东西。

English: [[He rolls his eyes, brushing you off.]]##What's an inquisition rat doing snooping around here anyways? I could have you arrested, you know.
Chinese: [[他翻着白眼，把你打发走。]]##宗教裁判所的老鼠跑到这儿乱转什么？我可是能抓你的。

English: Keep moving.
Chinese: 走开走开。

English: Not happening. Now get out of here.
Chinese: 没门。滚吧。

English: <<[Hand over your travel permit for inspection]>>
Chinese: <<[递交你的通行许可接受检查]>>

English: <<[Hand over your Union passport]>>
Chinese: <<[递交你的联盟护照]>>

English: Why not?
Chinese: 为什么不行？

English: Just let me through. I need to go home.
Chinese: 让我过去吧。我要回家。

English: <<You see a middle-aged man with patchy hair and thick moustaches tinkering with a sky skiff. His skin is weathered, and somehow a pipe stays in his mouth even as he toils.>>
Chinese: <<一个头发斑驳、蓄着浓密胡子的中年男人正在摆弄一艘天国小艇。他皮肤粗糙，奇怪的是，即便干着重活，烟斗也一直叼在嘴里。>>

English: Piss off, I am working.
Chinese: 滚开，我在干活。

English: A man who is working and not to be disturbed.
Chinese: 一个正在干活、不许打扰的男人。

English: And I am only working. So.
Chinese: 而我也正在干活。所以。

English: <<The man closes a panel on his skiff, then turns to examine you.>> ##Hrmph. Perhaps. Or, perhaps not. This depends on how helpful you can be.
Chinese: <<那人合上小艇的一块面板，转过身来打量你。>>##哼。也许吧。也许不吧。这取决于你有多大用处。

English: Hrmph. You do not look like an inquisitor. Or perhaps you are underneath a cover, yes?
Chinese: 哼。你可不像宗教裁判所的。或者你只是披了层皮，嗯？

English: Hrmph. From the Union? You are very far from home, parasite. We both know you have no authority here.
Chinese: 哼。联盟来的？你离家够远的，寄生虫。咱俩都清楚，你在这儿没什么权威。

English: You will find the papers in order, but it will not let you jump the queue. Unless of course you have proper warrant.
Chinese: 你会发现手续齐全，但那可不能让你插队。除非，当然，你有正式的逮捕令。

English: Besides, you do not look like an inquisitor. Or perhaps you are underneath a cover, yes?
Chinese: 再说，你可不像宗教裁判所的。或者你只是披了层皮，嗯？

English: From a genie. First wish was for sky skiff. Second wish was for strangers to ask annoying questions. Third was for strangers to fall in plague pit.
Chinese: 精灵给的。第一个愿望是天国小艇。第二个愿望是让陌生人问烦人的问题。第三个是让陌生人掉进瘟疫坑。

English: Name is [[Mikhail]], but friends call me [[Misha]]. You and I, we are not friends. Not yet.
Chinese: 我叫[[米哈伊尔]]，朋友叫我[[米沙]]。你和我，不是朋友。暂时还不是。

English: For his sins, old Misha is the only independent sky sailor in the Oneiric Isles with genuine cargo permit for the [[Clockwork Kingdom]].
Chinese: 造孽的是，老米沙是梦幻群岛唯一持有[[发条王国]]正规货运许可的独立天海水手。

English: Misha grew up there, many years, so he knows all the secret tricks to get your paperwork approved.
Chinese: 米沙在那儿长大，好多年，所以他知道所有能让你文件获批的秘门歪道。

English: But, the Clockwork Kingdom is not an easy place to enter. Borders are closed, visitors are jailed. So, Misha's skills are in high demand.##Current waiting time for new clients is about one year.
Chinese: 但是呢，发条王国可不是个好进的地方。边境关闭，访客坐牢。所以米沙的本事供不应求。##新客户的等候时间大约一年。

English: For his sins, old Misha is the only independent sky sailor in the Clockwork Kingdom with genuine permit to import goods to and from [[Hallowshire]].
Chinese: 造孽的是，老米沙是发条王国唯一持有正规许可、可与[[哈洛郡]]往来运货的独立天海水手。

English: Misha grew up here, many years, so he knows all the secret tricks to get your paperwork approved.
Chinese: 米沙在这儿长大，好多年，所以他知道所有能让你文件获批的秘门歪道。

English: But, the Clockwork Kingdom is not an easy place to leave. Borders are closed, emigrants are jailed. So, Misha's skills are in high demand. ##Current waiting time for new clients is about one year.
Chinese: 但是呢，发条王国可不是个好离开的地方。边境关闭，移民坐牢。所以米沙的本事供不应求。##新客户的等候时间大约一年。

English: So, you are not dead! Staying out of trouble, yes?
Chinese: 所以，你没死！在外面老实待着，嗯？

English: Well? Do you have anything to say that is worth the breath?
Chinese: 怎么样？你有什么值得开口的话吗？

English: Well? Speak quickly, lest we draw the eyes of the King.
Chinese: 怎么样？快说，免得招来国王的眼睛。

English: Are we done? Or do you have business yet with Misha?
Chinese: 谈完了吗？还是跟米沙还有生意？

English: So, has your pestering reached its end?
Chinese: 那么，你纠缠够了没有？

English: Only four rules of flying with Misha##One: do not lean over side.##Two: do not feed the jellyfish; it is not your friend.##Three: do not vomit in boat.
Chinese: 坐米沙的船只有四条规矩##一：不许探身出舷。##二：不许喂水母；它不是你的朋友。##三：不许吐在船上。

English: Last rule: Misha never goes inland in the Clockwork Kingdom. Once you leave Misha's landing site, you are on your own. ##So! Ready for today's exciting voyage?
Chinese: 最后一条：米沙在发条王国从不进内陆。你一离开米沙的降落点，就全靠自己了。##那么！准备好今天激动人心的航行了吗？

English: None of your business, pinhead.
Chinese: 不关你的事，针头脑。

English: Ach, time. We always think we have so much.
Chinese: 唉，时间。我们总以为有很多。

English: Do not die, friend.
Chinese: 别死了，朋友。

English: Hrmm. Perhaps.
Chinese: 嗯。也许吧。

English: Do not die. Misha hates to lose a customer.
Chinese: 别死了。米沙舍不得丢客户。

English: Eh? Misha's ears must be full of engine gunk. Misha thought he heard you say you wish to go ((back)) to the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 嗯？米沙的耳朵肯定被引擎的油泥堵住了。米沙好像听见你说，你想((回))发条王国。

English: Again? You are stranded in this shithole ((again))? What happened to beloved little children, hm? One of them forget their dolly?
Chinese: 又来？你((又))被困在这个鬼地方了？说好的心肝小宝贝们呢，嗯？其中一个把洋娃娃弄丢了？

English: Again? You are stranded in this shithole ((again))?
Chinese: 又来？你((又))被困在这个鬼地方了？

English: Hrmph. Well, it is your funeral. But getting in is not so simple as getting out.
Chinese: 哼。好吧，那是你的葬礼。不过进去可不像出来那么简单。

English: As I am sure a clever customer like you knows, entry to the Clockwork Kingdom is strictly forbidden. So, we must once again speak as philosophers do.
Chinese: 想必像你这么聪明的客户明白，发条王国严禁入内。所以，我们得再像哲学家那样谈谈。

English: Forget it, Misha does not even wish to know how.
Chinese: 算了，米沙连怎么弄的都不想知道。

English: The deal is the same. For [[40 coins]], Misha will transfigure you into innocent barrel of pilchards through the magic of... ##<<He spits.>> ((Paperwork)).
Chinese: 交易条件不变。[[40 枚硬币]]，米沙就能用……##<<他啐了一口。>>((文件))的魔法，把你变成一桶无辜的鲱鱼。

English: You are very funny. Cargo yes, people no. As I am sure a clever customer like you knows, entry to the Clockwork Kingdom is strictly forbidden. ##Of course, where there is will, there is way, hm?
Chinese: 你可真逗。货可以，人不行。想必像你这么聪明的客户明白，发条王国严禁入内。##当然，有志者事竟成，嗯？

English: Hrmph. Many are asking this of Misha. However, I am sure a clever customer like you knows that emigration from the Clockwork Kingdom is strictly forbidden. ##That is, unless you have official exit permit from the King.
Chinese: 哼。找米沙办这个的可多了。不过想必像你这么聪明的客户明白，发条王国严禁移民。##除非，你有国王的正式出境许可。

English: Not with Misha, mind. Misha does everything above the board. But... if we are speaking in abstract, as philosophers do...
Chinese: 不是跟米沙做，注意。米沙一切照章办事。但……如果我们像哲学家那样抽象地谈……

English: <<He snorts.>> As Misha thought. Officially speaking, Misha cannot help you. ##But, if we are speaking in abstract, as philosophers do...
Chinese: <<他嗤笑。>>正如米沙所料。按官方说法，米沙帮不了你。##但如果我们像哲学家那样抽象地谈……

English: If a traveller, much like you, were to give a sky sailor, much like Misha, a proper [[Apostatic Union passport]], then perhaps – in theory, yes? – arrangements could be made.
Chinese: 假如某位跟你差不多的旅人，给某位跟米沙差不多的天海水手，一本像样的[[叛教联盟护照]]，那么——理论上讲，对吧？——也许就能安排。

English: Let us first ask, what is cargo? This is simple: an object carried from place to place. Must it be dead? No; Misha often has ferried beasts and fowl. So, may a person be cargo? Perhaps, if they are listed on manifest.
Chinese: 先问一句，什么是货物？很简单：从一个地方运到另一个地方的东西。必须是死的吗？不是；米沙常运牲畜和家禽。那么，人可以当货物吗？也许吧，只要写上货单。

English: Union passport is quite a prize inside the Clockwork Kingdom. Useless for entering, but nowadays most people wish to exit. So, philosophically speaking, perhaps this would be fair trade.
Chinese: 联盟护照在发条王国内部可是稀罕物。入境没用，可如今大多数人想出去。所以，从哲学上讲，这算是公平交易。

English: But what ((is)) a person? Many have pondered this, without result. Then why should a person not be listed as a keg of beer, or case of bottled visions? ##Misha's philosophy is flexible. For [[40 coins]], it can be so.
Chinese: 可什么((才))算人？多少人想过，没有结论。那为什么不把一个人记成一桶啤酒、一箱瓶装幻象呢？##米沙的哲学很灵活。[[40 枚硬币]]，就可以。

English: In this way, we are the same.
Chinese: 这么说，我们是一路人。

English: This will suit Misha just fine.
Chinese: 这样米沙就很满意了。

English: We have discussed this. Bring Misha a proper [[Apostatic Union passport]], and perhaps arrangements can be made.
Chinese: 我们说过了。给米沙一本像样的[[叛教联盟护照]]，也许就能安排。

English: We have discussed this. For [[40 coins]], Misha will transfigure you into innocent barrel of pilchards through the magic of... ##<<He spits.>> ((Paperwork)).
Chinese: 我们说过了。[[40 枚硬币]]，米沙就能用……##<<他啐了一口。>>((文件))的魔法，把你变成一桶无辜的鲱鱼。

English: Oh, gold? I am so impressed. I cannot get gold anywhere else. ##<<Mikhail snorts derisively.>>
Chinese: 哦，金子？真是让我受宠若惊。我别处弄不到金子似的。##<<米沙轻蔑地嗤笑。>>

English: Misha has met many of your kind. You think everything is for sale. You even think you can buy love. You are no better than a wild beast, sniffing corpses.
Chinese: 米沙见过你这种人多了。你以为什么都能买。你甚至以为爱情也能买。你跟闻着尸味的野兽没两样。

English: %% <<Mikhail lets out a deep sigh.>>##Misha's heart is not a stone. You may go – but only you. Any other family still here, they must pay. Expenses are expenses, yes?
Chinese: %% <<米哈伊尔长叹一声。>>##米沙的心不是石头。你可以走——但只有你。其他家人还在的，都得照价付款。成本就是成本，对吧？

English: && <<Mikhail snorts>> Then your children will be learning many new skills. Misha has heard this one before.##[[40 coins]] is the fee, and no less.
Chinese: && <<米哈伊尔嗤笑>>那你孩子们要学好多新本事了。这话米沙听过。##[[40 枚硬币]]是价，少一个子儿都不行。

English: <<Mikhail counts your coins, then shakes his head.>> ##This is not what we agreed. Do not try to fuck with Misha – it is a long way down out there.
Chinese: <<米哈伊尔数了数你的硬币，然后摇头。>> ##这跟我们说好的不一样。别想糊弄米沙——那边摔下去可够远的。

English: Now, listen: this is a one way trip. If you wish to sail again, we must make new arrangement.
Chinese: 现在听着：这是单程票。想再坐船，我们得重新谈。

English: None of your business, pinhead.
Chinese: 不关你的事，针头脑。

English: Finally we are having a serious conversation. Misha will make sure it finds a good owner.
Chinese: 总算说正经话了。米沙会保证它找到好主人。

English: So. Perhaps you are thinking: what if this dashing yet enigmatic sky sailor is just common crook? What if he takes my shiny passport then throws me overboard? ##Do not have so little faith in Misha.
Chinese: 那么。也许你在想：万一这个潇洒又神秘的天海水手就是个普通的骗子呢？万一他拿了我的亮闪闪的护照就把我扔下船呢？##对米沙别这么没信心嘛。

English: <<He hands you a crudely-drawn parody of an Apostatic Union passport.>> ##Show this authentic travel document to the [[Royal Factor]] in the city of [[Ferropolis]], after we land. Good friend of Misha's. She will make sure you can cross gatebridge in future.
Chinese: <<他递给你一本画得歪歪扭扭的联盟护照仿制品。>> ##落地之后，把这份"真实"的旅行证件拿给[[铁城]]的[[皇家事务官]]看。米沙的好朋友。她会保证你以后能过关卡桥。

English: Official? Is this your desire? Official means clerks and stamps, searches and manacles. It is the rack, the strappado, the spell that makes your lungs burn like you're drowning until you betray every faith you have. Yes, Misha knows all about 'official'.
Chinese: 官方？你想要官方？官方就意味着文书和印章、搜查和镣铐。就是拉肢架、吊刑，就是那种烧得你肺像溺水一样、直到你背叛一切信仰的法术。是的，"官方"的事米沙懂得很。

English: Ah, but Misha forgets. You are an Inquisitor. So you are happy with official, yes?
Chinese: 哦，米沙忘了。你是裁判官。所以你喜欢官方的，对吧？

English: Questions, questions. Always so many questions. Are you never tiring of it?
Chinese: 问题，问题。永远这么多问题。你不累吗？

English: Surely you are not forgetting your old pal Misha? Ah, but you are so busy, always rushing back and forth.
Chinese: 该不会忘了老朋友米沙吧？唉，可你这么忙，总是来去匆匆。

English: Name is [[Mikhail]]. Friends call me [[Misha]]. I sail to the Clockwork Kingdom, I sail back. Sometimes you come with me. Other times, not.
Chinese: 我叫[[米哈伊尔]]。朋友叫我[[米沙]]。我往发条王国开船，再开回来。有时你跟我一起。有时不。

English: It is too soon to tell. Does anyone have a true friend in this shattered world, where each of us dies alone? This is a mystery that must be lived, not studied.
Chinese: 这还看不出来。在这个人人独自赴死的世界，谁有真正的朋友？这是个只能活出来、没法研究的谜。

English: Hrm. This is strange. Misha imagined he was in Hallowshire in fresh air, fixing sky skiff, but instead it seems he is in school teaching unruly child.
Chinese: 嗯。这就怪了。米沙还以为自己在哈洛郡的新鲜空气里修天国小艇，结果好像是在学堂里教一个没规矩的小孩。

English: Hrm. This is strange. Misha imagined he was in desolate forest, trying to fix sky skiff before he is eaten by Corrupted, but instead it seems he is in school teaching unruly child.
Chinese: 嗯。这就怪了。米沙还以为自己在荒林里赶着修天国小艇、免得被腐化者吃掉，结果好像是在学堂里教一个没规矩的小孩。

English: Oh wait! Misha was done schooling at age thirteen. If you still need teacher, that is your problem.
Chinese: 哦等等！米沙十三岁就毕业了。你要是还需要老师，那是你自己的问题。

English: Ah, you are used to being waited on hand and leg in some big cushy tavern, yes? Service with a smile? Perhaps you think Misha is buxom tavern wench with overflowing... hm, how do you say it?
Chinese: 啊，你习惯了在大酒馆里被人伺候得舒舒服服，是吧？微笑服务？你以为米沙是哪个体态丰满、身上什么都要往外冒……嗯，那个词怎么说来着？

English: <<He shoots you a nonplussed look.>>##((Tankard.)) The point is, you will get no smile with Misha. Smiling is not part of service. Why? Because Misha has what we tradesfolk call a captive market.
Chinese: <<他不解地看了你一眼。>>##((酒杯。))重点是，米沙这里没有微笑。微笑不是服务的一部分。为什么？因为米沙这行，用咱们买卖人的话说，叫垄断。

English: How many other sky sailors with official papers for the Kingdom?##Misha knew all of them. Grigory – dead. Anja – dead in prison. Najaf – Corrupted. Kofi – ehh, redacted.
Chinese: 有正规文件跑王国的天海水手还有几个？##米沙全认识。格里戈里——死了。安雅——死在牢里。纳贾夫——腐化了。科菲——呃，被删了。

English: So: Misha does not owe you smile. You want smile, go dig up Grigory's skull.
Chinese: 所以：米沙不欠你微笑。想要微笑，去把格里戈里的头盖骨刨出来。

English: Misha remembers Youssef. Good passenger. No trouble. Hope he is happy. ##However, you have misunderstood. Bottled visions come out of the Kingdom, they do not go in. Apostatic Union cannot make them.
Chinese: 米沙记得优素福。好乘客。不惹事。希望他过得好。##不过你搞错了。瓶装幻象只出王国，不进王国。叛教联盟造不出来。

English: Youssef? In Hallowshire? Misha remembers. Good passenger. Hope he is happy. ##However, you have misunderstood. Bottled visions go out of the Kingdom, they do not come in. Apostatic Union cannot make them.
Chinese: 优素福？在哈洛郡？米沙记得。好乘客。希望他过得好。##不过你搞错了。瓶装幻象只出王国，不进王国。叛教联盟造不出来。

English: You have caught Misha's attention. However, I am thinking this is not a gift, yes?
Chinese: 你引起了米沙的注意。不过，我想这不是白送的，对吧？

English: His sister... ##<<Mikhail lets out an odd little laugh, its meaning hard to read.>> A message in a bottle, hm? So be it. Upon my life, this will be done.
Chinese: 他妹妹……##<<米哈伊尔发出一声含义难辨的怪笑。>>瓶中信，嗯？那就这样吧。以我的性命担保，一定送到。

English: %% <<Mikhail scans your face shrewdly, then nods.>> Very good. These bottles shall find their shores.
Chinese: %% <<米哈伊尔精明地扫过你的脸，然后点头。>>很好。这些瓶子会抵达它们的彼岸。

English: && <<Mikhail scans your face shrewdly, then snorts.>> Nice try, pinhead. Hand over the others.
Chinese: && <<米哈伊尔精明地扫过你的脸，然后嗤笑。>>想得美，针头脑。把其余的都交出来。

English: <<Mikhail scans your face shrewdly, then nods.>> Very good. These bottles shall find their shores.
Chinese: <<米哈伊尔精明地扫过你的脸，然后点头。>>很好。这些瓶子会抵达它们的彼岸。

English: The Clockwork Kingdom is impossible to explain, but Misha will try.
Chinese: 发条王国没法解释，但米沙试试。

English: The countryside is full of [[Corruption]] – not to mention [[rogue myrmidons]]...
Chinese: 乡下到处是[[腐化]]——更别提[[失控的斯堤兵]]……

English: But the worst danger is the [[Clockwork King]] itself. It and its [[Machinist]] minions.##Piss them off and they will make you disappear – poof! Like a magic trick.
Chinese: 但最危险的是[[发条王]]本尊。还有它那些[[机械师]]爪牙。##惹了他们，你就人间蒸发——噗！像变戏法一样。

English: Oh, and if you see big house on wheels? Advice is simple: watch out.
Chinese: 哦对，要是你看见一栋带轮子的大房子？忠告很简单：当心。

English: <<A shadow crosses Mikhail's face.>>##Nothing good. There is a great scar cut into the land, east of the main gatebridge. Stay on this side, and you may live.
Chinese: <<一片阴影掠过米哈伊尔的脸。>>##没什么好事。主关卡桥以东的大地上有一道大疤。待在这一边，你还能活。

English: %% <<Mikhail sighs heavily.>> The King changes things, yes? That is its power. Land, weather, resources – even people, or so they say. Over time, these ((changes)) became... strange.
Chinese: %% <<米哈伊尔重重叹了口气。>>国王会改变东西，对吧？那就是它的力量。土地、天气、资源——甚至人，人家是这么说的。久而久之，这些((改变))变得……怪异。

English: A whole province was changed. ##That was where Misha's family lived.
Chinese: 一整个省被改变了。##那就是米沙一家住的地方。

English: So: now you know why Misha never goes inland. And why we are finished talking about Corruption.
Chinese: 所以：现在你知道米沙为什么不进内陆了。还有为什么腐化的事我们到此为止。

English: && <<Mikhail looks hard into your eyes.>> Some things are not to be spoken of in a place like this.
Chinese: && <<米哈伊尔死死盯着你的眼睛。>>有些事，在这种地方说不得。

English: Correct. A great machine of cipher magic, which can grant whatever wishes you desire. Built as a wise and just ruler, for all time.##<<His nose wrinkles in contempt.>>
Chinese: 正确。一台密文魔法的巨机，能实现你想要的一切愿望。造它的时候，要它当一位睿智公正、千秋万代的君主。##<<他的鼻子轻蔑地皱起。>>

English: Ah, the [[Machinists' Guild]]. Humble bigwigs of the Clockwork King. You will know them by their mechanical eye and iron muzzle.
Chinese: 啊，[[机械师公会]]。发条王麾下谦逊的大人物们。看见机械眼和铁口套就知道了。

English: How can Misha describe their devotion? Who has sacrificed more to defend the Kingdom's people? ##<Mikhail snorts.>> If anyone asks, this is all Misha told you.
Chinese: 他们的忠诚怎么说呢？还有谁为保卫王国的人民牺牲更多？##<<米沙嗤笑。>>要是有人问起，这些话都是米沙跟你说的。

English: The Guild built the King, when Misha was small. Now they are the ones who enforce its commands.##They claim they're the King's dogs, never making decisions of their own.
Chinese: 公会造了国王，那时米沙还小。现在执行它命令的就是他们。##他们自称是国王的狗，从不自行做主。

English: Well, Misha is just simple sky sailor, but he knows an otter from an onion. And everyone here knows who is boss.
Chinese: 呃，米沙只是个头脑简单的天海水手，可他分得清什么是水獭什么是洋葱。这儿的每一个人都清楚谁才是当家的。

English: So. Are you satisfied? Misha does not enjoy discussing his homeland.
Chinese: 那么。满意了吗？米沙可不喜欢聊他的家乡。

English: Yes, yes. You will be back.##<<Mikhail rolls his eyes.>>
Chinese: 是是。你还会回来的。##<<米哈伊尔翻了个白眼。>>

English: Are you ready for the voyage?##We are leaving soon.
Chinese: 准备好航行了吗？##我们很快出发。

English: If you wish to fly with Misha again, just find his skiff on either side and flash the passport.##Upon Misha's life, you will have safe passage.
Chinese: 想再搭米沙的船，在随便哪边找到他的小艇，晃一晃护照就行。##以米沙的性命担保，通行无阻。

English: Once you are inside the Kingdom, Ferropolis cannot be missed. Big city on stilts, yes? ##Just outside the city gate there is [[checkpoint]], with guards. You will find her there, lounging in some fancy office.
Chinese: 进了王国，铁城绝对不会错过。架在桩子上的大城，对吧？##城门外有[[检查站]]，有卫兵。她就在那儿，窝在某个气派的办公室里。

English: Excuse me, who are you?
Chinese: 打扰一下，你是谁？

English: No need to be sour, I'm only asking.
Chinese: 别酸了，我就问问。

English: Any room for passengers in that skiff of yours?
Chinese: 你那小艇还载客吗？

English: I'm on Inquisition business. It's best you cooperate.
Chinese: 我办的是宗教裁判所的公务。你最好配合。

English: Never mind. I'll leave you to your work.
Chinese: 算了。不打扰你干活。

English: Nice boat. Where'd you get it?
Chinese: 船不错。哪来的？

English: Never mind. I'll leave you to your work.
Chinese: 算了。不打扰你干活。

English: OK, pissing off.
Chinese: 行行行，我闪。

English: I'd like to sail to the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 我想坐船去发条王国。

English: I'd like to sail to Hallowshire.
Chinese: 我想坐船去哈洛郡。

English: Let's go.
Chinese: 走吧。

English: Why do you never go inland?
Chinese: 你怎么从不往内陆去？

English: Actually, I need more time.
Chinese: 其实，我还需要点时间。

English: About that Union passport you asked for...
Chinese: 关于你要的那本联盟护照……

English: Can you get me into the Clockwork Kingdom?
Chinese: 你能把我弄进发条王国吗？

English: Can you get me the hell off this island?
Chinese: 你能把我弄离这鬼岛吗？

English: I have bottled visions for you from Youssef.
Chinese: 我替优素福带了些瓶装幻象给你。

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗？

English: See you around, Misha.
Chinese: 回头见，米沙。

English: See you around, Mikhail.
Chinese: 回头见，米哈伊尔。

English: Look, I'm going through a very strange time in my life.
Chinese: 听着，我正在经历人生中一段非常奇怪的时期。

English: Look, I didn't pay you to ask questions.
Chinese: 听着，我付你钱不是让你提问的。

English: Fine, you have a deal. Let's get airborne.
Chinese: 行，成交。起飞吧。

English: Actually, I'm not ready to fly just yet.
Chinese: 其实，我还不能起飞。

English: Go on...
Chinese: 说下去……

English: I'm afraid not.
Chinese: 恐怕不行。

English: Would you believe I left it in my other pantaloons?
Chinese: 你信不信我落在另一条裤子里了？

English: I don't have time for this.
Chinese: 我没工夫耗着。

English: Maybe I'll just find my own way back.
Chinese: 也许我自己找路回去。

English: What if I could pay you twice its worth in coins?
Chinese: 要是我付你双倍价钱呢？

English: Funnily enough, I have a Union passport right here.
Chinese: 巧了，我这儿正好有本联盟护照。

English: [pay 40 coins] You have a deal. Let's get airborne.
Chinese: [付 40 枚硬币] 成交。起飞吧。

English: @@ Please – my children are in Hallowshire, alone.
Chinese: @@ 求你了——我的孩子还在哈洛郡，孤零零的。

English: I'll let you know if I find one.
Chinese: 找到我再告诉你。

English: Actually, I'm not ready to fly just yet.
Chinese: 其实，我还不能起飞。

English: Wait, what's the fourth rule?
Chinese: 等等，第四条规矩是什么？

English: Understood. Let's fly.
Chinese: 明白。飞吧。

English: This 'passport' doesn't look very official.
Chinese: 这本"护照"看着可不怎么官气。

English: Thanks. I'll keep it close.
Chinese: 谢谢。我会贴身收好。

English: Who are you again?
Chinese: 你是谁来着？

English: Wait, are we friends now?
Chinese: 等等，我们现在算朋友了？

English: Of course, now I remember.
Chinese: 对哦，我想起来了。

English: Who did you say you were?
Chinese: 你刚说你是谁来着？

English: Tell me about the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 给我讲讲发条王国。

English: What is the Clockwork Kingdom?
Chinese: 发条王国是什么？

English: Why are you so rude, Mikhail?
Chinese: 米哈伊尔，你怎么这么粗鲁？

English: Kindness?
Chinese: 善良？

English: Intellect?
Chinese: 智慧？

English: Decolletage?
Chinese: 低胸装？

English: Fine, fine, no more questions.
Chinese: 好了好了，不问了。

English: Youssef made these visions himself, in Hallowshire.
Chinese: 这些幻象是优素福在哈洛郡自己做的。

English: Youssef can. He said they'd be worth something in the Kingdom.
Chinese: 优素福能。他说这些在王国能值点钱。

English: The bottle marked 'Yasmeen' must reach Youssef's sister. The rest are yours.
Chinese: 标着"亚斯敏"的那瓶必须送到优素福妹妹手上。其余归你。

English: @@ <<[Lie and hold back some for yourself]>>
Chinese: @@ <<[撒谎，自己私扣几瓶]>>

English: <<[Give all the bottles]>> This is the whole stash.
Chinese: <<[把瓶子全部交出]>>全部家当都在这儿。

English: <<[Betray Youssef]>> All Youssef wants is a fair price for his wares.
Chinese: <<[出卖优素福]>>优素福就想要个公道价出手他的货。

English: <<Mikhail scans your face shrewdly, then nods.>> Very good. Misha may be harsh, but always is fair. ##<<Yasmeen's bottle disappears into the cargo hold. Perhaps someone else will dream Youssef's dream.>>
Chinese: <<米哈伊尔精明地扫过你的脸，然后点头。>>很好。米沙或许刻薄，但一向公道。##<<亚斯敏的瓶子消失进货舱。或许会有别人梦见优素福的梦。>>

English: A pleasure doing business again. Is this all?
Chinese: 又跟你做成生意，真愉快。就这些？

English: A pleasure doing business. Now, as Misha said the first time, piss off.
Chinese: 生意愉快。现在，照米沙第一次说的，滚吧。

English: The Clockwork Kingdom is impossible to explain, but Misha will try.
Chinese: 发条王国没法解释，但米沙试试。

English: What's this 'Corruption' you speak of?
Chinese: 你说的"腐化"是什么？

English: @@ I know it's hard to talk about, but my life may depend on this information.
Chinese: @@ 我知道这不好开口，可我的命可能就系在这消息上。

English: ... all right, I'll stay away.
Chinese: ……好吧，我不去。

English: Thanks for the advice.
Chinese: 多谢忠告。

English: Is the Clockwork King truly a machine?
Chinese: 发条王真是台机器？

English: Who are these 'Machinists' exactly?
Chinese: 这些"机械师"到底是些什么人？

English: That's all my questions.
Chinese: 我的问题问完了。

English: About that fee
Chinese: 关于那笔船费

English: I'll be back with more gold
Chinese: 我带更多金币回来

English: Is money all you care about?
Chinese: 钱就是你唯一在乎的？

English: How do I find this Royal Factor?
Chinese: 这位皇家事务官上哪找？

English: <<Mikhail studies the horizon with a grim face, muttering occasional curses to himself.>> ##Do not distract the helmsman from his work. These skies are treacherous, and we are being watched.
Chinese: <<米哈伊尔铁青着脸研究着地平线，偶尔低声咒骂。>>##别打扰舵手干活。这片天空险恶，而且有人在盯我们。

English: <<Mikhail appears a little more at ease, though it's hard to tell.>> ##The Kingdom is behind us, but we are not safe until there is dirt beneath our feet. 'Til then, no chit-chat.
Chinese: <<米哈伊尔看起来放松了一点，虽然不太好判断。>>##王国在身后了，但脚不沾地就不算安全。到那之前，别闲聊。

English: <<Mikhail takes a puff on his pipe. He looks calmer, though it's hard to tell.>> ##So, you did not fall overboard! Perhaps we will make a sky-sailor of you yet.
Chinese: <<米哈伊尔抽了口烟斗。他看起来平静了些，虽然不太好判断。>>##所以说，你没掉下船！说不定还真能把你练成个天海水手。

English: Now you are breathing the noble air of the Apostatic Union. No doubt you can taste the peace and prosperity on the wind, yes? ##<<He blows a plume of smoke, which smells faintly of cherries.>>
Chinese: 现在你呼吸的是叛教联盟的高贵空气。毫无疑问，你能从风里尝到和平与繁荣的味道，对吧？##<<他吐出一团烟，隐约有樱桃味。>>

English: The skiff must rest for a tick, along with its pilot. Come back later if you have other business for Misha.
Chinese: 小艇得歇一会儿，舵手也一样。有别的生意，晚点再来找米沙。

English: We must not launch again too quickly, lest we draw the King's eyes. Come back later if you wish to sail again.
Chinese: 不能太快再度起飞，免得招来国王的眼睛。想再飞，晚点再来。

English: Remember, keep your head down and ((trust no one)). Understand? You do ((not)) wish to be tangled in Machinist business.
Chinese: 记住，低头做人，((谁也别信))。明白吗？你((千万))别沾机械师的破事。

English: <<Mikhail looks off towards the mountains with an unreadable expression, then shakes his head.>> Well, here we are. Home shit home, or what is left of it.
Chinese: <<米哈伊尔望着群山，神情难辨，然后摇头。>>好了，到了。狗屁的家，剩下的这点。

English: Since Misha never goes inland, this is where we part. ##Misha will not ask your business, and it is best you do not tell. But if you wish to cross the [[gatebridge]], speak to the [[Royal Factor]].
Chinese: 米沙从不进内陆，所以就送到这儿。##米沙不问你的来意，你也最好别说。但你要过[[关卡桥]]，去找[[皇家事务官]]。

English: When you get to Ferropolis, keep your head down and ((trust no one)). Understand? You do ((not)) wish to be tangled in Machinist intrigue.
Chinese: 到了铁城，低头做人，((谁也别信))。明白吗？你((千万))别卷进机械师的阴谋。

English: So! Any questions? You have a rare opportunity. Misha is genuine, guaranteed, salt of the earth Clockwork citizen – not one of the Machinists' good little blinkered tour guides.
Chinese: 那么！有问题吗？机会难得。米沙是货真价实、如假包换的发条土著——不是机械师养的cc那些戴着眼罩的导游。

English: Wise plan. Do not die, yes?
Chinese: 明智。别死了，好吗？

English: Misha has not been to Ferropolis for many years. But there should be a [[checkpoint]] on the viaduct into the city. Find her there, show Misha's passport, and the border guards will not trouble you again.
Chinese: 米沙好多年没进铁城了。但进城高架桥上应该有个[[检查站]]。到那儿找她，出示米沙的护照，边防兵就不会再烦你。

English: Do not tarry here, hm?
Chinese: 别在这儿耗着，嗯？

English: Do not die. Misha hates to lose a customer.
Chinese: 别死。米沙舍不得丢客户。

English: I need to ask you about the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 关于发条王国，我要请教你。

English: Remind me where to find this Royal Factor?
Chinese: 再提醒我一下皇家事务官在哪找？

English: I thought you said I could always sail with you?
Chinese: 你不是说我随时可以搭你的船吗？

English: I understand. Thank you, Mikhail
Chinese: 明白。谢谢你，米哈伊尔。

English: Please. I need all the information I can get.
Chinese: 求你了。我能收集的情报越多越好。

English: I shouldn't linger.
Chinese: 我不该久留。

English: Our captain's a queer sort, innee?##Truth be told, I find 'im reassuring. It's the ones wot bow and scrape and act all ((courteous)) that'll fuck you over.
Chinese: 我们船长是个怪人，对吧？##说实话，我倒觉得他让人安心。那些点头哈腰、装得((客客气气))的家伙，才会坑死你。

English: You'll be another Clockwork refugee, I s'pose?
Chinese: 你也是发条难民吧？

English: Well, I wouldn't stop in 'Allowshire if I were you. Go to Vena, or Lundel, or even Slev. Anywhere but these blasted Isles.
Chinese: 呃，我要是你就不在哈洛郡停留。去维纳、伦德尔，或者斯列夫。除了这鬼群岛，去哪都行。

English: Cor, you some sorta trader, then? Diplomat? Or...##Heh. On second thoughts, say no more.
Chinese: 嚯，你是商人？外交官？还是……##嘿。算了，别说了。

English: Me, I was ready to stick it out. I was born 'ere and I'll die 'ere," that's what I said. But my daughter-in-law over there insisted. The nippers need their grandpa, she said. Well, mine's not to reason why, heh."
Chinese: 我呢，本来是打算死扛到底的。生在这里，死在这里"，我是这么说的。可我儿媳妇在那边坚持要走。孩子们需要爷爷，她说。呃，军令如山，我还能说什么，嘿嘿。"

English: Something like that.
Chinese: 差不多吧。

English: No, just a traveler.
Chinese: 不是，我就是个游客。

English: We couldn't afford for the whole family to cross at once, so my husband went first with the bairns, with me and Pa to follow##King willing, they're waiting for us in [[Hallow town]]...
Chinese: 我们全家一起过境太贵了，所以我丈夫带着孩子们先走，我和我爸随后。##国王保佑，他们现在应该在[[哈洛镇]]等着我们……

English: ...shite, I shouldn't say that anymore, should I? [['King's blessing']], and all that...##Who am I meant to thank for good luck in the Apostatic Union?
Chinese: ……糟了，我不该再说那个词了，对吧？[["国王赐福"]]什么的……##那在叛教联盟，交了好运我该谢谁来着？

English: Oh aye. That makes sense. Bit impersonal though, ennit? I mean, do those things actually ((care)) about us? ##Ach. I'll take an uncaring star over the kind of 'care' the King gave us.
Chinese: 哦对。有道理。不过挺没人情味的，不是吗？我是说，那些东西真((在乎))我们吗？##唉。比起国王给我们的那种"关心"，我宁愿要一颗冷漠的星。

English: Oh aye? My mam taught me it was bad luck to get too full of myself. Pride brings a curse!" she used to say."
Chinese: 哦是吗？我妈教我，人不能太自满。骄傲招祸！"她总这么说。"

English: I s'pose it's easier to chuck the priest in the temple than the one inside your head though.
Chinese: 不过话说来，把庙里的祭司赶走容易，把脑子里的那个赶走难。

English: Heh, wanna know a secret? Me too. Feels weird to be able to just ((say)) that with nobody listening. ##Mind, I'm no Wikkan. But folks like us have to hedge our bets.
Chinese: 嘿，想知道个秘密吗？我也是。能就这么((说出来))而没人在旁边听着，感觉很怪。##当然，我不是维坎。但像我们这样的人，得两头下注。

English: I was born in the Kardovan Republic, married in the Clockwork Kingdom, and now I'll raise my kids in the Apostatic Union. Makes you wonder where I'll be growing old.
Chinese: 我生在卡尔多瓦共和国，在发条王国成家，现在要在叛教联盟养孩子。都不知道自己会在哪变老。

English: Ha. Well, I s'pose there's wisdom in that.
Chinese: 哈。嗯，这话里有智慧。

English: One year. That's how long it's been since I saw my kids.##I feel like one of those [[Endless,]] all dead inside but still walking about.
Chinese: 一年。自我上次见孩子们，一年了。##我感觉自己像个[[无尽者]]，内心死了，还在四处走动。

English: Abstract forces. Neuron stars, winds of magic, and suchlike.
Chinese: 抽象的力量。神经元星、魔法之风，诸如此类。

English: Unionites like to credit good fortune to their own ingenuity.
Chinese: 联盟人喜欢把好运归功于自己的聪明才智。

English: Some still thank the gods, but only when they're alone.
Chinese: 有人仍会感谢诸神，但只在独处的时候。

English: Thank the Inquisition.
Chinese: 感谢宗教裁判所。

English: Don't know, don't care.
Chinese: 不知道，也不关心。

English: <<The man has the aura so someone who wishes to disappear.>>
Chinese: <<这人浑身透着一股想消失的气息。>>

English: <<He looks up, but does not respond. Something about his glare tells you that this is a dangerous person. A fleeing criminal? An inquisition spy? Or perhaps...>>##Leave me alone. It's better that way for everyone.
Chinese: <<他抬起头，却没有回应。他那道目光告诉你：此人危险。在逃的罪犯？宗教裁判所的探子？又或者……>>##别管我。这样对大家都好。

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗？

English: <<Introduce yourself>>
Chinese: <<自我介绍一下>>

English: What's your problem?
Chinese: 你有什么毛病？

English: <<This elegant-looking man appears lost in reverie, humming softly to himself. He has a youthful face despite his growing crow's feet, and his voice is as gentle as if he were murmuring to a sleeping babe.>>
Chinese: <<这位优雅的男士正沉浸在遐想中，轻声哼着曲子。尽管鱼尾纹渐生，他的脸仍显年轻，声音轻柔得像在对着熟睡的婴儿呢喃。>>

English: Oh! Hullo there. Where have you come from? You're certainly on the road less travelled. ##<<He calls out behind you.>> Sam! Would you be an angel and brew some more tea? We have a guest!
Chinese: 哦！你好呀。你从哪来的？你走的肯定是一条少有人走的路。##<<他朝你身后喊。>>萨姆！行行好再煮点茶好吗？来客人了！

English: Goodness gracious, where are my manners? I am [[Horace Metcalfe]] – lodger, child-minder, and general factotum hereabouts.##I also have a little sideline as a... weaver of dreams, I suppose, which has been surprisingly successful.
Chinese: 哎呀呀，瞧我这礼数。我是[[霍勒斯·梅特卡夫]]——本地的房客、保姆兼总管杂役。##我还有个小副业，算是……织梦人吧，居然还挺成功。

English: You're welcome to stay a while and rest your feet. I'm sure Sammol will be happy to fix you some refreshments.
Chinese: 欢迎你留下来歇歇脚。萨莫尔一定乐意给你弄点茶点。

English: <<He takes a dainty sip from his porcelain teacup.>> So, how else may I be of service?
Chinese: <<他从瓷茶杯里优雅地啜了一口。>>那么，还能为你效什么劳？

English: <<He takes a dainty sip from his porcelain teacup.>> ##So, to what do we owe this serendipitous visit?
Chinese: <<他从瓷茶杯里优雅地啜了一口。>>##那么，是什�么风把你吹来的？

English: Scarce little to tell, I fear. I've lived in the Clockwork Kingdom all my life – and jolly glad I am for it, too. My health keeps me from roaming, but Sammol has made me feel quite at home.
Chinese: 能讲的实在不多，恐怕。我在发条王国住了一辈子——而且乐在其中。身体不允许我四处跑，萨莫尔让我很有家的感觉。

English: As aforementioned, I also dabble with brewing [[bottled visions]]. I specialise in dreams of adventure upon the turbulent skies: aerial battles, swashbuckling duels, and other such derring-do. Judging by the letters I receive, they're quite popular.
Chinese: 如前所述，我也捣鼓[[瓶装幻象]]。我专做惊涛骇浪上的冒险梦：空战、剑斗，诸如此类的英勇事迹。从我收到的信来看，颇受欢迎。

English: Oh, how wonderful! It's always nice to know my work resonates with people. Would you like anything signed?
Chinese: 哦，太好了！知道自己的作品能引起共鸣，总是令人高兴。需要签名吗？

English: <<Metcalfe's face lights up with enthusiasm.>> Ah, the Dark Star Company! What a thrilling topic – I simply can't stop reading about them. The grizzled [[Jack Basalt]], the enigmatic [[Emberian]]... not forgetting the terrifying [[Vela Callose]] herself.
Chinese: <<梅特卡夫两眼放光。>>啊，黑星佣兵团！多带劲的话题——我简直读得停不下来。饱经风霜的[[杰克·巴索特]]、神秘莫测的[[余烬人]]……更别提那位可怕的[[薇拉·卡洛斯]]本人了。

English: Of course, [[Caxton Frost]] is the one best known here in the Kingdom. He was a famed antiquarian, and considered one of our brightest minds, so his defection was quite a scandal. Alas, he chose the wrong side in a mutiny, and was incinerated by one of his own contraptions.
Chinese: 当然，[[卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特]]是王国这边名气最响的。他是著名的古物学家，公认我们最聪明的头脑之一，所以他的叛逃轰动一时。唉，他在一场哗变中站错了队，被自己的一台机械烧死了。

English: <<He looks bashful.>>##Ah, well, you mustn't think I'm any kind of expert. You see, making bottled visions isn't like writing a book. You cannot control where the slumbering mind wanders. You can only influence it, by choosing what fodder it will chew on.
Chinese: <<他面露赧色。>>##啊，你可别把我当什么专家。要知道，做瓶装幻象可不像写书。你没法控制沉睡的心灵漫游到哪里。你只能施加影响——选择喂给它什么食料。

English: Since visions are such a vital industry, the King permits me to access literature from abroad.##News pamphlets. Ship schematics. ((Janus's Mercenary Weekly)). Even those silly Cadish Rakehill books. I devour every bit of reading material I can find.
Chinese: 既然幻象是支柱产业，国王特许我阅读国外文献。##新闻小报。舰船图纸。((雅努斯佣兵周刊))。甚至那些傻乎乎的卡迪什·雷克希尔小说。凡能找到的读物我都如饥似渴。

English: Although... ##<<It seems like he wants to say more, but then shakes his head.>>##Well, I'll stop there. An artist must keep ((something)) in his pocket, eh?
Chinese: 不过……##<<他似乎还想说什么，随即摇头。>>##好，我就说到这。艺术家总得((留一手))，嗯？

English: <<He looks uncomfortable.>>##Oh, you needn't pay that any mind. An artist must keep ((something)) in his pocket, eh?
Chinese: <<他神色不自在。>>##哦，您不必在意。艺术家总得((留一手))，嗯？

English: %% <<This seems to put him at ease, and he laughs a little.>> Ah, jolly well said. ##Well, I... suppose there's no harm in it. As long as it's only between us.
Chinese: %% <<这话似乎让他安了心，他轻笑了一下。>>啊，说得好。##嗯，我……觉得说说也无妨。只要只在你我之间。

English: && My dear, it's not as if I don't believe you. Really, I do. I'm just not comfortable going further on this topic.
Chinese: && 亲爱的，不是我信不过你。真的，我信。只是这个话题我不愿再深入。

English: <<He looks entranced.>> I say, have you ((really))? Well, in that case... perhaps we could...##Yes, why not? So long as you promise to spill every bean you have!
Chinese: <<他一脸着迷。>>真的吗？((您真见过))？那这样的话……也许我们可以……##对啊，有何不可？只要你保证一个字都不瞒！

English: <<He seems touched.>> Do they really? Well, I... yes. Candidly, there is some element of what one might call ((inspiration)).
Chinese: <<他似乎很感动。>>真的吗？嗯……是的。坦白说，确实有某种可以称之为((灵感))的成分。

English: The truth is, I did not choose these visions; I am ((plagued)) by them. Dreams of gleaming sails and burning citadels. The stench of gunsmoke, and the taste of blood. I hoped that bottling them might somehow pacify them, but still they come.
Chinese: 事实上，不是我选择了这些幻象；是它们((纠缠))着我。闪亮的船帆与燃烧的堡垒之梦。硝烟的恶臭，血的味道。我曾希望把它们装瓶就能安抚它们，可它们还是来。

English: Sometimes I dream of things I cannot possibly know. Of mushroom-covered ruins in the flickering light of a star-shell. Of watching cirrosquid frolic off the prow, or sailing through the glittering forest of a siren jelly's tentacles. Of kinship forged in battle, baptised in hellfire.
Chinese: 有时我会梦见我根本不可能知道的事。星光弹闪忽明忽灭下覆满蘑菇的废墟。看环鱿在船首旁嬉戏，或穿过海妖水母触手组成的闪烁森林。还有在战火中缔结、在地狱火中受洗的情谊。

English: And then there's the [[Ashen Woman]]. That's what I call her. She seems to be a recurring character. Of course, ((those)) bottles stay locked in my [[private collection]]. Somehow it doesn't feel safe to expose the public to her.
Chinese: 还有那位[[灰烬女人]]。我这么叫她。她似乎是个反复出现的角色。当然，((那些))瓶子都锁在我的[[私藏]]里。让公众接触她，总觉得不太安全。

English: Even now I see her. With hair like snow, and eyes like twin volcanoes. Bold, passionate, sardonic, yet pensive somehow.##Her left hand holds the [[seed of all our futures]], while her right hand holds the [[sword that ends the world]].
Chinese: 直到现在我都看得见她。雪一样的头发，双火山一样的眼睛。果敢，热烈，尖刻，却又不知为何带着沉思。##她左手握着[[我们全部未来的种子]]，右手握着[[终结世界的剑]]。

English: <<As Metcalfe continues his description, all remaining doubts leave your mind. Somehow, you know exactly who he's describing.>>
Chinese: <<梅特卡夫继续描述着，你心中所有疑虑一扫而空。不知为何，你确切地知道他描述的是谁。>>

English: <<Metcalfe's teacup pauses on the way to his mouth.>> ##I beg your pardon?
Chinese: <<梅特卡夫的茶杯在送到嘴边的路上停住了。>>##你说什么？

English: <<He lowers the teacup slowly back to its saucer.>> ...I am? I mean... I suppose I've seen her woodcut often enough. What of it?
Chinese: <<他把茶杯缓缓放回茶托。>>……是吗？我是说……我想，她的版画我见得够多了。怎么了？

English: <<He lowers the teacup slowly back to its saucer.>> ##... you do? At least that makes one of us. Might you care to enlighten me?
Chinese: <<他把茶杯缓缓放回茶托。>>##……你知道？至少这世上还有第二个人。可否赐教？

English: <<Metcalfe blinks several times.>>##Frost? What does he have to do with...?  ##By gum. You can't possibly think ((I'm)) this Frost character, can you?
Chinese: <<梅特卡夫连眨几次眼。>>##弗罗斯特？这跟他有什么……？##天哪。你该不会以为((我))就是那个弗罗斯特吧？

English: <<Metcalfe blushes furiously, and his manner makes it clear you've struck a nerve.>> ##I... well... I m-mean... by ((jingo)), is it your custom to pry into the anatomy of perfect strangers? Why the ((blazes)) would you ask?
Chinese: <<梅特卡夫满脸通红，他的样子分明显示你戳中了要害。>>##我……呃……我的意思是……看在((老天))的份上，盘问陌生人的身体构造是您的习惯吗？你((凭什么))问这个？

English: <<Metcalfe blinks several times.>>##...um. Goodness. Are you quite certain you're in the right house? I cannot fathom what would give you that notion.
Chinese: <<梅特卡夫连眨几次眼。>>##……呃。天哪。您确定没走错门吗？我真想不通您哪来的这种念头。

English: ...Jack Basalt knows who I am? But he couldn't possibly know about... ##I say, if this is some sort of prank, I'm afraid I find it in rather poor taste.
Chinese: ……杰克·巴索特知道我是谁？可他绝不可能知道……##我说，如果这是恶作剧，恐怕品位相当低劣。

English: Did you say [[Frost]]? By gum, you can't possibly think ((I'm)) [[Caxton Frost]], can you?##If this is some sort of prank, I'm afraid I find it in rather poor taste!
Chinese: 你说[[弗罗斯特]]？天哪，你该不会以为((我))就是[[卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特]]吧？##如果这是恶作剧，恐怕品位相当低劣！

English: I don't understand. Those are all ((my)) dreams. If this is some sort of prank, I'm afraid I find it in rather poor taste!
Chinese: 我不明白。那些都是((我))的梦。如果这是恶作剧，恐怕品位相当低劣！

English: Surely you're mistaken. How would we have ever met? If this is some sort of prank, I'm afraid I find it in rather poor taste!
Chinese: 你肯定弄错了。我们怎么可能见过？如果这是恶作剧，恐怕品位相当低劣！

English: Listen – I'm only an ordinary chap with an overactive imagination. I don't know anything about mercenaries, or... or ((adventurers))! My visions may be realistic, but they're pure fantasy. This is all just a silly misunderstanding.
Chinese: 听着——我只是个想象力过于丰富的普通人。佣兵的事我一概不知，还有……((冒险家))！我的幻象也许逼真，但纯属幻想。这一切只是个可笑的误会。

English: Well, thank you for the compliment! But don't you see that what you're proposing is impossible? I can't sail, or swordfight, or any of that. The closest I've come to an adventure was getting lost in a bookshop in Byonne. Skyships make me nauseous. I'm no good with machines. I'm ((allergic)) to rum!
Chinese: 多谢夸奖！可你不明白吗，你说的那些根本不可能？我不会航海，不会剑术，都不会。我最接近冒险的一次，是在拜昂的书店里迷了路。坐飞艇我晕。机器我一窍不通。我还((过敏))朗姆酒！

English: But that's impossible. I can't sail, or swordfight, or any of that. The closest thing I've ever had to an adventure is getting lost in a bookshop in Byonne. Skyships make me nauseous. I'm no good with machines. I'm ((allergic)) to rum!
Chinese: 可那不可能。我不会航海，不会剑术，都不会。我最接近冒险的一次，是在拜昂的书店里迷了路。坐飞艇我晕。机器我一窍不通。我还((过敏))朗姆酒！

English: Besides, how could I have gone gallivanting about in old ruins in my condition of health? I can barely walk a hundred yards!
Chinese: 再说了，就我这身板，怎么可能去古遗迹里瞎跑？我连一百码都走不动！

English: I ((swear)), upon my good name and the King's, that these visions come from between my own two ears! How I wish it were otherwise, some nights...
Chinese: 我((发誓))，以我的名誉和国王的名义，这些幻象出自我自己这两只耳朵之间！真希望不是这样，有些夜里……

English: But I would never commit such a fraud against my customers. I ((abhor)) those awful dream factories!##Stay here and watch me bottle them, if you wish. You can verify the entire production process.
Chinese: 可我绝不会对顾客犯下这种欺诈。我((深恶痛绝))那些可怕的造梦工厂！##愿意的话就留下来看我装瓶。整个生产过程你都可以亲眼验证。

English: Now, please. Can't you see I'm telling the truth? What more must I do to convince you? ##<<A faint rattling of porcelain emanates from his cup and saucer. His hands are shaking.>>
Chinese: 好了，求你。你看不出我说的是实话吗？还要我怎么做你才信？##<<他的杯子和茶托传来轻微的磕碰声。他的手在抖。>>

English: But ((how)), for pity's sake?! How can I admit something that isn't true? ((Dash)) it all to ((blazes)) – ##<<He throws up both hands in desperation.>> – I am ((not)) Caxton Frost!
Chinese: 可怎么((承认))，((我的))天?!我怎么可能承认一件不是事实的事？全都((见鬼))去吧——##<<他绝望地举起双手。>>——我((不是))卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特！

English: But ((how)), for pity's sake?! How can I admit something that isn't true? ((Dash)) it all to ((blazes)) – ##<<He throws up both hands in desperation.>> – I am ((not)) a Dark Star!
Chinese: 可怎么((承认))，((我的))天?!我怎么可能承认一件不是事实的事？全都((见鬼))去吧——##<<他绝望地举起双手。>>——我((不是))什么黑星！

English: <<There is a moment of silence, only broken by the steady dripping of the tea he just splashed across the wall.>>
Chinese: <<一瞬的沉默，只被他刚泼到墙上的茶水滴答声打破。>>

English: Yes. Yes, I ((flipping)) well do, because that's who I ((am)).
Chinese: 是。是的，我他妈((当然))知道，因为那就是((我))。

English: What? Don't be absurd. The King can't do that. I know there's rumours, but that's all just Union disinformation.
Chinese: 什么？别荒唐了。国王做不到那种事。传言是有的，但那不过是联盟的假消息。

English: I'm glad you're at least willing to admit the possibility. I assure you, Horace Metcalfe is exactly what he seems.
Chinese: 很高兴你至少愿意承认这种可能性。我向你保证，霍勒斯·梅特卡夫表里如一。

English: <<Clearly this conversation has hit a wall. You'll need to find some other way of jogging Metcalfe's memory.>> ##<<That private vision stash he mentioned must be the key. But where in the house is he keeping it?>>
Chinese: <<显然这场谈话陷入了僵局。你得想别的办法唤醒梅特卡夫的记忆。>>##<<他提到的那个幻象私藏一定是关键。可他把它藏在屋里哪了呢？>>

English: Ugh, what a jolly horrid day. This is going to affect my dreams for ((weeks)). A new, dark direction for Horace Metcalfe," that's what they'll say..."
Chinese: 呃，多么糟糕的一天。这要影响我((好几周))的梦了。霍勒斯·梅特卡夫的新黑暗方向"，他们准会这么说……"

English: <<He sighs deeply.>> You really are very strange, do you know that?
Chinese: <<他深深叹了口气。>>你真的很怪，你知道吗？

English: Confound it all! Begone from here, you... you... ((fudge-headed)) fiend! Brute! Blaggard! Blistering blue bell-bottomed ((bounder))!
Chinese: 该死！从这里滚出去，你这个……你这个((浆糊脑袋))的恶鬼！蛮夫！恶棍！穿蓝喇叭裤的无耻((流氓))！

English: Please, no more! I've already told you, I am ((not)) a Dark Star mercenary. ##Cripes, I've dealt with obsessed customers before, but this takes the biscuit...
Chinese: 求你了，别再来了！我说过了，我((不是))什么黑星佣兵。##天哪，痴狂粉丝我见得多了，可你这也太离谱了……

English: <<Clearly this conversation has hit a wall. You'll need to find some other way of jogging Metcalfe's memory.>> ##<<That private vision stash he mentioned must be the key. But where in the house is he keeping it?>>
Chinese: <<显然这场谈话陷入了僵局。你得想别的办法唤醒梅特卡夫的记忆。>>##<<他提到的那个幻象私藏一定是关键。可他把它藏在屋里哪了呢？>>

English: Please, no more! I've already told you, I am ((not)) a Dark Star mercenary. ##Cripes, I've dealt with obsessed customers before, but this takes the biscuit...
Chinese: 求你了，别再来了！我说过了，我((不是))什么黑星佣兵。##天哪，痴狂粉丝我见得多了，可你这也太离谱了……

English: Why... yes, I do. It's part of that old [[music box]] over there. I'm no good with devices, so I've never been able to figure out what was wrong. But how did you find it? The box hasn't played in ((years))...
Chinese: 为……是啊，知道。是那边那台旧[[音乐盒]]上的。我不擅长摆弄机器，所以一直没搞清哪里坏了。可你是怎么找到的？那盒子((好多年))没响过了……

English: <<Perhaps you should return once you've gathered more information...>>
Chinese: <<也许你该收集更多信息后再回来……>>

English: <<You sense something in this man; a dark past which even he has forgotten.>>##<<Perhaps you should return once you've gathered more information...>>
Chinese: <<你在这人身上察觉到什么；一段连他自己都已遗忘的黑暗过去。>>##<<也许你该收集更多信息后再回来……>>

English: Very kind. I didn't catch your name, Mr...?
Chinese: 您太客气了。还没请教您的名字，先生……？

English: Sorry, who are you exactly?
Chinese: 抱歉，您到底是哪位？

English: Tell me a little about yourself.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲你自己吧。

English: I'm looking for a man called Caxton Frost.
Chinese: 我在找一个叫卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特的人。

English: I'm looking for a [[Dark Star]] mercenary.
Chinese: 我在找一个[[黑星]]佣兵。

English: Vidal the vision trader sent me. I'm a ((huge)) admirer of yours.
Chinese: 幻象商人维达尔介绍我来的。我是您的((铁杆))书迷。

English: If I may ask, where do you get your ideas?
Chinese: 恕我冒昧，您的灵感都是从哪来的？

English: Is it true all that swashbuckling stuff is drawn from real life?
Chinese: 书里那些刀光剑影都是取材真人真事，是真的吗？

English: I'd best hit the road. Farewell.
Chinese: 我该上路了。再会。

English: When we last spoke, wasn't there something more you wanted to tell me?
Chinese: 上次我们聊的时候，是不是还有话没说完？

English: How do you know so much about all this?
Chinese: 这一切你怎么知道得这么清楚？

English: You're unusually informed about the Dark Stars.
Chinese: 你对黑星的事未免太门儿清了。

English: @@ Mr Metcalfe, I swear by the King that I won't tell a soul.
Chinese: @@ 梅特卡夫先生，我对国王起誓，绝不告诉任何人。

English: I've actually met [[Jack Basalt]] myself. Why don't we exchange notes?
Chinese: 我其实亲眼见过[[杰克·巴索特]]。咱们不妨互通有无？

English: But your visions are ((so)) realistic. Even [[Vidal]] says so. Surely it's not all just from books?
Chinese: 可您的幻象((就是))逼真啊。连[[维达尔]]都这么说。总不至于全是照着书写的吧？

English: Of course, of course. Forget I asked.
Chinese: 当然当然，就当我没问。

English: Vela.
Chinese: 薇拉。

English: That's Vela. You're describing Vela Callose.
Chinese: 是薇拉。你描述的是薇拉·卡洛斯。

English: I think I know what's going on here.
Chinese: 我想我知道这是怎么回事了。

English: I think you know, Mr Metcalfe. Or should I say... ((Caxton Frost))?
Chinese: 你心里清楚，梅特卡夫先生。或者我该叫你……((卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特))？

English: Mr Metcalfe, do you have a moth tattoo on your left buttock?
Chinese: 梅特卡夫先生，您左边屁股上是不是有个飞蛾刺青？

English: You're a former Dark Star mercenary, aren't you?
Chinese: 你是前黑星佣兵，对吧？

English: Come off it, Frost. Jack Basalt already told me about your tattoo.
Chinese: 别装了，弗罗斯特。杰克·巴索特早把你的刺青告诉我了。

English: You had me fooled at first, but your dreams gave you away.
Chinese: 起初你把我糊弄住了，可你的梦出卖了你。

English: Only someone who's met Vela could describe her so vividly.
Chinese: 只有亲眼见过薇拉的人，才能把她描述得这么活灵活现。

English: Drop the act. We both know you're not just some bumbling naif.
Chinese: 别演戏了。我们俩都清楚，你不只是个笨手笨脚的乡巴佬。

English: What if it's not just fantasy? What if those visions really happened?
Chinese: 如果那不只是幻想呢？如果那些幻象是真事呢？

English: Those visions had to come from a Dark Star. Are they not yours?
Chinese: 那些幻象必定出自黑星之手。难道不是你的？

English: If you don't talk, the world could be destroyed.
Chinese: 你不开口，世界可能会毁灭。

English: If you don't talk, I'll be drawn and quartered.
Chinese: 你不开口，我就会被五马分尸。

English: If you won't talk, I'll ((make)) you talk.
Chinese: 你不肯说，我就((让))你说。

English: Now I see. The Clockwork King has erased your memory.
Chinese: 我明白了。是发条王抹掉了你的记忆。

English: Shit. Maybe I really am mistaken.
Chinese: 该死。也许我真搞错了。

English: Horace, listen to me. Your whole identity is a fiction. You were a Dark Star, but someone has erased your memory. Now I need your help to save the world.
Chinese: 霍勒斯，听我说。你的整个身份都是虚构的。你曾是黑星，但有人抹掉了你的记忆。现在我需要你帮忙拯救世界。

English: Frost, if you can hear me in there, you MUST break free!
Chinese: 弗罗斯特，你要是在里面听得见，就必须挣脱出来！

English: I'll just leave you alone.
Chinese: 我就不打扰了。

English: I found this brass cylinder in a ruin. Do you recognise it?
Chinese: 我在遗迹里找到了这个黄铜圆筒。你认得吗？

English: [Leave him alone.]
Chinese: [别打扰他。]

English: Some of your facts are off.
Chinese: 你有几处细节记岔了。

English: ...you really believe you're Horace Metcalfe, don't you?
Chinese: ……你真相信自己就是霍勒斯·梅特卡夫，是吧？

English: <<Frost glowers at you.>>##As I said, you will find me at the [[Blinding Light]] once I've put my affairs in order. ##What a perfect mess! I hope you're pleased with yourself.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特恶狠狠瞪着你。>>##我说过了，等我料理完手头的事，[[炫光要塞]]见。##多完美的一个烂摊子！希望你对自己很满意。

English: <<Metcalfe gazes into nothingness, his eyes half closed. His breathing is slow and gentle, as if he is sleeping.>>
Chinese: <<梅特卡夫凝视虚空，双眼半阖。他的呼吸缓慢轻柔，仿佛睡着了一般。>>

English: <<He does not respond.>>
Chinese: <<他没有回应。>>

English: <<Quick as a flash, he jerks awake and grabs your wrist with surprising strength.>>
Chinese: <<说时迟那时快，他猛然惊醒，用大得惊人的力气抓住你的手腕。>>

English: <<Frantic eyes dart around the room before coming to rest on you. His breathing is sharp and shallow, like he's just survived a fight.>> ##You... you... ((blooming)) idiot! You've ruined my ((cover))!
Chinese: <<惊惶的双眼在屋里乱转，最后落在你身上。他的呼吸急促而浅，像刚从一场恶斗里活下来。>>##你……你……((天杀的))白痴！你毁了我的((掩护))！

English: ((I)) did this, you nincompoop. ((I)) erased my memories. It's the only thing that's kept me hidden from the Clockwork King for all these years. The only thing protecting Sammol.
Chinese: 是((我))干的，你这个笨蛋。((我))抹掉了我自己的记忆。这些年来，能躲开发条王的耳目，靠的就是这个。保护萨莫尔的，也是这个。

English: And now you've gone and ruined it all, you... you... ((blinking artichoke))! ##Hmm. That's interesting. It seems I still can't swear.
Chinese: 现在可好，被你全毁了，你这个……你这个((该死的洋蓟头))！##嗯。有意思。看来我还是骂不出脏字。

English: What, as if it's hard? Perhaps you're aware that the King alters people's minds. With an old book on memory magic purloined from the Duchess, I had little trouble back-engineering the technology.
Chinese: 什么，这很难吗？你或许知道，国王有改造人心智的能力。我从女公爵那里顺来一本讲记忆魔法的旧书，逆向破解出这套技术并不费事。

English: I called in a favour inside the Machinists' Guild to create some false records, and ((voila)): Horace Metcalfe was born. Except now you've killed him, you prize ((flipping)) dimwit.
Chinese: 我托公会里的关系伪造了几份档案，然后((当当))：霍勒斯·梅特卡夫诞生了。现在你把他弄死了，你这个宝贝((该死的))蠢货。

English: <<He squints at you.>> You really don't get it, do you? I ((liked)) being Horace. Nobody ever shot at Horace. Nobody tried to throw him off a sky ship. Nobody ever put a ((flipping)) typhos under his bed for beating them at cards!
Chinese: <<他眯眼看你。>>你还是没明白，是吧？我((喜欢))当霍勒斯。没人朝霍勒斯开枪。没人想把霍勒斯扔下飞艇。没人因为打牌输了就往霍勒斯床底下塞((该死的))提福斯炸弹！

English: Do you know how nice it is, after years of being feared, to simply be ((liked))?
Chinese: 被畏惧了这么多年之后，你知道单纯被人((喜欢))有多舒服吗？

English: In my Dark Star days I was known for having a rather dirty mouth. All just compensating, of course. Still, making Horace more prissy seemed a useful addition to my guise.
Chinese: 我在黑星那会儿，一张嘴是出了名的脏。当然，那全是掩饰罢了。不过，把霍勒斯塑造得拘谨点，倒是给我这张画皮添了点用处。

English: Help? You blunder in here, you set fire to my life, and you want my ((help))? You can go... go... go ((hang)) yourself! I'll have my ((bally)) hands full escaping the Kingdom and, oh yes, ((never seeing anyone I love ever again)).
Chinese: 帮忙？你闯进来，烧了我的生活，然后想要我((帮忙))？你可以去……去……去((上吊))吧！我光是逃离这个王国就够我((喝))一壶的了，哦对了，((再也见不到我所爱的任何人))。

English: <<Frost's brows rumple as he listens to your explanation.>> ##...so it's begun. Vela's great work. Has she already gone to the Underlands?
Chinese: <<听你解释时，弗罗斯特的眉头拧成一团。>>##……所以说，开始了。薇拉的大业。她已经动身去地下之地了吗？

English: <<His eyes briefly widen.>> The Cradle? You're sure of that? I thought it only a myth...
Chinese: <<他双眼骤然睁大。>>摇篮？你确定？我一直以为那只是个传说……

English: <<He shakes his head.>>##Not my problem. If you've found me, it's only a matter of time until the King finds me too. I must put my affairs in order and depart immediately.
Chinese: <<他摇头。>>##不关我的事。你能找到我，国王找到我也只是时间问题。我必须立刻料理善后，马上动身。

English: <<He snarls.>>##Because I never ((was)) a Dark Star! ##I was a ((spy)).
Chinese: <<他低吼。>>##因为我从来就((不是))什么黑星！##我是个((间谍))。

English: As a young man, it was my misfortune to become a hero of the Clockwork Kingdom.##My aptitude with ancient Emberian machines was prized, and I was easily dazzled by conditional acclaim.
Chinese: 年轻时，我不幸成了发条王国的英雄。##我摆弄古余烬机械的天赋颇受器重，而我对有条件的喝彩，向来没什么抵抗力。

English: You must understand, the future used to be so bright here. People lived well, and we truly seemed on the brink of a better world. I wanted to believe that more than anyone.##So, when the King gave me a chance to ((truly)) serve my country, I accepted.
Chinese: 你要明白，这里的未来曾经是那么光明。人们安居乐业，我们真的仿佛站在一个更美好世界的门槛上。我曾比任何人都愿意相信这一点。##所以，当国王给我一个((真正))报效国家的机会时，我接受了。

English: I posed as a disgruntled emigre, offering my services to Vela Callose. Together, we spent the next eight years unlocking the secrets of the Emberians – all of which I secretly relayed to my sovereign.
Chinese: 我假扮成心怀不满的流亡者，向薇拉·卡洛斯投诚。此后八年，我们一起破译余烬人的秘密——而所有这些，我都偷偷呈报给我的君主。

English: Having been somewhat of a thespian in my schooldays, I confess I found the subterfuge exciting. However, one does not wear a mask for so long without it changing one's face.
Chinese: 学生时代我毕竟演过几出戏，坦白说，我觉得这种潜伏挺刺激。不过，面具戴得久了，总会改变你的脸。

English: As news from the Kingdom grew darker, I came to trust Vela over the King.##She promised that ((we)) could be the ones to build [[Elysium]], using powers from before the World Rend. And until that ((blooming)) [[mutiny]], I believed her.
Chinese: 随着王国传来的消息越来越黑暗，我渐渐信薇拉多过信国王。##她许诺说，((我们))可以用世界撕裂之前的力量，亲手建造[[极乐净土]]。直到那场((该死的))[[哗变]]之前，我都信着她。

English: Discontent had long been brewing over our frayed relations with the Union. And anyone could see that Vela was growing more reckless and paranoid by the week. Her plan to drag us all to the [[Underlands]] was merely the final straw.
Chinese: 我们与联盟日渐恶化的关系早就埋下了不满。而谁都看得出，薇拉一周比一周更鲁莽、更多疑。她要把我们全体拖去[[地下之地]]的计划，不过是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。

English: The mutiny was led by Vela's childhood friend. I think she felt it as rejection not only of her plans but of herself – of ((everything)) they'd shared. Pray that on the day you feel like that, you do not have command of an Eschaton-class kilocaliber howitzer.
Chinese: 哗变是薇拉的青梅竹马带的头。我想，在她看来那不仅是对她计划的否定，更是对她本人的否定——对他们((共享))的一切的否定。但愿有朝一日你体会这种心情时，手里没有一门口径千倍的末世级重榴炮。

English: I fought for Vela that day, but my faith was broken. I'd lived through enough purges and coups d'etat in the King's early years to know a tyrant when I saw one. Still, my mission stood – or so I thought. As it turned out, my next orders would be my last.
Chinese: 那一天我为薇拉而战，但我的信念已经破碎。国王早年那些清洗和政变，我亲历得够多，一眼就能认出暴君。不过，我的任务还在——至少我这么以为。结果证明，我接到的下一道命令，就是最后一道。

English: The King wanted me to steal Vela's treasure map. To betray the only people I'd ever felt truly at home with, and deliver untold power to an increasingly callous despot. Yet what was my alternative? Betray my homeland, and hand that power instead to an increasingly cruel and unstable outlaw?
Chinese: 国王要我去偷薇拉的藏宝图。要我背叛此生唯一让我有归属感的人，把无穷的权力交给一个日益冷酷的暴君。可我还能怎么办？背叛我的祖国，把那份权力交给一个日益残忍、癫狂的不法之徒？

English: It was an impossible choice, so I did what any coward would do... ##<<He shrugs.>> I ran away.
Chinese: 这是个无解的抉择，所以我做了所有懦夫都会做的事……##<<他耸耸肩。>>我逃了。

English: My only mistake was to hide my old memories instead of destroying them. A sentimental lapse I shan't repeat.
Chinese: 我唯一的错误，是藏起了旧日的记忆，而没有彻底销毁。一时心软，下不为例。

English: Because they were my home. I grew up in Progress, amidst the machinery that was meant to liberate us all. As to how many of my family escaped, I can only speculate. A fitting grave for a failed patriot, wouldn't you say?
Chinese: 因为那里是我的家。我在进步城长大，长在那些本该解放我们所有人的机器中间。我的家人逃出来几个，我只能猜测。对一个失败的爱国者来说，倒也算个体面的坟墓，你说呢？

English: Something more valuable than gold, or so she said. An ancient artefact with the power to turn the world upside down. I was sceptical, but evidently the King was willing to burn my entire mission just to get hold of it.
Chinese: 她说，是比黄金贵重得多的东西。一件有翻天之力量的上古造物。我当时不信，但显然，国王为了得到它，宁可烧掉我的整个使命。

English: Regardless, nothing has changed. I still lack the courage either to help Vela or to stop her. ##You have destroyed my life for no good purpose, and now I shall bid you adieu.
Chinese: 无论如何，一切都没有改变。帮薇拉，还是拦薇拉，我依然没有那个勇气。##你平白毁了我的一生，就此别过。

English: <<His eyes narrow.>>##What could you possibly say that would change my mind?
Chinese: <<他眯起眼。>>##你说什么才能让我回心转意？

English: <<His eyes narrow.>>##I ((beg)) your pardon? How dare you –
Chinese: <<他眯起眼。>>##你((说))什么？你怎么敢——

English: Of course I do! My memories from Horace are cloudy, but he wasn't ((blinking)) stupid.
Chinese: 我当然知道！关于霍勒斯的记忆虽然模糊，但他((绝对))不蠢。

English: Of course I'm not! My memories from Horace are cloudy, but he wasn't ((blinking)) stupid.
Chinese: 我当然不是！关于霍勒斯的记忆虽然模糊，但他((绝对))不蠢。

English: Well, I... ##<<He blinks.>> Wait, what?
Chinese: 呃，我……##<<他眨眨眼。>>等等，什么？

English: I say, I hardly think that's –
Chinese: 我说，我可不觉得——

English: ((Confound)) you, don't you think I ((flipping)) know? That's ((why)) I wanted to be Horace!
Chinese: ((去你))的，你以为我((他妈))不知道吗？我((就是))为了这个才想当霍勒斯的！

English: Is that so ((flipping)) evil? What the ((fudge)) else are they meant to do? What was ((I)) meant to do?
Chinese: 那((有多))邪恶？他们((又能))怎么办？我((当时))又能怎么办？

English: <<There is a long silence as you stare at each other.>>
Chinese: <<长久的沉默，你们对视着。>>

English: ...would you perhaps like a moment to get your breath back?
Chinese: ……要不要先缓口气？

English: <<Frost lets out a long, deep sigh.>> ##You're right, of course. I ((have)) been hiding. Hiding from the fear that my better world will never come to pass.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特长长地、深深地叹了口气。>>##你说得对。我((一直))在躲。躲那个恐惧——怕我心中的美好世界永远不会到来。

English: No matter who's in charge, it always goes wrong; and yet I cannot bring myself to truly give up hope. At least for Horace, things were simple.
Chinese: 无论谁当权，到头来都会搞砸；可我又没法真心放弃希望。至少跟着霍勒斯，一切还简单些。

English: Who is to say that I could do any better? I, who devoted my body and soul to leaders who could not love me back? Who cocooned myself in artificial childhood rather than face my duties as a man?
Chinese: 谁能说我能做得更好？我，把身心都献给那些不会回报我以爱的人？我，用人工的童年把自己裹起来，不敢承担成人的责任？

English: And yet... there is truth in what you say. The door is already open, and cannot be closed. Sooner or later, ((someone)) will claim the power Vela seeks. If not her, then the King – or worse. Better that I play some role than leave the stage to them.
Chinese: 可是……你说得也有道理。门已经开了，关不上了。迟早会有((某个人))攥住薇拉追寻的那种力量。不是她，就是国王——或者更糟。与其把舞台让给他们，我还不如扮演点什么角色。

English: So where would ((you)) drag us? What are ((you)) fighting for? The Inquisition? The status quo? You lament the price of others' goals, but how many people have you hurt to get here? And how many more will it take to stop Vela?
Chinese: 那么((你))要把我们拖向哪里？((你))又是为了什么而战？为了宗教裁判所？为了维持现状？你哀叹别人目标的代价，可你自己走到今天，又伤害了多少人？要拦住薇拉，还得再死多少？

English: And yet... there is truth in what you say. For years I've been pretending that I can't smell the smoke, and all I accomplished was to let the blaze grow out of control. Better that I stop the show than let the stage burn down.
Chinese: 可是……你说得也有道理。这些年我一直假装闻不到烟味，结果只是任由火势失控。与其看着舞台烧塌，不如我来谢幕。

English: Perhaps... there is truth in what you say. It was always so easy to defer to other people's dreams. To trust the impresario, and play the role I was given. Now the stage is burning and half the audience are dead.
Chinese: 也许……你说得也有道理。顺从别人的梦，总是那么容易。信任班主，演好分给我的角色。如今舞台烧起来了，一半观众已经死了。

English: All I wanted was a quiet life with Sam. Well, I don't need to know all the answers to know that's still worth fighting for. I can at least make sure Vela's treasure doesn't blow up the world, and figure out the rest as I go.
Chinese: 我想要的不过是跟萨姆过安稳日子。我不必懂得所有道理也知道，这仍值得为之而战。至少我能确保薇拉的宝藏不会炸掉这个世界，剩下的边走边看。

English: However, that is not enough. I want a full Inquisition pardon. I want Union citizenship for me, Sammol, and his family. I want 5,000 coins in silver bullion, and another 5,000 in fully assignable, non-revocable promissory notes from the Usurers' Guild of Riova.
Chinese: 不过，这还不够。我要一纸完整的宗教裁判所赦令。我要我和萨莫尔，连同他全家，拿到联盟国籍。我要五千枚银锭硬币，再加五千枚里奥瓦高利贷公会出具的、可全额转让、不可撤销的本票。

English: Good. Given the stakes, and my skills, I think it's rather a bargain.
Chinese: 好。考虑到其中的风险，还有我的本事，我觉得这价钱相当公道。

English: So you're only a pawn? Then tell your masters that if ((they)) don't promise it, they will wake up on the morning of their final assault to find me gone and all their machines dead.
Chinese: 这么说你只是个棋子？那就告诉你的主子：((他们))要是不答应，总攻那天早上醒来就会发现，人没了，机器全趴窝了。

English: Vela always planned to hole up at the [[Blinding Light]] if things went pear-shaped. Since she is now in the wind, I would guess you have already captured the fortress. I'll make my way there.
Chinese: 薇拉早就计划好了，一旦局面失控就退守[[炫光要塞]]。她如今下落不明，我猜你们已经拿下了那座要塞。我会自行前往。

English: But first...##<<Frost closes his eyes, taking a deep breath.>> ##First I must say goodbye to Sam. I'd... rather hoped we might get married. Perhaps even petition to adopt...
Chinese: 不过在此之前……##<<弗罗斯特闭上眼，深吸一口气。>>##我得先跟萨姆道别。我……本来还盼着我们能结婚呢。说不定还能申请收养……

English: Well, I suppose it'll have to wait.
Chinese: 唉，看来只能以后再说了。

English: <<Frost glares at you.>>##You think I ((want)) to remember any of that mess?
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特瞪着你。>>##你以为我((想))记得那团烂账吗？

English: Mr Metcalfe? Are you quite all right?
Chinese: 梅特卡夫先生？您还好吗？

English: [Wave your hand in front of his face.]
Chinese: [在他脸前挥手。]

English: [Poke him.]
Chinese: [戳戳他。]

English: Caxton Frost, I presume.
Chinese: 我想，这位就是卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特吧。

English: What do you mean, 'your cover'?
Chinese: 什么叫"你的掩护"？

English: You mean I saved you from the King's brainwashing.
Chinese: 你这是说，我把你从国王的洗脑里救出来了。

English: How did you erase your own memories?
Chinese: 你是怎么抹掉自己记忆的？

English: Aren't you happy to be your true self again?
Chinese: 变回真正的自己，你不高兴吗？

English: You seriously brainwashed yourself to not swear?
Chinese: 你为了不说脏话专门给自己洗脑？

English: Listen, never mind all that. I need your help.
Chinese: 行了，这些先放着。我需要你帮忙。

English: Vela Callose is trying to destroy the world.
Chinese: 薇拉·卡洛斯要毁灭世界。

English: Vela Callose is trying to save the world.
Chinese: 薇拉·卡洛斯想拯救世界。

English: If I don't find Vela Callose, the Inquisition will kill me.
Chinese: 我找不到薇拉·卡洛斯，宗教裁判所就会杀了我。

English: Yes, but we can't get to her without you.
Chinese: 对，但没有你我们够不着她。

English: Yes, to something called the Cradle.
Chinese: 对，去找一个叫"摇篮"的东西。

English: So you ((are)) interested?
Chinese: 这么说你((还是))感兴趣？

English: You followed Vela for years. How can you just walk away?
Chinese: 你追随薇拉多年，怎么能一走了之？

English: You helped Vela build her army. How is she not your problem?
Chinese: 你帮薇拉建起了她的军队。怎么现在不关你的事了？

English: What caused the mutiny?
Chinese: 哗变是怎么引起的？

English: How did Vela respond?
Chinese: 薇拉什么反应？

English: So what did you do, in the end?
Chinese: 那你最后是怎么做的？

English: Why did you choose those ruins in particular?
Chinese: 你为什么专挑那处遗迹？

English: What did Vela's treasure map point to?
Chinese: 薇拉的藏宝图指向什么？

English: We've no time for this. What's done is done.
Chinese: 没工夫说这些了。过去的就过去了。

English: Please, wait a second. Just hear me out.
Chinese: 求你了，等一秒。听我把话说完。

English: Will you shut your mouth for one fucking second?'
Chinese: 你他妈能不能闭嘴一秒？'

English: Do you actually know what's been happening in your beloved Kingdom?
Chinese: 你真知道你深爱的王国正在发生什么吗？

English: Are you COMPLETELY ignorant about anything outside your cosy little life?
Chinese: 你对小日子之外的一切都一无所知，是不是？

English: So you know the King's been vanishing people and erasing all memory of them?
Chinese: 那你知道国王在抹除人口、连他们的记忆都一并清空吗？

English: So you know everyone's memories keep vanishing and nobody knows why?
Chinese: 那你知道所有人的记忆都在不断消失，没人知道为什么吗？

English: So you know the King is totally, utterly, and irredeemably cuckoo?
Chinese: 那你知道国王已经彻底地、无可救药地疯掉了吗？

English: So you know summer's been abolished and nobody can get anything to eat?
Chinese: 那你知道夏天已经被废除了，人人都在挨饿吗？

English: No, of course not! Because you've seen sitting here sucking your thumb while cooking up fantasies to distract everyone from their kingdom's death spiral!
Chinese: 不，你当然不知道！因为你一直坐在这里嘬手指头，编着幻想故事，好让所有人不去看这个王国正螺旋坠向死亡！

English: I'm not finished! So what if I ruined your little game of pretend? We can't all just choose to deny reality! You're one of the only people in the world who can stand up to Vela, and hiding from it won't make it go away!
Chinese: 我还没说完！毁了你那场过家家又怎样？不是谁都能选择无视现实的！你是世上仅有的几个能跟薇拉抗衡的人，躲是躲不过去的！

English: You've been living in a dream, Frost. The real world is ((fucked)).
Chinese: 你一直活在梦里，弗罗斯特。真实的世界((已经))烂透了。

English: The world needs you to be Frost now. Please.
Chinese: 这个世界现在需要你当弗罗斯特。求你了。

English: I see. You'd bury yourself in small comforts while the world is rent anew.
Chinese: 我明白了。世界被重新撕开的时候，你要躲进你的小确幸里。

English: You've been spinning yarns to distract people while their neighbours die.
Chinese: 邻居们一个个死去，你却在这里编故事给大家解闷。

English: Aye, actually I would.
Chinese: 嗯，说实话，我愿意。

English: Shut up.
Chinese: 闭嘴。

English: Forget Vela, and forget the King. With what's down there, you could build that world yourself.
Chinese: 忘了薇拉，也忘了国王。有了埋在下面的那东西，你亲手就能建起那个世界。

English: You've seen where these grand ideas always end. Let's stop Vela from dragging everyone down with her.
Chinese: 那些宏大理想的下场你都见过了。别让薇拉把所有人一起拖下水。

English: You can't build that world by magic or force. You do it by helping the people you love.
Chinese: 那个世界靠魔法和强权建不起来。要建它，就去帮助你爱的人。

English: Done.
Chinese: 成交。

English: Er, I'll do what I can.
Chinese: 呃，我尽力。

English: Hiding from your past won't make it go away!
Chinese: 躲着你的过去，它不会自己消失！

English: Drat. Blast. Sugar. Blinking, blooming, flipping, f-f-f-f-((fudge)).
Chinese: 见鬼。该死。天呐。明明、偏偏、通通，去去去去……((去他的))。

English: Alas, I fear the muse of filth has forsaken me for good...
Chinese: 唉，恐怕脏话缪斯女神已经永远离我而去了……

English: Cuh.... cuh... ((cummerbund)). Ugh, this is just undignified.
Chinese: 初……初……((束腰带))。呸，太不成体统了。

English: Oh, go and gargle your own urine.
Chinese: 哦，滚去用自己的尿漱口吧。

English: Do you have some purpose for bothering me? As I said, restoring this mountain of rust to its proper glory is keeping me rather busy.
Chinese: 你打扰我是有什么事吗？我说过，把这座锈山修复到它应有的辉煌，已经够我忙的了。

English: But enough of that. Are you bothering me for a purpose? Or do you truly value your time so cheaply as to spend it on ((blooming)) chit-chat?
Chinese: 闲话少说。你打扰我到底有事没事？还是说你的时间真这么不值钱，舍得浪费在((无聊))的闲扯上？

English: <<Frost scowls.>> I wouldn't go that far. Will that be all?
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特皱眉。>>倒也不至于。还有别的事吗？

English: Good. Will that be all?
Chinese: 很好。还有别的事吗？

English: Will that be all?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗？

English: Oh, like a louse to an armpit. Who the ((fluff)) do you imagine restored this fortress in the first place?
Chinese: 哦，像虱子住进腋窝一样自在。你以为这要塞当初是谁((他妈))修好的？

English: Given my abrupt departure from the Dark Stars, I suppose it's nice to be finishing the job. If only these ((dashed)) Union cretins would stop trying to 'assist' me.
Chinese: 想当初我仓促脱离黑星，如今能把这活干完，倒也算圆满。只要这群((讨厌的))联盟蠢货肯别来'帮'我忙就更好了。

English: As it happens, my father helped build these monsters back in the God War. The wooden parts are Lundelese, but the guns, plumbing, and nearly everything metal was made in Kardova. He used to put me to sleep by reciting components and assembly procedures.
Chinese: 巧了，神之战那会儿，我父亲就参与建造过这些怪物。木质部件产自伦德尔，但火炮、管路，几乎一切金属构件都出自卡尔多瓦。他从前给我念部件清单和装配流程催眠。

English: Touche.
Chinese: 说得对。

English: Correct, although back then it was called the Kardovan Republic. Somewhere in the guts of this thing there'll be a nameplate: Laid down in such and such a year, Progress, Kardova. No gods, no masters.""
Chinese: 没错，虽然那会儿它还叫卡尔多瓦共和国。这东西的内脏某处会有一块铭牌：“某某年于卡尔多瓦·进步城铺设龙骨。没有神，也没有主人。”

English: Funny how that one turned out.
Chinese: 这话后来应验得真讽刺。

English: My, how observant you are. In fact, ambulatory support is merely one of its functions. The first incarnation was rather less powerful; but, to be fair, I was rather smaller.
Chinese: 哎呀，你观察得真仔细。其实行走辅助不过是它的功能之一。初代没这么强大——不过公平地说，那时候我也小得多。

English: I expect you want the whole story? After all, it is so very ((inspirational.))
Chinese: 我猜你想听完整的故事？毕竟它如此((励志。))

English: I'll spare you the exhaustive history of my diverse ailments. Suffice it to say that I was a sickly child.##The only thing my physicians agreed upon was that I must submit completely to their humiliating 'remedies', no matter how painful or ineffective.
Chinese: 我就不细数我那一身病症的漫长历史了。长话短说，我是个体弱多病的孩子。##我的医师们唯一的共识是：我必须完全服从他们那些羞辱人的'疗法'，无论多疼、多无效。

English: I disagreed, and in due course it proved that with a little technological cunning I could treat myself better than they could. Machines, you see, actually listen to what one tells them.
Chinese: 我不赞同，而后来的事实证明，凭一点技术上的小聪明，我把自己治得比他们治得好。要知道，机器是真正听话的——你对它说什么，它就做什么。

English: How people ((loved)) to hear me tell that tale once I grew up. The Machinists loved it especially. Come to the Clockwork Kingdom, where even a low-born invalid can travel the skies and be garlanded as a champion of the realm!
Chinese: 我长大后，人们((多爱))听我讲这段故事啊。机械师们尤其爱听。来发条王国吧——在这里，连出身低微的病残之人都能翱翔天际，还被冠以国之名将的桂冠！

English: True, I was dogged and ingenious. But to what purpose?##Yes, I improved my capabilities; but for whose benefit?
Chinese: 不错，我确实执着而机巧。可为了什么？##没错，我提升了自己的能力；可造福了谁？

English: I accomplished great things. But for whom? Myself? <<He sneers.>> What a cosy thought.
Chinese: 我成就了大事。可为了谁？为了我自己？<<他冷笑。>>想得倒美。

English: Sometimes I almost wish I hadn't bothered. At least then I wouldn't have been so ((useful)).
Chinese: 有时我几乎希望自己当初没折腾。至少那样，我就不会这么((有用))了。

English: Luck is for amateurs, my dear.
Chinese: 运气是外行才需要的东西，亲爱的。

English: <<Just as you're turning away, there is an awkward cough.>> Actually, one moment, if you please? ##I wish to... that is, it behooves me... ((dash)) it all, let's not prevaricate about the bush.
Chinese: <<你正要转身，身后传来一声尴尬的咳嗽。>>其实，请稍等一下？##我想……就是说，我有必要……((见鬼))，咱们就别拐弯抹角了。

English: You were quite correct to scold me back in the Kingdom. The word for what I was doing is ((wallowing)). Specifically, in childish rage and self-pity.##<<He pauses, apparently unsure what to say next.>>
Chinese: 你在王国里骂我，骂得很对。我当时的状态，用词来说叫((自怨自艾))。具体而言，沉溺于孩子气的暴怒和自怜。##<<他顿住，显然不知下一句该说什么。>>

English: ((Confound)) it, what else would I be trying to say? ((Bog)) off before I regret such wasteful sentimentality!
Chinese: ((该死))，不然我还想说什么？趁我没后悔这番浪费感情的煽情，快((滚))！

English: Hrm. Yes, quite. Very good. ##Well, what are you waiting for? A medal? ((Bog)) off before you break something expensive.
Chinese: 哼。是，没错。很好。##那么，你还等什么？等颁奖章？趁你还没碰坏什么贵重东西，快((滚))。

English: Let's see if you can come up with a question I haven't heard before.
Chinese: 看看你能不能问出个我没听过的问题。

English: Now, was that really your best attempt at an original question? I think you can do better.
Chinese: 我说，这真是你原创提问的最高水准？我觉得你能做得更好。

English: Ah yes, the search for my erstwhile comrades. Or should I say my former targets? Either way, this reunion will be ((interesting))...
Chinese: 啊对，搜寻我昔日的同伴。还是说，我昔日的监视目标？不管怎样，这场重逢会((很有意思))……

English: [[Jack Basalt]] will have already calculated that his best chance to stop Vela is to collaborate with the Union. He's wanted in the Kingdom, and he has a phobia of the Endless, which means he is in Hallowshire – and most likely in the [[Wobbly Noggin]].
Chinese: [[杰克·巴索特]]应该已经盘算清楚了：想拦住薇拉，他最好的机会就是与联盟合作。他在王国是通缉犯，又怕无尽者怕得要死，也就是说他就在哈洛郡——多半泡在[[摇晃酒馆]]。

English: I see you've pressed old [[Jack Basalt]] back into active service. The poor fellow's currently avoiding me, which is adorable. Granted, we hardly parted on the best of terms, but at some point we'll need to have a little chat.
Chinese: 看来你把老[[杰克·巴索特]]重新征召入伍了。这可怜家伙现在躲着我呢，真可爱。诚然，我们当初闹得不太愉快，但找个时候我们得聊聊。

English: [[The Duchess]] is a devoted family woman, and was already bored to undeath of the Skyrealms when I knew her. Therefore I would guess she is back at her country pile in the [[Endless Realm]], doing nothing in particular.
Chinese: [[女公爵]]是个顾家的女人，我认识她那会儿，她就早对天空领域腻烦得不死不休了。所以我猜她回了[[无尽领域]]的乡下宅邸，无所事事。

English: Alas, I'd forgotten how much [[the Duchess]] infuriates me. What she calls 'magic' is merely the cant of a more primitive age. Reciting cipher spells from memory, for pity's sake! It's like carrying a cart on your shoulders after the invention of the wheel.
Chinese: 唉，我都忘了[[女公爵]]多让我来气。她所谓的'魔法'不过是更原始时代的行话。背诵密文法术，我的天！这就好比发明了车轮之后还用肩膀扛车。

English: [[The Emberian]] is an odd one. She confided in me once that she was trying to unravel some ancient mystery, though she wouldn't say what. Most of this archipelago's extant prelapsarian sites are in [[Hallowshire]]. Ergo, that is where you should look first.
Chinese: [[余烬人]]是个怪人。她曾向我吐露，她在试图解开某个古代谜团，但不肯说是哪个。这片群岛现存的天裂前遗迹大多在[[哈洛郡]]。因此，你该先去那里找。
