English: I get on rather well with [[Orlaith]] – or [[the Emberian]], as you mustn't call her to her face. Initially we despised each other, but then we had an arm wrestle and everything was tickety-boo. Since I was too drunk to remember it, I choose to believe I won.
Chinese: 我和[[奥莱丝]]相处得相当融洽——不过[[余烬人]]这个称呼你千万别当她的面叫。起初我们互相看不顺眼，后来掰过一次手腕，从此一切安好。因为我喝得太多不记得结果了，所以我选择相信是我赢了。

English: ((Nul points)) for novelty, I'm afraid. But at least you tried.
Chinese: 新意方面恐怕要给((零分))了。但至少你试过了。

English: Must we?
Chinese: 非问不可吗？

English: Now, was that really your best attempt at an original question? I think you can do better.
Chinese: 我说，这真是你原创提问的最高水准？我觉得你能做得更好。

English: Must you?
Chinese: 非问不可吗？

English: I was born and raised in [[Progress]], back when they still called it [[Istriksburg.]]##My mother made ammunition, while my father toiled in the Fortress Works. It was dangerous, but far better than serfdom in Lundel. For the first time in history, my family was wealthier than dirt.
Chinese: 我在[[进步城]]出生长大，那时它还叫[[伊斯特里斯堡]]。##我母亲制造弹药，我父亲在要塞工厂做工。虽然危险，却比伦德尔的农奴境遇好得多。历史上头一回，我们家的家当比泥土值钱。

English: Nor would you, if your childhood tongue had been scoured out by your schoolmaster. ##The last time I saw my parents, we sounded like we came from different planets.
Chinese: 要是你童年的口音也被教书先生刮洗过，你也不会像。##我最后一次见父母时，我们说话像来自两个星球。

English: <<He smiles without mirth.>>##Horace Metcalfe was hardly the first of my disguises.
Chinese: <<他笑得毫无笑意。>>##霍勒斯·梅特卡夫可不是我的第一个伪装。

English: After the God War, I studied in Byonne. A scholarship, funded by the new Kardovan Republic. My Union classmates were scions of barons or wealthy merchants, and they tormented me frightfully. Yet ((I)) was punished merely for setting them ((lightly)) on fire.
Chinese: 神之战后，我在拜昂求学。奖学金是新生的卡尔多瓦共和国资助的。我的联盟同窗都是男爵或富商之后，他们把我折磨得够呛。可((我))不过是把他们((轻轻))烧了一下，竟要受罚。

English: Indeed. Eventually my studies were cut short by Kardova's split from the Union, and I returned home to begin my archaeological career. Our new Machinist leaders were ravenous for Emberian lore, and it wasn't long before I was assigned my own dig team.
Chinese: 的确。后来卡尔多瓦脱离联盟，我的学业就此中断，我回到家乡开始了考古生涯。新上台的机械师领袖们对余烬秘闻如饥似渴，没多久我就有了自己的挖掘队。

English: Unquestionably these were the best years of my life. I followed my curiosity to the edge of the sky, and even to the Underlands, winning great renown and no small compensation. Yet I always felt as if everything could be snatched away if I failed to deliver even once.
Chinese: 那无疑是我一生中最好的年月。我追随好奇心抵达天空的尽头，甚至深入地下之地，赢得盛名和可观的报酬。但我总感觉，只要有一次失手，一切都会被夺走。

English: Perhaps that is why I felt so much more at home among the outcasts, oddballs, and reprobates of the Dark Star Company.
Chinese: 或许正因如此，我才在黑星的那群弃儿、怪胎和浪子中间，觉得如此自在。

English: Where does one even begin? We fought. We caroused. We feasted, we starved. We loved and we despised. We hurt each other, then we nursed each other. We were family, with all the best and worst implied by such a word.
Chinese: 这从何说起呢？我们并肩作战。我们纵酒狂欢。我们大宴，我们也挨饿。我们相爱，也相轻。我们互相伤害，又互相照料。我们是一家人——这个词包含的最好与最坏，我们都占全了。

English: The Caxton Frost who stands before you is a product of those days. I had to be sharp. Ruthless. Avenge every insult threefold, lest others smell blood.
Chinese: 站在你面前的卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特，就是那些年月的产物。我必须敏锐。无情。每一句侮辱都要三倍奉还，免得被人闻到血腥味。

English: Vela could tell it was a facade, but she was gracious or canny enough not to expose me in front of the crew. Except when she was ((truly)) angry. One minute she could make you feel like you were bathed in starlight. The next, like the basest of worms.
Chinese: 薇拉看得出那是张假面，但她要么出于风度、要么出于精明，从不在船员面前拆穿我。除非她((真的))动了怒。前一分钟她还能让你觉得沐浴在星光里，下一分钟就让你觉得自己是最低贱的蠕虫。

English: I've often wondered. Certainly our expeditions contributed much to the Kingdom's progress. Sometimes I got the uncanny sense that she knew my real purpose, yet kept me around anyway.
Chinese: 我也常常纳闷。我们的探险确实为王国的进步贡献良多。有时我会有种诡异的直觉：她知道我真正的使命，却仍把我留在身边。

English: I've often wondered. Certainly our expeditions contributed much to the Kingdom's progress. Sometimes I got the uncanny sense that she knew my real purpose, yet kept me around anyway.
Chinese: 我也常常纳闷。我们的探险确实为王国的进步贡献良多。有时我会有种诡异的直觉：她知道我真正的使命，却仍把我留在身边。

English: Why she would do so, I cannot say. Perhaps it was simply our shared fascination with the Emberians. She told me once that I reminded her of someone who had been dear to her, long ago. I never did find out who, though.
Chinese: 她为何这么做，我说不上来。也许只是因为我们同样痴迷于余烬人。她曾告诉我，我让她想起很久以前一位对她很重要的人。至于是谁，我始终没能弄清。

English: <<Frost snorts.>> Why, I'd been doing that all my life. The only difference now was the extra pay.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特嗤了一声。>>嗬，我这一辈子都在干这个。唯一的区别是现在多了份薪水。

English: Actually, I have my suspicions that the Clockwork King may have helped. At the time I had no idea that Its Majesty could alter minds. But I do recall being surprised at how quickly I took to the role. Of course, I can prove nothing.
Chinese: 其实，我怀疑发条王可能帮了忙。当时我完全不知道国王陛下有改写心智的能力。但我确实记得，自己入戏之快连自己都吃惊。当然，我拿不出任何证据。

English: <<Frost sighs.>> Frankly, I'm not completely sure myself. But consider what had led to that moment...
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特叹了口气。>>坦白说，我自己也不完全确定。但想想是什么把我们逼到那一步的……

English: Eight years undercover. Can you imagine what that's like? To be believable, you cannot merely pretend. One part of you must truly ((become)) the false self, while another watches from the outside, remembering your mission.
Chinese: 卧底八年。你能想象那是什么滋味吗？要想以假乱真，你不能只是假装。你必须有一部分真正((变成))那个假我，同时另一部分冷眼旁观，牢记自己的使命。

English: I knew that if I betrayed the Clockwork King, it would never stop hunting me. Yet I couldn't bear to live in deceit for one more day. Thus the inevitable conclusion: the best cover identity is one who doesn't even realise he's fake.
Chinese: 我知道，一旦背叛发条王，它对我的追捕就永无止境。可这样的欺骗生活，我一天也熬不下去了。于是便有了那个必然的结论：最好的伪装，是连自己都不知道自己是假的。

English: I haven't decided whether I like being Frost again. He used to feel like armour, and now he feels... confining. Still, he's indisputably the man for the job. And I must admit it's easier when I don't have to be two people at once.
Chinese: 我还没决定是否喜欢重新当回弗罗斯特。他从前像一副铠甲，如今却让人感觉……束缚。不过，这份活儿确实非他莫属。而且我必须承认，不用同时当两个人的时候，日子轻松多了。

English: Still having trouble cursing?
Chinese: 骂人还是不行？

English: Say it with me: Cunt. Cuh-unt.
Chinese: 跟我念：操。初——操。

English: Maybe this is good for you? It'll force you to get creative.
Chinese: 也许这样对你有好处？能逼你发挥创造力。

English: wanted to see how you're settling in.
Chinese: 想看看你住得习不习惯。

English: That explains a lot.
Chinese: 难怪呢。

English: So this fortress was made in the Clockwork Kingdom?
Chinese: 所以这座要塞是发条王国造的？

English: Well, I'm glad you're feeling at home.
Chinese: 嗯，很高兴你有宾至如归的感觉。

English: I wanted to ask you about something.
Chinese: 我想请教你些事。

English: This clockwork leg brace is new. It helps you walk?
Chinese: 这副发条腿支架挺新的。是帮你走路的？

English: Please, go on.
Chinese: 请讲。

English: You can skip it.
Chinese: 可以跳过。

English: That's all. Good luck with the fortress.
Chinese: 就这些。要塞修复顺利。

English: Is 'thank you' perhaps the phrase you're looking for?
Chinese: 你想找的词，该不会是"谢谢"吧？

English: Don't mention it. We all have our bad days.
Chinese: 别放在心上。谁都有倒霉的日子。

English: About the task at hand...
Chinese: 关于眼下的事……

English: About your past...
Chinese: 关于你的过去……

English: What was your life like before joining Vela?
Chinese: 加入薇拉之前，你过着怎样的生活？

English: You know, you really don't sound like a peasant.
Chinese: 你知道吗，你听起来真不像个庄稼人。

English: You hide your common origins very well.
Chinese: 你把寒微的出身藏得很好。

English: Actually, no further questions.
Chinese: 其实，没有别的问题了。

English: There's no justice in this world.
Chinese: 这世上就没有公道。

English: At least you left them something to remember you by.
Chinese: 至少你给他们留了个念想。

English: Tell me of your time as a Dark Star.
Chinese: 讲讲你当黑星的那段日子吧。

English: Did she ever suspect you were a spy?
Chinese: 她怀疑过你是间谍吗？

English: How did you manage to maintain your persona?
Chinese: 你是怎么维持伪装身份的？

English: Let me ask you about something else.
Chinese: 换个话题问吧。

English: I still don't quite understand why you had to wipe your memory.
Chinese: 我还是不太明白你为什么必须抹除自己的记忆。

English: I'd like to ask you about another topic entirely.
Chinese: 我想完全换个话题问你。

English: <<It's a music box, of rare and intricate design. Its lid depicts pastoral scenes of ordinary mortals working and relaxing together, finely inlaid with iridescent chitin and mother of cloud-pearl.>>
Chinese: <<那是一只音乐盒，设计精巧，世所罕见。盒盖上镶嵌着虹彩甲壳与云母珍珠，细密地描绘着凡人一同劳作、一同休憩的田园景象。>>

English: <<However, there doesn't seem to be any music in it...>>
Chinese: <<然而，里面似乎并没有音乐……>>

English: <<When you wind the mechanism it plays a haunting tune, somehow familiar and ethereal all at once, like a lullaby from time's own beginning.>>
Chinese: <<你给机括上弦，它奏出一段萦绕心头的曲调，既熟悉又缥缈，仿佛时间源头的摇篮曲。>>

English: <<You laboriously wind up the mechanism, and then release. As the cylinder turns, its needles pluck the teeth of a steel comb, and a tender twinkling music begins to play...>>
Chinese: <<你费力地拧紧发条，然后松手。滚筒转动，细针拨过钢梳的齿，一段轻柔闪亮的音乐开始流淌……>>

English: <<It's a haunting tune, somehow familiar and ethereal all at once, like a lullaby from time's own beginning. You feel a shiver run up your spinal cord, and the hairs on your arms prick up.>>
Chinese: <<那是一段萦绕心头的曲调，既熟悉又缥缈，仿佛时间源头的摇篮曲。你感到一阵战栗顺着脊椎爬上来，手臂上的汗毛根根竖起。>>

English: <<Behind you, a porcelain teacup smashes on the floor.>>
Chinese: <<你身后，一只瓷茶杯摔碎在地板上。>>

English: [Insert the brass drum that you found in Progress]
Chinese: [装入你在进步城找到的黄铜滚筒]

English: [Leave it alone.]
Chinese: [别碰它。]

English: <<A ghostly light ripples from within each meticulously labeled bottle. Evidently this is someone's private vision stash.>> ##<<However, without talking more to its owner, you're >>[[not sure what to look for]]<<...>>
Chinese: <<幽幽的光从每只贴着细致标签的瓶子里荡漾出来。显然，这是某人私藏的幻象库存。>>##<<不过，不跟主人多聊聊，你>>[[不知道该找什么]]<<……>>

English: <<A ghostly light ripples from within each bottle, their contents swirling like mist. Evidently this is Horace Metcalfe's private vision stash.>>
Chinese: <<幽光在每只瓶中荡漾，瓶内的东西如雾气般旋绕。显然，这是霍勒斯·梅特卡夫的私藏幻象。>>

English: <<His labeling system is meticulous, and you quickly locate a bottle marked 'NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION' that mentions the 'Ashen Woman'.>>##[[You take the bottle.]]
Chinese: <<他的标签体系一丝不苟，你很快找到一瓶标着"非卖品"的，上面提到了"灰烬女人"。>>##[[你拿走了那瓶幻象。]]

English: <<Horace's private stash of bottled visions.>>##[[You already took a bottled vision from the stash. Open your inventory and select the bottle to use it.]]
Chinese: <<霍勒斯的瓶装幻象私藏。>>##[[你已经从私藏里拿了一瓶。打开物品栏，选中那瓶即可使用。]]

English: <<A private stash of bottled visions. You have no further business here.>>
Chinese: <<一处瓶装幻象私藏。你在、这里没什么可做的了。>>

English: <<You drift into a restless sleep.>>
Chinese: <<你坠入一场辗转难安的睡眠。>>

English: <<You're climbing through the skeleton of a titanic machine. Above you, the Ashen Woman pauses on a rusted clavicle to give you a cocky grin.>> ##C'mon, slowcoach. You forget to oil your legs?
Chinese: <<你正攀爬在一台巨型机器的骸骨间。头顶上，灰烬女人在一根锈蚀的锁骨上停了停，冲你得意地一笑。>> ##快点啊，慢吞吞。忘了给腿上油吗？

English: <<That's right. You're Horace Metcalfe now, not whoever you were before.##You watch Vela input [[some kind of code]], and the titan's braincase opens so you can clamber out. Then she takes your hand, gives it a reassuring squeeze, and you both lift off the ground.>>
Chinese: <<没错。你现在是霍勒斯·梅特卡夫，不是从前的任何人。##你看着薇拉输入[[某种密码]]，巨兽的颅腔打开，你们攀爬而出。然后她握住你的手，安抚地捏了捏，你们双双腾空而起。>>

English: <<You fly over the Corrupted Lands, light as a leaf on the wind. In the distance is a dead city, its charred bones exposed to the desolate sky, growing ever larger as you spiral down towards its gates.>>
Chinese: <<你们飞过腐化之地，轻如风中之叶。远处是一座死城，焦黑的骨架袒露在荒凉的天空下，随着你们盘旋着朝它的城门降下，它越来越大。>>

English: [[QUERY]]: ANY LAST WORDS? ##<<...says the Clockwork King, its voice like a cyclone of blowflies and broken glass. You feel your heartbeat quicken. You do remember, don't you?>>
Chinese: [[问询]]：可有遗言？##<<……发条王说，它的声音像绿头苍蝇与碎玻璃卷成的旋风。你感到心跳骤然加速。你还记得的，对吧？>>

English: <<The King's mouth shivers open, its teeth dripping with blood, and you both walk through into darkness.>> ##<<When your eyes adjust, you find yourself in your childhood schoolroom.>>
Chinese: <<国王的嘴颤抖着张开，牙齿上滴着血，你们双双走入黑暗。>>##<<等眼睛适应过来，你发现自己站在童年的教室里。>>

English: <<The room is half-buried in compacted ash, the blackboard a palimpsest of faded sums and slogans. Vela, wearing a schoolmaster's cap, throws a shovel at you.>> ##Well, boy? Aren't you going to show us what you can do?
Chinese: <<教室半埋在夯实的灰烬里，黑板上层层叠叠写满褪色的算术和标语。薇拉戴着教书先生的帽子，朝你扔来一把铁锹。>> ##怎么了，小子？不想让我们瞧瞧你的本事吗？

English: <<You dig for hours, until you strike something brittle and crunchy. As you clear away more debris, you realise you're standing on a giant mirror, with cracks radiating out from where your blade hit home.>>
Chinese: <<你挖了几个小时，直到铲到什么又脆又响的东西。清开更多碎屑后，你意识到自己站在一面巨大的镜子上，裂纹从你剑锋落点向四下辐射。>>

English: <<You look so different from how you remember. Handsome, hard and imperious, standing fully upright, your legs encased in some kind of clockwork armour. You feel your heart pounding like a battering ram against your ribcage.>>
Chinese: <<你看起来和你记忆中的自己如此不同。英俊、冷硬、威严，站得笔直，双腿裹在某种发条铠甲里。你感到心脏像攻城锤一样撞击着肋骨。>>

English: <<Your reflection gives you a cruel, taunting smile.>> ##What's the matter, darling? Forgot your line?
Chinese: <<镜中的你露出残忍的、嘲弄的笑。>> ##怎么了，亲爱的？忘词了？

English: <<You wake up breathless and drenched in sweat, your thoughts racing.>> ##<<The>> [[Corrupted Lands]]... The [[dead city]]. That's where you must go.>>
Chinese: <<你惊醒过来，汗透衣背，思绪狂奔。>>##<<[[腐化之地]]……那座[[死城]]。你必须去那里。>>

English: The hard light of creation burns within the fallible flesh.
Chinese: 造物的硬光在易朽的血肉中燃烧。

English: Alas, we who wished to lay the grounds of kindness could not ourselves be kind.
Chinese: 哀哉，我们这些想为人间播撒善念的人，自己却未能行善。

English: I must obey the inscrutable exhortations of my soul.
Chinese: 我必听从灵魂深处那不可名状的驱策。

English: <<The control console is caked with dirt and dust. A spider skitters away into the hole where an indicator light has been torn out. Nobody has been here in a long time.>>
Chinese: <<控制台积满尘土。一只蜘蛛窜进指示灯被拔掉的孔洞里。很久没有人来过这里了。>>

English: <<Amidst the decay you spy a keypad with six round keys.>>
Chinese: <<在朽败之间，你瞥见一块有六个圆形按键的键盘。>>

English: <<A memory of Vela's hand rises up from your subconscious like bubbles from a drowning soul. You punch in the numbers 0-5-0-4-5-1.>>
Chinese: <<薇拉按手的记忆像溺水者吐出的气泡，从潜意识深处浮起。你敲入了0-5-0-4-5-1。>>

English: <<You feel a mechanical click inside your skull, and alien knowledge drops into your mind like a live fish into your undergarments. You punch in the numbers 0-5-0-4-5-1.>>
Chinese: <<你感到颅内咔哒一响，陌生的知识像一条活鱼落进你的内衣，直坠脑海。你敲入了0-5-0-4-5-1。>>

English: <<Somewhere beneath your feet, an engine thrums to life, and the metal catwalk begins to vibrate...>>
Chinese: <<在你脚下的某处，一台引擎轰鸣着苏醒，金属栈桥开始震动……>>

English: <<The machine beeps nastily at you.>>
Chinese: <<机器冲你发出刺耳的哔哔声。>>

English: <<The keypad seems to have powered off. No matter; you have no further use for it.>>
Chinese: <<键盘似乎断电了。没关系；你已经用不着它了。>>

English: <<You methodically punch in the numbers, occasionally pausing to squint at Genevieve's tiny handwriting. Most of them fail, until you try the final code: 0-5-0-4-5-1.>>
Chinese: <<你一丝不苟地依次输入密码，不时停下眯眼辨认吉纳维芙那蝇头小字。大多失败，直到你试到最后一组：0-5-0-4-5-1。>>

English: <<[Enter the code you saw in Metcalfe's vision.]>>
Chinese: <<[输入你在梅特卡夫幻象中看到的密码。]>>

English: <<[Try to picture Aphra in your mind.]>>
Chinese: <<[试着在脑海中想象阿芙拉。]>>

English: <<[Enter a code at random.]>>
Chinese: <<[随便输入一组密码。]>>

English: <<[Leave it alone.]>>
<<[Try the access codes given to you by the librarian.]>>
Chinese: <<[试试图书管理员给你的通行码。]>>

English: <<Sammol glares at you suspiciously.>> ##Horace tries to hide it, but I can tell he's rattled. What did you say to him? Why are you harassing us like this?
Chinese: <<萨莫尔狐疑地瞪着你。>>##霍雷斯想装没事，但我看得出他心神不宁。你跟他说什么了？你干吗这样纠缠我们？

English: <<This man has a wiry strength about him, the kind that comes from years of hard work outdoors.>> ##You must be here to see Horace? Well, our home is your home, however humble.
Chinese: <<这人身上有种精瘦的力气，那是常年户外劳作磨出来的。>>##你是来找霍雷斯的吧？寒舍虽然简陋，也当你自己家便是。

English: Now will you leave us in peace?
Chinese: 现在能让我们清净了吗？

English: Anything else you need?
Chinese: 还有别的需要吗？

English: I'm Sammol; this is my house. Technically, anyway. The other fellow is Horace Metcalfe, my... ##<<He knits his brows and gives you a wry smile.>> Lodger? Housemate? Friend.
Chinese: 我是萨莫尔；这房子是我的。至少法律上算是。另一位是霍勒斯·梅特卡夫，我的……##<<他皱起眉，冲你露出一个无奈的笑。>>房客？室友？朋友。

English: We're pretty isolated out here, so look after ourselves. I chop our wood and catch our meals while he brings in the coin.
Chinese: 我们这儿前不着村后不着店，所以凡事都得自己来。我劈柴打猎，他挣钱贴补。

English: <<Sammol listens to your explanation with increasing confusion.>> Dark Stars? The Underlands? ((Horace?)) ##Listen, you've got it all wrong. Comically, cosmically wrong.
Chinese: <<萨莫尔听你解释，一脸越来越深的困惑。>>黑星？地下之地？((霍雷斯？))##听着，你全搞错了。错得离谱，错得没边。

English: Evidently you don't know much about Horace, but I do. The idea that he'd be mixed up in this nonsense is preposterous. The man wouldn't hurt a fly. And even if he wanted to, he wouldn't know how.
Chinese: 显然你不了解霍雷斯，但我了解。说他掺和进这种鬼名堂，简直荒谬。这人连苍蝇都不忍伤害。就算他想伤害，也不知道怎么下手。

English: King's arse, why would you want to go ((there))? The whole place is under quarantine. Since the bridge is closed, I s'pose you'd have to find some way across that [[great trench]] south of the mountains.
Chinese: 国王的屁股，你去((那儿))干什么？整个地方都被隔离了。桥既然封了，我猜你得想办法跨过山南那条[[大壕沟]]。

English: But listen: if you do go trespassing, don't you ((dare)) come back here afterward. I won't let you put us at risk.
Chinese: 但听着：你真要擅自闯进去，事后((敢))再回这儿，试试看。我不会让你把我们俩置于险地。

English: <<Sammol looks wary.>>##Depends what it is. You're not one of those weirdo dream fiends Horace gets, are you?
Chinese: <<萨莫尔满脸警惕。>>##得看是什么事。你不是霍雷斯那些怪里怪气的痴梦客吧？

English: Was that all you wanted to know?
Chinese: 你想知道的就这些？

English: He moved in three years ago, after my wife passed away. I had an empty room, and I was lonely. He needed a quiet place where he'd have help if his sickness flared up. Since then, he's become part of the family.
Chinese: 他三年前搬来的，在我妻子过世之后。我有间空房，人又孤单。他需要个清净地方，发病时也有人照应。从那以后，他就成了家里的一员。

English: Most folk think him scatterbrained, but he has such a kind soul. And what an imagination! I've no idea where he gets it all from. I just thank my lucky star I get to live with it.
Chinese: 大多数人觉得他丢三落四，可他有颗顶善良的心。还有那想象力！我都不知道他从哪来的那么多点子。我只能谢天谢地，能天天跟他一起生活。

English: What? How did you know – ##<<Sammol catches himself.>> Pfft, as if I'd tell you a thing like that!
Chinese: 什么？你怎么知道——##<<萨莫尔猛然收声。>>切，好像我会告诉你似的！

English: I s'pose I should have known you were one of ((those)) visitors. You're lucky I have a soft spot for oddballs – otherwise I'd kick your ((buttocks)) right into the Underlands.
Chinese: 我早该料到你是((那种))访客。算你走运，我偏爱怪人——不然我早把你((屁股))踢进地下之地了。

English: I'm Sammol; this is my house. The other fellow is Horace Metcalfe, my dearest friend and companion.
Chinese: 我是萨莫尔；这房子是我的。另一位是霍勒斯·梅特卡夫，我最亲爱的朋友和伴侣。

English: What is this place?
Chinese: 这地方是什么？

English: I have reason to believe your 'Horace' is more than he seems.
Chinese: 我有理由相信你的"霍雷斯"另有来历。

English: Do you know any way into the Corrupted Lands?
Chinese: 你知道去腐化之地的路吗？

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗？

English: Thank you for your hospitality. Farewell.
Chinese: 多谢款待。告辞。

English: How well do you know Horace?
Chinese: 你了解霍雷斯多少？

English: Tell me about yourself again.
Chinese: 再自我介绍一下吧。

English: Don't worry, that's all.
Chinese: 别担心，就这些。

English: Does Horace happen to have a moth tattoo on his left buttock?
Chinese: 霍雷斯左边屁股上是不是恰好有个飞蛾刺青？

English: <<Sammol is struggling to put a brave face on deep disquiet.>> ##I... overheard your conversation. If Horace believes this is important, I won't stand in his way.
Chinese: <<萨莫尔强作镇定，掩着深深的不安。>>##我……偷听到你们的谈话了。如果霍雷斯认为这很重要，我不会拦他。

English: But you bring that man back safe and sound, understand? I don't care what nonsense you've put into his head. ((I)) need him.
Chinese: 但你要把那个人完好无损地带回来，明白吗？不管你往他脑子里塞了什么鬼话。((我))需要他。

English: <<He nods, no longer able to meet your gaze.>> ##That's all I can ask. I'll be praying to the King for you both.
Chinese: <<他点点头，再不敢看你的眼睛。>>##我也只能要求这些了。愿国王保佑你们俩。

English: <<He takes a deep, shaky breath.>> ##Yeah, I was afraid you might say that.
Chinese: <<他深吸了一口气，微微发颤。>>##唉，我就怕你说这个。

English: Please don't forget your promise. I need Horace to come home safe.
Chinese: 请别忘了你的承诺。我需要霍雷斯平安回家。

English: I know you can't promise anything, but please look out for my darling Horace.
Chinese: 我知道你许不了什么保证，但请多照看我心爱的霍雷斯。

English: I promise I'll do my best to keep him safe.
Chinese: 我保证我会尽全力保他平安。

English: I'm sorry, I can't make any promises.
Chinese: 对不起，我没法打包票。

English: <<Bzzzt.>> [[JUDGEMENT]]: THE CITY OF [[PROGRESS]] IS UNDER STRICT QUARANTINE, BY ORDER OF THE CLOCKWORK KING.
Chinese: <<嘀。>>[[裁定]]：[[进步城]]奉发条王敕令，处于严格隔离状态。

English: THEREFORE, [[EDICT]]: ENTRY IS FORBIDDEN EXCEPT BY THOSE IN POSSESSION OF THE PROPER PASSWORD.
Chinese: 因此，[[敕令]]：除持有正确口令者外，一律禁止入内。

English: <<A memory of Metcalfe's vision wells up from your subconscious, like a leech rising from a lake bed to feed after dark.>>
Chinese: <<梅特卡夫幻象中的记忆从潜意识深处涌起，像天黑后从湖底浮起来觅食的水蛭。>>

English: <<Bzzzt.>> PONDERING... ##EMERGENCY OVERRIDE ACCEPTED. WELCOME BACK, MR FROST.
Chinese: <<嘀。>>思虑中……##紧急越权指令已接受。欢迎回来，弗罗斯特先生。

English: <<The [[Quarantine Guardian]] says nothing more.##It stares through its empty mask, watching you quietly.>>
Chinese: <<[[隔离守卫]]不再多说。##它透过空洞的面具，静静注视着你。>>

English: The hard light of creation burns within the fallible flesh.
Chinese: 造物的硬光在易朽的血肉中燃烧。

English: Alas, we who wished to lay the grounds of kindness could not ourselves be kind.
Chinese: 哀哉，我们这些想为人间播撒善念的人，自己却未能行善。

English: I must obey the inscrutable exhortations of my soul.
Chinese: 我必听从灵魂深处那不可名状的驱策。

English: <<This shopkeeper has his nose buried in a giant ledger.>> King's blessing, citizen, I'll be with you in a... ##<<He glances up and does a double take.>> ...tick. Gods' teeth, a new customer!
Chinese: <<店主鼻尖埋在一本巨厚的账册里。>>国王赐福，公民，请稍……##<<他抬头一瞥，愣了一愣。>>……等等。诸神的牙齿，来新客人了！

English: <<The shopkeeper seizes your hand and shakes it vigorously.>> ##Welcome, welcome, dear citizen. I am [[Vidal]], the foremost ((fully)) licenced vision trader in Ferropolis, and dare I say the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: <<店主一把抓住你的手，热烈地摇晃。>>##欢迎欢迎，亲爱的公民。我是[[维达尔]]，铁城头号((完全))持证的幻象商人，斗胆说一句，也是全发条王国的头号。

English: Exactly so, good citizen! The Kingdom's premier export, famed across the Sky Realms. ##Please forgive me for not standing up. These legs haven't been the same since the God War.
Chinese: 正是如此，好公民！王国的头号特产，誉满天空领域。##请恕我不能起身相迎。神之战以后，这两条腿就不中用了。

English: Oh! My sincere apologies, citizen. It's just so exciting to see a new face in here. ##Forgive me for not standing up. These legs haven't been the same since the God War.
Chinese: 哦！实在失礼了，公民。只是店里来新面孔，实在太叫人高兴。##请恕我不能起身相迎。神之战以后，这两条腿就不中用了。

English: <<Your ears prick up at that last remark. Jack Basalt said that Caxton Frost, one of Vela's former comrades, had trouble walking.>>
Chinese: <<听到最后那句话，你竖起了耳朵。杰克·巴索特说过，薇拉的旧同伴之一卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特走路不利索。>>

English: So, what's your fancy? A dream of flying, lightness and freedom on the wing? A reverie of the vanished past? Or, for the daring soul, a nightmare so chilling your waking life will seem like bliss?
Chinese: 那么，您今天想看点什么？一场翱翔、轻逸与自由振翅的梦？一段逝去往昔的遐想？还是说，给胆大的客人来一场毛骨悚然的噩梦，让您醒来后觉得人间堪比极乐？

English: Welcome back, good citizen. What's your fantasy today?
Chinese: 欢迎回来，好公民。今天想做什么样的梦？

English: What else can I do for you today?
Chinese: 今天还能为您效什么劳？

English: How intriguing! Perhaps I can help?
Chinese: 有意思！或许我能帮上忙？

English: Did you have another question?
Chinese: 还有别的问题吗？

English: Visions are the Kingdom's premier export, thanks to our unique aplomb for thaumotechnology.##The siphoning and distillation apparatus is quite affordable, so almost anyone can become a dreamwright if they apply themselves.
Chinese: 幻象是王国的头号特产，全赖我们在奇术科技上独步天下的造诣。##虹吸与蒸馏设备价格亲民，只要肯下功夫，几乎人人都能成为织梦师。

English: Naturally, the Apostatic Union despises it. They say it distracts the serfs from their drudgery, and fills their heads with dangerous ideas. But no matter how many shipments they intercept, they can't prevent people from dreaming.
Chinese: 自然，叛教联盟恨透了这行当。他们说幻象让农奴无心苦役，往他们脑袋里灌危险思想。但无论他们截获多少货船，也拦不住人做梦。

English: As for the supposed side effects, I can assure you that chronic oneironism is exceedingly rare, and easily avoided as long as you dream ((responsibly)).
Chinese: 至于那些所谓的副作用，我可以向您保证，慢性梦疾极其罕见，只要((负责任地))做梦，很容易避免。

English: A mercenary? King's grace, no. There ((was)) a fellow named [[Caxton Frost]] who ran off to join some band of sky pirates. That was the Dark Stars, I think. However, he met a sticky end when his leader made him walk the plank.
Chinese: 佣兵？国王开恩，不。倒是((有过))一个叫[[卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特]]的家伙，跑去投了什么天上海盗团。好像是叫黑星来着。不过，他的头儿让他走了跳板，下场可惨得很。

English: <<Vidal's expression brightens as he apprehends a sales opportunity.>> ##...of course, if you're interested in sky battles and suchlike, we have ((plenty)) in stock. It's quite a common fantasy.
Chinese: <<维达尔捕捉到推销良机，眼前一亮。>>##……当然，如果您对空战之类的题材感兴趣，我们((存货充足))。这可是很常见的幻想。

English: Let's see... palanquins... penis thieves... pirates!##Would you like to be one, fight one, romance one, be menaced by one, be menaced ((and)) romanced by one, attend university with one, play chess with one, inexplicably find yourself naked with one, or something else?
Chinese: 让我想想……轿子……窃阳贼……海盗！##您是想当海盗、打海盗、跟海盗谈恋爱、被海盗威胁、((又))被威胁又被撩、跟海盗做大学同窗、跟海盗下棋，还是莫名其妙跟海盗坦诚相见？或者来点别的？

English: Are you sure? We just got the latest Metcalfe in, and those are ((very)) popular. If you'd waited another day to ask me, they'd already be sold out.
Chinese: 确定吗？我们刚进了最新一批梅特卡夫，那可是((抢手货))。您要是晚一天来问，早就卖光了。

English: Then you'll be pleased to know that we just got the latest Metcalfe in. They're ((very)) popular – if you'd waited another day to ask me, they'd already be sold out.
Chinese: 那您听了肯定高兴：我们刚进了最新一批梅特卡夫。((抢手得很))——您要是晚一天来问，早就卖光了。

English: Why, it was in last month's Metcalfe, and those are ((very)) popular. You're lucky – we've only just received his latest. If you'd waited another day to ask me, they'd already be sold out.
Chinese: 哎呀，上个月的梅特卡夫里就有，那可是((抢手货))。您运气好——他的最新一期我们刚到。您要是晚一天来问，早就卖光了。

English: Oh, Metcalfe's visions are as real as it gets! The atmosphere, the details – just exquisite. A lot of customers think he must have really ((been)) a buccaneer.
Chinese: 哦，梅特卡夫的幻象可逼真得没话说！那氛围、那些细节——妙极了。好多客人都觉得他((一定真))当过海盗。

English: Metcalfe is the best in the business. Exquisite imagination. All those little details you'd never think to imagine – it's like he's really ((been)) a buccaneer.
Chinese: 梅特卡夫是这行的头牌。想象力精妙绝伦。那些你想都想不到的小细节——简直就像他((真))当过海盗。

English: <<Vidal leans in conspiratorially.>> But would you like to know his secret? I've met the man, and I can categorically tell you...
Chinese: <<维达尔凑近，一副密谋的架势。>>但您想不想知道他的秘密？我见过这个人，我可以斩钉截铁地告诉您……

English: ...[[Horace Metcalfe]] is an ordinary human being like the rest of us. ##Just goes to show there's no limit on dreams, eh?
Chinese: ……[[霍勒斯·梅特卡夫]]就是个平平无奇的普通人，跟你我没两样。##可见做梦是没有上限的，嗯？

English: I'm afraid I'm not at liberty to divulge his address. Bottled visions can... stir up powerful emotions, you understand? Some people get a little fixated on one supplier or another. Best for everyone that dreams stay dreams.
Chinese: 恐怕他的住址我不能奉告。瓶装幻象这东西……能搅起强烈的情感，您明白吗？有些人会对某个供货人有点过于执着。梦还是留在梦里，对大家都好。

English: All I will say is that he lives outside the city, so it's far too dangerous for you to go searching for him.
Chinese: 我只能告诉您，他住在城外。您去找他，太危险了。

English: Oh, um... wait! Please, wait just a moment. ##Are you... looking for work, by any chance? Only you seem a ((sturdy)) sort, and there's someone I'm a little worried about.
Chinese: 哦，呃……等等！请稍等片刻。##您是不是……正好在找活干？您看着就((结实))，我正有位客人有点让我放心不下。

English: [[Nadja]] is a regular – one of my best customers. She usually comes every week, but lately I haven't seen her at all. She lives in that [[big tenement]] near the park. Do you think you could check up on her?
Chinese: [[娜佳]]是老主顾——我最好的客人之一。她往常每周都来，最近却完全没了人影。她住在公园旁边那栋[[大公寓楼]]里。您能帮忙去看看她吗？

English: I'd visit her myself, but her room is right at the top of the building, and with my legs I wouldn't even get past the second staircase.
Chinese: 我本想自己去，可她的房间在楼顶，就我这双腿，第二段楼梯都上不去。

English: Ah, I'm afraid I don't have anything spare to reward you. Times being what they are, you know. ##But perhaps Nadja's mother might have work for you? I hear her family was once of respectable means.
Chinese: 唉，恐怕我拿不出多余的报酬了。世道您也知道。##不过娜佳的母亲兴许能给您派点活？听说她家从前也是体面人家。

English: [[Nadja]], yes. Do you have any news?
Chinese: [[娜佳]]，对。有什么消息吗？

English: Ah yes. Do you have any news?
Chinese: 啊对。有什么消息吗？

English: [[Nadja]]? Why yes, she's a regular of mine. One of my best customers, actually. But I haven't seen her in weeks. Is anything the matter?
Chinese: [[娜佳]]？哦，她是我老主顾。其实算得上我最好的客人之一。可我好几个星期没见着她了。出什么事了吗？

English: <<Vidal's face falls into an expression of horror as you explain the situation.>> ##Oh. Oh dear. Oh dear, oh dear.
Chinese: <<听你说明情况，维达尔的脸垮成了惊恐。>>##哦。天哪。天哪，天哪。

English: I've, um, read about this happening, of course. I've just never... I mean, nobody ((I)) know... ##Look, I don't know anything ((about)) this! I'm just a shopkeeper, you understand?
Chinese: 这种事，呃，我当然读过。只是我从没……我是说，我((认识))的人里没人……##听着，我对这个((一无所知))！我就是个开店的，您明白吗？

English: <<He seems to take strength from your words.>> ##...Yes. Yes, you're right. Nadja is my customer, and I have a responsibility to her. King knows I ((never)) wanted to do her any harm.
Chinese: <<你的话似乎让他有了力气。>>##……对。对，你说得对。娜佳是我的客人，我对她有责任。国王在上，我((从来))没想害过她。

English: <<Vidal looks sick to his stomach.>> What? No! I mean... ##It's not my ((place)) to tell people what they can and can't do. Is it? King knows I ((never)) wanted to do her any harm.
Chinese: <<维达尔一脸恶心。>>什么？不！我是说……##轮不到我((管))人家能做什么、不能做什么。对吧？国王在上，我((从来))没想害过她。

English: [[Doctor Pripp]]. That's the man you want. He's a medical genius, and quite a canny businessman. He invented much of the technology that sustains our trade. I ((know)) he's been studying dreamsickness very closely.
Chinese: [[普里普医生]]。您要找的就是他。他是医学天才，头脑也精明。 sustaining我们这行的技术大半是他发明的。我((知道))他一直在密切研究梦病。

English: Pripp runs the [[Royal Vision Works]] out in Cloudpine Oblast. It's in the far [[northeast]] of the Kingdom, on its own little island out [[beyond the mountains]].
Chinese: 普里普在云杉州经营[[皇家幻象工坊]]。在王国的[[东北]]角，[[群山之外]]的一座小岛上。

English: I'm ((sure)) he'll have some treatment or elixir for poor Nadja.
Chinese: 我((确信))他一定有办法治可怜的娜佳，或有什么灵药。

English: Indeed, it just arrived by special courier. I take it Doctor Pripp wasn't able to cure Nadja, then? ##I've always felt a little queasy about the Vision Works, but it sounds like the right decision.
Chinese: 可不是嘛，刚由专差送到。这么说，普里普医生没能治好娜佳？##幻象工坊那地方我一直有点犯膈应，但听起来这是正确的决定。

English: Even with Pripp's fifty per cent cut, the proceeds from that place can be considerable. I doubt Nadja's mother will need to worry about money again.
Chinese: 就算普里普抽走一半，那地方的进项也相当可观。娜佳的母亲往后想必不用为钱发愁了。

English: <<Vidal looks confused.>> Really? Um, right, very well! I'll make sure it reaches her.
Chinese: <<维达尔一脸茫然。>>是吗？呃，好，很好！我会确保交到她手上的。

English: Ah. I take it Doctor Pripp wasn't able to cure her, then? ##It'll be a difficult change for Nadja's mother, but bravo to her for making a go of it.
Chinese: 唉。这么说，普里普医生没能治好她？##对娜佳的母亲来说，这会是个艰难的转变，但她肯撑起这份家业，值得称赞。

English: Naturally, I'll do everything I can to set her up. In fact, if she's willing to sell through me, I won't charge her any distribution fees for the first year.
Chinese: 自然，我会竭尽全力帮她张罗起来。其实，如果她愿意经我的渠道出售，头一年我可以分文不收分销费。

English: <<Vidal catches sight of your expression.>> I mean, for the first three years!
Chinese: <<维达尔瞥见你的表情。>>我是说，头三年！

English: <<Vidal sighs, sounding rather less chirpy than usual.>> ##Well, what else can I do for you today?
Chinese: <<维达尔叹了口气，语气不似往常那般欢快。>>##嗯，今天还能为您效什么劳？

English: Vision trader?
Chinese: 幻象商人？

English: You're still shaking my hand.
Chinese: 你还在握着我的手呢。

English: About that customer you wanted me to check on...
Chinese: 关于你让我去看的那位客人……

English: Actually, I'm looking for information.
Chinese: 其实，我是在打听消息。

English: Let's see what visions you're selling.
Chinese: 看看你都卖哪些幻象。

English: See you later, vision trader.
Chinese: 回见，幻象商人。

English: Where did you say I'd find this 'Horace Metcalfe'?
Chinese: 你刚说那个"霍勒斯·梅特卡夫"在哪来着？

English: I'm looking for a Dark Star mercenary. Seen one?
Chinese: 我在找一个黑星佣兵。见过吗？

English: I'm not interested in bottled visions right now.
Chinese: 我现在对瓶装幻象没兴趣。

English: Romancing a pirate sounds interesting...
Chinese: 跟海盗谈恋爱听着挺有意思……

English: Who wants to play ((chess)) with pirates?
Chinese: 谁想跟海盗下((棋))啊？

English: I'm looking for a real person, not some fantasy.
Chinese: 我在找一个真人，不是什么幻想。

English: Why are Metcalfe's visions so popular?
Chinese: 梅特卡夫的幻象为什么这么受欢迎？

English: ...how very interesting. I'd love to meet him.
Chinese: ……真有意思。我倒想见见他。

English: Where would I find this 'ordinary human being'?
Chinese: 这位"普通人"上哪找？

English: Can you tell me more about the vision trade?
Chinese: 幻象这行当，能再多给我讲讲吗？

English: Thanks, you've been very helpful.
Chinese: 谢谢，帮大忙了。

English: About that customer you wanted me to check on...
Chinese: 关于你让我去看的那位客人……

English: I'm here on behalf of a customer called Nadja.
Chinese: 我是替一位叫娜佳的客人来的。

English: About your customer, Nadja...
Chinese: 关于你的客人娜佳……

English: What's in it for me?
Chinese: 我能得到什么好处？

English: I'll see what I can do.
Chinese: 我尽力而为。

English: Remind me who I'm looking for again?
Chinese: 再提醒一下，我要找的人是谁？

English: It's not good. I'm afraid she's very sick.
Chinese: 情况不好。恐怕她病得很重。

English: Where did you say I'd find the good doctor?
Chinese: 你刚说那位好医生在哪来着？

English: I believe you have some money for me from Doctor Pripp.
Chinese: 我记得普里普医生有笔钱要交给你转交。

English: Yasmeen is going to start selling Nadja's visions from home. I thought you should know.
Chinese: 亚斯敏打算在家出售娜佳的幻象了。我想你该知道。

English: Nothing just now.
Chinese: 暂时没有。

English: You're well-connected in the vision trade. You must know someone who can help.
Chinese: 你在幻象行业人脉广。一定有认识的人能帮忙。

English: Am I meant to believe you didn't notice your 'best customer' was an addict?
Chinese: 你要我相信你没注意到你的"最好的客人"是个成瘾者？

English: Thanks, Vidal.
Chinese: 谢谢，维达尔。

English: <<[Hand back the money]>> Give this Yasmeen when you see her. I didn't do this for the coin.
Chinese: <<[把钱递回去]>>见到亚斯敏时把这个给她。我干这个不是为了钱。

English: <<Within a few minutes of emptying the bottle, you fall into a deep yet restless sleep...>>
Chinese: <<喝空瓶子没几分钟，你就坠入一场深沉却辗转难安的睡眠……>>

English: <<You're in your childhood cottage in the mountains of the Clockwork Kingdom, where gods in extravagant brass masks have gathered to coordinate their plans for the end of time.>>
Chinese: <<你置身于发条王国群山间的童年小屋，戴着华丽铜面具的诸神齐聚一堂，正在协调他们终结时代的计划。>>

English: <<You try every rhetorical gambit you can imagine to make them postpone it, but the discussion gets lost in irrelevant details.>>##What will we tell the Hydra?"<< objects the surgeon-god of death.>>"
Chinese: <<你用尽想象得到的种种言辞策略，劝他们把计划推迟，可讨论却岔进了无关的细枝末节。>>##我们怎么跟九头蛇交代？"<<死亡与外科之神抗议道。>>"

English: <<You wake up with a sense of creeping doom.>>
Chinese: <<你醒来时，心头爬满不祥的预感。>>

English: <<You walk along a pine-forested clifftop with a beautiful woman, on the shore of a great inland lake.##It's your last day together, and it's perfect.>>
Chinese: <<你与一位美丽的女人并肩走在松林覆盖的崖顶，脚下是一片巨大的内陆湖。##这是你们相处的最后一天，而这一天完美无瑕。>>

English: <<As you lie beside her by the fire that night, listening to the rhythmic crash and hiss of the waves, she tells you that you're going to be okay.##You believe her.>>
Chinese: <<夜里，你们并肩躺在火堆旁，听着海浪有节奏的拍击与嘶鸣，她告诉你：一切都会好起来的。##你信了她。>>

English: <<You wake with a feeling of inconsolable loss.##Later, you notice that the label reads>> in loving memory"."
Chinese: <<你带着难以排解的失落醒来。##后来，你注意到标签上写着>>致挚爱的回忆"。"

English: <<You're trying to join the Machinists' Guild, but every time you go to take the exam you are foiled by malevolent shadows that no one else can see.>>
Chinese: <<你想加入机械师公会，可每次去参加考核，都会被只有你能看见的恶意阴影搅局。>>

English: <<You enlist your own shadow to help, only to find yourself becoming dimmer and foggier while it grows ever more substantial..>>
Chinese: <<你召来自己的影子帮忙，结果你变得越来越暗淡模糊，它却越来越实体化……>>

English: <<You wake up with the feeling you're being watched.>>
Chinese: <<你醒来时，总觉得有什么在盯着你。>>

English: <<Heinrich is stalking you through the hedge maze. He keeps shouting obscenities about your friends so that you'll laugh and reveal your position.>>
Chinese: <<海因里希正穿过树篱迷宫追捕你。他不停大喊辱骂你朋友们的脏话，好让你笑出声、暴露位置。>>

English: <<Eventually he succeeds, and you drag him into the brambles to make the most mind-blowing love you've ever known.>>
Chinese: <<最终他得手了，你把他拖进荆棘丛，度过了你有生以来最神魂颠倒的一夜春宵。>>

English: <<You wake up tingling, with the ghost of whiskey on your lips.>>
Chinese: <<你醒来时浑身酥麻，唇上还残留着威士忌的余味。>>

English: <<Your pet hunting spider has stolen your moustache.##She looks ridiculous, but she's far too agile to catch, and crosses her pedipalps at even the most succulent bribe.>>
Chinese: <<你的宠物猎蛛偷走了你的胡子。##她那模样可笑极了，可她灵活得根本抓不住，连最肥美的贿赂都只换来一对须肢交叉成 X。>>

English: <<Everyone keeps tittering at your naked upper lip. When you appeal to the Clockwork King, it just sighs:>> She never listens to me, either...""
Chinese: <<大家都在偷笑你光溜溜的上唇。你向发条王申诉，它只是叹气：>>它从来也不听我的……""

English: <<You wake up oddly interested in getting a pet hunting spider.>>
Chinese: <<你醒来时，莫名很想养一只宠物猎蛛。>>

English: <<Your rival's cutlass swishes and clangs as he pushes you back along the yardarm with deft strokes. Smoke from the burning sails stings your eyes.>>## Last chance, dog!" <<he snarls.>> "Apologise for crashing my wedding!""
Chinese: <<死敌的弯刀呼啸铿锵，招招精妙地把你逼退到帆桁端头。燃烧的船帆浓烟刺痛你的双眼。>>##最后一机会了，狗东西！"<<他咆哮。>>"为我撞烂我的婚礼道歉！""

English: <<It seems like only yesterday you were playing cards together in the quiet orlop deck, nestled among coiled ropes as thick as your thigh under the pale phosphorescence of the ship's gargantuan hull-mending slime mould.>>
Chinese: <<仿佛就在昨天，你们还在安静的底层甲板上打牌，盘着的大腿粗的缆绳间，在船体巨大补船黏菌的淡淡磷光下相偎。>>

English: <<Back in the present the slime mould sings as it dies.##Your ship lists heavily to port, and your rival loses his footing, but on a split-second impulse you lunge down and seize his hand.>>
Chinese: <<回到此刻，黏菌在死去时歌唱。##你的船向左舷严重倾侧，死敌脚下一滑，可你在一瞬间俯身抓住了他的手。>>

English: <<He dangles, staring up into your eyes with a mixture of fury and something else...>>
Chinese: <<他悬在半空，抬头瞪着你的双眼，目光里有愤怒，还有别的什么……>>

English: <<You wake up with nerves a-flutter, eager to dream again.>>
Chinese: <<你醒来时心潮荡漾，迫不及待想再入梦境。>>

English: Welcome to the [[graveyard]], pal. What brings you all the way out here?
Chinese: 欢迎来到[[墓场]]，伙计。大老远跑来做什么？

English: Was there owt else?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗？

English: Heh. Funny sort o' gravestones, ain't they?
Chinese: 嘿。这些墓碑是不是挺逗的？

English: This is where they keeps the things the [[Clockwork King]] makes wot no one can find a use for.##Teapots, chess sets, bathtubs, grand pianos – it all ends up here. Some things, nobody even knows what they are.
Chinese: 这儿埋的是[[发条王]]造出来、却没人找得到用处的玩意儿。##茶壶、棋具、浴缸、三角钢琴——最后全归这儿。有些东西，连是啥都没人知道。

English: Why Its Majesty makes 'em I couldn't tell you.##There's plenty o' stuff people'd give their left arms for that ain't getting built. But it's not for me to question the logic of our King.
Chinese: 陛下为什么造它们，我可说不上来。##多少人人求都得不来，偏偏不造。可国王的逻辑，轮不到我多嘴。

English: Blimey, you mean someone's actually bin ((readin')) my reports? Better late than never, I s'pose.
Chinese: 老天，居然还真有人((读))我的报告？晚来总比不来强吧。

English: It's these [[yellow boxes]], see. We've had 'em for years, but even the King's Speaker hisself couldn't make head nor tail of 'em. Told me to look after 'em 'til they're needed. That'll be the day.
Chinese: 就是这些[[黄盒子]]。摆在这儿好些年了，连国王代言人本尊都摸不着头脑。让我照看着，等用得上的时候。等着吧，有那天。

English: Well, a fair few ticks ago, some of the [[boxes]] started [[talkin']], and now they won't shut up!##Weird stuff. Music, sometimes. Mind, I knows better than to listen.
Chinese: 嗯，不久前，有些[[盒子]]开始[[说话]]了，现在还停不下来！##怪事。有时是音乐。不过我懂规矩，不去听。

English: Maybe you could take a look?##Most of the boxes here don't talk, you'll have to [[listen closely]] if you want to find the right ones.
Chinese: 要不你去看看？##这儿大多数盒子不说话，想找对的那几只，你得[[仔细听]]。

English: Anyroad, here's the [[key]] to get inside. I'll stay put where it's nice and warm, if you don't mind.
Chinese: 反正，这是进场的[[钥匙]]。我就待在暖和的地方不挪窝了，你不介意吧。

English: Sorry, pal. No visitors allowed, unless you're on [[official business]]. More'n my job's worth to let any old weirdo poke around in there.
Chinese: 抱歉，伙计。谢绝参观，除非你有[[公务]]。放任何古怪家伙进去乱翻，我这份工就没了。

English: Well, were you able to figure anything of those [[yellow boxes]]?
Chinese: 怎么样，那些[[黄盒子]]研究出什么名堂了吗？

English: Most of them here don't talk, you'll have to [[listen closely]] if you want to find the right ones.
Chinese: 这儿大多数盒子不说话，想找对的那几只，你得[[仔细听]]。

English: Seems like they've gone quiet...##I guess whatever you did worked, eh?
Chinese: 看来它们安静下来了……##想必你那招管用了，嗯？

English: This doesn't look like any graveyard I've seen.
Chinese: 这看着可不像我见过的任何墓场。

English: Actually, I'm here to inspect the graveyard. Official business.
Chinese: 其实，我是来检查墓场的。公务。

English: I'll be going now.
Chinese: 我先走了。

English: Can I look inside the graveyard?
Chinese: 我能进墓场里看看吗？

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> I'm here on official business.
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>我是来执行公务的。

English: <<The machine emits a grating rattle. After a moment, you realize that it's the distorted sound of human snoring.>>
Chinese: <<机器发出刺耳的咔啦声。片刻后你才意识到，那是人打鼾的失真声。>>

English: <<The snoring continues, heedless of your presence. It seems you'll have to come back later.>>
Chinese: <<鼾声依旧，毫不理会你的到来。看来你只能稍后再来。>>

English: <<Perhaps you should come back later.>>
Chinese: <<也许你该稍后再来。>>

English: <<The machine emits a buzz, this time with an encouraging tone. It seems the door is already open to you.>>
Chinese: <<机器发出一阵蜂鸣，这次的调子颇有鼓励意味。看来门早已对你敞开。>>

English: <<The machine emits a buzz, then a distorted human voice.>> ##Go away! Nobody's home.
Chinese: <<机器发出蜂鸣，随后是失真的人声。>>##走开！家里没人。

English: <<Bzzzt.>>##Didn't I tell ya to buzz off?
Chinese: <<哔。>>##我不是叫你走远点吗？

English: <<Bzzzt.>>##Like I said, nobody. Nobody here, nothing available. Get the picture?
Chinese: <<哔。>>##都说了，没人。这儿没人，什么都没有。懂了吗？

English: Is this what ya do for fun? I'm closing this channel. ##<<There is a click, then silence.>>
Chinese: 你就拿这个解闷？我要关闭这条频道了。##<<咔哒一声，随后是寂静。>>

English: <<Bzzzt.>>##Wow, sorry to hear that. I'm rootin' for ya though.
Chinese: <<哔。>>##哇，节哀。那我给你加油。

English: <<Bzzzt.>>##Never heard a' them.
<<Bzzzt.>>##Great. Now like I said, buzz off.
Chinese: <<哔。>>##很好。照我说的，走远点。

English: <<A long pause, then a loud clunk.>> ##<<Bzzzt.>> Door's unlocked. Wipe yer boots.
Chinese: <<长久的停顿，然后一声响亮的闷响。>> ##<<哔。>>门开了。擦擦你的靴子。

English: <<A pause.>> You said Cohen? ((Cohen)) sent you? ##<<There follows a string of barely-intelligible curses that would whiten a sky sailor's hair.>>
Chinese: <<停顿。>>你说科恩？((科恩))派你来的？##<<接下来是一串几乎听不清的咒骂，足以让飞天水手当场白了头。>>

English: <<Bzzzt.>> Listen, sweetheart: I'll hear ya out for old times' sake. But this ain't no charitable order. You want me to scratch your ass, you better scratch mine.
Chinese: <<哔。>>听着，甜心：看在旧日情分上，我可以听你说完。但这儿可不是慈善机构。你想让我帮你挠背，你最好也帮我挠。

English: I'm waiting on a ((delivery)). Two weeks late now. Odds are the courier met their maker trying to get through that [[old ruined factory]] on the way here.
Chinese: 我在等一份((包裹))。已经晚了两个星期。八成是信使在来的路上，想穿过那座[[破败老工厂]]时见了上帝。

English: Bring me that [[parcel]], then we'll talk.
Chinese: 把那个[[包裹]]给我拿来，我们再谈。

English: <<Bzzzt.>> If you ain't got my [[parcel]], I ain't interested.
Chinese: <<哔。>>没带我的[[包裹]]，就免谈。

English: %% <<A long pause, then a loud clunk.>> ##<<Bzzzt.>> Door's unlocked. Wipe yer boots.
Chinese: %% <<长久的停顿，然后一声响亮的闷响。>> ##<<哔。>>门开了。擦擦你的靴子。

English: && Nice try, sweetheart, but I can see ya as well as hear ya. Come back when you've got the goods.
Chinese: && 想得美，甜心。我能看见你，就跟听见你一样。带齐了货再来。

English: Hello? Wake up!
Chinese: 喂？醒醒！

English: <<[Let them rest.]>>
If nobody's home, who are you?
Chinese: 既然家里没人，你又是谁？

English: I'm looking for Morozov. Is this the right tower?
Chinese: 我在找莫罗佐夫。是这座塔吗？

English: Please, I need shelter! I'm being pursued by rogue machines!
Chinese: 求你了，我需要避难！失控的机器在追我！

English: Buzzing off.
Chinese: 这就"走远点"。

English: Maybe I want to talk to nobody about nothing.
Chinese: 也许我就想跟"没人"聊聊"没有"的事。

English: Chief Interpreter Aphra sent me. It's about the Sydovski Problem.
Chinese: 首席释经官阿芙拉派我来的。是关于希多夫斯基难题。

English: Cleanup Worker Cohen sent me. Said you could help me.
Chinese: 清理工科恩派我来的。说你能帮我。

English: Did I say something wrong?
Chinese: 我说错什么话了？

English: Sounds like there's no love lost between you.
Chinese: 听起来你们俩积怨不浅。

English: Actually, I have your parcel right here.
Chinese: 其实，你的包裹就在我这儿。

English: @@ <<[Lie]>> Oh, you mean ((this)) parcel? It's a little blood-stained, but it looks intact.
Chinese: @@ <<[撒谎]>>哦，你说的是((这个))包裹？沾了点血，但看着还完整。

English: I'll see what I can do.
Chinese: 我尽力试试。

English: <<The stout, ageing Machinist looks surprised to see you.>> ##What? How'd ya get inside? Get outta here right now or my security'll fry ya to a crisp!
Chinese: <<这位粗壮的年迈机械师见到你颇为吃惊。>>##什么？你怎么进来的？马上滚出去，不然我的安保系统会把你炸成薯片！

English: What? Why in the hell would I do that? I'll have you know I'm in the middle a' some ((very)) important work...
Chinese: 什么？我他妈为什么要走？你给我搞清楚，我正在干((非常重要))的工作……

English: <<She scratches her head.>> Oh yeah, so I did. Where's that parcel you...? ##<<She looks you up and down.>> Ahhhh, son of a god. You ain't got nothin', do ya?
Chinese: <<她挠挠头。>>哦对，我是说过来着。你那包裹……呢？##<<她上下打量你。>>啊啊，神的儿子。你什么都没带，对吧？

English: <<She narrows her eyes at you.>> You're a real wiseass, aintcha? Why dontcha try inspecting ((THIS))?!? ##<<She slams a button on her machine console.>>
Chinese: <<她眯眼瞪你。>>你嘴还真是欠啊？要不要来见识见识((这个))？！##<<她一巴掌拍在机器控制台的按钮上。>>

English: <<Something in the ceiling sparks, then begins to smoke.>> ##Aw, son of a god! I just fixed that last week...
Chinese: <<天花板上什么东西迸出火花，接着冒起烟。>>##哦，神的儿子啊！我上星期才修好的……

English: Well, what the hell d'ya want? I'll have you know I'm in the middle a' some ((very)) important work...
Chinese: 那么，你到底想要什么？你给我搞清楚，我正在干((非常重要))的工作……

English: ...and I'm guessing you ain't got my ((parcel)), neither. ##Well, what the hell d'ya want? I'll have you know I'm in the middle a' some ((very)) important work...
Chinese: ……我猜你也没带我的((包裹))。##那么，你到底想要什么？你给我搞清楚，我正在干((非常重要))的工作……

English: <<You notice a cheaply-bound romance open spine up beside her, plus stacks of dirty plates and half-empty teacups.>>
Chinese: <<你注意到她手边摊着一本装帧廉价的言情书，书脊朝上，旁边堆着脏盘子 and 喝了一半的茶杯。>>

English: Ugh, can't ya leave a girl in peace? Whaddya want now? ##<<A cheaply-bound romance lies open spine up beside her, along with stacks of dirty plates and half-empty teacups.>>
Chinese: 唉，你就不能让姑娘清静清静？这回又要干嘛？##<<她手边摊着一本装帧廉价的言情书，书脊朝上，旁边堆着脏盘子和喝了一半的茶杯。>>

English: Ugh, can't ya leave a girl in peace? Whaddya want now?
Chinese: 唉，你就不能让姑娘清静清静？这回又要干嘛？

English: Are we done here, darlin'? I ain't got all day. Or night. What time is it again?
Chinese: 我们的事谈完了吗，亲爱的？我可没一整天。或者一整晚。现在几点来着？

English: <<She snatches the parcel with alarming speed and tears it open, revealing a clutch of bottled visions.>> ##Oh ho ho! Well, if it ain't the latest Metcalfe. Come to mama...
Chinese: <<她以惊人的手速夺过包裹撕开，里面是一把瓶装幻象。>>##哦嚯嚯！这不是最新一期的梅特卡夫嘛。到妈妈这儿来……

English: <<She seems to remember your presence.>> ##Ugh, why are you still here? You said somethin' about [[Cohen]]?
Chinese: <<她似乎才想起你的存在。>>##呃，你怎么还在这儿？你刚才说什么来着，[[科恩]]？

English: <<She seems to remember your presence.>> ##Shit, I guess I oughta throw ya some coin. Shame about the courier, but one soul's fate is another's fortune, right?
Chinese: <<她似乎才想起你的存在。>>##妈的，按理我该扔你几个硬币。信使死得挺惨，不过一个人的命就是另一个人的财，对吧？

English: Now, show yerself out, willya? Auntie Morozov's gonna be a little busy.
Chinese: 现在，自己找路出去好吗？莫罗佐夫阿姨要忙上一阵了。

English: Moderator, sweetheart, it's a [[Cranial Moderator]]. ##<<She scratches her head.>> Aphra, huh? Bitch won't even write me, and now she wants a favour. I guess she knows I can't say no to her...
Chinese: 调节器，亲爱的，它的全名是[[颅腔调节器]]。##<<她挠挠头。>>阿芙拉？这个贱人连信都不给我写，现在倒想起要我帮忙了。看来她知道我没法拒绝她……

English: <<Morozov shakes her head.>> That dumb bitch...
Chinese: <<莫罗佐夫摇头。>>那个蠢婆娘……

English: ((Know her))? Ha, sure. Me and Aphra, we go... way back. What's she dreamin' about these days? Ahhh, don't tell me, I don't want any part of it.
Chinese: ((认识她))？哈，当然。我和阿芙拉，我们可是……老交情了。她这些天在梦见什么？啊，别告诉我，我不想沾边。

English: Pshh. It's a famous problem in cipher theory, about whether ya could use an 'Advance Time' spell to go ((backwards)). We were both assigned to work on it, years ago now – it's how we met.
Chinese: 呸。那是密文理论里一个著名的难题：能不能用"跨越时间"法术((倒着))走。多年前我们俩都被派去研究它——我们就是这么认识的。

English: Doesn't seem like I can stop ya. Whaddya wanna know?
Chinese: 看来我也拦不住你。想知道什么？

English: What else d'ya wanna know?
Chinese: 还想知道什么？

English: Name's [[Morozov]]. I'm a cranial engineer, which means I know how to jam a buncha clockwork inta your brain without turnin' ya inta a prize cabbage.
Chinese: 我叫[[莫罗佐夫]]。颅腔工程师，也就是说，我知道怎么往你脑子里塞一堆发条零件，还不把你塞成一颗极品卷心菜。

English: As if that weren't talent enough, I'm also wunna this kingdom's most prolific dreamers. If ya've ever tried a bottled vision, chances are ya've sampled the fruit a' this crafty ol' noggin. <<She knocks on the side of her head.>>
Chinese: 这还没算完，我还是这个王国最多产的织梦者之一。你要是试过瓶装幻象，八成品尝过我这颗机灵老脑瓜的果实。<<她敲敲自己的太阳穴。>>

English: Involved? I practically keep it in business! I sell a lotta visions, but I buy too; ya might call me a connoisseur. Ya gotta know good art to make good art, right?
Chinese: 参与？这行当简直靠我养着！我卖大量幻象，我也买；你可以叫我行家。得懂好艺术，才做得出好艺术，对吧？

English: Vision trade's about the only business we got left in this kingdom, and it ain't hard to see why. Folk outside the Kingdom go crazy for it too. I guess however bad things get, our dreams are still worth somethin'.
Chinese: 幻象贸易是这王国硕果仅存的生意了，原因不难猜。王国外面的人也为它疯狂。看来世道再烂，我们的梦还是值几个钱的。

English: I saw all this coming, yaknow. The winter, the Corruption – all a'it, or close enough. It didn't take a genius to see things would get bad. It's all there in the royal output logs, not to mention right before yer eyes.
Chinese: 这一切我早就料到了，你懂的。寒冬、腐化——全都，或者八九不离十。看出事情会变糟不需要天才。王室输出日志里写得明明白白，更别提就摆在你眼皮底下。

English: So, I made a big noise about needin' peace an' quiet for my work. What can I say? Ya girl's a drama queen. Guild gave me this tower, and here I am in blessed isolation. At least until some galoot like you shows up.
Chinese: 于是，我大张旗鼓地宣称工作需要安静。怎么说呢？本姑娘就是个戏精。公会给了我这座塔，于是我便在受祝福的与世隔绝中安顿下来。直到某个像你这样的莽汉出现。

English: <<She grins toothily.>> A rare quality, ain't it. But what are they gonna do – hang me? Then who'll keep all their own skulls tickin' away, and fix up the new recruits?
Chinese: <<她咧嘴露齿一笑。>>这可是稀罕品质，嗯。但他们能拿我怎么样——绞死我？那他们自己那些脑袋谁来保它滴答走，新兵谁来装？

English: The Guild loves to eat its own, but all the other cranial engineers got eaten long ago. Go ahead, report me: they love to shoot the messenger, too.
Chinese: 公会最爱吃自己人，可其他颅腔工程师早就被吃光了。去举报吧：他们同样爱杀信使。

English: Listen, darlin', you didn't ask, but take it from me: the Clockwork Kingdom is doomed. If yer smart, you'll do as I do, find a safe place to hole up, and stay put 'til it all comes crashing down.
Chinese: 听着亲爱的，虽然你没问，但听我一句：发条王国完蛋了。你要是聪明，就学我，找个安全地方猫起来，等一切轰然倒塌之前别挪窝。

English: Oh, you can always hope, darlin'. Be my guest.
Chinese: 哦，希望嘛，随时可以有，亲爱的。请便。

English: Ain't gonna lie, that's the craziest thing I ever heard – and I'm a ((Machinist)). But who am I to tell ya not to chase that rainbow? Anyway, I owe ya for finding my parcel.
Chinese: 不瞒你说，这是我听过最疯的话——我可是个((机械师))。但凭什么叫你别去追彩虹？反正，你帮我找到了包裹，我欠你一份情。

English: Ya want ((what?)) ##...wow, yer actually serious. Fine, go ahead and chase that rainbow. But what do I get in return?
Chinese: 你想要((什么？))##……哇，你是认真的。行，去追你的彩虹吧。那我图什么？

English: I'm waiting on a ((delivery)). Two weeks late now. Odds are the courier met their maker trying to get through that [[old ruined factory]] on the way here. ##Bring me that [[parcel]], then we'll talk.
Chinese: 我在等一份((包裹))。已经晚了两个星期。八成是信使在来的路上，想穿过那座[[破败老工厂]]时见了上帝。##把那个[[包裹]]给我拿来，我们再谈。

English: %% <<She sizes you up.>> ##Ugh, you sure drive a hard bargain. Fine, let Auntie Morozov fix ya up, if it'll get ya outa here...
Chinese: %% <<她上下打量你。>>##呃，你这买卖砍得真狠。行，莫罗佐夫阿姨给你装，只要你赶紧消失……

English: Ugh, you sure drive a hard bargain. Fine, let Auntie Morozov fix ya up, if it'll get ya outa here...
Chinese: 呃，你这买卖砍得真狠。行，莫罗佐夫阿姨给你装，只要你赶紧消失……

English: && Nice try, sweetheart. Nobody who's already safe an' warm in Ferropolis is gonna make that trek on a rumour – and if they try, they'll be cut to shreds by rogue machines. But I like yer style, so I'm gonna make a counter-offer.
Chinese: && 想得美，甜心。一个已经在铁城安居乐业的人，绝不会凭一句传闻跑这趟腿——真要来，早被失控的机器剁成渣了。不过我喜欢你的路数，所以我给你个反向提议。

English: Now listen, sweetheart: gettin' ya brain to accept a big hunk a' gears as part of itself ain't exactly a cakewalk. I need a slice a' ya meat that's got deep connections to all the rest.
Chinese: 现在听着，甜心：让你脑子接受一大坨齿轮是"自己的一部分"，可不是散步那么轻松。我需要你身上一块肉，一块和其余部分联系深密的肉。

English: Pick a person – someone ya really cherished, see, someone that made ya who ya are. Yer gonna forget 'em, and I'll stick the [[Cranial Moderator]] in their place. It'll be as dear to ya as they were, heh heh.
Chinese: 挑一个人——真正被你珍惜的人，塑造了今天的你的人。你会忘掉他们，而我把[[颅腔调节器]]装进那个位置。它会像他们一样亲，嘿嘿。

English: Don't tell me about 'em – I don't care. Just think of 'em. Say yer goodbyes, hey?
Chinese: 别跟我讲他们——我不关心。只在心里想着他们。道个别吧，嗯？

English: Ahhhh, spoilsport. Well, you ain't the first to chicken out. You change yer mind, ya know where to find me.
Chinese: 啊啊，扫兴鬼。好吧，你不是第一个临阵脱逃的。改主意了，你知道上哪找我。

English: That's right, just like that... come to mama... ##<<You fall into a black and timeless place.>>
Chinese: 对，就这样……到妈妈这儿来……##<<你坠入一个漆黑而超越时间的地方。>>

English: <<When you come to, your head feels heavier than before.>> ##...stupid thing, where'd I leave it... ##Well hey now! Look who's awake. How ya doin', sweetheart?
Chinese: <<你醒来时，脑袋比之前沉了。>>##……蠢东西，我把它放哪了……##哟！瞧瞧谁醒了。感觉怎么样，甜心？

English: Truer words were never spoken, hun. Well, seems the Moderator went in nice and smooth. Congratulations; yer part machine.
Chinese: 说得真不赖，宝贝儿。嗯，调节器装得又顺又稳。恭喜；你半是机器了。

English: All make sense to ya?
Chinese: 都弄明白了吗？

English: Now ya can understand the Sixfold cipher language of our glorious King. Read it, write it, speak it, hear it – or shove it up yer ass for all I care.
Chinese: 现在你能读懂我们光荣国王的六重密文语言了。读、写、说、听——或者拿它捅屁股，随你的便。

English: Oh, sure. Watch out for migraines, seizures, deafness, blindness, aneurysms, nightmares, prophetic dreams, mental decline, partial or total amnesia, paranoia, delusions a' being dead, religious ecstasy and/or agony, out a'body experiences, Wycliffe's Idiocy, gangrene...
Chinese: 哦，当然。小心偏头痛、癫痫、失聪、失明、动脉瘤、噩梦、预言梦、智力衰退、部分或全部失忆、偏执、自己已死的妄想、宗教狂喜和/或狂痛、灵魂出窍、威克里夫白痴症、坏疽……

English: You'll want to come in for a check-up every few years; some a' those metals are a little toxic. ##Worst of all: whenever someone has a problem with the King's magic, they'll ask ((you)) to fix it.
Chinese: 每隔几年你得回来复查一次；有些金属略带毒性。##最糟的是：谁跟国王的魔法起了冲突，都会来找((你))修。

English: Ugh, I shoulda farmed silkslugs.
Chinese: 唉，我早该去养丝蛞蝓的。

English: Don't mention it, darlin'. No really, don't. In fact, leave my tower and don't speak to me again. Nothin' personal, but I got a hot date with a cheese wheel I've been savin'.
Chinese: 不客气，亲爱的。不，说真的，别客气。我的意思是，滚出我的塔，以后别再跟我说话。不是针对你，我跟一块存了好久的奶酪轮有个火热的约会。

English: Hey, all sales are final, no take-backs.
Chinese: 嘿，货既售出，概不退换。

English: ...hey, wait one gods-damned tick! I already ((did)) your Moderator, ya prize nitwit. ##Now don't worry, hun – a little amnesia is perfectly normal after the procedure. Although it don't usually last this long...
Chinese: ……喂，等一下，等一下你这上帝的滴答！你的调节器我((已经装了))，你这宝贝蠢货。##别担心，宝贝——术后有点失忆完全正常。虽然一般不会持续这么久……

English: Sure, sure. I guess technically it's my 'job' or something. ##My condolences on becoming her new recruit. If you ask me, the Guild's a sinkin' ship.
Chinese: 行行。严格说算我的'本职'什么的吧。##节哀，你成了她的新兵了。要我说，公会就是艘正在下沉的船。

English: <<Morozov listens to your tale with escalating incredulity, and frequent interjections.>>
Chinese: <<莫罗佐夫越听越难以置信，不断插嘴。>>

English: ...Say ((what?)) ##...Get the ((fuck)) outa here! ##...Are you serious?!
<<One you're finished, she laughs.>> ##Darlin', how can I put this kindly? Yer nuts. Absolutely, certifiably, bats-in-the-belfry, six-teeth-short-of-a-cogwheel, over-the-rainbow doolally.
Chinese: <<你讲完后，她大笑。>>##亲爱的，我该怎么委婉地说呢？你疯了。彻头彻尾、持证上岗、阁楼里有蝙蝠、齿轮少六齿、彩虹那头住的疯婆子。

English: You want me to misappropriate royal resources to perform a strictly regulated techno-surgical procedure on an unsanctioned stranger who ((ain't)) part of the Machinists' Guild, all so you can trace one poor missing fuck?
Chinese: 你要我挪用王室资源，对一个((根本))不属于机械师公会的、未获批准的陌生人，执行一项受严格管制的技术外科手术，就为了追查一个可怜的失踪人口？

English: <<She cackles.>> I love it! Listen, I musta installed these implants inta ((hundreds)) of damn fool kids. And for what? All so they can spend the rest a' their lives bossing people around and suckling on the King's copper tit.
Chinese: <<她咯咯笑。>>我喜欢！听着，这些植入体我装过((几百))个傻乎乎的小年轻。图什么？图他们下半辈子吆五喝六，吮着国王的铜奶头。

English: <<Morozov ignores you as she begins gathering up books, notes, and alarming-looking medical instruments.>>
Chinese: <<莫罗佐夫不理你，开始收拾书本、笔记和一堆看着吓人的医疗器械。>>

English: Ah, shit. Looks like Auntie [[Morozov's]] in debug mode. Well? What the hell d'ya want?
Chinese: 啊，妈的。看来[[莫罗佐夫]]阿姨进了调试模式。怎么样？你他妈想干什么？

English: Sure, whatever. The sooner I can get back to my work, the better. Izzat all?
Chinese: 行，随便。越早回去干活越好。就这些？

English: Here goes nothin', I guess...
Chinese: 那开始吧，管他呢……

English: Um, you let me in?
Chinese: 呃，是你放我进来的？

English: I'm the official door lock inspector. You failed.
Chinese: 我是官方门锁检查员。你不合格。

English: I'm ready to install the Cranial Moderator now.
Chinese: 我现在可以装颅腔调节器了。

English: Here's your parcel. The courier didn't make it.
Chinese: 你的包裹。信使没能走到。

English: Aphra wants me to get a... 'Cranial Modulator'?
Chinese: 阿芙拉让我来装个……"颅腔调节器"？

English: I need a Machinist skull implant so I can speak to the Corrupted.
Chinese: 我需要一个机械师颅骨植入体，好跟腐化者说话。

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗？

English: I'll leave you to your, um, 'work'.
Chinese: 不打扰你的，呃，"工作"了。

English: Not yet. I still have business with you.
Chinese: 还没有。我还有事找你。

English: I'm searching for a child nobody can remember.
Chinese: 我在找一个没有人记得的孩子。

English: You know her well?
Chinese: 你跟她很熟？

English: What is the 'Sydovski Problem', anyway?
Chinese: 希多夫斯基难题到底是什么？

English: So you'll help, then?
Chinese: 那你是愿意帮我了？

English: Tell me more about yourself.
Chinese: 再多讲讲你自己。

English: So you're involved in the vision trade?
Chinese: 这么说你也做幻象生意？

English: Let me ask you something else.
Chinese: 我问点别的。

English: What are you doing all the way out here?
Chinese: 你怎么跑到这么远的地方来了？

English: You're... remarkably frank about the Kingdom's problems.
Chinese: 你……对王国的问题倒是相当坦率。

English: That's all my questions.
Chinese: 我的问题问完了。

English: Do you truly think there's no hope?
Chinese: 你真觉得毫无希望了吗？

English: Thanks for the tip, I suppose.
Chinese: 多谢指点，算是吧。

English: What do you need?
Chinese: 你需要我做什么？

English: @@ If you refuse, I'll tell everyone in Ferropolis that you're offering food and shelter. And that your door doesn't work.
Chinese: @@ 你要是拒绝，我就告诉全铁城的人，你这儿管吃管住。还有，你家门锁是坏的。

English: <<[Forget your parents. You've given up trying to make them understand.]>>
Chinese: <<[忘掉你的父母。你早已放弃让他们理解你。]>>

English: <<[Forget your first love. You needn't carry that heartbreak anymore.]>>
Chinese: <<[忘掉你的初恋。那份心碎你不必再背了。]>>

English: <<[Forget your best friend. It hurts to think how far apart you've grown.]>>
Chinese: <<[忘掉你的挚友。想起你们渐行渐远，还是心疼。]>>

English: <<[Forget your mentor. You still feel the sting of their disappointment.]>>
Chinese: <<[忘掉你的恩师。他们失望的目光仍刺着你。]>>

English: Actually, I don't think I can do this.
Chinese: 其实，我做不到。

English: Argh.
Chinese: 呃啊。

English: Blurgh.
Chinese: 呕。

English: Glrrrgh.
Chinese: 咯咯呕。

English: What can I do now that it's installed?
Chinese: 装好了之后，我能用它做什么？

English: Are there any drawbacks?
Chinese: 有什么副作用吗？

English: Thanks. I guess we're done here.
Chinese: 谢谢。我想我们的事就到这儿吧。

English: I hope you're very happy together.
Chinese: 祝你们幸福美满。

English: Actually, there's something else we must discuss.
Chinese: 其实，还有件事我们必须谈谈。

English: I still have questions about the Cranial Moderator.
Chinese: 关于颅腔调节器，我还有问题。

English: Not until you've installed that skull implant.
Chinese: 等你装好那个颅骨植入体再说。

English: Sure, once you've done what you promised.
Chinese: 行，等你兑现承诺再说。

English: Yes.
Chinese: 是。

English: I'll do whatever's necessary to reach the truth.
Chinese: 为了触及真相，什么都在所不惜。

English: When you put it like that, it does sound a little mad.
Chinese: 你这么一说，听起来确实有点疯。

English: I promise you I won't be doing ((that)).
Chinese: 我向你保证，我((绝不会))干那种事。

English: Wait, does the King actually have...?
Chinese: 等等，国王真有那个……？

English: Well, child, do you see anything else that interests you?
Chinese: 好了孩子，还有别的看上眼的吗？

English: <<You see a middle-aged person with light brown skin and an eyepatch, dressed in an eclectic patchwork of colourful fabrics. You can't quite figure out their gender, which seems deliberate.>>
Chinese: <<眼前是个中年人，浅棕色皮肤，戴着眼罩，浑身拼贴着五颜六色的布料。你猜不透他们的性别——这似乎是故意的。>>

English: Why, hello there, child. Come to browse?
Chinese: 哎哟，孩子，来逛逛？

English: <<The gaudy trader squints at you, then glances left and right to check nobody is listening. They beckon you closer...>>
Chinese: <<花枝招展的摊主眯眼打量你，然后左顾右盼，确认没人偷听。他们朝你招了招手……>>

English: Why, charms and trinkets to attract the favour of the Clockwork King – or ward off Its Majesty's displeasure. Look here...
Chinese: 哎，都是些求发条王开恩的小护符小玩意儿——或者挡陛下不快的。你看这个……

English: This cogwheel was plucked from the King's own belly, inscribed with sacred Sixfold cipher. Worn around your neck, it will grant you fortune at summoning stations.
Chinese: 这枚齿轮是从国王自己肚子里取出来的，錾着神圣的六重密文。戴在脖子上，召唤站里手气会变好。

English: Or this incense. Burn it while you write a petition to the King, and it shall speed your request...
Chinese: 或者这炷香。给国王写呈文时点上它，你的请求就会办得快些……

English: The name is [[Reza]], child. Fortune teller, trinket vendor, and listener on many grapevines. For a price, I can sell you talismans of luck and protection, or perhaps even give a little advice about your problems.
Chinese: 我名叫[[雷扎]]，孩子。算命的、卖小玩意儿的，还有好多条消息道上的耳朵。只要价钱合适，我可以卖你护身符，或者给你的难题出出主意。

English: <<Reza gives you a crooked grin.>> We are all children of the cosmos, no?
Chinese: <<雷扎咧嘴一笑。>>我们都是宇宙的孩子，不是吗？

English: King's blessings follow you, my child.
Chinese: 愿国王的祝福与你同行，我的孩子。

English: Everyone's problems are different, child. To truly help a person, there must be ((trust)), hmm?
Chinese: 每个人的难处都不一样，孩子。要真正帮一个人，得有((信任))，嗯？

English: && Alas, child, you are not the only one with reason to be wary. In time, I hope, we shall know each other better.
Chinese: && 唉，孩子，可不是只有你一个人需要提防着谁。来日方长，希望我们能慢慢熟络。

English: %% <<They examine you, then their expression softens.>> ##I am sorry, child. I can only imagine. This is not a good place for travellers, is it?
Chinese: %% <<他们端详你，神情柔和下来。>>##对不起，孩子。我感同身受。这地方对旅人可不算友好，是吧？

English: Everyone must deal with the King now and then. In my long life, I'm lucky to have learned a little of Its Majesty's ways. So I help people with their problems, as best I can. Nothing illegal – just advice.
Chinese: 谁都得时不时跟国王打交道。活了我这把年纪，我有幸摸清了陛下的一些脾气。所以我尽己所能，帮人解决难处。不干违法的事——只出主意。

English: I can coach you to file an appeal that the Guild will treat as 'high priority'. Diagnose misfiring magic in your building's heating engine. Interpret a royal proclamation you can't make sense of, perhaps even point you towards a friendly Machinist...
Chinese: 我可以教你怎么递申诉，让公会把它当"高优先级"处理。帮你诊断你那栋楼暖气引擎的魔法失灵。帮你解读看不懂的王室文告，甚至给你指个愿意帮忙的机械师……

English: I never cheat – no, no. I only help people find the path where everyone ends up happy. ##So you see, child: I too, in my own way, am a servant of the King.
Chinese: 我从不骗人——不不。我只是帮人找到皆大欢喜的路子。##所以你看，孩子：我以我自己的方式，也是国王的仆人。

English: <<They listen to your tale.>> ##Oh, my child. Quite an ordeal, hm? Show me your hand...
Chinese: <<他们听你讲完。>>##哦，我的孩子。可真是一番磨难，嗯？把手伸给我……

English: <<Reza traces their bony fingers gently along the lines of your palm, humming a hypnotic tune and swinging a cipher-inscribed vacuum tube back and forth on a sprocket chain.>>
Chinese: <<雷扎用枯瘦的手指轻轻抚过你的掌纹，哼着一段催眠的调子，链轮链上挂着一支錾了密文的真空管，来回晃荡。>>

English: The King has sensed that a terrible destiny stalks behind you, matching your step. You chase a strange star. Your quarry seeks to exhume the grave of history and rewrite the music of time...
Chinese: 国王察觉到，一个可怕的命运正跟在你身后，亦步亦趋。你在追一颗怪星。你的猎物想掘开历史的坟墓，重写时间的乐章……

English: Perhaps Its Majesty believes you have a role to play here in the Kingdom, too. ##<<They release your hand, smiling kindly.>> Or perhaps it is a mistake. The King does make them, you know.
Chinese: 也许陛下认为，你在这个王国也有一份角色要演。##<<他们松开你的手，慈祥地笑。>>又或许这只是个错误。国王嘛，也是会犯错的，你知道的。

English: <<They melt seamlessly into an attitude of gracious compliance.>> ##Child, why didn't you say? Of course, old Reza is an open book to the blessed Machinists' Guild...
Chinese: <<他们毫无痕迹地换上一副恭顺姿态。>>##孩子，你怎么不早说？当然啦，老雷扎在尊贵的机械师公会面前，向来知无不言……

English: Who told you to come here? Were you followed?
Chinese: 谁让你来这儿的？有人跟着你吗？

English: Hrmph. Good. ##<<They appraise you with their remaining eye.>>
Chinese: 哼，好。##<<他们用剩下的那只眼打量你。>>

English: Hrmph. You're the lippy sort, I see. ##<<They appraise you with their remaining eye.>>
Chinese: 哼，嘴还挺硬。##<<他们用剩下的那只眼打量你。>>

English: So you are the one who's helping Aphra. I see she's got your head stuffed with clockwork, like a good little Machinist. ##Tell me, did she explain what a [[Cranial Moderator]] ((does))?
Chinese: 原来帮阿芙拉的就是你。看得出她把你脑袋塞满了发条，活脱脱一个小机械师。##我问你，她有没有跟你解释[[颅腔调节器]]((到底))是干什么的？

English: Ha! I'm sure. So then, nobody warned you how a Cranial Moderator warps your thinking? Smoothes out any ((irrational)) notions? Makes you look at the world like a Machinist, seeing everything as a puzzle you can solve?
Chinese: 哈！我就知道。那么，没人警告过你颅腔调节器是怎么悄悄改变你的思维的吗？把你那些((不理性))的念头一点点磨平？让你像机械师一样看世界，把一切都当成一道道等着你去解的题？

English: You've barely got your paws on that [[Machinist Insignia]] and you're pushing people around. Perhaps you didn't need much of a prod to act like them, hmm?
Chinese: 你那枚[[机械师徽记]]刚捂热乎，就开始对别人指手画脚了。看来要你学他们的做派，都不用多推一把，嗯？

English: The biggest changes will take a few years, but mark my words, they will come. ##That is why I got rid of mine.
Chinese: 最大的改变要几年后才显现，但记住我的话，一定会来。##所以我自己那台，早扔了。

English: Yes, for many years. I even wrote some of the cipher magic that lets the King alter people. So I speak with authority when I say that ((countless)) lives depend on you defying Aphra's plan.
Chinese: 是啊，好多年。让国王改造人的那些密文魔法，有几道还是我写的。所以我以权威身份告诉你：((无数))人的性命，都系在你敢不敢顶住阿芙拉的计划上。

English: <<Reza grabs your wrist with surprising strength.>> Child, this is your last chance to hear the whole truth. Once you enter the King's audience chamber, you'll never see me again – just like all those people the King has vanished.
Chinese: <<雷扎用惊人的力气攥住你的手腕。>>孩子，这是你听完整真相的最后机会。一旦你踏进国王的觐见厅，你就再也见不到我了——就像被国王抹掉的那些人一样。

English: Don't misunderstand me. Aphra is a sweet girl. We were very close, once. She ((absolutely)) believes she is doing the right thing. ##Sadly for all of us, she is wrong.
Chinese: 别误会。阿芙拉是个好姑娘。我们曾经非常亲密。她((百分之百))相信自己做的没错。##可惜，对我们所有人来说，她错了。

English: Look around you, child. See how we are all at the mercy of this infernal machine, which not even the Machinists can control. Can you honestly say that what we need is ((more)) Clockwork King?
Chinese: 看看你的四周，孩子。看看我们所有人如何被这台地狱机器摆布，连机械师都驾驭不了它。你敢说我们需要的是((更多))的发条王吗？

English: However brilliant Aphra's spell may be, it cannot fix the problems with the King – because the King ((is)) the problem.
Chinese: 阿芙拉的法术再精妙，也修不好国王的问题——因为国王((本身))就是问题。

English: <<Reza flashes you a crooked grin and hands you something heavy, wrapped in colourful rags.>> ##I am glad you asked.
Chinese: <<雷扎冲你咧嘴一笑，递过来一个用花布裹着、沉甸甸的东西。>>##问得好。

English: This is [[a different kind of spell]]. Inserted in place of Aphra's, it will trigger a runaway fault cascade that gradually but irrevocably [[shuts down the King]] with minimum destruction.
Chinese: 这是[[另一种法术]]。代替阿芙拉那张插进去，它会引发一场失控的故障级联，逐步而不可逆地[[关闭国王]]，且破坏最小。

English: <<They smile cryptically.>> There's no such person as the Saboteur, child. Only a group of like-minded people who love this land, and see no good in leaving its fate to an overgrown grandfather clock.
Chinese: <<他们意味深长地一笑。>>根本没有什么破坏者这个人，孩子。只有一群志同道合的人，他们热爱这片土地，不肯把它的命运交给一只长疯了的落地大钟。

English: So, do we understand each other? Or is there more you would know?
Chinese: 那么，我们互相明白了？你还想知道些什么？

English: As you wish. The least I can do is answer.
Chinese: 如你所愿。至少我能答的都会答。

English: What about it, child?
Chinese: 它怎么了，孩子？

English: Do you still have questions, child?
Chinese: 还有问题吗，孩子？

English: Aphra's had these plans for a long time. We used to stay up so late, bouncing wild ideas back and forth. She believes she has been lucky, and wants the same for others. I admire that about her, truly.
Chinese: 阿芙拉这些打算由来已久。我们从前常常熬夜，你一句我一句地碰各种疯狂的点子。她觉得自己是幸运儿，也想让别人同样幸运。这点我真心敬佩她。

English: But ask her this: under her plan, will people really be free to choose whatever changes they want? Or will there be a limit? Will the King be neutral on what changes we make, or will it have a bias?
Chinese: 但你去问问她：按她的方案，人们真能随心所欲地选择任何改造吗？还是会有门槛？对我们怎么改造，国王会保持中立，还是会偏向某一方？

English: Aphra is a child of the Guild. She believes in her soul that if she keeps tinkering she can design a perfect system. ##If only she understood how much they have stolen from her.
Chinese: 阿芙拉是公会养大的孩子。她打心底相信，只要她一直修修补补，就能设计出一套完美的制度。##她要能明白他们从她身上偷走了多少东西就好了。

English: <<They grimace.>> I won't pretend otherwise. There will be chaos, and much suffering, and certainly death. I only ask you to consider how many more could die if you keep the King in place.
Chinese: <<他们做了个苦相。>>我不装。会有混乱，会有大量苦难，一定会有死亡。我只求你想一想：若把国王继续留着，还会有多少人头落地。

English: We will never know how many people the King has altered to make them 'better workers'. My former colleagues saw people's baser instincts as an impediment to progress, so they chose to scrap the people and build another.
Chinese: 国王到底改造了多少人，好让他们成为"更听话的工人"，我们永远不会知道。我昔日的同僚把人的低劣本能视为进步的绊脚石，于是他们选择把人扔掉，再造一个。

English: But, child, in my trade, you learn a lot about people. Most folk ((want)) to help each other. It is this vile contraption breathing down their necks that stops them. Making us fear each other, envy each other, denounce each other for one more day's bread.
Chinese: 可是孩子，干我这一行，你会看透人心。大多数人((是愿意))互相扶持的。拦着他们的，正是这台抵着他们后脖颈的凶器机器。是它让我们彼此恐惧、彼此嫉妒，为多混一天的面包彼此告发。

English: Without the King, our fate will rest again upon each other's shoulders. There's no work of cipher that I trust more than that. It's all we really have, and all we need.
Chinese: 没有国王，我们的命运将重新压上彼此的肩头。没有任何密文之作，比这更让我信靠。它是我们真正拥有的全部，也是我们需要的全部。

English: I will tell you whatever I can without endangering my comrades.
Chinese: 不危及同志的范围内，我知无不言。

English: <<Reza snorts.>> Hogwash! Child, I know what the King is made of. I could recite every syllable of its cipher nucleus by heart, although to do so would be most unwise.
Chinese: <<雷扎嗤笑。>>胡说八道！孩子，国王是什么造的我一清二楚。它密文核心的每一个音节我都能倒背如流——虽然真背出来就太不明智了。

English: Do we sabotage the King when we believe it will do good? Certainly. Do we divert royal goods to distribute fairly in our communities? Yes, sometimes. But are ((we)) the root of the King's madness? Don't make me laugh.
Chinese: 我们觉得能造福时，就搞破坏？当然。我们把王室物资截下来，在社区里公平分掉？是的，偶尔。可国王的发疯，根源在((我们))？别逗我笑了。

English: We could toil for decades and cause fewer faults than the King itself generates before breakfast. Only a truly stupid Machinist could believe that we are anything more than an excuse for their failures.
Chinese: 我们苦干几十年闯的祸，还没有国王做顿早饭前闯的多。只有蠢透了的机械师才会相信，我们不过是他们失败的替罪羊。

English: <<Reza grins crookedly.>> Now you are asking the right questions. ##Yes, I accept my share of blame for the mess this Kingdom is in. Luckily, I do not work alone.
Chinese: <<雷扎咧嘴一笑。>>现在你终于问对问题了。##是的，这个烂摊子我认下我那一份。幸运的是，我不是单干。

English: Although this spell was drafted by my hands, it is the work of many minds. Most of my comrades, whom you will never meet, are ordinary layfolk. I pledge my magic to serve them, not the other way round.
Chinese: 这道法术虽出自我的手，却是许多头脑的共同作品。我的大多数同志，你永远不会见到，都是普普通通的平民。我献出魔法为他们服务，而不是反过来。

English: Do you know why I was chosen to give you this punchcard? Because I'm the most expendable. The Machinists already know very well who I am.
Chinese: 你知道为什么选我把这张打孔卡交给你吗？因为我最可有可无。机械师们早就把我摸得一清二楚了。

English: <<They sigh deeply.>> ##Child, did you ever hear that old fairytale about the boy who got a splinter of a mirror in his eye? That made him cold and cruel, seeing only the worst in things?
Chinese: <<他们长叹一声。>>##孩子，你听过那个古老的童话吗——男孩的眼睛里扎进了一面镜子的碎片，从此他变得冷酷残忍，看什么只见其最坏的一面？

English: The King wields unimaginable power – far too much for any one being. In my youth I thought that this made the Guild ((more)) important; that we had a duty to use such power wisely.
Chinese: 国王握着无法想象的权力——对任何单一存在来说都太大了。我年轻时以为，这正说明公会((更加))重要；我们有责任明智地使用这种权力。

English: But when you make so many life or death decisions every day... when you see people's darkest secrets, piled up in stacks every morning in the royal archives like so many freshly-cut logs...
Chinese: 可当你每天要做那么多生死攸关的决定……当你每天清晨看见人们最黑暗的秘密，像刚砍下的圆木一样，一摞摞码在王室档案馆里……

English: You grow numb to it. You forget what the stakes are. ##I did not like what I saw reflected in my colleagues' eyes, or in my own.
Chinese: 你会麻木。你会忘记赌注是什么。##我不喜欢我在同僚眼里看到的倒影，也不喜欢我自己眼里的。

English: <<Reza snorts.>> A reward? Child, by the time you enter that audience chamber, I will be gone – either dead or in hiding.
Chinese: <<雷扎嗤笑。>>报酬？孩子，等你踏进那间觐见厅时，我已经不在了——要么死了，要么躲起来了。

English: Perhaps the Guild has told you about all the sacks of gold we get from the Apostatic Union? I have never seen a penny of it, and neither have my comrades.
Chinese: 也许公会跟你说过，叛教联盟给了我们多少袋金子？我一个子儿都没见过，我的同志们也没有。

English: Any resources that we do possess will be needed in the days ahead. You must do this because it is right, or not at all.
Chinese: 我们仅有的资源，往后的日子还用得着。你做这件事，要么因为它是正确的，要么干脆别做。

English: That's all I ask, child. Don't trust Aphra, and don't trust me either. Just do what you think is right.
Chinese: 我就求这一件事，孩子。别信阿芙拉，也别信我。只按你认为正确的做。

English: Ah, my child. I always wondered if I would live to see my [[debug mode]]. Don't worry, I am quite familiar with how this works. ##So. What will you do with this strange island in causality, this time outside of time?
Chinese: 啊，我的孩子。我一直好奇能不能活着见到自己的[[调试模式]]。别担心，这套东西的规矩我一清二楚。##那么。这片因果之外的时外之岛，这次你想拿它做什么？

English: So be it. Let us go back to the world, as the poet Cohen once said. ##I mean Cleanup Worker Cohen, naturally. We enbies must stick together, no?
Chinese: 那就这么办。让我们回到尘世去吧，诗人科恩如是说。##当然，我说的是清理工科恩。我们这种不分性别的人，总得抱团，不是吗？

English: If you say so, child. Just know that this is the mere illusion of power, nothing more.
Chinese: 你说了算，孩子。只需知道，这不过是权力的幻影，仅此而已。

English: I'm looking for the seventh letter.
Chinese: 我在找"第七个字母"。

English: What are you selling?
Chinese: 你卖什么的？

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: Who are you again?
Chinese: 你是谁来着？

English: I still have questions about your punchcard.
Chinese: 关于你的打孔卡，我还有问题。

English: No thank you, I'm just passing by.
Chinese: 不用了谢谢，我就是路过。

English: I must be off now.
Chinese: 我该走了。

English: What kind of problems do you mean?
Chinese: 你说的难处，是什么难处？

English: You keep calling me 'child', but I'm at least as old as you.
Chinese: 你一口一个"孩子"，我岁数可不比你小。

English: No talismans for me, thanks.
Chinese: 护身符就不必了，谢谢。

English: @@ I'm new here, and this place terrifies and confuses me. I'd be glad for your guidance.
Chinese: @@ 我是新来的，这地方吓得我晕头转向。正想请您指点迷津。

English: Actually, I had a confusing encounter with the King just recently...
Chinese: 其实，我最近和国王有过一次莫名其妙的遭遇……

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Would you like this conversation to become ((official)) business?
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>要不要让这次谈话变成((公务))？

English: Fair enough, I suppose.
Chinese: 好吧，也算有理。

English: Why don't you tell me, since you've apparently been watching my progress?
Chinese: 你既然一直在"观察"我的进展，何不直接告诉我？

English: Misha sends his greetings.
Chinese: 米沙向你问好。

English: No, I wasn't followed.
Chinese: 没有，没人跟着我。

English: She said it would let me speak Sixfold cipher.
Chinese: 她说装了它我就能说六重密文。

English: Morozov mentioned a few side effects – migraines, seizures.
Chinese: 莫罗佐夫提过几个副作用——偏头痛、癫痫。

English: Honestly, she sort of glossed over it.
Chinese: 说实话，她有点含糊其辞。

English: You used to be a Machinist too?
Chinese: 你以前也是机械师？

English: <<[Try to leave]>> I've had enough of plots and conspiracies.
Chinese: <<[想走]>>这些阴谋诡计我受够了。

English: All right, I'm listening.
Chinese: 好吧，我听着。

English: What's your alternative?
Chinese: 那你的替代方案是什么？

English: What am I supposed to do about it?
Chinese: 那我该怎么办？

English: Wait – you're the Saboteur, aren't you?
Chinese: 等等——你就是破坏者，对吧？

English: So ((you're)) this mystery villain I keep hearing about.
Chinese: 所以((你))就是那个我老听说的神秘大反派。

English: About your spell...
Chinese: 关于你的法术……

English: What's so dangerous about Aphra's spell?
Chinese: 阿芙拉的法术有什么危险？

English: Everyone here depends on the King. If you kill it, many people will die.
Chinese: 这里人人都指着国王过活。你杀了它，会死很多人。

English: Let me ask you about something else.
Chinese: 我问点别的。

English: About you and your cause...
Chinese: 关于你和你那份事业……

English: The Machinists say ((you're)) the reason for the King's problems.
Chinese: 机械师们说，国王的毛病都是((你))搞出来的。

English: You were a Machinist too. What makes you any better than Aphra?
Chinese: 你也当过机械师。你哪点比阿芙拉高尚？

English: Why did you leave the Machinists' Guild?
Chinese: 你为什么离开机械师公会？

English: What's in it for me, if I follow your plan?
Chinese: 如果我按你的计划办，我能得到什么？

English: Very well. I'll consider what you've said.
Chinese: 好吧。你说的我会考虑。

English: <<This stocky, middle-aged woman is methodically entering numbers into a ledger. She does not look up.>> ##Your ticket, please.
Chinese: <<这位矮壮的中年女性正有条不紊地把数字录入账册，头也不抬。>>##请出示您的号牌。

English: <<She continues writing, eyes fixed on her book.>>##Why, Citizen Javed, you've changed a great deal since I saw you last week. For instance, your missing leg has grown back.
Chinese: <<她继续写着，眼睛盯着账本。>>##哟，贾维德公民，自我上周见您以来，您变化可真大。比如您那条断腿又长回来了。

English: <<She continues writing, eyes fixed on her book.>>##We have a system here, citizen. Everyone takes a ticket, and everyone waits their turn. So it wouldn't be fair to let you jump the queue, would it?
Chinese: <<她继续写着，眼睛盯着账本。>>##我们这儿有制度，公民。人人取号，人人排队。让您插队对别人可不公平，对吧？

English: <<Finally she looks up at you over her spectacles. Her expression is surprisingly kind.>> ##I know it's very frustrating to be kept waiting like this. I imagine you've come a long way.
Chinese: <<她终于从眼镜上方抬起头。表情出奇地和善。>>##让您这样干等着，确实憋闷。想必您远道而来。

English: But we've just had another wave of evacuees from Cloudpine, and every one of them needs a proper bed.##So you're not the only one who has urgent business with the [[Royal Factor]] today, see?
Chinese: 可云杉州又送来一批疏散居民，人人都要一张正经床铺。##所以您瞧，今天有急事要找[[皇家事务官]]的，可不止您一位。

English: <<The Royal Factor continues writing, her little wire-rimmed spectacles perching upon her nose.>> ##Did you have other business? I'm afraid you'll just have to wait your turn like everyone else.
Chinese: <<皇家事务官继续写着，小小的金属丝边眼镜架在鼻梁上。>>##还有别的事吗？恐怕您得跟其他人一样，按号等着。

English: <<The Royal Factor continues writing, her little wire-rimmed spectacles perching upon her nose.>> ##I'm afraid you'll just have to wait your turn, citizen. Downstairs.
Chinese: <<皇家事务官继续写着，小小的金属丝边眼镜架在鼻梁上。>>##恐怕您得按号等着，公民。楼下。

English: <<She raises her voice to address her clerk.>> Mr Gallo, find this one a seat in the waiting room, won't you? One of the nice ones, with all four legs still on it.
Chinese: <<她扬声吩咐属员。>>加洛先生，给这位在候见室找个座，行吗？挑把好的，四条腿都在的那种。

English: Now, ((please)) don't make me call the Militia out of their nice warm barracks. They'll be ever so grumpy.
Chinese: 现在，((请))别逼我把民兵队从暖烘烘的营房里叫出来。他们可是会很不高兴的。

English: Well, that's a shame, isn't it? I'm afraid some of your fellow citizens have been waiting much longer than you. Sometimes that's just the way the cookie crumbles, see?
Chinese: 唉，那可遗憾了，不是吗？恐怕有些公民比您等得久得多。世事就是这样，你懂的。

English: Oh dear, I'm sorry to hear that. Mr Gallo, will you fetch us a petition sheet? Petition 107-F, complaint against a senior servant of the King. There's a good lad.
Chinese: 哎呀，听到这个真遗憾。加洛先生，给我们拿一张呈文表好吗？107-F 号呈文，控告国王高级官员。乖孩子。
