English: <<She smiles apologetically.>>##This may take a while, so you'd best wait downstairs. Mr Gallo will bring you the petition once he's dug it out. Will you need someone to read it aloud to you?
Chinese: <<她抱歉地笑了笑。>>##这恐怕得等一阵，您最好在楼下等着。等加洛先生把呈文翻出来，会送过去。需要有人念给您听吗？

English: I'm the [[Royal Factor]] of Ferropolis.##I handle all those little matters of administration that don't require the attention of the Clockwork King, or the blessed Machinists' Guild.
Chinese: 我是铁城的[[皇家事务官]]。##那些不需要发条王或尊贵的机械师公会亲自过目的大小行政杂务，都归我管。

English: So as you can imagine, I'm quite busy, see?
Chinese: 所以你可以想象，我有多忙，对吧？

English: <<She examines you properly for the first time.>> ##((Misha)) sent you? Well, why didn't you say so? Mr Gallo, hold all tickets, please!
Chinese: <<她这才正经打量了你一遍。>>##((米沙))派你来的？哎，怎么不早说！加洛先生，请所有号码暂停叫号！

English: Now, let's have a look at this [['passport']]... ##Heh. It's really not a bad likeness, is it? He's captured your nose perfectly.
Chinese: 来，让我们看看这张[["护照"]]……##嘿。画得还真不赖，是吧？他把您的鼻子画绝了。

English: <<She produces an official-looking parchment and begins filling it in.>>##So, you'll be wanting a travel permit? Not to worry – this will stand up to scrutiny. After all, it's quite real, see?
Chinese: <<她拿出一张官气十足的羊皮纸，开始填写。>>##所以，您要办通行许可？别担心——这份经得起查。毕竟，它是如假包换的真件，对吧？

English: && <<The Factor's quill does not stop moving.>> ##An interesting theory, citizen, but I'm afraid I do not comment on idle speculation. Besides...
Chinese: && <<事务官的笔没有停。>>##有意思的推测，公民，但恕我对无凭的猜想不作评论。再说了……

English: <<She stamps the parchment and gives you a bright smile.>> ##If anyone owes Misha a favour, I'd say it's you, see?
Chinese: <<她在羊皮纸上盖了章，冲你灿烂一笑。>>##要论谁欠米沙一个人情，我想是您，对吧？

English: %% <<The Factor's quill stops moving. She gives you a cautioning look, then gently sets it down.>> ##Misha and I have a good working relationship. In our own way, we both serve the King.
Chinese: %% <<事务官的笔停了。她警告地看了你一眼，然后轻轻放下笔。>>##米沙和我合作愉快。我们各按其分，都在为国王效力。

English: Each of us has targets to meet. ((He)) has access to goods that are subject to a temporary mismatch of supply and demand here in the Kingdom. Whereas ((I)) have a city to feed and clothe, see?
Chinese: 人人都有指标要完成。((他))手里有王国这边供需暂时错位的货物。而((我))要养活、要穿衣的是一整座城，对吧？

English: So it's everyone in Ferropolis who owes Mikhail a favour... ##<<She stamps the parchment and gives you a bright smile.>> ...not least yourself.
Chinese: 这么说，欠米沙人情的其实是全铁城的人……##<<她在羊皮纸上盖了章，冲你灿烂一笑。>>……您本人也不例外。

English: <<With an unceremonious efficiency, she stamps the parchment.>>
Chinese: <<她利落干脆地盖下章。>>

English: Well, I believe all is in order here. The [[gatebridges]] will be open to you now.##Send my love to Misha, won't you?
Chinese: 好了，我想这边都办妥了。现在[[关卡桥]]对您开放了。##替我向米沙问好，好吗？

English: <<With an unceremonious efficiency, she stamps the parchment.>>
Chinese: <<她利落干脆地盖下章。>>

English: <<The Royal Factor glances up at you over her little wire-rimmed spectacles.>> ##Thanks to your help, my position here is now quite secure. And I ((always)) remember those who do me a good turn, see?
Chinese: <<皇家事务官从金属丝边眼镜上方瞥了你一眼。>>##多亏你帮忙，我现在的位子坐得稳稳的。而帮我忙的人，我((向来))记得住，对吧？

English: Do pop by again if you need anything. No need to wait in the queue.
Chinese: 有事常来。不用排队。

English: <<She hands the passport back to you.>> ##You'll be wanting a [[travel permit]], then? I believe I can help. But given your ((unconventional)) means of arrival, I will require just a ((teensy)) little test of your loyalty. One hand washes the other, see?
Chinese: <<她把护照递还给你。>>##那么，您要办一张[[通行许可]]了？我想我能帮忙。不过鉴于您来的((路数))不太寻常，我需要来一((小小))的忠诚测试。互相帮衬嘛，对吧？

English: <<She wrinkles her nose.>> I wasn't going to say anything about it. What with half the water pipes in this city still frozen up, you're not the smelliest citizen I've seen to this week.
Chinese: <<她皱了皱鼻子。>>我本来都没打算提。这城一半水管还冻着呢，您不是我这周见过最有味的公民。

English: <<She smiles.>> What I mean, citizen, is that a little mutual back-scratching makes the world go round. Here in the Kingdom we call that 'comity'.
Chinese: <<她笑了。>>我是说，公民，互相帮衬一点，世界才转得动。在王国我们管这叫"礼尚往来"。

English: Some days ago, a [[goods caravan]] was ambushed out in Yansk while on its way to Ferropolis. The only survivor died of their wounds before they could tell us the culprit.
Chinese: 几天前，一支[[货队]]在扬斯克前往铁城的路上遭了伏击。唯一的幸存者还没来得及供出凶手就伤重不治。

English: Currently all my Militia squads are tied up keeping order in the city, so a proper retrieval mission will have to wait. But there was one particular item in the caravan that we just can't do without.
Chinese: 眼下我所有民兵小队都在城里维持秩序，正经的回收行动只能往后排。但货队里有一样东西，我们万万少不得。

English: What you're looking for is a [[royal freight capsule]] with a [[chest]] inside. It should be somewhere [[northwest of here]], in the forest beyond the farmlands.
Chinese: 您要找的是一个[[皇家货舱]]，里面有一只[[箱子]]。它应该在[[西北方向]]，农田外的森林里。

English: <<The Factor smiles maternally.>> ##If you can bring me the contents of that chest, I think you and I will have a very fruitful relationship.
Chinese: <<事务官露出母性十足的微笑。>>##要是您能把箱子里的东西带回来，我想你我会有非常愉快的合作。

English: <<The Royal Factor glances up at you over her little wire-rimmed spectacles.>> ##Did you find the cargo, citizen? I'm afraid I've no time for you otherwise.
Chinese: <<皇家事务官从金属丝边眼镜上方瞥了你一眼。>>##货物找到了吗，公民？否则我可没空搭理您。

English: <<The Factor raises her eyebrows and lets out a low whistle.>> ##Not personally, but we should thank him nonetheless. After all, he's just saved both your head and mine, see?
Chinese: <<事务官扬起眉毛，低低吹了声口哨。>>##倒不是他亲自送来的，但我们照样该谢他。毕竟，他这一下可救了你我的脑袋，对吧？

English: <<The Factor maintains an impenetrable poker face.>> ##That would be [[Chairman Duncan]] – the inimitable first leader of the Machinists' Guild.
Chinese: <<事务官的扑克脸纹丝不动。>>##那就是[[邓肯主席]]——机械师公会无可替代的首任领袖。

English: Apparently our King is convinced that he possessed some critical knowledge of the correct path forward for the Kingdom. Ever since he died, the Guild has been trying to winkle it out of his brain.
Chinese: 据说我们的国王确信，他掌握着王国前进正道的某些关键知识。自他死后，公会一直想方设法从他脑子里把那些知识抠出来。

English: In the meantime, given the current instability, Its Majesty has decreed that the head be moved to Ferropolis and put on display for public veneration. To bolster morale, see?
Chinese: 与此同时，鉴于当前局势不稳，陛下敕令将这颗头颅移至铁城，供公众瞻仰。以振民心，你懂的。

English: <<She pats the glass jar gently and smiles at you.>> ##I don't know about you, but I feel better already.
Chinese: <<她轻轻拍了拍玻璃罐，冲你微笑。>>##不知您怎么样，反正我已经感觉好多了。

English: Yes, let's get you sorted, shall we? <<She produces an official-looking parchment and begins filling it in.>> ##Not to worry – this will stand up to scrutiny. After all, it's quite real.
Chinese: 好，那咱们把你这事办了吧？<<她拿出一张官气十足的羊皮纸，开始填写。>>##别担心——这份经得起查。毕竟，它是如假包换的真件。

English: <<[Show the ticket you stole]>> Number 115.
Chinese: <<[出示你偷来的号牌]>>115 号。

English: <<[make up a number]>> Number 53.
Chinese: <<[随口编个号]>>53 号。

English: Ticket? What ticket?
Chinese: 号牌？什么号牌？

English: <<[Show 'passport']>> Mikhail sent me. He says hello.
Chinese: <<[出示"护照"]>>米沙派我来的。他向你问好。

English: Wait, I need to ask you some questions.
Chinese: 等等，我还有几个问题。

English: This is outrageous! I shall make a complaint!
Chinese: 简直岂有此理！我要投诉！

English: Sorry, what is it you do here exactly?
Chinese: 抱歉，您在这里具体是做什么的？

English: @@ So how do you know Mikhail? Seems like you owe him quite the favour.
Chinese: @@ 您怎么认识米沙的？看起来您欠他一个天大的人情。

English: [Wait silently for her to finish]
Chinese: [默默等她写完]

English: Fine, fine, I'm leaving.
Chinese: 好吧好吧，我走。

English: What did you have in mind?
Chinese: 您有什么打算？

English: Honestly, I haven't had a wash in weeks.
Chinese: 说实话，我好几个星期没洗过澡了。

English: I'm not familiar with that expression.
Chinese: 我不懂这个说法。

English: <<[Dump the pickled head on her desk]>> Friend of yours?
Chinese: <<[把腌渍的头颅倒在她桌上]>>您认识的朋友？

English: What did you want me to do again?
Chinese: 你刚说要我做什么来着？

English: Not yet.
Chinese: 还没有。

English: What's so important about this head, anyway?
Chinese: 这颗头到底有什么要紧的？

English: So, about that travel permit...
Chinese: 那么，关于那张通行许可……

English: <<You pick up the trumpet and put it to your ear.>>
Chinese: <<你拿起喇叭筒，贴到耳边。>>

English: <<This doesn't seem like the King's message.>>
Chinese: <<这似乎不是国王的讯息。>>

English: <<Inside the yellow box is a mechanical console, with something like an ear trumpet hanging on a curly wire.>> ##<<Tinny noises issue from its mouth.>>
Chinese: <<黄盒子里面是一台机械控制台，一根弯弯的电线挂着个喇叭筒似的东西。>>##<<细小的声响从筒口漏出来。>>

English: <<Your brain is flooded by a cacophony of jagged noise. Then you realise it's some kind of otherworldly music...>>
Chinese: <<你的脑子被一片锯齿状的噪声洪流淹没。然后你意识到，那是某种来自异界的音乐……>>

English: <<The music throbs in an alien time signature, defying your attempts to track its rhythm. Ghostly, inhuman voices lap over each other like waves. It feels like a memory from before the universe was made....>>
Chinese: <<那音乐以一种陌生的拍子搏动，你试图跟上节奏却总是落空。幽灵般非人的嗓音层层叠叠，如浪相逐。仿佛宇宙诞生之前的记忆……>>

English: <<This doesn't seem like the King's message. You'll have to try one of the other boxes.>>
Chinese: <<这似乎不是国王的讯息。你得试试别的盒子。>>

English: <<You can hear two people in soft conversation, their voices echoing as if from the other end of a long stone passage.>>
Chinese: <<你听见两个人在轻声交谈，嗓音带着回响，仿佛从一条悠长的石砌走廊尽头传来。>>

English: There now. It'll be all right. ##(("How)) is it going to be ((all right))? Lydia's just ((gone)), and nobody remembers. I feel like my brain is melting and running out of my ears!"
Chinese: 好了好了。会没事的。##（(("会怎么))((没事))？莉迪亚就那么((没))了，没人记得她。我觉得我的脑子在融化，正从耳朵里往外流！"）

English: I know, I know. All I mean is, we've got each other, and I ain't going nowhere. ##<<A pause.>> "I was washing up today. Did you ever notice how many dishes we have? Enough for five people, not two."
Chinese: 我知道，我知道。我是说，我们还有彼此，我哪儿也不去。##<<停顿。>>"我今天洗碗来着。你注意过没有，咱家的碗碟有多少？够五个人用的，不是两个。"

English: Well... helps to have extra, don't it?" ##"You ((know)) we can't afford more of anything than we need. We had an extra bed, too, before we sold it. And that cot.">>"
Chinese: 呃……多备点总没坏处，不是吗？"##"你((明知道))咱们买不起多余的东西。多出来的床，我们不是卖了吗。还有那张小床。">>"

English: I... suppose it was nice to have guests round. Before all this, I mean. ##"And do you ((remember)) ever having guests?" <<A pause.>> "How many people used to live in this house, Kwesi?"
Chinese: 我……以前有客人来，是挺好的。我是说，在这一切之前。##"你((还记得))咱们家来过客人吗？" <<停顿。>>"这屋子以前住过几个人，奎西？"

English: <<A long pause.>> I... I don't know." ##"No. Me neither.""
Chinese: <<好长的停顿。>>我……我不知道。"##"嗯。我也不知道。""

English: <<There is a long silence, and then a series of odd little wet sounds.>> ##Oi, oi! What are you doing?" ##"Sorry, should I stop?""
Chinese: <<一阵长长的沉默，然后是一串奇怪而湿润的声响。>> ##喂喂！你干什么呢？" ##"抱歉，要我停下吗？""

English: ...I didn't say stop." ##<<You hear grateful sighs, a giggle, then a loving moan. You quickly put the trumpet down before you hear any more.>>"
Chinese: ……我又没说让你停。" ##<<你听见一声感激的叹息，一声轻笑，然后是一声缠绵的呻吟。你赶紧放下喇叭筒，免得听到更多。>>"

English: <<An old man's voice echoes from the other end.>> ##Hello? Hello? Can anyone hear me? I don't know where I am... please. It's cold...
Chinese: <<老人的嗓音从另一端回响过来。>>##喂？喂？有人听得见吗？我不知道我在哪……求求了。好冷……

English: <<The old man doesn't seem to be able to hear you.>> ##I can't see anything. I... I can't feel my body. Is anyone there? Hello? Please, if anyone's there, say something...
Chinese: <<老人似乎听不见你。>>##我什么都看不见。我……我感觉不到我的身体。有人吗？喂？求求了，有人就应一声……

English: <<At first you just hear hissing, and then the tune that Aphra hummed. A genderless voice announces with mechanical regularity:>> ##SIX. ONE. SIX. THREE. TWO. BREAK. FIVE. TWO. SIX. ALDER. BANTAM. TWO. BREAK. FOUR. SIX...
Chinese: <<起初只有嘶嘶声，然后是阿芙拉哼过的那段曲子。一个无性别的嗓音以机械般的节奏播报：>>##六。一。六。三。二。停。五。二。六。桤木。矮脚鸡。二。停。四。六……

English: <<The voice drones on, and then repeats. This must be the King's message.>> ##<<You scribble down everything you can, then replace the trumpet.>>
Chinese: <<那声音单调地播下去，然后循环一遍。这一定就是国王的讯息。>>##<<你把能记的全草草记下，然后放回喇叭筒。>>

English: <<It's a whirlwind of noise: chattering voices, snatches of song, weird mechanical screeches. At one point, you hear your own name. You hurriedly replace the trumpet.>>
Chinese: <<那是一片噪声的旋风：喋喋的人声、歌曲的碎片、诡异的机械尖啸。某一刻，你听见了自己的名字。你慌忙放回喇叭筒。>>

English: [Pick up the trumpet and listen]
Chinese: [拿起喇叭筒听]

English: [Keep listening]
Chinese: [继续听]

English: [Put the trumpet down]
Chinese: [放下喇叭筒]

English: Yes, I can hear you!
Chinese: 听得见！我听得见你！

English: Who is that speaking?
Chinese: 说话的是谁？

English: Stay calm. I'll try to help you.
Chinese: 冷静。我会想办法救你。

English: Halt, citizen! Do ((not)) interfere with these silkslugs in any way, or you'll answer to the Machinists' Guild.
Chinese: 站住，公民！((切莫))以任何方式招惹这些丝蛞蝓，否则你要向机械师公会交代。

English: They're under royal protection, so go about your business. ##<<A silkslug begins to probe inquisitively at their weapon.>> Oi! Leave that alone! Please?!
Chinese: 它们受王室保护，该干嘛干嘛去。##<<一只丝蛞蝓好奇地凑上去戳他的武器。>>喂！别碰那个！求你了？！

English: Why shouldn't I interfere with them?
Chinese: 为什么我不能招惹它们？

English: I wasn't even thinking about it.
Chinese: 我压根没想。

English: <<An old man sits watching the birds.>> ##King's favour, pal. No disrespect, but I came here to be alone.
Chinese: <<一位老人坐着看鸟。>>##国王赐福，伙计。恕我直言，我来这儿是想一个人待着。

English: <<He examines you suspiciously.>> A friend o' who?
Chinese: <<他狐疑地打量你。>>谁的朋友？

English: I don't know ye from an Emberian, pal. If that's all, ye can beat it.
Chinese: 伙计，我跟你素不相识。没事的话，请便吧。

English: <<He studiously avoids looking at the note.>> Did they now? Well, best of luck findin' 'em.
Chinese: <<他刻意不去看那张字条。>>是吗？那就祝你找得顺当。

English: Are ye daft? It's a sort of pavilion – like a wee building with no walls, just the roof an' pillars. Everyone knows that. ##There's one just over there, if ye need remindin'.
Chinese: 你傻吗？那是一种亭子——就是没墙、只有顶和柱子的小建筑。人人都知道。##喏，那边就有一座，不用我提醒吧。

English: <<Just as you're turning to leave, he pipes up again.>> ##Oh, pal? Ye might try comin' back [[after dark]]. Some folk come here to unwind after a hard day's work, like.
Chinese: <<你正要转身离开，他又开了腔。>>##哦，伙计？你可以[[天黑后]]再来。辛苦一天，有人来这儿松快松快。

English: <<The old man examines you suspiciously.>> Eh? Who's askin'?
Chinese: <<老人狐疑地打量你。>>嗯？哪位在问？

English: <<He relaxes.>> Ah, grand. I thought ye might be, but ye can't be too careful nowadays. ##Name's [[Ngozi]]. Pleased to meet another friend o' Aphra's.
Chinese: <<他放松下来。>>啊，太好了。我是猜你会来，可如今这世道，多小心都不为过。##我叫[[恩戈齐]]。很高兴认识阿芙拉的另一位朋友。

English: I've not seen her today, but try comin' back [[after dark]]. She's alway cooped up scrivenin' and scribin' in the Machinarium by daylight. Comes down here to unwind, like.
Chinese: 今天还没见着她。你可以[[天黑后]]再来。白天她总在机械殿里抄抄写写，闷得慌。下了班就来这儿松快松快。

English: Is that all, pal?
Chinese: 就这些吗，伙计？

English: We're kindred spirits. Well, we both like sittin' in this park anyway. Proper funny ideas she has. Though mebbe she'd say the same about me.
Chinese: 我们是同类人。至少，我们都爱坐在这个公园里。她的想法怪得有趣。不过换成她说我，恐怕也一样。

English: Ye look like a queer sort. She tends to attract 'em. Plus, ye seemed a little lost. She attracts those too.
Chinese: 你瞧着就是个怪人。她招这类人。再说你瞧着还有点迷路的样子。迷路的她也招。

English: <<An old man sits watching the birds.>> ##King's favour, pal. Say, have ye seen [[Aphra]] lately? Ye know, that Machinist girl who's always hangin' around here after dark...
Chinese: <<一位老人坐着看鸟。>>##国王赐福，伙计。话说，你最近见过[[阿芙拉]]吗？就是那个天黑后老在这附近转悠的机械师姑娘……

English: <<Ngozi's brows wrinkle with worry.>> Can't? What d'ye mean...? ##<<Then he catches himself.>> O' course, o' course. Not my place to stick my nose in Machinist business, no, no..
Chinese: <<恩戈齐的眉头皱出忧色。>>不能？什么叫……？##<<随即他回过神。>>当然了，当然了。机械师的事不归我多嘴，不不……

English: <<He stares at you for a moment, mouth slightly open, then catches himself.>> ##Oh! Err, well... sounds like she got what she deserved! You know I never trusted that girl? Treason never prospers, that's what I say...
Chinese: <<他盯着你看了一会儿，嘴微微张着，随即回过神。>>##哦！呃，这个……那她也是罪有应得！我一直就没信过那丫头，你知道吗？叛国者从无好下场，我一直这么说……

English: <<Ngozi's brows wrinkle with worry.>> I hope she's not in any trouble... ##Well, I'm sure she knows what she's doing.
Chinese: <<恩戈齐的眉头皱出忧色。>>但愿她没惹上麻烦……##唉，我相信她心里有数。

English: Aye. ##<<He turns his attention back to the birds.>>
Chinese: 嗯。##<<他转回去继续看鸟。>>

English: <<Ngozi spits in the dirt and rolls his eyes.>> ##[[Debug Mode]], ye said? I never heard a bigger load o' shite. Go on then, do yer worst.
Chinese: <<恩戈齐往土里啐了口唾沫，翻了个白眼。>>##[[调试模式]]，你说的？没听过比这更扯的屁话。来吧，随你折腾。

English: That so? Mind, my memory ain't what it was.
Chinese: 是吗？提醒一句，我的记性可不如从前了。

English: Pardon me, but have you seen Aphra lately?
Chinese: 恕我冒昧，你最近见过阿芙拉吗？

English: Excuse me, are you... 'A Friend'?
Chinese: 请问，您是……"一位朋友"吗？

English: Well, of me, I suppose.
Chinese: 呃，我的朋友吧。

English: No one in particular.
Chinese: 没特指谁。

English: <<[Show him the enigmatic note]>> Someone asked to meet me here.
Chinese: <<[给他看那张神秘字条]>>有人约我来这儿见面。

English: This might be a silly question, but what's a gazebo?
Chinese: 问个傻问题，凉亭是什么？

English: Fine, I get the message.
Chinese: 行，我懂了。

English: King's favour to you.
Chinese: 国王赐福。

English: Don't worry, I've spoken to Aphra. We're... friends.
Chinese: 别担心，我和阿芙拉谈过了。我们是……朋友。

English: How do you know Aphra?
Chinese: 你怎么认识阿芙拉的？

English: Why did you think I might know her?
Chinese: 你为什么觉得我会认识她？

English: King's favour to you, Ngozi.
Chinese: 国王赐福，恩戈齐。

English: Nobody. Never mind.
Chinese: 没谁。当我没问。

English: I... can't tell you.
Chinese: 我……不能告诉你。

English: She was conspiring against the King. I put an end to it.
Chinese: 她密谋反对国王。我终结了这一切。

English: She... had to go abroad on official business. I don't know if she'll be back.
Chinese: 她……因公出国了。不知道还回不回来。

English: Move along, citizen. The [[King]] abhors dawdlers.
Chinese: 走吧走吧，公民。[[国王]]厌恶游手好闲之徒。

English: <<The guard is shouting with a frenetic energy at anyone passing by.>>##Move along, move along! Stop your gawping! Whatever's above you is ((not)) your concern!
Chinese: <<卫兵用狂热的劲头朝每个过路人大喊。>>##走吧走吧！别东张西望！你头顶上那些东西((不))用你操心！

English: <<The surface of the noticeboard is entirely lost beneath layer upon layer of paper, while half-melted candles shelter at its foot. A sign at the top reads:>> ##MISSING PERSONS
Chinese: <<告示板的板面完全被一层压一层的纸盖住，板脚撑着几支半融的蜡烛。顶端一行字：>>##失踪人口

English: <<One notice in particular catches your eye. It looks relatively new, and is written in a spidery hand...>>
Chinese: <<其中一张告示特别扎眼。它相对较新，字迹细密歪斜……>>

English: <<This notice appears relatively new, written in a spidery hand.>>
Chinese: <<这张告示相对较新，字迹细密歪斜。>>

English: Dear Child, ##I dont no why I am writing this. I dont no who you are. I dont even remember your Name. I just no there is a Hole in my life & Nothing fills it.
Chinese: 孩子：##我不知道我为什么要写这个。我不知道你是谁。我甚至不记得你的名字。我只知道我的生活里有个洞，什么都填不满。

English: If you are real, pleas com home. I want to feel right again. ##– Oleg Igorovich
Chinese: 如果你是真的，请回家。我想让一切重新变回对的模样。##——奥列格·伊戈罗维奇

English: <<This must be the notice Sunil meant. It gives directions to a house on the northeast islet of Ferropolis, accessed via the city's rear gate.>>
Chinese: <<这一定就是苏尼尔说的那张告示。上面指明了铁城东北小岛上一栋房子的位置，从城的后门过去。>>

English: <<Something tugs at you about this strange notice. Maybe you should offer your help?>> ##<<The notice gives directions to a house on the northeast islet of Ferropolis, accessed via the city's rear gate.>>
Chinese: <<这张奇怪的告示有什么东西在牵动你。也许你该施以援手？>>##<<告示指明了铁城东北小岛上一栋房子的位置，从城的后门过去。>>

English: <<The notice gives directions to a house on the northeast islet of Ferropolis, accessed via the city's rear gate.>>
Chinese: <<告示指明了铁城东北小岛上一栋房子的位置，从城的后门过去。>>

English: <<This notice is written on the back of a royal petition slip, seemingly by several different hands.>>
Chinese: <<这张告示写在一张王室呈文单的背面，笔迹似乎出自好几个人之手。>>

English: [[MISSING 2 MONTHS]]: Edith Ng, 71, retired plummer, last seen visiting Quarshie the Clothier. Dark hair + lite brown skin. Foul of mouth & smoaks like a chimny. Argues bitterly on any point at witch she takes a fence, & cannot by any means be reason'd with or pacify'd.
Chinese: [[失踪两个月]]：伊迪丝·吴，71 岁，退休管道工。最后一次露面是在裁缝夸尔希的铺子。黑发，浅棕皮肤。嘴毒，抽烟凶。但凡她看不上眼的事都要争个面红耳赤，任何人无法说服，无法安抚。

English: V. much miss'd by her 3 children, 14 grandchildren, 6 great grandchildren, & 7 mummerbirds. ##Please send word of any sighting to Chartreuse Ng, c/o Amrit Kaur, 14 Rampart Sq, Ferropolis, CWK.
Chinese: 三个子女、十四个孙辈、六个曾孙辈和七只假面鸟，都万分想念她。##如有目击请告知 Chartreuse Ng，转交 Amrit Kaur 收，铁城 Rampart 广场 14 号，CWK。

English: <<This notice was evidently printed by woodblock, suggesting it is one of multiple identical copies.>>
Chinese: <<这张告示显然是木版印刷的，说明它只是多份相同副本中的一张。>>

English: [[ATTENTION ALL TRUE PATRIOTS]]! ##A Memorial will be held on Month 3, Day 32, Hour 17 for the lost Citizens of Progress, marking the Fifth Anniversary of its Downfall, in Unison Park, Ferropolis.
Chinese: [[全体忠诚爱国者注意]]！##3月32日17时，将于铁城合鸣公园举行进步城罹难公民追悼会，纪念陷落五周年。

English: The Citizens' Disaster Memorial Committee will continue to petition our gracious King for Answers as to the fate of our Loved Ones, & or else for those still listed as Missing to be declared Dead & given fit Honours.
Chinese: 公民灾难纪念委员会将继续向仁慈的国王请愿，要求给出我们挚爱亲人的下落，或将仍列为失踪者宣告死亡并授予相应荣誉。

English: <<This notice is in a messy hand, blotched with tea-stains and burn marks.>>
Chinese: <<这张告示字迹潦草，染着茶渍和焦痕。>>

English: What happened to us, B? I see u every day, yet each time u treat me like a Stranger. Your familly act like they never met me. You taut me every thing I know.
Chinese: 我们怎么了，B？我天天见你，可你每次都待我像陌生人。你家里人像从来没见过我。我懂的每一件事都是你教的。

English: Did u truly forget that nite u saved my life, on the roof of the Squeeky Weal? Or are u only pretedning? Is this my Fault? Did I u wrong?
Chinese: 你真忘了那一晚吗，在吱嘎轮的屋顶上，你救过我的命？还是你在装？是我的错吗？我哪里对不起你？

English: <<This notice is fresh, written in neat block capitals.>>
Chinese: <<这张告示墨迹未干，字迹工整，全为大写。>>

English: [[DOES ANYONE REMEMBER]]: Vidal the vision trader having an Assistant? Young man, short, trying & failing to grow Beard, courteous to a Fault. Often retrieved Items from high Shelves, and called his master Guvnor.
Chinese: [[还有人记得吗]]：幻象商人维达尔是不是有过一个助手？年轻人，个子矮，想留胡子一直没留成，客气得过分。常从高架上取货，管他老板叫"掌柜的"。

English: Several Persons recall this man, but not his Name. Anyone with Information is kindly requested to tear off a Slip and write or call upon us at your own Convenience.
Chinese: 好几个人记得这个人，却不记得他叫什么。有线索者请撕下纸条写给我们，或按您方便的方式登门。

English: <<This notice is old and faded, half-hidden under several newer ones.>>
Chinese: <<这张告示又旧又褪色，半掩在几张新告示下面。>>

English: I wake up and heat a pot of water and my friend is gone. I queue for the summoning station and my friend is gone. I do the puzzle in the Royal Dispatch and my friend is gone.
Chinese: 我醒来烧一壶水，我的朋友没了。我去召唤站排队，我的朋友没了。我做王室急报上的谜题，我的朋友没了。

English: I look after my cousin's bairns, and laugh at their silly games, and my friend is gone. I check on my downstairs neighbour's silkworms while he's away on rotation, and my friend is still gone.
Chinese: 我帮表亲照看娃，笑他们幼稚的游戏，我的朋友没了。邻居轮休出门，我帮他照看蚕，我的朋友还是没了。

English: Please be alive. Please be safe. I'm so fucking lost.
Chinese: 求你活着。求你平安。我他妈真的茫然无措。

English: <<You place Oleg's candle among the others and light the wick. A soft green glow suffuses the leaves of paper, each one marking a life and a name.>>
Chinese: <<你把奥列格的蜡烛放在其他蜡烛中间，点燃烛芯。柔和的绿光漫过一张张纸页——每一张，都是一个生命和一个名字。>>

English: <<You think about Oleg's daughter, and all her sisters, and all the people for whom there will never be any candles.>> ##<<Then you think about the faces you saw on your way here.>>
Chinese: <<你想起了奥列格的女儿，想起她所有的姐妹，想起那些永远不会有蜡烛的人。>>##<<然后你想起了来这路上见过的那些面孔。>>

English: <<You think about Oleg's daughter, and all the people for whom there will never be any candles.>> ##<<Then you think about the faces you saw on your way here.>>
Chinese: <<你想起了奥列格的女儿，想起那些永远不会有蜡烛的人。>>##<<然后你想起了来这路上见过的那些面孔。>>

English: <<What have they lost that they won't let themselves mourn? Whose absence do they feel without even knowing it? How many are pretending not to see the abyss, for fear of being dragged in too? How many think it could never happen to them?>>
Chinese: <<他们失去了什么，却不许自己哀悼？他们感受着谁的缺席，却连自己都不知道？有多少人在假装看不见深渊，生怕也被拖进去？又有多少人觉得，这绝不可能轮到自己？>>

English: <<Behind you, someone begins to sing. Croaking and hesitant at first. No words – just a mournful, keening tune. Something like an elegy, something like a howl.>>
Chinese: <<你身后，有人开始唱起来。起初嘶哑而迟疑。没有词——只有一段哀恸、如泣如诉的调子。像挽歌，又像哀嚎。>>

English: <<A prayer and a promise. A hymn for the missing.>>
Chinese: <<一句祷词，一个承诺。一首献给失踪者的圣咏。>>

English: <<[Light a candle for Oleg's daughter.]>>
Chinese: <<[替奥列格的女儿点一支蜡烛。]>>

English: <<[Read one of the notices.]>>
Chinese: <<[读一张告示。]>>

English: <<[Look for the notice Sunil described.]>>
Chinese: <<[找找苏尼尔说的那张告示。]>>

English: <<[Look at Oleg's notice again.]>>
Chinese: <<[再看一眼奥列格的告示。]>>

English: <<[Read through the other notices.]>>
Chinese: <<[把其他告示读一遍。]>>

English: <<[Leave the noticeboard alone.]>>
Chinese: <<[别动告示板。]>>

English: <<[Read another notice.]>>
Chinese: <<[再读一张告示。]>>

English: <<A temporary sign on faded red paper is pinned to the noticeboard, reading: DEBUG MODE".>"
Chinese: <<告示板上钉着一张褪色红纸写的临时告示：调试模式"。>"

English: <<There is no response. Surely you didn't expect a noticeboard to talk back to you?>>
Chinese: <<没有任何反应。你总不会指望一块告示板回话吧？>>

English: <<Nothing seems to happen, but when you look away for a moment and look back, the DEBUG MODE" sign has vanished. Was it ever really there?>>"
Chinese: <<似乎什么都没发生，但当你移开视线再回头看，调试模式"的告示不见了。它真的存在过吗？>>"

English: <<A glass bottle flies past your ear and smashes against the doorframe. Its thrower is a middle-aged man, clearly very drunk.>>
Chinese: <<一只玻璃瓶擦着你的耳朵飞过，在门框上摔得粉碎。扔瓶子的是个中年男人，明显醉得不轻。>>

English: Hoodah – <<He hiccups.>> – ((fuck)) are ((you?)) Geddada mmmugudssam ((home!))
Chinese: 霍达——<<他打了个嗝。>>——((你他妈))是((谁？))给、给我滚回((家！))

English: <<The man's eyes widen in recognition, and he begins stabbing his finger at your chest.>>
Chinese: <<那人认出了你，眼睛一瞪，开始用手指戳你的胸口。>>

English: <<The man's eyes widen in recognition, and a deep blush blossoms across his cheeks.>>
Chinese: <<那人认出了你，脸颊涨起一片深红。>>

English: You! Yerrrr that – hic – ((Inquishiter))! Yafuggen... shhhlugshit, defeatishh ((bashtard))! Worrayuu done with mhhy [[child]], you misherable... ##<<He hiccups again.>> ...((fuckshters!))
Chinese: 是你！你个——嗝——((宗教裁判所的))！你们这群……嗝……烂蛆，你个该死的混账！你把我的[[孩子]]怎么了，你个卑鄙的……##<<他又打了个嗝。>>……((((混蛋玩意！))))

English: You. Yerrrr that – hic – ((Inquishiter)). ##L-lishen, thawha... jushta wuntim... iddin mean ((nuffin)), you misherable... <<He hiccups again.>> ...((fuckshter!))
Chinese: 是你。你个——嗝——((宗教裁判所的))。##听、听着，塔瓦……我就是想……没别的((意思))，你个卑鄙的……<<他又打了个嗝。>>……((混蛋玩意！))

English: <<The man peers without recognition.>> Frhhrr... borrda? Lodda – hic! – people adda borrda. Lissen... ##<<He stabs his finger at you.>> I donnnno you... frum SHIT.
Chinese: <<那人毫无认出的迹象，眯眼打量。>>弗唔……门口的？门口——嗝！——人多着呢。听着……##<<他戳戳你。>>我从根本上就不认识你。

English: <<He thinks for a moment.>> ##Knowha? Fuggit. Thasssshhhh whad I say. Fuggit! Leddemall through. Lleddem... blowup the ((King!))
Chinese: <<他想了想。>>##知道吗？管他呢。我就是这个意思。管他呢！都放进来。放他们……把((国王))炸上天！

English: Thasshhh what they get fer takin away mhhy [[child]]. ##<<He hiccups again.>>
Chinese: 这就是他们抢走我[[孩子]]的下场。##<<他又打了个嗝。>>

English: <<The man struggles to focus his eyes on you.>> ##Mmmiii... aright? Mmmh I all ((right))? Mmmyhh [[child]] is ((gone)) an yurasken ((me)) if m'allright?!
Chinese: <<那人努力聚焦双眼看你。>>##我……我((挺好))？我挺好的？我[[孩子]]((没了))，你还((问))我好不好？！

English: Yuu... shlugsucker! Shitbird! Misherable... ##<<He hiccups>> ...fuckshter!
Chinese: 你……蛆虫！臭鸟！卑鄙……##<<他打了个嗝>>……混蛋玩意！

English: Gwhaar... yuuaghen? ##Juss'... geddahell out. Duneven kurrenymore. <<He hiccups.>>
Chinese: 格哇……你又要怎样？##滚……滚远点。老子不在乎了。<<他打了个嗝。>>

English: <<Oleg groans at the sight of you. Some kind of word puzzle lies half-finished on the table.>> ##You again? Have I not humiliated myself enough?
Chinese: <<奥列格一见你就呻吟。桌上摆着一道做了一半的字谜。>>##又是你？我丢的人还不够吗？

English: Then leave me alone. I have humiliated myself enough.
Chinese: 那就别烦我。我丢的人够多了。

English: <<Oleg grunts.>> Next time I won't miss.
Chinese: <<奥列格哼了一声。>>下次我就扔准了。

English: Wherrghssyyfhlyddssshya... who's askin?
Chinese: 呼……唔……你谁啊？

English: Notish, notish... ##<<He hiccups.>> Yeahhh, ipuddah notish. Enya knowha?
Chinese: 告示、告示……##<<他打了个嗝。>>对哦，我贴过告示。然后呢？

English: ((Fuck)) allathat sssshhhhhhhhit. Who even cairsh? Whassa poin? Ev'rywunns mishen nowadaysh. Sno yoosh. <<Hic.>>
Chinese: 全是((屁))。谁在乎？有什么意义？如今人人都有"使命"。少来这套。<<嗝。>>

English: Advunnssha? Yerra fucken ad – <<hic>> scuse me – ad-venshhra? Whaddahell daz((zat)) mean?
Chinese: 先知？你个该死的先——<<嗝>>不好意思——先知是什么((鬼))东西？

English: Ooooh, yagonna... yagonna slash me wivva ((shword))? <<He makes wild swinging motions with his hands.>>
Chinese: 哦哦，你要……你要拿((剑))砍我？<<他双手胡乱挥舞。>>

English: <<His eyes cross as he looks at the insignia.>> ##Thawha...? ##<<He squints at you.>> Huh. Yuknowha?
Chinese: <<他看着徽记，双眼对起了焦。>>##这是……？##<<他眯眼看你。>>嘿。你懂的还挺多？

English: ((To hell)) widda mashima... mashinama... guddsam ((Guild)). Firdy yerrs a' servish ennyadun givvah ((fuck))abad anyvush!
Chinese: ((去他))的什么机械……机械师……该死的((公会))。干了四十年，到头来没一个人((他妈))在乎！

English: <<He rubs his eyes and stares at you.>> Wha...? Izzat really...? ##Ey. ((Ey.)) Yerrno ma kid.  I gan ((shhhmell)) it. Yerr nuthin butta guddsam ((shhwindler!))
Chinese: <<他揉揉眼，盯着你。>>啥……？真是……？##喂。((喂。))你不是我孩子。我((闻))得出来。你就是个该死的((骗子！))

English: Ya loushy crook! Shcoundrel! Goblinsshh <<hic>> bashtard!
Chinese: 你这个无赖！恶棍！哥布林<<嗝>>杂种！

English: <<If you want anything useful out of him, you'll need to sober him up.>>
Chinese: <<想从他嘴里问出有用的东西，你得先让他醒酒。>>

English: <<You pat your pockets, but it seems you're fresh out.>>
Chinese: <<你拍了拍口袋，似乎一滴不剩。>>

English: <<The man shrugs and drinks it. His eyes widen and his hands begin to shake. Then he dunks a pitcher of water over his own head.>>
Chinese: <<那人耸耸肩喝了下去。他双眼圆睁，双手开始发抖，然后举起一罐水兜头浇下。>>

English: <<The man shrugs and drinks it. His eyes widen as he stares around in wonder. Then he looks at you.>> ##Oh. Stranger. I am so ((sorry)).
Chinese: <<那人耸耸肩喝了下去。他双眼圆睁，惊讶地环顾四周，然后看向你。>>##哦。陌生人。我非常((抱歉))。

English: <<He shakes his head to clear it.>> Whoof!
Chinese: <<他甩了甩头，想把它甩清醒。>>呼！

English: <<The man blinks in surprise, then slaps you back.>> ##You bastard! Who the hell do you think you are, coming into my house –
Chinese: <<那人吃惊地眨眨眼，反手给你一巴掌。>>##你个混蛋！你算什么东西，敢闯进我家——

English: <<He scrunches up his eyes.>> ((Ow.))
Chinese: <<他眼睛皱成一团。>>((嗷。))

English: <<Oleg glares at you.>> Is this your idea of helping? ##You have wasted your time. [[My child]] is gone, and I am still here. That's all there is; case closed, end of message.
Chinese: <<奥列格瞪着你。>>这就是你说的帮忙？##你白白浪费时间。[[我的孩子]]没了，我还在这儿。就这样；结案，完事。

English: I ((have)) no child. Once, yes. Galette Myshkin and Indira Myshkin. Died young. Buried them myself. Ancient history. You can see I live alone here.
Chinese: 我((没有))孩子。曾经有过。加莱特·米什金和英迪拉·米什金。小小年纪就没了。是我亲手埋的。陈年旧事了。你看，我现在独自生活。

English: But... last month I found something. A [[locket]], in among the junk at the back of that cabinet I never open. Says: to my father". I don't recognise it, yet somehow I know I have seen it before."
Chinese: 但是……上个月我发现了样东西。一枚[[吊坠]]，就在那个我从来不开的柜子深处，混在一堆破烂里。上面写着：给我父亲"。我不认得它，可不知为何，我知道我曾经见过它。"

English: I've thought about it, and there's only one answer. ##The locket is mine. I ((did)) have another child. One that I have somehow [[forgotten]].
Chinese: 我想了很久，答案只有一个。##吊坠是我的。我((确实))有过另一个孩子。一个不知为何被我[[遗忘]]的孩子。

English: So, now you've heard the whole sorry tale. Isn't it pathetic, a grown man weeping over a fantasy? ##I don't care if you believe me. Just leave me to drown myself in peace.
Chinese: 好了，这段心酸的往事你都听完了。挺可悲的，对吧？一个成年人对着幻想流泪。##你信不信无所谓。让我安安静静地淹死就行。

English: Whatever you like. I have no pride left to conserve.
Chinese: 随你怎么说。我的自尊早就所剩无几了。

English: Now, have you finished tormenting me?
Chinese: 现在，你折磨够了吗？

English: <<Oleg laughs bitterly.>> Quite a puzzle, right? Can you ((imagine)) how bad a father you would have to be?
Chinese: <<奥列格苦笑。>>好一个谜题，对吧？你能((想象))一个人得差劲到什么地步，才算得上这样的父亲吗？

English: I cannot explain it. Or at least... ##<<He eyes you cautiously.>> ...Not to you.
Chinese: 我解释不了。或者至少……##<<他警惕地打量你。>>……不对你解释。

English: First I thought it must be my ex-wife's, right? So I send the old harpy a letter. She says it must have been dropped by one of my strumpets". Ha! I should be so lucky."
Chinese: 起初我想，那一定是我前妻的，对吧？于是我给那只老母鸡写了封信。她说肯定是我哪个狐狸精"掉的。哈！我要真有这艳福就好了。"

English: Then I notice other things. That shitty clay pot; who made it? Not Indira. Or those height marks on the wall; whose? Indira never got that tall.
Chinese: 后来我又注意到别的。那个破陶罐，谁做的？不是英迪拉。还有墙上那些刻的身高线，是谁的？英迪拉从来没长到那么高。

English: You ever feel like you've lost something, but you don't know what? Like you're incomplete, but you don't know how? For years I have felt this.
Chinese: 你有没有过那种感觉：丢了什么东西，却不知道丢了什么？觉得自己缺了一块，却不知道缺在哪？这种感觉我有很多年了。

English: So, when the idea came to me, I knew instantly. This was it. The missing piece.
Chinese: 所以当那个念头冒出来时，我立刻就知道：就是它。缺失的那一块。

English: Nothing. You see my problem? There are no clues. The pain is so much worse now that I know – and yet, I have no way to end it.
Chinese: 毫无头绪。你明白我的难处了吧？一点线索都没有。现在知道了，反而更痛——可我却没有任何办法终结这种痛。

English: I thought perhaps if I drink enough, I will forget all over again. No such luck.
Chinese: 我一度想，也许喝得够多，就能再忘掉一次。没这个福气。

English: So now you see: the case is hopeless. And the one person who could help would never talk to me. As I said, you are wasting your time.
Chinese: 所以你看到了：这个案子没有希望。唯一能帮我的人，永远不会跟我说话。我说过，你在浪费时间。

English: <<Oleg examines you, weighing his options.>> ##Hrm. Well, if it will make you leave me in peace...
Chinese: <<奥列格打量着你，权衡利弊。>>##唔。好吧，只要能让你让我清净……

English: To the west of this city is a place called the [[Library of Untruths]]. No signs point to it, and no ((official)) map marks it, but it's there.
Chinese: 这座城以西有个地方，叫[[虚言图书馆]]。没有路标指向它，((官方))地图也不标它，但它就在那里。

English: Take my [[locket]] and and show it to the [[librarian]], and perhaps – ((maybe)) – she will help.
Chinese: 带上我的[[吊坠]]给[[图书管理员]]看，也许——((只是也许))——她会帮忙。

English: Listen, I am not sentimental. I know my child may be dead, or worse. All I want is to know their [[name]] and their [[fate]]. At least then I know who to mourn for.
Chinese: 听着，我不是感情用事的人。我知道我的孩子可能死了，或者更糟。我只想知道他们的[[名字]]和[[下落]]。至少那样，我知道该为谁哀悼。

English: <<Oleg examines you, weighing his options.>> ##Many years I have served this kingdom. Guarding the border, seizing contraband.
Chinese: <<奥列格打量着你，权衡利弊。>>##我为这个王国效力了很多年。守边境，查违禁品。

English: We get all ((kinds)) of contraband. If some of it went missing, no one would notice.
Chinese: 什么((种类))的违禁品都有。要是少了几件，不会有人注意。

English: Oleg Igorovich, I presume.
Chinese: 我想，这位就是奥列格·伊戈罗维奇吧。

English: Wait, I know you. You're that border guard I met at the gatebridge.
Chinese: 等等，我认识你。你是关卡桥上那个边防兵。

English: Sir, are you quite all right?
Chinese: 先生，您还好吗？

English: So you ((are)) Oleg Igorovich.
Chinese: 这么说你((就是))奥列格·伊戈罗维奇。

English: What's this about your child?
Chinese: 你孩子的事是怎么回事？

English: I still have questions about your child.
Chinese: 关于你孩子，我还有问题。

English: I'll leave you to your hangover.
Chinese: 你慢慢醒酒吧。

English: I saw your missing persons notice. I'm here to help.
Chinese: 我看到了你的失踪告示。我是来帮忙的。

English: I'm an adventurer. Maybe I can find your child.
Chinese: 我是个冒险者。也许我能找到你的孩子。

English: <<[Show insignia]>> The Guild has taken an interest in your case, citizen.
Chinese: <<[出示徽记]>>公会关注了你的案子，公民。

English: <<[Lie]>> Father, it's me! It's been so long...
Chinese: <<[撒谎]>>爸爸，是我呀！好久不见……

English: <<If you want anything useful out of him, you'll need to sober him up.>>
Chinese: <<想从他嘴里问出有用的东西，你得先让他醒酒。>>

English: <<You pat your pockets, but it seems you're fresh out.>>
Chinese: <<你拍了拍口袋，似乎一滴不剩。>>

English: <<[Give him a potion of stamina.]>>
Chinese: <<[给他一瓶体力药水。]>>

English: <<[Give him a potion of truth.]>>
Chinese: <<[给他一瓶真言药水。]>>

English: <<[Give him a slap.]>>
Chinese: <<[给他一巴掌。]>>

English: Hold that thought. I'll be right back.
Chinese: 你先等着。我马上回来。

English: What do you mean, gone?
Chinese: 什么叫"没了"？

English: Then why did you post that notice?
Chinese: 那你为什么贴那张告示？

English: Where should I start looking?
Chinese: 那我该从哪开始找？

English: How is it possible to forget your own child?
Chinese: 怎么会有人忘掉自己的孩子？

English: How can you be sure it's really your locket?
Chinese: 你怎么确定那真的是你的吊坠？

English: Can you tell me anything at all about the child?
Chinese: 关于这个孩子，你多少能告诉我点什么吧？

English: That's all my questions for now.
Chinese: 我暂时就问这些。

English: What if I could talk to this person for you?
Chinese: 要是我能替你去跟那个人谈呢？

English: You'd be surprised what I can do if properly ((compensated)).
Chinese: 只要((报酬))到位，我能做到的事会让你吃惊。

English: I'll see what I can do, Mr Myshkin.
Chinese: 我尽力试试，米什金先生。

English: Let me ask you something else first.
Chinese: 先问点别的吧。

English: <<You find Oleg absorbed in some kind of word puzzle, with a bottle of liquor open on the table. He does not look up.>>
Chinese: <<你发现奥列格正埋头做某种字谜，桌上开着瓶酒。他头也不抬。>>

English: <<You find Oleg absorbed in some kind of word puzzle. He is sober, but when he glances up, you see bags under his eyes.>> ##You again. Have you come to throw in the towel?
Chinese: <<你发现奥列格正埋头做字谜。他清醒着，但抬眼看你时，眼下挂着黑眼圈。>>##又是你。是来打退堂鼓的？

English: <<Oleg shrugs.>> You are free to waste your own time.
Chinese: <<奥列格耸耸肩。>>你的时间随你浪费。

English: <<Oleg stares at you for a long time, without visible emotion.>> ##You are trying to scam me. You just picked that out of some book you read.
Chinese: <<奥列格久久地盯着你，不形于色。>>##你想骗我。这话是你从哪本书里抄的。

English: <<Oleg looks at the wall. He starts to reach for a bottle, then stops.>> ##...Aphra. What kind of name is that? Must have been Genevieve's idea. I would never have chosen it.
Chinese: <<奥列格看向墙。他伸手要够酒瓶，又停住了。>>##……阿芙拉。这算什么名字？一定是吉纳维芙的主意。换我绝不会选这个。

English: Well? You used the past tense, so I assume it is not good news.
Chinese: 怎么样？你用了过去时，那我猜不是好消息。

English: <<You tell Oleg a partial story, saying his daughter was killed when Progress fell to the Corruption. At one point his hands begin shaking, so he hides them in his lap.>>
Chinese: <<你给奥列格讲了个半截故事，说他的女儿在进步城陷落于腐化时死了。讲到一半，他的手开始发抖，便藏进了膝间。>>

English: <<You tell Oleg about your encounter in the cleanup camp, but no more. At one point his hands begin shaking, so he hides them in his lap.>>
Chinese: <<你跟奥列格讲了清理营的遭遇，仅此而已。讲到一半，他的手开始发抖，便藏进了膝间。>>

English: <<You tell Oleg the whole story, from the cleanup camp to your confrontation with Sunil. At one point his hands begin shaking, so he hides them in his lap.>>
Chinese: <<你把整个故事讲给奥列格听，从清理营到你与苏尼尔的对峙。讲到一半，他的手开始发抖，便藏进了膝间。>>

English: I had suspicions, of course. That my forgetting was no accident. We all know the Guild changes people – normal people, not just crooks and saboteurs. If you are observant, you see signs everywhere. Only, you can never be sure who is safe to tell.
Chinese: 我当然起过疑心。我的遗忘绝非偶然。谁都知道公会在改造人——普通人，不只是骗子和破坏分子。只要你留心，处处都是迹象。只是你永远说不准谁能听、跟谁说安全。

English: <<He shakes his head.>> Special project. I guess I ought to feel honoured. ##They should have looked after her. Given her an easy job, a pension. At least a fucking ((medal)).
Chinese: <<他摇头。>>特别计划。我猜我还该觉得光荣。##他们本该照顾她。给她个轻松的差事，一份养老金。至少发枚他妈的((勋章))。

English: Well then. Do you... still have my [[locket]]?
Chinese: 那么。你……还留着我的[[吊坠]]吗？

English: <<He takes the locket gingerly in both hands, as if afraid of breaking it, and bows his forehead against it for what feels like an eternity.>>
Chinese: <<他小心翼翼地用双手接过吊坠，像怕碰碎它，然后额头抵着它，抵了很久很久。>>

English: <<You see his temper start to flare, and he opens his mouth to yell. But something inscrutable deserts him at the last moment, and he slowly sags back into his chair, staring at the table.>>
Chinese: <<你看见他的火气窜起来，张嘴要吼。可最后关头，某种说不清的东西从他身上泄掉了，他缓缓瘫回椅子里，盯着桌面。>>

English: Pah. Sentimental crap. But... ##<<He sighs.>> Perhaps it is fitting. Were not the queens of the ancient surface buried with their belongings?
Chinese: 呸。多愁善感的屁话。不过……##<<他叹了口气。>>或许也算相称。古地表的女王下葬时，不也带着随身之物吗？

English: <<Oleg looks up at you, clearly struggling for words.>> ##The way this ended is... no fault of yours. You have given me answers. I am...in your debt.
Chinese: <<奥列格抬头看你，显然在努力措辞。>>##这件事的结局……不是你的错。你给了我答案。我……欠你的。

English: A debt like this can never be made square. But let me at least give you a down payment.
Chinese: 这样的人情永远还不清。但至少让我付个首付。

English: This [[key]] was kindly donated by a smuggler we picked up. In a ((polite)) and ((civil)) conversation, he told us that it unlocked a stolen [[royal freight capsule]], jettisoned from his ship while flying over one of those [[outlying islands]] nobody visits.
Chinese: 这把[[钥匙]]是我们抓的一个走私犯好心捐的。在一场((礼貌))而((文明))的谈话里，他告诉我们，它能开一只被窃的[[皇家货舱]]——是他驾船飞过某座没人去的[[离岛]]时抛下的。

English: The island is only reachable by [[air]], but you can bet there's [[treasure]] in that capsule. ##It was going to be my retirement plan, until somehow the key vanished from our stockpile. Oh well. Happens all the time.
Chinese: 那座岛只有走[[空中]]才能到，但我敢说货舱里肯定有[[宝藏]]。##那本来是我的退休计划，结果钥匙不知怎么就从库房里消失了。唉，常有的事。

English: And now I must ask one more favour. Not for me, but for my daughter. ##Take this [[candle]] to the [[missing persons noticeboard]] after dark. Light it, and let that be an end.
Chinese: 现在我还要再求你一件事。不是为我，是为我女儿。##天黑后把这支[[蜡烛]]带到[[失踪人口告示板]]去。点上它，就此了结。

English: Good. Well, you have the candle. ##<<He goes back to his word puzzle.>>
Chinese: 好。蜡烛你拿好了。##<<他回去继续做他的字谜。>>

English: I will find my own kind of ceremony. Some things must be done properly, that is all.
Chinese: 我会用我自己的方式办仪式。有些事必须办得体面，仅此而已。

English: <<Oleg says nothing. You leave him sitting in his cold little apartment, absorbed in his puzzle.>>
Chinese: <<奥列格一言不发。你离开时，他仍坐在冰冷的小公寓里，埋头做他的字谜。>>

English: <<Oleg's expression turns sour.>> What now? Can a man not be left to grieve in peace?
Chinese: <<奥列格神色一沉。>>又怎么了？就不能让一个人安安静静地哀悼吗？

English: Now, please, no more questions. What else is there to say?
Chinese: 好了，请别再问了。还有什么可说的？

English: I am happy for them, but they are ((not)) my daughters. You say they were altered by magic? Then they are new people.
Chinese: 我为她们高兴，可她们((不是))我的女儿。你说她们被魔法改造过？那她们就是新的人了。

English: If they are anyone's children, they are the King's. Let Its Majesty look for them, if it wants.
Chinese: 要说她们是谁的孩子，那是国王的。陛下想要，让它自己找去。

English: Are you going to say that some part of her is still in there? That maybe there is a way to save her? ##These are foolish tales people tell themselves because they are scared of the truth.
Chinese: 你是不是要说，她有一部分还在那里面？说不定还有办法救她？##这些都是人们吓怕了讲给自己听的傻话。

English: Just as a corpse may gasp and twitch hours after death, so the Corrupted vomit up chunks of the person they replaced. What you spoke to was only an echo, like a ghost.
Chinese: 就像尸体死后几小时还会抽搐喘息，腐化者也会吐出被它们取代的那个人的一些碎片。你对话过的只是回声，一个幽灵。

English: Besides, what would I do? Break her out of her cage? Smuggle her past quarantine? Hide her in my cupboard? Then we would both be destroyed.
Chinese: 再说，我能怎么办？把她从笼子里劫出来？偷运过隔离线？藏进我家柜子？那我们俩就都完了。

English: My daughter is gone. Whatever ((thing)) has her body now, let them burn it.
Chinese: 我的女儿已经没了。如今占着她身体的那个((东西))，让它们烧了吧。

English: <<He eyes you venomously.>> ##What ((exactly)) are you saying? That this was my fault? What kind of question is that for a grieving father?
Chinese: <<他恶狠狠地瞪你。>>##你到底((想))说什么？说这是我的错？对一个哀悼的父亲，这算什么问题？

English: <<He slams the table.>> [[Enough]]! What the hell do you know about my life? About my country?
Chinese: <<他猛拍桌子。>>[[够了]]！我的人生你懂什么？我的国家你懂什么？

English: Do you think I can just knock on the King's door and ask nicely? You think they can't find someone else who wants my job, my house?
Chinese: 你以为我能敲开国王的门好好商量？你以为他们找不着别人来要我的工作、我的房子？

English: I ((protect)) this Kingdom. It is outsiders like ((you)), sneaking in and out – smugglers, mercenaries, saboteurs and spies – that force the King to take such a heavy hand. If everyone followed the law, none of this would have happened.
Chinese: 我在((保卫))这个王国。正是像((你))这样的外人——走私犯、佣兵、破坏者和间谍——进进出出，才逼得国王下手这么重。人人都守法的话，这一切都不会发生。

English: Oleg, I need to ask you something.
Chinese: 奥列格，我有事要问你。

English: <<[Leave without a word.]>>
Chinese: <<[一言不发地离开。]>>

English: I found your daughter. Her name was Aphra.
Chinese: 我找到你女儿了。她叫阿芙拉。

English: Not yet. There's one more lead I need to investigate.
Chinese: 还没有。还有条线索要查。

English: She'd be 36 this year. She worked on a farm in Istrik. She wanted to come home to Ferropolis, but the King denied her.
Chinese: 她今年该 36 岁了。她在伊斯特里克的一个农场干活。她想回铁城，国王没批准。

English: She wanted to go to technical school but they sent her to a factory. Then they took away her medicine, so she got fired.
Chinese: 她想上技术学堂，却被派进了工厂。后来他们停了她的药，她就丢了工作。

English: She asked the King to change her body, but it refused. At one point she got arrested for wearing the wrong clothes.
Chinese: 她请求国王改造她的身体，被拒绝了。有阵子她还因为穿错衣服被逮捕过。

English: I'm sorry. Your daughter is dead.
Chinese: 对不起。你的女儿死了。

English: I'm sorry. Your daughter has become Corrupted.
Chinese: 对不起。你的女儿被腐化了。

English: <<[Tell him about Project Horoscope]>> Actually, it's complicated...
Chinese: <<[告诉他星象计划的事]>>其实，说来复杂……

English: <<[Silently hand it over.]>>
Chinese: <<[默默交给他。]>>

English: I left it with your daughter. It seemed like the right thing to do.
Chinese: 我留给你女儿了。我觉得那样做是对的。

English: Wait a minute. This isn't over.
Chinese: 等等。这事还没完。

English: <<[Remain silent.]>>
Don't you want to be there when I light it?
Chinese: 我点蜡烛的时候你不想在场吗？

English: Let me ask you something else before I go.
Chinese: 走之前再问你点事。

English: Farewell, Oleg.
Chinese: 再会了，奥列格。

English: There are versions of your daughter that survived. Don't you want to meet them?
Chinese: 你女儿有一些存活的版本。你不想见见她们吗？

English: Corrupted or not, Aphra recognised the locket. She remembered you.
Chinese: 就算被腐化了，阿芙拉认得那枚吊坠。她记得你。

English: Don't you see you're part of this? Your job upholds the regime that got her killed.
Chinese: 你看不出你也是这一切的一部分吗？你的工作支撑着的体制，害死了她。

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就是这些。

English: Very well. I'm done.
Chinese: 好吧。我说完了。

English: You can't just carry on like nothing is wrong!
Chinese: 你不能就这样若无其事地过下去！

English: You have power in this kingdom. You could ((do)) something.
Chinese: 你在这个王国是有影响力的人。你本可以((做))点什么。

English: You're right, I'm sorry. Forget I said anything.
Chinese: 你说得对，抱歉。就当我没说。

English: Halt, traveller – ##<<Oleg looks around in puzzlement.>> Ach, King's cock. This is [[debug mode]], isn't it?
Chinese: 站住，旅人——##<<奥列格困惑地环顾四周。>>唉，国王的老二。这是[[调试模式]]，对吧？

English: <<He gives you a venomous glare.>> ##Well? What did you bring me here for, you defeatist scum?
Chinese: <<他恶毒地瞪你。>>##怎么样？你把老子弄到这儿来干什么，你这失败的软蛋？

English: Whatever. All the mushroom wine in Hallowshire cannot make this experience bearable.
Chinese: 随你便。哈洛郡的蘑菇酒再多，也解不了这摊事的苦。

English: ((What)) did you say to me, you little – ?!
Chinese: 你((说))我什么，你这个小——？！

English: Are you the one Oleg's been waiting for? He was ((very)) intent on not missing you. Made me promise to wake him up if anyone called while he was asleep.
Chinese: 你就是奥列格等的人吗？他((千叮万嘱))不能错过你。让我答应他，谁来找他就叫醒他。

English: <<The man turns and yells upstairs.>> ##Oi! Oleg! Visitor!
Chinese: <<那人转身朝楼上喊。>>##喂！奥列格！有人找！

English: You here to see Citizen Myshkin? He's just upstairs, in the rooms above. ##Mind yourself, though – he's mean when he's drunk. Which lately means pretty much always.
Chinese: 你是来找米什金公民的？他就在楼上。##不过你自己当心——他喝醉了很凶。最近嘛，他基本一直是醉的。

English: Aye, that's the one. Is he in trouble or something? ##<<The man snorts.>> Couldn't have happened to a nicer bloke.
Chinese: 对，就是他。他惹上麻烦了？##<<那人嗤笑。>>再没有比他更合适的了。

English: Would that be 'Oleg Igorovich Myshkin', by any chance?
Chinese: 该不会是"奥列格·伊戈罗维奇·米什金"吧？

English: Thanks for the warning.
Chinese: 多谢提醒。

English: ...mass over sorrow to the power of quiddity is equal to the square root of petrichor point seven seven one recurring, carry the amphibrach...
Chinese: ……团块乘以悲怆的本质幂，等于雨后土香的循环小数点七七一，进位一个短长短格……

English: ...No, no, no, heresy, ((HERESY!)) Find another path, yes, another answer...
Chinese: ……不，不，不，异端，((异端！))再找一条路，对，另一个答案……

English: Hey. Buddy. Hey buddy. Help a fella out? I know where you can find some ((real)) treasures. All ya gotta do is get me outta here...
Chinese: 嘿。伙计。嘿伙计。搭把手呗？我知道哪儿能找到((真正))的宝贝。你只要把我从这里弄出去……

English: Ehhh... you know. Treasures. The kind mortals just love. Gold, jewels, ingots. Pearl necklaces, fancy hats. Fresh fruit and loving parents. That kinda thing.
Chinese: 呃……你懂的。宝贝。凡人最爱那种。金子、珠宝、金条。珍珠项链、漂亮的帽子。新鲜水果和慈爱的爹娘。那一类的。

English: All one hundred percent guaranteed to ((not)) be cursed in any way.
Chinese: 全部百分之百保证((绝对))不受任何诅咒。

English: Aw c'mon, buddy! I can make ya rich beyond your wildest dreams. Where you goin', friend? Chum? Ol' pal o' mine? You rotten filthy bastard, you can't just leave me here...!
Chinese: 哎呀别走啊伙计！我能让你富得流油，超出你最狂野的梦。去哪啊朋友？老兄？老伙计？你这肮脏的混蛋，你不能就这么把我丢在这儿……！

English: What kind of treasures?
Chinese: 什么样的宝贝？

English: Sorry, not interested.
Chinese: 抱歉，没兴趣。

English: <<This woman is in late middle age, perfectly inconspicuous but for her bright red lipstick. She looks up from a stack of papers to inspect you through half-moon glasses.>>
Chinese: <<这位妇女年近暮年，毫无出奇之处，唯独唇上一抹鲜红。她从一摞文件上抬起头，透过半月形眼镜打量你。>>

English: Can I help you, dearie? Do try to keep your voice down; the mechapedes are provoked by sound.
Chinese: 需要帮忙吗，亲爱的？请尽量压低声音；机械蜈蚣会被声音惊动。

English: <<You hear a mechanical chittering from the ceiling.>> ##A little quieter please, dearie. They stay snuggled away most of the time, but if we make too much noise they'll come scurrying out hungry for blood.
Chinese: <<你听见天花板传来机械的窸窣声。>>##请再小点声，亲爱的。它们大部分时间都蜷着，可我们要是太吵，它们就会饿着血味冲出来。

English: Mechapedes, dearie. They stay snuggled away most of the time. If I were to scream, they'd come scurrying out hungry for blood. But I'm sure you wouldn't give me any cause for that, hmm?
Chinese: 机械蜈蚣，亲爱的。它们大部分时间都蜷着。要是我尖叫，它们就会饿着血味冲出来。不过我相信你不会给我这种理由的，嗯？

English: Now, can I help you find anything?
Chinese: 那么，需要我帮你找什么吗？

English: Hello again, dearie. Can I help you find anything?
Chinese: 又见面了，亲爱的。需要我帮你找什么吗？

English: Did you need something else, dearie?
Chinese: 还有别的需要吗，亲爱的？

English: A rather dreary archive, I'm afraid, run by blessed [[Machinists' Guild]]. Before the God War, this was a chapel to one of those dreadful Wikkan deities.
Chinese: 一座相当乏味的档案库，恐怕如此，由尊贵的[[机械师公会]]运营。神之战之前，这里是供奉某位可怕的维坎神祇的小教堂。

English: Any other questions?
Chinese: 还有别的问题吗？

English: Now it stores official records for the [[Clockwork King]] – most of which will put you straight to sleep.
Chinese: 如今它为[[发条王]]存放官方档案——大部分能让你当场睡着。

English: You're the first in a while, dearie. I don't mind admitting it gets a bit lonely out here, but at least the machines keep me company.
Chinese: 你是好一阵子来的头一位，亲爱的。不瞒你说，这儿有点冷清，好在还有机器作伴。

English: Perhaps one day they'll replace ((me)) with a machine, eh? Hopefully only after I've earned my pension.
Chinese: 说不定哪天他们就会用机器换掉((我))，嗯？但愿那是在我领上养老金之后。

English: That depends, dearie. Documents can be accessed from the [[reading room]] upstairs, as long as you have the right paperwork.
Chinese: 那要看情况，亲爱的。文件可以在楼上的[[阅览室]]查阅，只要手续齐全。

English: Does that all make sense, dearie?
Chinese: 这些都说清楚了吗，亲爱的？

English: Usually we'd want a specific permit from the Clockwork King for whatever records you wish to see. Occasionally Its Majesty grants general permits, but we don't see those too often.
Chinese: 通常，你想看哪份档案，就得有发条王的具体许可。偶尔陛下会发通用许可，但很少见。

English: <<She examines it, then looks kindly at you over her spectacles.>> ##That's a very nice brooch, but I'm afraid I'll need something more specific. Let me know if you need help filling out a petition.
Chinese: <<她看了看，然后从眼镜上方和善地看你。>>##这枚胸针很漂亮，但恐怕我需要更具体的东西。填呈文需要帮忙的话告诉我。

English: <<She consults a ledger.>> Hmm, let me see... ##You're in luck, dearie. We have an issue of the [[Royal Dispatch]] that mentions that group. It's public material, so you won't need any permit.
Chinese: <<她查了查登记册。>>嗯，让我看看……##你运气好，亲爱的。我们有一期提到过那个组织的[[王室急报]]。那是公开材料，不需要许可。

English: <<The librarian straightens up in her chair and whistles three eldritch notes. Your ears pop, and an intangible wind rustles the pages all around you.>>
Chinese: <<图书管理员从椅子上直起身，吹了三声诡异的口哨。你的耳朵嗡地一胀，一阵无形的风吹动了你四周的纸页。>>

English: You'll find it on one of the lecterns in this room. ##Just don't try to tamper with it, hm? Otherwise the mechapedes will be ((very)) angry.
Chinese: 它就在这间屋子的某张阅读台上。##别想着乱动它，嗯？不然机械蜈蚣会((非常))生气。

English: <<She looks at you over her spectacles.>> The library of ((what))? That certainly doesn't sound like a real place, dearie.
Chinese: <<她从眼镜上方看你。>>((什么))的图书馆？这听起来可不像真实存在的地方，亲爱的。

English: If such a place did exist, you wouldn't be allowed there; and so, if this was it, you'd have to leave. But... ##<<She smiles sweetly at you.>> It doesn't, and this isn't, so you're fine.
Chinese: 就算真有那种地方，你也不被允许进去；所以，如果这里是的话，你就得离开。不过……##<<她朝你甜甜一笑。>>这里不是，所以你没事。

English: Is this a game, dearie? I confess I don't know the rules. Three fingers, of course.
Chinese: 这是在玩游戏吗，亲爱的？恕我不知规则。三根手指，当然是。

English: Try not to disturb the skulls, dearie. They have all kinds of funny ideas.
Chinese: 别打扰那些骷髅，亲爱的。它们满脑子的怪主意。

English: <<She frowns.>> What's this? Did Oleg send you? ##Damnit, I've already told him I know nothing about any...
Chinese: <<她皱眉。>>怎么？奥列格派你来的？##该死，我已经跟他说过了，我对什么……一无所知……

English: <<Her eyes catch the locket, and suddenly she can't look away.>> ##...locket.
Chinese: <<她的目光落在吊坠上，忽然再也移不开。>>##……吊坠。

English: I've never seen this locket in my life. Except... why does it feel so...? ##<<She takes it gingerly, feeling it in her hands.>>
Chinese: 我这辈子从没见过这枚吊坠。只是……为什么它摸起来这么……？##<<她小心翼翼地拿起它，在手中摩挲。>>

English: <<She shoves the locket back at you.>> ##Please leave. Tell that drunken bloody oaf I want nothing to do with him, and I'm ((not)) –
Chinese: <<她把吊坠塞回给你。>>##请走吧。告诉那个醉鬼老混蛋，我跟他没有任何瓜葛，我也((不))——

English: <<She slams her fist on the desk to emphasise her point, prompting a chorus of mechanical chitters from the ceiling.>>
Chinese: <<她一拳砸在桌上以示强调，惊得天上传来一片机械的窸窣声。>>

English: <<The librarian sighs and lowers her voice to a sharp whisper.>> ##As I said. I'm not rescinding my petition.
Chinese: <<图书管理员叹了口气，把声音压成尖锐的耳语。>>##正如我说的。我不会撤回我的申请。

English: Our ((divorce)) petition. Isn't that why Oleg sent you? We've been waiting more than a year now for Its Majesty's ruling. Unfortunately, there's a backlog.
Chinese: 我们那((离婚))申请。奥列格不就是为这个派你来的吗？我们等陛下的裁决已经等了一年多。可惜，积压得很。

English: <<She listens to your explanation with growing alarm.>> ##But... but that's preposterous. That can't be right. I ((know)) that isn't...
Chinese: <<她越听越是惊惶。>>##可……可这太荒谬了。那不可能是对的。我((知道))那不是……

English: <<Her eyes return inexorably to the locket.>> King's mercy. It's true, isn't it?
Chinese: <<她的目光不由自主地又回到吊坠上。>>国王开恩。是真的，对不对？

English: <<She looks back at you, seemingly on the verge of tears.>> ##I... apologise for my, um, outburst. I'm a little taken aback. You see, [[it's my child too]].
Chinese: <<她回头看你，仿佛快哭出来。>>##我……为我刚才的发火道歉。我有点措手不及。你知道，[[那也是我的孩子]]。

English: Listen. I ((can't)) help you. This ((is)) just an ordinary library, you see? There's ((nothing)) here about any [[missing child]]. And I ((am)) authorised to help you with ((whatever)) you need. Do you understand?
Chinese: 听着。我((不能))帮你。这((就是))一座普通的图书馆，明白吗？这里((没有任何))关于[[失踪孩子]]的东西。而我((确实有))权限帮你解决((一切))需求。明白了吗？

English: <<She gives you a meaningful look.>> Don't be absurd. There used to be a librarian here who could only lie, but she turned into a dragon and flew away.
Chinese: <<她意味深长地看了你一眼。>>别说傻话。从前这儿是有一个只会说谎的管理员来着，后来她变成一条龙飞走了。

English: Sorry I couldn't be of more help, dearie.
Chinese: 没能帮上更多忙，抱歉了亲爱的。

English: <<She steels herself.>> Go on, dearie. How can I help?
Chinese: <<她鼓起勇气。>>说吧，亲爱的。我能怎么帮你？

English: <<She thinks for a moment.>> Everything stored here is absolutely true, see? And it always was.
Chinese: <<她想了想。>>这里存放的一切都绝对真实，明白吗？过去也一直是。

English: Whatever you may have heard about the King being able to edit people out of reality is complete nonsense. If that ((was)) happening, everyone would certainly notice.
Chinese: 你可能听说的那些"国王能把人从现实里编辑掉"的话，纯属一派胡言。那种事((如果真在))发生，所有人一定会注意到。

English: And of course there would be no record of it. How can you keep records of something that never existed? ##I can't imagine why the Machinists would ever need something like that.
Chinese: 而且当然不会有任何记录。没存在过的东西，怎么留记录？##我想不出机械师们怎么会需要那种东西。

English: Whatever do you mean? Naturally I can tell you basic facts about this library, such as how to access documents. And no one will mind if we chat about our own lives, or the weather or suchlike.
Chinese: 你什么意思？关于这座图书馆的基本事实，比如怎么查阅文件，我当然可以告诉你。聊聊我们自己的生活、天气之类，也没人会介意。

English: I just can't discuss any hidden purpose to the library, or some spooky enchantment I might be under – because, of course, neither thing exists.
Chinese: 我只是不能谈论图书馆的什么隐藏目的，或者我可能受到的什么邪门附体——因为，当然咯，这两样东西都不存在。

English: Well... since neither I nor Oleg can remember the child, it stands to reason that they never existed. And if they never existed, there couldn't be any [[record]]. Certainly not here.
Chinese: 嗯……既然我和奥列格都不记得这个孩子，按理说他们就从未存在过。如果从未存在过，就不可能有[[记录]]。当然不会在这里。

English: Anyway, there's no way to access the [[reading room]] upstairs without a royal permit. No way at all. Can you ((imagine)) if it was something as simple as a hidden lever? ##<<Her gaze briefly darts down under her desk.>>
Chinese: 总之，没有王室许可，楼上的[[阅览室]]是进不去的。绝对进不去。你能((想象))它要是一根简单的暗杆就好了吗？##<<她的目光飞快地瞟向她的桌子底下。>>

English: <<She yawns theatrically.>> Oh dear, I'm feeling rather tired. You'll behave yourself if I rest my eyes for a moment, won't you?
Chinese: <<她夸张地打了个哈欠。>>哎呀，我有点困了。我闭会儿眼，你会乖乖的，对吧？

English: <<The librarian snores ostentatiously.>>
Chinese: <<图书管理员煞有介事地打起鼾来。>>

English: <<Your fingers quest around underneath the lip of her desk until they find something that clicks.>> ##<<Upstairs, you hear a mechanical door clank open.>>
Chinese: <<你的手指在她桌沿下摸索，直到碰到一个咔哒作响的东西。>> ##<<楼上，你听见一扇机械门哐当打开。>>

English: Thank you, dearie. ##It's, um, Genevieve, by the way. My name. Genevieve Myshkin. I don't know why, but I felt you should know that.
Chinese: 谢谢你，亲爱的。##对了，我叫，嗯，吉纳维芙。我的名字。吉纳维芙·米什金。不知道为什么，我觉得你应该知道。

English: Did you say ((mechapedes))?!
Chinese: 你说((机械蜈蚣))？！

English: <<[Lower your voice]>> Sorry, the what?
Chinese: <<[压低声音]>>抱歉，什么东西？

English: About your missing child...
Chinese: 关于你失踪的孩子……

English: What is this place, exactly?
Chinese: 这地方到底是什么？

English: So, can I look through your records?
Chinese: 那么，我能翻阅你们的档案吗？

English: Is this the Library of Untruths, by any chance?
Chinese: 该不会，这里就是虚言图书馆吧？

English: I'll stop making noise and leave you alone.
Chinese: 我不再出声，不打扰你了。

English: Do you get many visitors?
Chinese: 常有人来吗？

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就是这些。

English: What kind of paperwork do I need?
Chinese: 我需要什么手续？

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Will this do?
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>这个行吗？

English: Do you have anything about Dark Star mercenaries?
Chinese: 黑星佣兵的资料有吗？

English: Very well, I understand.
Chinese: 好吧，我明白了。

English: <<[Show her Oleg's locket]>> Does this change your answer?
Chinese: <<[给她看奥列格的吊坠]>>这会改变你的答案吗？

English: <<[Hold up three fingers]>> Quick question: how many fingers am I holding up?
Chinese: <<[举起三根手指]>>快问：我竖着几根手指？

English: I see. Thanks for your help.
Chinese: 明白了。多谢帮忙。

English: Is something wrong?
Chinese: 怎么了？

English: So you do recognise it.
Chinese: 这么说你还是认出了它。

English: Sorry, what petition do you mean?
Chinese: 抱歉，你说的是什么申请？

English: You misunderstand. I'm looking for Oleg's missing child.
Chinese: 你误会了。我在找奥列格失踪的孩子。

English: Wait... are you lying right now?
Chinese: 等等……你现在是在撒谎吗？

English: I get it. You're enchanted so you can't talk about this place.
Chinese: 我懂了。你被施了魔法，不能谈论这个地方。

English: So what is this place really?
Chinese: 那这地方到底是什么？

English: Is there anything you ((are)) allowed to talk about?
Chinese: 有什么是你((可以))谈的？

English: If there ((were)) any record of your child, how would I find it?
Chinese: 如果((真有))你孩子的记录，我该怎么找？

English: Thank you, Genevieve.
Chinese: 谢谢你，吉纳维芙。

English: Don't worry, you've been very helpful.
Chinese: 别担心，你帮了大忙。

English: Er... ma'am? Are you still with me?
Chinese: 呃……夫人？您还在吗？

English: <<[Reach over her desk for the hidden lever.]>>
Chinese: <<[越过她的桌子去够那个暗杆。]>>

English: <<The librarian quickly hides a handkerchief underneath some papers as you approach. Her eyes are red and wet.>>
Chinese: <<你走近时，图书管理员迅速把手帕藏进文件底下。她的眼睛又红又湿。>>

English: Oh, hello dearie. Do pardon me – all the parchment here plays havoc on my allergies.
Chinese: 哦，你好亲爱的。请多包涵——这里的羊皮纸害得我过敏。

English: <<The librarian smiles weakly.>> Was that all, dearie?
Chinese: <<图书管理员勉强一笑。>>就这些吗，亲爱的？

English: <<The librarian puts her hand over her mouth.>> Oh. I... ##I'm sorry. I don't think I can handle it yet. But... thank you for telling me. And for giving us some answers.
Chinese: <<图书管理员捂住嘴。>>哦。我……##对不起。我现在还承受不了。但是……谢谢你告诉我。谢谢给我们一些答案。

English: You tell Oleg what you found, and when I'm ready, I'll ask him. I've been meaning to check in on him anyway...
Chinese: 你把发现告诉奥列格，等我准备好了，我会去找他。反正我也一直想着去看看他……

English: <<She gives you a sharp look.>> Not that I'm even ((thinking)) about rescinding my petition, mind you.
Chinese: <<她狠狠瞪你一眼。>>当然，我可((没有))在想撤回申请的事，你明白。

English: <<She wipes her eyes.>> Oh, thank you for asking, dearie. I'm sure I'll be all right. People can go back to normal after anything, can't they? As long as we have some way to ((get)) there.
Chinese: <<她擦了擦眼。>>谢谢你问起，亲爱的。我肯定没事的。人经历什么都能回到正常，不是吗？只要我们有一条((走))过去的路。

English: When my little Indira died, we had a funeral. Sang songs, said goodbye. Then there was a gravestone, with a name on it. I still visit every year.
Chinese: 我的小英迪拉走的时候，我们办了葬礼。唱歌，道别。然后有一块墓碑，上面刻着名字。我每年都去看。

English: It was like... I don't know. Like a ((bridge)). Linking the world where she was alive to the one where she was gone. ##But this? What am I even meant to ((do)) with this?
Chinese: 那像是一座……我说不好。像一座((桥))。连接她还在的世界和她走了的世界。##可这个呢？这让我((怎么办))？

English: At least there's only machines here to witness my tears.
Chinese: 好在这里只有机器见证我的眼泪。

English: Oh. Um. Well then... ##<<She takes a deep breath.>> Go ahead. I'm as ready as I can be.
Chinese: 哦。呃。那好……##<<她深吸一口气。>>说吧。我已经做了能做的一切准备。

English: Istrik? Oh... oh dear me. That's what we used to call the [[Corrupted Lands]], before they were consumed. I've never heard of any survivors...
Chinese: 伊斯特里克？哦……天哪。那是[[腐化之地]]被吞噬前的旧称。我从没听说过有幸存者……

English: How, um... how curious. That's quite similar to what the King says when you ask it about people who've fallen prey to the Corruption...
Chinese: 真奇怪，呃……真是奇怪。这跟国王被问及腐化受害者时说的话几乎一模一样……

English: <<Genevieve looks forlorn.>> ##I suppose the answer is staring us in the face, isn't it? When something becomes Corrupted, its official records get scrambled.
Chinese: <<吉纳维芙神情凄然。>>##我想答案就明摆在我们眼前，不是吗？东西一旦被腐化，它的官方档案就会被打乱。

English: Some say it also affects people's memories of the thing... ##<<She sighs.>> Although ((obviously)), you and I both know that last part is claptrap.
Chinese: 还有人说它也会影响人们对那东西的记忆……##<<她叹了口气。>>((当然))啦，你我都清楚，后半句纯属胡扯。

English: Istrik is gone, but there's a [[royal cleanup camp]] near where it used to be, out in the [[Corrupted Lands]]. If there ((are)) any clues left as to this child's fate, you'd surely find them there.
Chinese: 伊斯特里克已经没了，但在它旧址附近有一处[[皇家清理营地]]，就在[[腐化之地]]里。如果这孩子的下落还((留))有线索，你一定能在那儿找到。

English: Oh, King's blessing on those brave cleanup workers.
Chinese: 哦，愿国王庇佑那些勇敢的清理工人。

English: At the [[far eastern end of this island]], across an [[artificial ditch]]. The whole area is restricted by order of the King, and the cleanup crews get in and out by skybarge...
Chinese: 在[[本岛的最东端]]，越过一条[[人工壕沟]]。整片区域奉国王敕令封锁，清理队靠空中驳船进出……

English: <<She glances around to check the mechapedes are still dormant, then lowers her voice.>> ##But between you and me, I heard there's some kind of [[abandoned machine]] out there that you could clamber up.
Chinese: <<她环顾四周，确认机械蜈蚣仍在休眠，然后压低声音。>>##不过跟你说句悄悄话，我听说那边有台[[废弃机器]]，可以爬上去。

English: Here... <<She passes you a little scrap of paper.>> ##These are the [[access codes]] we use at the Library. A lot of the King's machines use the same ones. Perhaps if you try them, you'll get lucky?
Chinese: 给……<<她递给你一张小纸条。>>##这是我们在图书馆用的[[通行码]]。国王的许多机器用的都是同一套。你试试，说不定就撞上运气了？

English: Nobody's quite sure, dearie. I do know it started long before the fall of Istrik. Just little outbreaks here and there – only murmured about, never officially acknowledged.
Chinese: 没人说得准，亲爱的。我只知道它早在大溃落之前就开始了。零星爆发，这里一点那里一点——只在私下嘀咕，官方从不承认。

English: But then the town of [[Progress]] was consumed in a matter of weeks, and the rest of Istrik wasn't far behind. After that, ((everyone)) knew.
Chinese: 可后来，[[进步城]]在几周之内就被吞了，伊斯特里克的其余部分也没撑多久。从那以后，((人人都))知道了。

English: I remember exactly where I was when I heard Progress had fallen. In that little apartment in Ferropolis, washing Oleg's socks.
Chinese: 听说进步城陷落的那一刻，我清楚地记得自己在哪。在铁城那间小公寓里，洗奥列格的袜子。

English: Thank you, dearie. I'll be praying to the King for you.
Chinese: 谢谢你，亲爱的。我会替你向国王祈祷的。

English: Genevieve, I found the truth about your child's fate.
Chinese: 吉纳维芙，我找到了你孩子下落的真相。

English: Where should I search next for your child?
Chinese: 下一步该去哪找你的孩子？

English: I think I found something about your missing child.
Chinese: 我好像找到了你失踪孩子的线索。

English: How are you holding up, Genevieve?
Chinese: 你还撑得住吗，吉纳维芙？

English: That's all for now. Take care of yourself.
Chinese: 先这样吧。照顾好自己。

English: The last known location was a place called Istrik Oblast.
Chinese: 最后已知的地点是一个叫伊斯特里克州的地方。

English: I didn't get the child's name. Something about a 'fault in status check'.
Chinese: 我没查到孩子的名字。只有一句什么"状态核查故障"。

English: How do I reach the Corrupted Lands?
Chinese: 我要怎么去腐化之地？

English: What's the nature of this 'Corruption'?
Chinese: 这场"腐化"到底是什么？

English: I'll do what I can.
Chinese: 我尽力而为。

English: <<Genevieve looks alarmed, but tries to hide it.>> ##Ah. Now I remember. Here we are again in [[debug mode]], eh? ##I assure you, I don't find ((anything)) alarming about this situation ((at all)).
Chinese: <<吉纳维芙面露惊慌，却努力掩饰。>>##啊。我想起来了。我们又进[[调试模式]]了，嗯？##我向你保证，这种情况((完全))没什么好惊慌的，((一点都不))。

English: Certainly, dearie. Can I help you find anything else?
Chinese: 没问题，亲爱的。还需要我帮你找什么吗？

English: Very well, dearie. Until next time, eh? ##Do please try to be kind to my other self. She's had a rough few years.
Chinese: 好的，亲爱的。下次再会，嗯？##请务必善待我的另一个自己。这几年她过得不容易。

English: <<The machine thrums with sorcery. A quill is tethered to it by a silver chain.>> ##WELCOME TO THE [[LIBRARY OF UNTRUTHS]]. PLEASE INSCRIBE THY QUERY.  ##((Beware! Unsanctioned access is punishable by controlled annihilation.))
Chinese: <<机器在巫术的嗡鸣中运转。一支羽毛笔由银链系在机身上。>>##欢迎来到[[虚言图书馆]]。请书写你的问询。##((当心！未经授权的访问将受到受控湮灭之刑罚。))

English: <<The machine clatters as it whisks away the parchment and unfurls a new one.>> ##WELCOME TO THE [[LIBRARY OF UNTRUTHS]]. PLEASE INSCRIBE THY QUERY.
Chinese: <<机器咔嗒作响，卷走羊皮纸，展开新的一卷。>>##欢迎来到[[虚言图书馆]]。请书写你的问询。

English: <<Wheels and gears begin to spin. Below your feet you hear the library pulling up scrolls to be loaded into the machine.>> ##PONDERING...
Chinese: <<齿轮与轮盘开始转动。你听见脚下的图书馆正把卷轴吊上来装入机器。>>##思虑中……

Chinese: [[哀哉]]，无法调取名录。##[[故障记录]]：该名录未获本设施授权。本档案仅收录已删改主体。
