English: [[ATTENTION]]: PLEASE EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY FOR YOUR OWN. SO WE'LL NO MORE GO A-ROVING. PLEASE HELP US. [[ALAS]], CANNOT EXIST. APHRA THERE'S NO TIME. UNLATCH, RESEAT.
Chinese: [[注意]]：请立刻撤离，为了你自己。我们再也不去漫游了。请救救我们。[[哀哉]]，无法存在。阿芙拉，没时间了。松开，重插。

English: <<Whatever remains of Aphra Myshkin holds Oleg's locket in both hands, apparently entranced. She does not speak again.>>
Chinese: <<阿芙拉·米什金残存的 whatever，双手捧着奥列格的吊坠，显然出了神。她再没有说话。>>

English: ...[[GLOAMING]]: CHERISH EVERY GHOST. COULD YOU HELP ME FIND? THOUGH THE HEART STILL BE AS LOVING. [[ALAS]], THIS IS A DISASTER. UNLATCH, RESEAT.
Chinese: ……[[暮色]]：珍爱每一个亡魂。你能帮我找找吗？尽管心依旧满怀爱意。[[哀哉]]，这是灾难。松开，重插。

English: <<The creature seems confused at first. Then she takes it gingerly in both hands, apparently entranced by it, and does not speak again.>>
Chinese: <<这生物起初一脸困惑。随后她小心翼翼地用双手接过吊坠，显然被它迷住了，再没有说话。>>

English: <<You've done what Oleg asked of you, and he'll be waiting to hear what you found.>> ##<<But perhaps first you should try to learn the whole truth.>>
Chinese: <<你已完成奥列格的嘱托，他会等着听你的发现。>>##<<不过也许你该先设法弄清全部真相。>>

English: <<What was the purpose of Project Horoscope? What role did it play in Aphra Myshkin's fate? And how is she connected to other Aphra that you met before?>>
Chinese: <<星象计划的目的是什么？它在阿芙拉·米什金的命运中扮演了什么角色？她和你先前遇见的其他阿芙拉又有什么关联？>>

English: <<What was the purpose of Project Horoscope? Why was Aphra Myshkin recruited to it? And what role did it play in her fate?>>
Chinese: <<星象计划的目的是什么？阿芙拉·米什金为何被选入其中？它在她的命运中扮演了什么角色？>>

English: <<The only one who could answer these questions is the man whose name was stamped all over the Horoscope files: Sunil Khan, the King's Speaker.>>
Chinese: <<唯一能回答这些问题的人，是名字盖满星象档案的那个人：苏尼尔·可汗，国王代言人。>>

English: <<[Show it Oleg's locket]>> Do you recognise this?
Chinese: <<[给它看奥列格的吊坠]>>你认得这个吗？

English: <<[Show it Oleg's locket]>> Your father sent me. I'm here to help.
Chinese: <<[给它看奥列格的吊坠]>>你父亲派我来的。我是来帮你的。

English: Can you tell me your name?
Chinese: 你能告诉我你的名字吗？

English: What happened to you?
Chinese: 你身上发生了什么？

English: Ugh, this is pointless.
Chinese: 唉，这是白费劲。

English: ...did you say Aphra? As in, Chief Interpreter Aphra?
Chinese: ……你刚才说阿芙拉？首席释经官阿芙拉的那个阿芙拉？

English: I'm sorry. I don't know how to help you.
Chinese: 对不起。我不知道该怎么帮你。

English: I promise, I'm going to tell Oleg where you are.
Chinese: 我保证，我会告诉奥列格你在哪。

English: <<[Offer Oleg's locket]>> Here. You should be the one to have this.
Chinese: <<[递出奥列格的吊坠]>>给。这个应该由你来保管。

English: <<[Keep the locket to give back to Oleg.]>>
Chinese: <<[留下吊坠，物归原主给奥列格。]>>

English: Watch yourself, citizen. If these monsters get too rowdy, I'm shutting the cage – whether you're still in there or not.
Chinese: 当心点，公民。这些怪物要是闹得太凶，我就锁笼子——管你还在不在里面。

English: Stay back, citizen! These monsters are dormant right now, but they could rouse at any moment. And if they get their claws into you, you'll be everybody's problem.
Chinese: 退后，公民！这些怪物眼下在休眠，但随时可能惊醒。它们要是把爪子搭上你，你就成了大家的问题了。

English: Would you believe they used to be citizens just like you or me? Once the [[Corruption]] takes you, there's no return.
Chinese: 你敢信吗，它们从前也是跟你我一样的公民？[[腐化]]一旦缠上你，就再没有回头路。

English: <<They size you up.>> That was you, eh? I s'pose you ((are)) kind of weird looking. No offence.
Chinese: <<他们上下打量你。>>刚才那是你，嗯？我猜你((长得))是有点怪。别介意。

English: Go on in, then – it's your funeral. Not that you'd get a funeral, mind.
Chinese: 那就进去吧——后果自负。倒不是说你还办得了葬礼，哼。

English: Have you lost your marbles? No one's allowed in there without – ##<<Suddenly their words are drowned out by a deafening metallic voice from the main building.>>
Chinese: 你疯了吗？没有——谁都不准进……##<<主楼方向突然响起一个震耳欲聋的金属嗓音，盖过了他们的话。>>

English: <<ATTENTION ALL HANDS. SHIFT CHANGE IS DELAYED BY 72 MINUTES. REPEAT, 72 MINUTES. HUANG OUT.">> "
Chinese: <<"全体人员注意。换班延误72分钟。重复，72分钟。黄完毕。">>

English: ...as I was saying. No entry without orders from the chief.
Chinese: ……我刚才说到哪了。没有队长的命令，一律不得入内。

English: <<The cleanup worker looks pained.>> Shit. I'm... sorry about your kid, I really am. But my orders are strict. We can't risk anyone bringing the Corruption into Ferropolis.
Chinese: <<清理工一脸痛苦。>>妈的。你孩子的事我……我真的很抱歉。但我的命令很严。我们不能冒险让任何人把腐化带进铁城。

English: ...hmm. It's true the wages ain't much for work this dangerous. And half the time they pay us late...
Chinese: ……嗯。干这么危险的活，工资是少得可怜。而且有一半时候还拖欠……

English: <<They glance at the Corrupted Ones in the cage.>> ##But, it's not worth my life.
Chinese: <<他们瞥了一眼笼中的腐化者。>>##可这还不至于值得我搭上命。

English: Ah, ((shit)). Why is it always me? ##I'm sorry, your honour, but I'm under strict orders not to let ((anyone)) in without the chief's blessing. No exceptions.
Chinese: 啊，((见鬼))。怎么每次都是我？##抱歉了您呐，我奉了严令，没有队长点头，((谁))都不准进。无一例外。

English: Look, if you're hell-bent on it, talk to [[Cleanup Leader Huang]]. He's over in the main building, top floor. ##Just don't tell him I sent you – he's got a foul temper.
Chinese: 听着，你要是非进不可，去找[[清理队长黄]]。他在主楼顶层。##可别说是我让你去的——他脾气坏得很。

English: Like I said, talk to [[Cleanup Leader Huang]] if you want to look inside the cage. He's over in the main building, top floor. ##Just don't tell him I sent you – he's got a foul temper.
Chinese: 就像我说的，想看笼子里面就去找[[清理队长黄]]。他在主楼顶层。##可别说是我让你去的——他脾气坏得很。

English: What are those things?
Chinese: 那些东西是什么？

English: You're Cohen, right? Huang said I could look inside the cage.
Chinese: 你是科恩吧？黄说我可以看笼子里面。

English: Can I take a look inside the cage?
Chinese: 我能看一眼笼子里面吗？

English: Thanks for the warning.
Chinese: 多谢提醒。

English: <<[Lie]>> Please. I have reason to believe one of them is my child.
Chinese: <<[撒谎]>><拜托了。我有理由相信其中一个是我的孩子。

English: <<[Offer coins]>> Surely you could just look away for a minute?
Chinese: <<[递上硬币]>>你就不能眨眨眼放我一分钟？

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> This is Guild business. I need to get in there.
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>这是公会公务。我必须进去。

English: How'd you get on in there? That last one looked like it wanted to make a proper mess of you.
Chinese: 你在里面怎么样？最后那家伙看着是想把你大卸八块啊。

English: Sixfold? You mean you ((understood)) that gobbledegook? ##I see now. You've got one of those fancy Machinist [[skull implants]]. Hope you had an edifying dialogue?
Chinese: 六重密文？你是说你((听得懂))那堆天书？##我明白了。你装了那种高档的机械师[[颅骨植入体]]。希望这场对话让你有所收获？

English: Still human, are you? Not bad going, out here.
Chinese: 还算个人呢，是吧？在这种地方，算不错了。

English: Anyway, what else can I do you for?
Chinese: 总之，还有什么要我效劳的？

English: What else can I do you for?
Chinese: 还有什么要我效劳的？

English: Oh, sure. That gobbledegook they talk... ##<<Cohen's words are drowned out by a metallic voice booming across the camp.>>
Chinese: 哦，行啊。他们嘴里那套天书……##<<科恩的话被横扫营地的金属嗓音盖过。>>

English: <<ATTENTION, CLEANUP WORKER PNIN. WHERE'S MY DAMNED SUPPER? HUANG OUT.">>"
Chinese: <<"全体清理工注意。普宁，我那顿该死的晚饭呢？黄完毕。">>

English: Ahem. That gobbledegook is some kind of cipher dialect. Only the Machinists can make head or tail of it – and only if they've got one of those fancy [[skull implants]].
Chinese: 咳。那种天书是某种密文方言。只有机械师才看得懂——而且还得装了那种高级的[[颅骨植入体]]才行。

English: Get one? I mean, they're meant to be for cogs only. I hear the waiting list is longer than a terror wyrm's todger – most of our cranial engineers got purged years ago. ##That said...
Chinese: 装一个？那玩意儿本来就是给齿轮佬配的。听说排队名单比恐怖蠕虫那玩意儿还长——我们的颅腔工程师几年前就被清洗得差不多了。##不过……

English: You'd know better than me, your honour. Or ain't they told you yet? I hear the waiting list is longer than a terror wyrm's todger. ##Well, I'll share what I know...
Chinese: 这您比我在行，长官。怎么，他们还没跟您说？听说排队名单比恐怖蠕虫那玩意儿还长。##嗯，我知道的都告诉您……

English: I used to guard the Machinarium, back in Ferropolis. Got into a, er, let's call it an ((amorous entanglement)) with this cog named [[Morozov]]. Proper fruitcake, she was. A real force of nature...
Chinese: 我以前在铁城守机械殿。跟一个叫[[莫罗佐夫]]的齿轮佬搞出了一段，呃，就说是((风流孽债))吧。她是个地地道道的疯婆娘。天生一股疯劲……

English: <<Cohen trails off and stare into space for a moment.>>
Chinese: <<科恩的声音低了下去，怔怔望着远方。>>

English: <<They shrug bashfully.>> It was tempestuous, I'll put it that way. ##Anyway, point is: ((she's)) the one that used to fix up trainee Machinists with their new skull-plumbing.
Chinese: <<他们不好意思地耸耸肩。>>这么说吧，那段日子水深火热。##总之重点是：给实习机械师装新颅管的就是((她))。

English: <<They shake their head as if to clear it.>> Oh, sorry. Tempestuous time in my life. ##Point is, ((she's)) the one that used to fix up trainee Machinists with their new skull-plumbing.
Chinese: <<他们摇头，像要把什么甩出脑袋。>>哦，抱歉。那阵子太动荡了。##重点是，给实习机械师装新颅管的就是((她))。

English: Morozov lives in a [[tower]] up in the mountains, [[north of Ferropolis]]. Maybe if you mention my name, it'll be worth something? ##This was ages ago, mind – can't say if she's still ticking.
Chinese: 莫罗佐夫住在山上的[[塔]]里，[[铁城以北]]。说不定你提我的名字还能值点钱？##不过那是老掉牙的事了——她那口钟还在不在走，我可说不准。

English: <<Cohen shrugs.>> Not that I know of. Personally, all the treasure in Puria couldn't convince me to let some screwball cog stick their oily digits into my noodle. ##But, if you're dead set on it...
Chinese: <<科恩耸耸肩。>>据我所知没有。把普利亚的金银堆成山，我也不让哪个疯齿轮佬把油乎乎的手指捅进我脑袋。##不过，你要是一意孤行……

English: <<Cohen shrugs.>> Not that I know of. All the treasure in Puria couldn't convince ((me)) to let some screwball cog stick their oily digits into my noodle. No offence, your honour. ##But, if you're dead set on it...
Chinese: <<科恩耸耸肩。>>据我所知没有。普利亚的金银堆成山，也说服不了((我))让哪个疯齿轮佬把油乎乎的手指捅进脑袋。不是冒犯您，长官。##不过，你要是一意孤行……

English: <<Cohen notices your Cranial Moderator.>> ##...but I can see you're already ahead of me. Well then: try chatting to those [[Corrupted Ones]] again. With your new plumbing, you might even learn something.
Chinese: <<科恩注意到你的颅腔调节器。>>##……不过看得出来，你已经走在我前面了。那么：再去跟那些[[腐化者]]聊聊试试。有了这套新管路，说不定你真能问出点什么。

English: You can try. Frankly they're still a bloody mystery to me.
Chinese: 你试试呗。说实话，他们对我来说还是一滩烂谜。

English: Anything else you wanna know?
Chinese: 还有想知道的吗？

English: <<Cohen looks perturbed.>> ##Its ((name))? You sure you heard that right?
Chinese: <<科恩面露不安。>>##它的((名字))？你确定没听岔？

English: That's ((definitely)) weird. I s'pose that supports my 'vestigial memory' theory. Assuming it wasn't just some name it heard around the camp.
Chinese: 那可((确实))邪门。我想，这印证了我的"残存记忆"说。前提是那名字不是它在外头听来的。

English: Look, I know it's unsettling, but they do this sometimes. The last Machinist we saw here thought it was some sort of reflex action, like rigor mortis. Try not to lose too much sleep over it, eh?
Chinese: 听着，我知道这事瘆人，但它们偶尔会这样。上次来这儿的机械师说，这算某种反射行为，跟尸僵差不多。别为这个太睡不着觉，嗯？

English: Hmm. That's uncommon, but not unknown. Sometimes they seem to be attracted to particular places – houses, town squares, ruined fountains. My theory is that some of 'em retain vestigial memories from their life.
Chinese: 唔。这不常见，但也不是没见过。有时候它们似乎会被特定地点吸引——房子、镇广场、荒废的喷泉。我的理论是：有些还残留着生前的记忆碎片。

English: Ehhh, sort of. There ((was)) this cog who visited last year. Spent hours listening to 'em, taking notes. Never seen anyone write so fast. He had one of those implants, too.
Chinese: 呃，((算是))吧。去年来过一位齿轮佬。一坐几小时听它们念叨，记笔记。没见过写字那么快的。他也装着那种植入体。

English: He was pretty tight-lipped, but I gathered he didn't learn much. Said it was like talking to a lunatic, or one of those big insects that mimics your voice. They're saying words, but there's no deeper meaning. Sound and fury, innit?
Chinese: 他嘴挺严，但我听出来他没问出多少。他说跟它们说话就像跟疯子聊，或者跟那种会学人声的大虫子聊。词是一个个往外蹦，可没有更深的含义。喧嚣与躁动，就这德行。

English: I think they were talking to me, but I couldn't understand anything.
Chinese: 我觉得它们是在跟我说话，可我一个字都听不懂。

English: You didn't tell me the Corrupted spoke Sixfold cipher.
Chinese: 你没跟我说过腐化者会讲六重密文。

English: Can I ask you some questions about the Corrupted?
Chinese: 关于腐化者，我能问你几个问题吗？

English: Where did you say I'd find that 'cranial engineer'?
Chinese: 你刚说那位"颅腔工程师"在哪找来着？

English: Stay safe, Cohen.
Chinese: 保重，科恩。

English: Where would I get such a skull implant?
Chinese: 那种颅骨植入体上哪弄？

English: Isn't there some other way?
Chinese: 就没有别的办法吗？

English: That good, huh?
Chinese: 就这点出息，嗯？

English: That bad, huh?
Chinese: 就这么糟糕，嗯？

English: <<[Snap your fingers]>> Focus, Cohen.
Chinese: <<[打个响指]>>专心点，科恩。

English: One of them told me her name. I think she was asking me for help.
Chinese: 其中一个跟我说了她的名字。我觉得她在求我帮忙。

English: One of the Corrupted seemed to recognise my locket.
Chinese: 其中一个腐化者好像认出了我的吊坠。

English: Do the Machinists know how to talk to these things?
Chinese: 机械师们知道怎么跟这些东西交流吗？

English: Thank you for your time.
Chinese: 谢谢你抽时间。

English: <<You find Cleanup Worker Cohen singing to themselves, a strange bittersweet tune about a soldier-musician who attempts to enlighten people's spirits amid brutal conflict.>>
Chinese: <<你撞见清理工科恩在自顾自哼歌，一首苦乐参半的怪调，唱一个在残酷战乱中试图启迪民心的军中乐手。>>

English: Oi oi. Reza warned me about [[debug mode]], but I s'pose I didn't believe them. ##Well? What's all this about then?
Chinese: 哟嚯。雷扎跟我说过[[调试模式]]，我还不信。##怎么样？这又是唱哪出？

English: Right you are. What else can I do you for?
Chinese: 明白。还有什么要我效劳的？

English: Back to nothing special, eh? I'll face it like a... well, like a Cohen, I s'pose.
Chinese: 回到这无关紧要的日子，嗯？我照样面对，像……嗯，像科恩那样面对吧。

English: <<This young woman lies tucked up in bed, with that childlike and unselfconscious peace that blesses all sound sleepers.>> ##<<A faint smile plays across her lips, as if at some private satisfaction.>>
Chinese: <<年轻女子裹在被子里，带着一切睡得香甜的人都有的那种孩子气的、不自知的安宁。>>##<<一抹浅笑在她唇边浮动，仿佛怀着自己的小满足。>>

English: <<This young woman lies tucked up in bed, with that childlike and unselfconscious peace that blesses all sound sleepers.>> ##<<Her face is creased in an expression of unease, as if grappling with some private impasse.>>
Chinese: <<年轻女子裹在被子里，带着一切睡得香甜的人都有的那种孩子气的、不自知的安宁。>>##<<她眉头拧着一丝不安，仿佛在跟什么无解的疙瘩较劲。>>

English: <<Someone has brushed her hair back neatly over her head, so it doesn't get in her eyes.>>
Chinese: <<有人把她额前的头发整齐地拢到脑后，免得遮住眼睛。>>

English: <<A lock of messy hair falls over her eyes, partly covering her face. No one seems to have bothered about it.>>
Chinese: <<一绺乱发垂下来遮住半张脸。似乎没人在意。>>

English: <<There. Nice and neat.>>
Chinese: <<好了。整整齐齐。>>

English: <<It's strange to see Nadja in this industrial setting, crammed in with other dreamers like peas in a pod – or barrels in a warehouse.>>
Chinese: <<在这座工厂里见到娜佳真叫人不是滋味——她和其他织梦者挤在一起，像豆荚里的豌豆，又像仓库里的木桶。>>

English: <<Nevertheless, a faint smile plays across her lips, as if at some private satisfaction.>>
Chinese: <<尽管如此，一抹浅笑仍在她唇边浮动，仿佛怀着自己的小满足。>>

English: <<[Gently brush back her hair out of her eyes.]>>
Chinese: <<[轻轻把她眼前的头发拨开。]>>

English: <<[Leave her alone.]>>
Sorry mate, no time to chat. I have a ((lot)) of bedpans to empty and clean before the end of my shift, and the vegetables aren't about to lend a hand.
Chinese: 抱歉伙计，没空闲聊。下班前我还((一大堆))便盆要倒要洗，那帮"蔬菜"可不会搭把手。

English: <<This technician is watching one of the sleepers, with a pensive expression on their face.>> ##You know, sometimes I wonder what they're going through. It must be amazing, in its way.
Chinese: <<这名技术员望着一位沉睡者，若有所思。>>##你知道嘛，有时候我会想，他们正在经历什么。某种程度上，一定很奇妙吧。

English: From the outside, it looks like they're snoozing as soundly as a baby given gin to keep it quiet. But inside, they're living lives we can barely imagine, full of wonder and terror.
Chinese: 从外面看，他们睡得跟灌了杜松子酒哄安静的婴儿一样香。可里面呢，他们过着我们难以想象的生活，满是奇观与恐怖。

English: Me? Oh no, I never touch the stuff. My friends think I'm weird, but maybe they'd feel the same after working here.
Chinese: 我？哦不，我从来不碰那玩意儿。朋友都说我怪。不过在这儿干过之后，说不定他们也会跟我一样想。

English: Haven't you ever tried one of their visions?
Chinese: 你从没试过他们的幻象吗？

English: I'll leave you to your work.
Chinese: 不打扰你工作了。

English: <<This slumbering citizen addresses you with startling cogency, though their eyes remain closed.>> ##The engine. You need to start the engine. I can't do it myself.
Chinese: <<这位沉睡的公民闭着眼睛，却以惊人的条理对你说起话来。>>##引擎。你得把引擎启动。我自己做不到。

English: There's a seven-dimensional hyperprism embedded in the side of Mount Carrick. You should be able to handle it; you never took the Mark.
Chinese: 卡里克山山坡里嵌着一个七维超棱柱。你应该搞得定；你没领过印记。

English: <<They smile to themselves.>> Bring back a palanquin from the Land of Nod. They'll give you a medal for crinkling quietly.
Chinese: <<她自顾自地笑。>>从梦乡之国带一顶轿子回来。安静打呼噜的话他们会给你发奖章的。

English: Mmhhmm. Missions are ((hard)). I've done 87 of them with my grandma. Could you tell her I said hello?
Chinese: 嗯嗯。任务((好难))。我和外婆一起做过87个。能替我跟她问个好吗？

English: Bring a carriage-beetle with you to pull the sarcophagus. The weevils are waiting for you inside. They're friendly but you mustn't insult their intelligence.
Chinese: 带一只拖车甲虫来拉石棺。象鼻虫在里面等你。它们很友好，但你可不能侮辱它们的智商。

English: <<They yawn expansively, but do not respond any further.>>
Chinese: <<她大大地打了个哈欠，再没有别的回应。>>

English: <<This citizen's eyes are half-open, and their pupils swing to meet yours.>> ##Mmphh... where am I?
Chinese: <<这位公民双眼半睁，瞳孔晃过来对上你的目光。>>##唔……我在哪？

English: Huh. <<They look around blearily.>> ##Ohhh. Thassright. M' in the Vision Works.
Chinese: 哈。<<他们迷糊地环顾四周。>>##哦哦。想起来了。在幻象工坊。

English: Lissen, is Mandip a'right? I wanna make sure she... got the money...
Chinese: 听着，曼迪普还好吗？我得确认她……拿到钱了……

English: <<They smile and close their eyes.>> Good. Thassgood. ##Tellerta... rememmer whaddaye tauder. M'gonna... se'er soon...
Chinese: <<他笑着闭上眼。>>好。那就好。##告特尔塔……记着人教的。我很快……就回去……

English: <<They sigh and close their eyes.>> Mmrhmm. Hope she's a'right. ##Tellerta... rememmer whaddaye tauder. M'gonna... se'er soon...
Chinese: <<她叹了口气，闭上眼。>>唔嗯。希望她没事。##告特尔塔……记着人教的。我很快……就回去……

English: Ohhh aye... so I am. Thassa relief.
Chinese: 哦哦对……是这么回事。那就放心了。

English: <<They smile and close their eyes.>> ##A'right then. Yer a nice dream.
Chinese: <<他笑着闭上眼。>>##那行。你是个好梦。

English: <<This slumbering citizen is tossing and turning in the throes of some awful phantasm. Their brow is creased with worry and fear.>>
Chinese: <<这位沉睡的公民在某种可怕的幻象里翻来覆去，眉头拧满忧虑与恐惧。>>

English: <<This slumbering citizen is murmuring softly to themselves. You can't make out what they're saying, if indeed there are any words at all.>>
Chinese: <<这位沉睡的公民在喃喃自语。听不清说的什么——如果说那算得上词的话。>>

English: <<This slumbering citizen has an expression of contentment upon their face. A good dream, hopefully.>>
Chinese: <<这位沉睡的公民脸上挂着满足的神情。但愿是个好梦。>>

English: Mrrph... no... don't wanna wear the wig... ##Mammy! Make him burn it!
Chinese: 唔……不……我不想戴那假发……##妈！让他把假发烧了！

English: <<This slumbering citizen is snoring like a beehive, without any outward sign of inner activity.>>
Chinese: <<这位沉睡的公民鼾声如蜂箱炸锅，外表看不出半点内心活动的迹象。>>

English: <<This slumbering citizen is clawing at the air with an expression of wonder on their face.>>
Chinese: <<这位沉睡的公民在空中抓挠，脸上写满惊奇。>>

English: Zzzz... 'm the op'rator of a home calculatin' engine... S'mine. You can't have it.
Chinese: 呼……我是家用计算机引擎的操作员……是我的。你们不能拿走。

English: <<Beside their bed, luminous liquid drips and bubbles through a series of glass pipes and vessels.>>
Chinese: <<床边，发光的液体在一串玻璃管和容器里滴淌、冒泡。>>

English: What engine?
Chinese: 什么引擎？

English: Sure. Where do I find it?
Chinese: 行。去哪找？

English: <<[Leave them alone.]>>
I'll do my very best.
Chinese: 我会尽全力的。

English: Sorry pal, I'm here on another mission.
Chinese: 抱歉伙计，我来办的是别的任务。

English: Sure. Where do I find it?
Chinese: 行。去哪找？

English: Honestly, I'm really not sure.
Chinese: 说实话，我真不清楚。

English: You're in the Royal Vision Works.
Chinese: 你在皇家幻象工坊。

English: Don't worry. This is only a dream.
Chinese: 别担心。这只是一场梦。

English: Aye, she's doing well.
Chinese: 嗯，她挺好的。

English: I'm afraid I don't know.
Chinese: 恐怕我不知道。

English: <<A smell of jasmine lingers around this excessively well-kempt man. Little round spectacles frame his cadaverous face, and a neatly trimmed moustache nestles on his top lip.>>
Chinese: <<这位男士过分整洁，周身萦绕着茉莉香。圆片小眼镜架在死人般苍白的脸上，唇上蓄着修剪齐整的小胡子。>>

English: Well,  well! There's something one doesn't see every day: a mystery visitor. I know all the names and faces of my workers' regular visitors, so I would warrant you are here to see me.
Chinese: 哎呀呀！这可是件稀罕事：一位神秘访客。我的工人常客的名字和面孔我全都记得，所以我敢断定，你是来找我的。

English: <<He gives you a small but theatrical bow.>> ##Doctor [[Carl von Pripp]], at your service. Physician, visionwright, and appointed steward of all the industrious dreamers who serve here.
Chinese: <<他微微鞠了一躬，却鞠得像登台演出。>>##[[卡尔·冯·普里普医生]]，愿为您效劳。医师、幻象师，兼此地勤劳织梦者的指定总管。

English: Ah, the armed avenger returns. Do you have any further demands?
Chinese: 啊，持械的复仇者回来了。还有什么别的要求吗？

English: Greetings again, visitor. How may I help you?
Chinese: 又见面了，访客。有何贵干？

English: So, what brings you to the Royal Vision Works today?
Chinese: 那么，今天是什么风把您吹到皇家幻象工坊来的？

English: How else can I be of service?
Chinese: 还有别的事要我效劳吗？

English: Very well. While you're here, do you have any other demands? I'm afraid most of our cash is kept off-premises.
Chinese: 很好。既然你在这里，还有什么别的要求吗？恐怕我们的现金大多存在场外。

English: A prison? On the contrary, most of our workers come here of their own free will. The rest are far past the point of making their own decisions.
Chinese: 监狱？恰恰相反，大多数工人是自愿来的。其余那些，早已过了能自己做决定的阶段。

English: Some come from desperate circumstances, and wish to lift their relatives out of a financial hole. Others are working to furnish their own future. Occasionally a delinquent debtor will be given the choice of coming here instead of being gaoled.
Chinese: 有人出身绝境，想拉亲人走出经济泥潭。有人在为自己的将来攒家底。偶尔也有赖账的惯犯，可以选择来这儿，免于坐牢。

English: A rare few of them are, to be blunt, simply tired of life. I hope even my detractors would agree that my patented Eversleep Elixir is far preferable to suicide.
Chinese: 坦白说，还有极少数，纯粹是活腻了。我希望连我的诋毁者都会同意：我的专利"永眠灵药"，远比自杀可取。

English: We enjoy the letter patent from our glorious Clockwork King, which gives us a legal monopoly on exporting bottled visions outside the Kingdom.
Chinese: 我们持有尊贵发条王颁发的专利特许状，在王国境外出口瓶装幻象的业务上享有合法垄断。

English: Separately, I am chairman of the Oneiric Oversight Committee, which regulates the vision trade, licenses visionwrights, and ensures that bottles hazardous to public morals are taken off the shelves.
Chinese: 另外，我是幻梦监督委员会的主席，负责监管幻象贸易、给幻象师发执照，并确保有伤风化的瓶子下架。

English: It is a duty that I take exceedingly seriously.
Chinese: 这份职责，我是极其认真地对待的。

English: That is noble of you. Very well: what is your plan to evacuate the invalids? About one third of them suffer from chronic oneironism; the rest will struggle to walk for at least a month.
Chinese: 志向可嘉。那好：你打算怎么疏散这些病员？约三分之一患有慢性梦疾；其余的至少一个月内难以行走。

English: And naturally, I presume you are familiar with the required dietary and alchemical regimen to gradually re-habituate their digestive systems to solid food without rupturing their stomachs?
Chinese: 还有，想必你熟悉让他们的消化系统逐步重新适应固体食物而不至胃破裂的膳食与炼金调理流程？

English: There is also the matter of their wages. Many of their families are dependent on the income they provide. Those who joined us voluntarily may be quite indignant with you for ruining their plans.
Chinese: 还有工资问题。许多工人的家庭靠他们的收入过活。那些自愿来的人，被你搅了生计，怕是要跟你拼命。

English: In any case, I will do as you instruct. After all, you are the one with the weapon.
Chinese: 无论如何，我会照你说的办。毕竟，拿枪的是你。

English: Thoughtful of you to ask. I must say she's taken to our business rather adeptly. Most imaginative. I suspect that she will prove one of our most profitable workers.
Chinese: 难得你过问。不得不说她相当适应我们这行。想象力极丰富。我怀疑她会成为我们最赚钱的工人之一。

English: Her dreams have a certain ((whimsy)) to them – a particular Clockwork Kingdom quaintness – which is very popular in our foreign markets.
Chinese: 她的梦自有一种((奇趣))——一种发条王国特有的古雅风味——在我们的海外市场大受欢迎。

English: <<Doctor Pripp listens to your tale with studious dispassion, his brows slightly furrowed.>>
Chinese: <<普里普医生带着学者式的冷静听你讲完，眉头微微皱起。>>

English: It is a most unfortunate case. Alas, it is also a familiar one. Would you like the good news first, or the bad news?
Chinese: 这是个非常不幸的病例。唉，也是常见病例。你想先听好消息，还是坏消息？

English: The good news is that I can offer at least two solutions to the poor girl's predicament. Her mother may not like them, but I am a doctor and not a minor god.
Chinese: 好消息是，这可怜姑娘的困境，我至少能提供两条路。她母亲未必喜欢，但我是医生，不是什么小神。

English: The bad news is that there is [[no known]] cure for chronic oneironism once it advances to such a late stage. Naturally this is a major avenue of my research, but in my professional opinion it is unlikely to bear fruit for at least a decade.
Chinese: 坏消息是，慢性梦疾一旦发展到这么晚的阶段，[[尚无已知]]的治愈方法。这自然是我的主要研究方向，但以专业眼光看，十年之内恐怕难有成果。

English: <<Pripp sighs.>> Chalk up another failure for my 'bedside manner', I suppose. I never could get the hang of that.
Chinese: <<普里普叹了口气。>>我的"床边风范"又记上一败吧。我从来就没学会过那玩意儿。

English: There is [[no known cure]] for chronic oneironism once it advances to such a late stage. Nevertheless, there may still be a way that I can help.
Chinese: 慢性梦疾一旦发展到这么晚的阶段，[[尚无已知疗法治愈]]。不过，我这里或许仍有一条路能帮上忙。

English: The simplest option is for Nadja to [[join our happy crew]]. Many of our workers are chronic cases like her, and I can assure you they are comfortable and well taken care of.
Chinese: 最简单的办法，是让娜佳[[加入我们这个快乐的大家庭]]。我们的许多工人都是她这样的慢性病例，我可以向你保证，他们过得舒适，被照顾得很好。

English: Her mother would share in the profits, while being relieved of the burden of caring for her, and could visit regularly during our open hours. ##Naturally, we would also pay you a [[finder's fee]].
Chinese: 她母亲可以分享收益，又卸下照顾她的重担，还可以在我们的开放时间定期探视。##自然，我们也会付给你一笔[[介绍费]]。

English: Alternatively, Yasmeen could [[buy her own vision siphon]], also known as a [[dream crown]]. I believe the current price is [[120 coins]], including permit fees. This would enable her to support Nadja at home by bottling and selling her visions independently.
Chinese: 另一个选择，是亚斯敏[[自购一台幻象虹吸器]]，又称[[梦境之冠]]。我记得现价[[120 枚硬币]]，含许可费。这样她就能在家照料娜佳，独立把她的梦装瓶出售。

English: Any other questions?
Chinese: 还有别的问题吗？

English: Look around you. Does it seem to you as if I am joking? ##Nadja and Yasmeen are not the first to suffer this predicament, and I am afraid they will not be the last.
Chinese: 看看你的四周。我像是在开玩笑吗？##娜佳和亚斯敏不是第一对陷入这种困境的母女，恐怕也不会是最后一对。

English: I must correct you on one point. Only a very small percentage of vision imbibers suffer from chronic oneironism, and invariably we find that they have a history of ((excessive)) use. The label does warn you against that, you know.
Chinese: 有一点我必须纠正。饮用幻象的人里，只有极小比例患慢性梦疾，而且无一例外，他们都有((过量))饮用的历史。标签上可是警告过的，你知道吧。

English: But yes, perhaps there is a certain poetic irony to the situation. As a physician and a public servant, I do not concern myself with such intangibles.
Chinese: 不过，是，这局面或许有几分诗意的讽刺。作为医师和公务人员，这类玄虚不在我的关心范围。

English: Chronic oneironists are an interesting cohort. For all their outward lethargy, their imaginations remain superbly active – which is to say, profitable.
Chinese: 慢性梦疾者是个有趣的群体。外表看他们昏昏沉沉，想象力却依然极度活跃——也就是说，非常值钱。

English: Here at the Works we can bottle their visions en masse, using cutting-edge equipment, and we enjoy good relationships and very favourable rates with both domestic and foreign distributors.
Chinese: 在本工坊，我们可以用尖端设备把他们的幻象大批装瓶，而且与国内外分销商都有良好的合作关系和非常优惠的费率。

English: We also host a weekly support group for family members of chronic oneironists, which Yasmeen would be welcome to attend.
Chinese: 我们还为慢性梦疾者的家属每周办一次互助会，亚斯敏随时欢迎参加。

English: If memory serves, she could buy one at Vidal's shop. She would need a permit, but since I chair the body that approves said permits, that won't be a problem.
Chinese: 如果我没记错，她可以在维达尔的店里买。她需要一张许可，不过审批许可的机构由我主持，这不成问题。

English: I must caution you that without the benefit of our extensive distribution network, and our royal monopoly on exports, this option would inevitably be less lucrative for Yasmeen.
Chinese: 但我必须提醒：没有我们庞大的分销网络，也没有出口上的王室垄断，这个选项给亚斯敏带来的收益必然要少得多。

English: On the other hand, with practice, Yasmeen could learn to capture her ((own)) dreams and administer them to Nadja – potentially permitting a form of bidirectional communication between the pair.
Chinese: 反过来说，勤加练习后，亚斯敏可以学会采集她((自己的))梦，再施加给娜佳——这甚至可能让母女之间实现某种双向交流。

English: Why don't you take one of our standard contracts for her to read through? A pre-stamped 0th-class Royal Post envelope is included in the package.
Chinese: 这样吧，拿一份我们的标准合同给她读？包裹里附了一枚预先盖戳的零等皇家邮信封。

English: If Yasmeen accepts our offer, I shall leave your [[finder's fee]] with [[Vidal the vision trader]] in Ferropolis.
Chinese: 如果亚斯敏接受了我们的条件，我会把你的[[介绍费]]留在铁城的幻象商人[[维达尔]]那里。

English: Remember, this is not a decision that should be taken lightly. I encourage Yasmeen to take all the time she wishes.
Chinese: 记住，这不是一个可以草率做出的决定。我建议亚斯敏用她想用的时间慢慢考虑。

English: <<Pripp splutters as he is covered in a shower of papers.>> ##Uff! You certainly have a flair for drama.
Chinese: <<文件雨点般砸了普里普一身，他呛了一口。>>##呃！你可真有戏剧天分。

English: <<He looks at you coldly over his little spectacles as he brushes a page off his shoulder.>> ##Your petulance notwithstanding, my offer remains open.
Chinese: <<他拂掉肩上的纸页，从圆片小眼镜上方冷冷地看你。>>##尽管你如此任性，我的提议依然有效。

English: Chronic oneironism is a tragic condition, and has been the ruin of several families. In one infamous case, a heavily indebted woman was hanged for poisoning her unwaking husband.
Chinese: 慢性梦疾是个悲惨的病症，已毁掉好几个家庭。有一桩出了名的案子：一个负债累累的女人，因毒死她长眠不醒的丈夫被处以绞刑。

English: Yasmeen is unlikely to find anyone else who can offer our standard of care. In any case, she knows where to find us.
Chinese: 亚斯敏找不到第二家能提供我们这种照护水准的地方。无论如何，她知道去哪找我们。

English: What is this place? It looks like a hospital but it feels like a prison.
Chinese: 这地方是什么？看着像医院，感觉却像监狱。

English: <<[Draw your weapon]>> This place is sick. I'm here to liberate your 'workers'.
Chinese: <<[拔出武器]>>这地方有病。我来解放你们的"工人"。

English: I'm here on behalf of a woman who can't wake up.
Chinese: 我受一位醒不过来的女人所托而来。

English: I have some more questions about Yasmeen's options.
Chinese: 关于亚斯敏的选择，我还有几个问题。

English: How is Nadja settling in?
Chinese: 娜佳住得怎么样？

English: Nothing just now. I'll see myself out.
Chinese: 暂时没有。我自己出去。

English: And what does the 'Royal' part mean?
Chinese: 那"皇家"两个字是什么意思？

English: ...I see. Let me ask you about something else.
Chinese: ……明白了。我问点别的。

English: <<[Put away your weapon]>> ...fine. But I still have business with you.
Chinese: <<[收起武器]>>……好吧。但我跟你还有笔账要算。

English: Don't worry. I'll be back with friends.
Chinese: 放心。我会带着朋友回来的。

English: The good news.
Chinese: 先说好消息。

English: The bad news.
Chinese: 先说坏消息。

English: Don't play games with me. Can you help or not?
Chinese: 别跟我兜圈子。你到底能不能帮？

English: You can't be serious.
Chinese: 你不是在开玩笑吧。

English: Tell me more about Nadja becoming one of your 'workers'.
Chinese: 再多讲讲娜佳怎么当你们的"工人"。

English: Tell me more about Yasmeen buying a dream crown.
Chinese: 再多讲讲亚斯敏买梦境之冠的事。

English: Very well. I'll have to see what Yasmeen thinks.
Chinese: 好吧。我得看看亚斯敏怎么想。

English: Let me get this straight. Bottled visions make people sick, and then you use those people to make more bottled visions?
Chinese: 让我捋一捋。瓶装幻象把人喝病了，然后你们再拿这些病人去生产更多瓶装幻象？

English: ...fine, never mind.
Chinese: ……行吧，算了。

English: Thanks, I suppose.
Chinese: 谢谢，算是吧。

English: <<[Throw the contract in back his face]>> Shove it up your arse, Pripp.
Chinese: <<[把合同摔在他脸上]>>自己塞屁股里去吧，普里普。

English: TWO
Chinese: 二

English: THREE
Chinese: 三

English: FOUR
Chinese: 四

English: SIX
Chinese: 六

English: SEVEN
Chinese: 七

English: <<This middle-aged woman looks worn down to the bone, with bags under her eyes and deep worry lines in her forehead. Her jet-black hair is unkempt but held in place by a long, ornamented pin of surprising finery.>>
Chinese: <<这位中年妇女疲惫得形销骨立，眼下挂着黑眼圈，额头刻着深深的愁纹。她乌黑的头发乱糟糟的，却用一支出奇华美的长别针别着。>>

English: Oh, hello. Are you one of [[Nadja's]] pals? I'm afraid she's not seeing anyone right now.
Chinese: 哦，你好。你是[[娜佳]]的朋友吗？恐怕她现在谁也不见。

English: <<A cloud crosses her face.>> ((Vidal?)) The vision trader? Of all the ((nerve)) – !
Chinese: <<一片阴云掠过她的脸。>>((维达尔？))那个幻象商人？好大的((脸))——！

English: <<Something about your manner seems to cut her, and when she speaks her voice cracks as if she's about to cry.>> ##I... no. No, she's ((not)) all right.
Chinese: <<你话里的什么刺痛了她，再开口时她的声音发颤，像要哭出来。>>##我……不。不，她((不))好。

English: <<The woman closes her eyes and takes a deep breath.>> ##I apologise, stranger. You're... not seeing me at my best just now.
Chinese: <<女人闭上眼，深吸一口气。>>##抱歉，陌生人。你现在……看到的不是我最好的样子。

English: <<She makes a small noise of polite amusement.>> ##This tenement is a maze, isn't it? If there's any order to the room numbers, I've never mastered it.
Chinese: <<她发出一声礼貌而无奈的轻笑。>>##这栋公寓楼是个迷宫，对吧？房号就算有规律，我也从没摸透。

English: Well, stranger, I hope you find what you're looking for.
Chinese: 好了，陌生人，愿你找到你想找的。

English: I'm Nadja's mother, [[Yasmeen]]. This last month I've been her full-time carer as well. ##It's those [[bottled visions]], you see.
Chinese: 我是娜佳的母亲，[[亚斯敏]]。这一个月，我还当起了她的全职看护。##都是那些[[瓶装幻象]]害的。

English: Our family has had a rough few years, and there wasn't much joy in our lives. So when Nadja first started getting into visions, I was happy for her.
Chinese: 我们家这几年过得艰难，日子里没什么高兴事。所以娜佳刚迷上幻象的时候，我还为她高兴。

English: Then she began spending all her free time dreaming. Soon she was sleeping until noon, missing work. ##Now she [[barely wakes up at all]], and she's never lucid when she does.
Chinese: 后来她把所有空闲时间都拿去做梦。很快她睡到中午、误了上工。##现在她[[几乎完全不醒了]]，偶尔醒着，也神志不清。

English: She can't work; can't even feed herself. But she ((does)) need food, and fuel to keep warm. With all these summoning glitches I have to pay cash on the black market, and we're down to the last dregs of our savings.
Chinese: 她没法工作；连吃饭都要人喂。可她((确实))要吃饭，还要燃料取暖。这么多召唤故障，我只能去黑市花现金买，我们的积蓄已经见了底。

English: <<Yasmeen shrugs despairingly.>> ##I just don't know how we can ((survive)) like this for much longer.
Chinese: <<亚斯敏绝望地耸耸肩。>>##我只是不知道，我们还能这样((撑))多久。

English: A few years ago my husband passed away, and I got very sick. The Creeping Cough, you know. Even today I can't really work, because of all the spores in my lungs.
Chinese: 几年前我丈夫去世了，我自己也大病一场。就是那个"蔓延咳"。直到今天，肺里全是孢子，我还是干不了活。

English: Then, last year, we had to leave [[our house]] in the countryside due to the Corruption. As far as I know it's still out there, slowly sinking back into the mud. This room and its contents are all we have left.
Chinese: 然后去年，因为腐化，我们不得不离开乡下的[[老宅]]。据我所知它还在那儿，慢慢陷回泥里。这间屋子和屋里的东西，就是我们的全部了。

English: I don't mean to moan, truly. There's so many in this kingdom who have it worse than us. I just know it was tough on Nadja, that's all.
Chinese: 我不是想诉苦，真的。这个王国里比我们惨的人多得多。我只知道，娜佳受的苦最重，就这样。

English: <<Yasmeen throws up her hands in frustration.>> I don't know! I'm not an alchemist, or any kind of vision expert. We petitioned the King for a doctor to visit, but with the way things are it'll be ((months)) before we hear back.
Chinese: <<亚斯敏懊恼地摊开双手。>>我不知道！我又不是炼金师，也不是幻象专家。我们向国王申请派医生来，可照眼下这情形，等回音要((几个月))。

English: <<A tentative hope is kindled in her eyes.>> Oh, would you? ##Yes, you could ask [[Vidal the vision trader]] about it. I doubt I could face him myself without knocking his lights out and trashing his shop...
Chinese: <<她眼里燃起一线希望。>>哦，你愿意吗？##你可以去问问[[幻象商人维达尔]]。我自己去见他，八成会忍不住把他打晕，再把店砸了……

English: <<A tentative hope is kindled in her eyes.>> Oh, do you think? ##I doubt I could face him myself without knocking his lights out and trashing his shop. But if ((you)) could ask him on my behalf...
Chinese: <<她眼里燃起一线希望。>>哦，你觉得行？##我自己去见他，八成会忍不住把他打晕，再把店砸了。但((你))要是肯替我问问……

English: Vidal ((must)) have seen cases like Nadja's before. If there's any way to help her, he'd surely know. ##<<She arches her eyebrows.>> And if he refuses, you tell him he'll answer to me.
Chinese: 维达尔((一定))见过娜佳这样的病例。真有办法救她，他肯定知道。##<<她扬起眉毛。>>他要是敢推脱，你就说，他会付出代价的。

English: Thank you, dear. ##But, um, could I ask you a favour? I'll understand if it's not possible, of course...
Chinese: 谢谢你，亲爱的。##不过，呃，能再请你帮个忙吗？办不到的话没关系，当然……

English: Should you happen to find yourself in [[Vidal's bottled vision shop]], perhaps you could ask him about Nadja? If there's any way to help her, he'd surely know.
Chinese: 你若是路过[[维达尔的瓶装幻象店]]，能替我向他问问娜佳的事吗？真有办法救她，他肯定知道。

English: <<You find Yasmeen feeding her daughter porridge from a wooden bowl, singing a soft lullaby. She looks worn down to the bone.>>
Chinese: <<你见到亚斯敏正用木碗给女儿喂粥，轻轻哼着摇篮曲。她憔悴得形销骨立。>>

English: <<Yasmeen glances in your direction.>> ##Ah, hello again. Did you have any luck?
Chinese: <<亚斯敏朝你这边看过来。>>##啊，又见面了。有收获吗？

English: <<Yasmeen looks a little better than when you saw her last, and the bags under her eyes are much reduced.>> ##Ah, hello again. Can I do anything for you?
Chinese: <<亚斯敏看上去比你上次见时好了一些，黑眼圈淡了许多。>>##啊，又见面了。有事要我帮忙吗？

English: <<Yasmeen makes her best attempt at a smile.>> ##Was there anything else you wanted?
Chinese: <<亚斯敏努力挤出一点笑。>>##还有别的事吗？

English: You mean ((your)) house? <<She gives you a mischievous smile.>> ##It's outside Ferropolis, [[to the north]].
Chinese: 你是说((你们))家那栋房子？<<她冲你狡黠一笑。>>##在铁城外，[[北边]]。

English: If you leave via the main checkpoint and keep going forward, you should find it on a cliff overlooking the forest.
Chinese: 从主关卡出城一直往前，你会在一处俯瞰森林的悬崖上找到它。

English: Oh, that's easy. It's a bit of a landmark – a central fixture of this town. <<She snorts bitterly.>>
Chinese: 哦，那个好找。算个地标了——我们镇的中心坐标。<<她苦笑一声。>>

English: It's not far from here. Just opposite the Machinarium, beside the steps that lead up from the lower city.
Chinese: 离这儿不远。就在机械殿正对面，下城区那道台阶旁边。

English: <<She thinks for a long time before responding. When she does, her words are eerily calm.>>
Chinese: <<她想了很久才开口。开口时，语气平静得可怕。>>

English: Sometimes I just want to ((scream)). Scream and scream and scream and scream. And keep screaming until I ruin my throat and can't make any noise at all.
Chinese: 有时候我只想((尖叫))。一直叫，叫，叫，叫。叫到喊坏嗓子，一点声音都发不出来为止。

English: And do you know something? I don't think anything would happen. Nobody would respond. We're all so trained to stay in our little circles of candlelight. To never really ((think)) about what's happening all around us.
Chinese: 你知道吗？我觉得就算叫了也不会有任何事发生。没人会回应。我们都太习惯缩在自己的那圈烛光里了。从来不去((想))周围正在发生什么。

English: Because if you think about it, then it becomes real for you too, and not just for some other poor bastard you don't know. ##Maybe I'd be the same, if not for what's happened to Nadja.
Chinese: 因为一旦你想了，它对你也就成真的了，不再是发生在别的哪个倒霉蛋身上的事。##若不是娜佳出了事，我大概也一样。

English: Oh, well, it's all change here. So much paperwork! But I've signed Doctor Pripp's contract, and they've already taken Nadja to the Works to begin her new life.
Chinese: 哦，这里一切都变了。好多文书要签！我已经签了普里普医生的合同，他们已经把娜佳接去工坊，开始她的新生活了。

English: Oh, well, it's all change here. So much paperwork! But I've signed Doctor Pripp's contract, and he'll be sending a carriage and some nurses to pick Nadja up next week.
Chinese: 哦，这里一切都变了。好多文书要签！我已经签了普里普医生的合同，下周他会派马车和护士来接娜佳。

English: It'll be... difficult, living here alone. Even this tiny room feels empty without her. I keep forgetting she's gone, and making porridge I don't need...
Chinese: 往后的日子会……很难。她不在，连这间小屋都显得空荡荡的。我总是忘了她已经走了，还在煮没人喝的粥……

English: It'll be... difficult, living here alone. Only being able to see her when I visit. But I'm praying to the King that one day they'll find a cure. And when they do, I'll try to have a good life ready and waiting for her.
Chinese: 往后的日子会……很难。只有探视的时候才能见到她。但我在向国王祈祷，祈祷有一天他们会找到解药。到那时，我会为她准备好一个美好的生活，等着她回来。

English: But I'll be visiting her twice a week, and I'm praying to the King that one day they'll find a cure. When they do, I'll have a good life ready and waiting for her.
Chinese: 但我每周会去探视她两次，我也在向国王祈祷，祈祷有一天他们会找到解药。到那时，我会为她准备好一个美好的生活，等着她回来。

English: Oh, well, it's all change here. As you can see, I've already got the dream crown set up. I was surprised by how quickly my permit was approved.
Chinese: 哦，这里一切都变了。你看，梦境之冠我已经装好了。许可批下来那么快，我自己都吃惊。

English: Oh, well, it's all change here. I've applied for a bottling permit, and Vidal kindly gave me a book about how to get into the vision trade. I must say, it's all ((very)) complicated.
Chinese: 哦，这里一切都变了。我申请了装瓶许可，维达尔还好心送了我一本入行幻象贸易的书。不得不说，这里面的门道((复杂))得很。

English: Vidal kindly gave me a book about how to get into the vision trade – though I must say, it's all ((very)) complicated.
Chinese: 维达尔还好心送了我一本入行幻象贸易的书——不得不说，这里面的门道((复杂))得很。

English: Maybe this is a silly plan. Maybe in a year's time I'll be broke again and crawling back to Doctor Pripp, cap in hand. But if I can still talk to Nadja, even in her dreams, then it'll have been worth it.
Chinese: 也许这是个傻主意。也许一年后我又会身无分文，捧着脸去求普里普医生。但如果我还能跟娜佳说话——哪怕只在梦里——那就值了。

English: Perhaps one day they'll find a cure, and Nadja will wake up to find that she's famous. Wouldn't that be funny?
Chinese: 也许有一天他们会找到解药，娜佳一觉醒来发现自己已经名满天下。那多有意思？

English: Oh! Yes. Yes, I do. Have you seen him? Is he safe? ##What a funny coincidence. I recently got a message from him, though it was a rather odd one.
Chinese: 哦！对。对，我有。你见过他？他平安吗？##真巧。我最近刚收到他一封信，不过写得怪怪的。

English: Oh! Yes. Yes, I do. Have you seen him? Is he safe? I haven't heard from him in ((years))...
Chinese: 哦！对。对，我有。你见过他？他平安吗？我((好多年))没有他的音讯了……

English: King's beard. Well, that explains some things about his message... ##Thank you for telling me. I'm glad at least he's still ticking.
Chinese: 国王的胡子。这下他信里的一些事说得通了……##谢谢你告诉我。至少知道他还活着，我就放心了。

English: King's beard, how horrible. I truly hoped he'd escaped that sort of thing for good.  ##Thank you for telling me. I'm glad at least he's still ticking.
Chinese: 国王的胡子，太可怕了。我真心盼着他已经彻底躲开了那种事。##谢谢你告诉我。至少知道他还活着，我就放心了。

English: Ah, I see. Well, I'm glad at least he's still ticking. ##<<She sighs.>> What I wouldn't do to taste his fish goulash again!
Chinese: 啊，这样。唉，至少他还活着，我就放心了。##<<她叹了口气。>>真想再尝一口他做的炖鱼啊！

English: <<She sighs.>> What I wouldn't do to taste his fish goulash again! Or to hear Bina sing again...
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>真想再尝一口他做的炖鱼啊！或者再听一次宾娜唱歌……

English: <<You hand her the sheaf of papers that Pripp gave you, and begin to explain...>>
Chinese: <<你把普里普给你的那沓文件交给她，开始解释……>>

English: <<From the way Yasmeen listens, you can tell that she has plenty of experience maintaining composure in the face of tragedy.>> ##<<This time, though, it's not enough.>>
Chinese: <<从亚斯敏听的样子看得出，面对惨事维持镇定这件事，她经验丰富。>>##<<只是这一次，不够用了。>>

English: <<When she's finished, she looks over at Nadja for a long time.>> ##Oh, my darling. How could I have let this happen to you?
Chinese: <<她听完，久久地望着娜佳。>>##哦，我的宝贝。我怎么就让你落到这一步呢？

English: <<Yasmeen looks back at you.>> ##I know you did your best, but this is quite the dilemma you've brought me. What do ((you)) think I should do?
Chinese: <<亚斯敏回头看你。>>##我知道你已经尽力了，可你给我出的这个难题着实不小。你觉得((我))该怎么办？

English: Yes. In theory it's the obvious choice. I don't know how to care for Nadja properly, let alone bottle her visions. But ((they)) do. And obviously, the money wouldn't go amiss.
Chinese: 是的。理论上这是最明显的选择。我不知道怎么才能妥善照顾娜佳，更别说装瓶她的幻象。可((他们))知道。而且说实话，有笔钱总不是坏事。

English: <<She pats the contract you gave her.>> If the figures described here are even halfway accurate, I'd be able to live comfortably for as long as Nadja's illness lasts.
Chinese: <<她拍了拍你递来的合同。>>就算这里的数字只对了一半，在娜佳的病好之前，我也能过得宽裕了。

English: Yes. You can't put a price on family. I may not know how to care for Nadja properly, or bottle visions. But I can learn. King knows I've seen a lot of change in my life.
Chinese: 是的。家人是无价的。我或许不会照顾娜佳，不会装瓶幻象。但我可以学。国王作证，我这辈子见过的变故够多了。

English: Although... it ((would)) be a lot of work. If my sickness flares up, I might not be able to keep the business going. We could easily end up back where we started, without a penny.
Chinese: 虽然……那((确实))是很大的工作量。万一我的病犯了，生意可能就撑不下去。到头来我们很可能又回到原点，一个子儿都不剩。

English: My heart tells me I should keep Nadja here. No matter how long it takes for me to learn the vision trade, or how difficult it would be to take care of her.
Chinese: 我的心告诉我，应该把娜佳留在家里。不管我要花多久学这行幻象生意，也不管照顾她有多难。

English: And if there's ((any)) way that I can still communicate with her – even if it's only through dreams – I want to take it.
Chinese: 只要还有((任何))办法能让我和我女儿继续交流——哪怕只能在梦里——我都想抓住。

English: Truthfully, though, it's moot. I don't have [[120 coins]] to buy a [[dream crown]] from Vidal, and I doubt I ever will. My neighbours have been a tremendous help, but there isn't that much cash in this entire tenement.
Chinese: 说实话，这都是空谈。我拿不出[[120 枚硬币]]去维达尔那儿买[[梦境之冠]]，恐怕永远也拿不出。邻居们已经帮了天大的忙，可整栋公寓楼也凑不出这么多现金。

English: I suppose I'll get in touch with this Doctor Pripp and begin the process. What else can I do?
Chinese: 我想我会去联系这位普里普医生，开始走流程。不然还能怎么办呢？

English: %% <<Yasmeen seems touched by this.>> That's true. She always used to tell me not to worry about working. That she'd take care of everything, so I could rest my lungs. Maybe this really is what she'd want.
Chinese: %% <<亚斯敏似乎被打动了。>>是啊。她从前总跟我说，别惦记干活的事。她说她会打理好一切，让我好好养肺。也许这真的是她想要的。

English: <<You can tell you've made her feel better about her decision.>>
Chinese: <<看得出来，你的话让她对自己的决定好受了些。>>

English: && <<Your words only seem to deepen Yasmeen's sorrow.>> ##That's true. She always used to tell me she'd take care of everything, support us both. But I never wanted her to do it like ((this!)
Chinese: && <<你的话似乎只让亚斯敏更悲伤了。>>##是啊。她从前总说她会打理好一切，养活我们俩。可我从来没想过要她用((这种方式做！

English: <<You can tell that Yasmeen is conflicted about your offer.>> ##What? Oh no, no, I couldn't possibly accept that. You've already helped so much...
Chinese: <<看得出，你的提议让亚斯敏心绪矛盾。>>##什么？哦不，不，我不能收。你已经帮了我们太多了……

English: I think it was [[120 coins]]. But, King's ears, you shouldn't have to pay that – you've already done so much for us.
Chinese: 我记得是[[120 枚硬币]]。可是，国王的耳朵，你不该替我们掏这个钱——你为我们做得已经够多了。

English: <<She smiles a little, then looks up at you with tears in her eyes.>> ##Very well, then. That will be enough time, I should think.
Chinese: <<她浅浅一笑，然后抬起头，眼里含着泪。>>##那就这么定了。我想，这些时间足够了。

English: <<If she's disappointed, she takes care not to show it.>> ##Of course, dear. I know how it is. Well then – I suppose I'll get in touch with this Doctor Pripp and begin the process.
Chinese: <<若说有失望，她也没有表现出来。>>##当然，亲爱的。我知道难处。那这样吧——我去联系这位普里普医生，开始走流程。

English: Whatever the outcome, you've helped Nadja more than I could have asked. I wish I could pay for your time, but... well, perhaps this will suffice.
Chinese: 无论结果如何，你帮娜佳帮的，已经超出我所敢求的了。真想付你点辛苦钱，可是……嗯，也许这个能顶一顶。

English: This is the [[deed]] to our old family home, [[just outside Ferropolis]]. Technically, we need to petition the Clockwork King for a change of ownership... but since the Militia have all but abandoned the countryside, you should be left alone.
Chinese: 这是我们家老宅的[[地契]]，[[就在铁城城外]]。严格来说，我们得向发条王申请变更所有权……不过民兵队早就不管乡下了，你应该能安生住着。

English: Oh yes you can! What use would we have for it anyway? Restoring that place is a full time job – one for someone ((without)) a lungful of spores.
Chinese: 你收得下！反正留着它对我们也没什么用？修那地方是个全职工作——还是得交给((没有))一肺孢子的人来干。

English: <<Yasmeen arches her eyebrows mischievously.>> ##Call it a loan, if you like. No interest, just give it back before the world ends.
Chinese: <<亚斯敏俏皮地扬起眉。>>##就当借给你好了。不算利息，在世界末日之前还我就行。

English: Call it collateral, if you like. When this Kingdom is peaceful enough for our family to return there, I can buy it back from you.
Chinese: 就当是抵押好了。等这个王国太平了，我们家能回去了，我再从你手里把它买回来。

English: It's not far from here, off [[to the north]]. If you leave via the main checkpoint and keep going forward, you should find it [[on a cliff]] overlooking the forest.
Chinese: 离这儿不远，在[[北边]]。从主关卡出城一直往前，你会在[[一处悬崖上]]找到它，俯瞰着森林。

English: <<This time her smile is warm and genuine.>> ##May you have more luck with it than we did.
Chinese: <<这一次，她的笑容温暖而真诚。>>##愿你用它，比我们用得更有福气。

English: <<It seems this matter is settled. All that remains now is to pick up your finder's fee at Vidal's vision shop in Ferropolis.>>
Chinese: <<看来这件事已定。剩下的只是去铁城维达尔的幻象店领你的介绍费了。>>

English: Very well. I'll hold off on signing the contract for now. ##But please don't tarry. I need to make a decision soon.
Chinese: 好吧。那合同我暂时不签。##但请你别拖太久。我得尽快做个决定。

English: It's a good question. They're such a fact of life here in the Kingdom that I've never really thought about it.
Chinese: 问得好。在这王国里幻象太平常了，我还真没想过这个问题。

English: The first bottled vision I ever tried turned out to be somebody's nightmare – all clacking scissor-teeth and cold sweat. Why anyone would bottle such a horrible dream I've no idea, but it put me off them for good.
Chinese: 我第一次试的瓶装幻象，开出来竟是别人的噩梦——满嘴咔嗒作响的剪刀牙，一身冷汗。谁会把这么可怕的梦装瓶卖，我真想不通，反正它让我从此戒了。

English: My brother [[Youssef]] says most of them aren't like that, though. He's a real aficionado. Honestly, it makes me wonder whether there's some addictive streak that runs in our family.
Chinese: 不过我弟弟[[优素福]]说，大多数不是那样的。他是地道的行家。说实话，我都怀疑我们家族是不是血脉里就带成瘾体质。

English: <<She shrugs.>> But people don't really like to talk about that sort of thing, you know? Especially when the vision industry has such strong backing from the King.
Chinese: <<她耸耸肩。>>不过这种事大家一般不爱聊，你懂吧？尤其幻象产业背后站着国王。

English: Not exactly. Vidal asked me to check in on her.
Chinese: 不完全是。维达尔让我来看看她。

English: Is she all right? She looks like she's out for the count.
Chinese: 她还好吗？看着像是人事不省。

English: No, sorry, I must have taken a wrong turn.
Chinese: 不，抱歉，我大概走错门了。

English: What happened to her?
Chinese: 她怎么了？

English: What about bottled visions?
Chinese: 瓶装幻象怎么了？

English: You mentioned your family has had a rough time lately.
Chinese: 你刚说你家这几年过得艰难。

English: Isn't there some kind of treatment?
Chinese: 就没有什么疗法吗？

English: Maybe I could help find Nadja a doctor.
Chinese: 也许我能帮娜佳找个医生。

English: Maybe Vidal would know where to find a doctor.
Chinese: 也许维达尔知道去哪找医生。

English: I'm very sorry. I'll leave you alone.
Chinese: 非常抱歉。先不打扰了。

English: Where did you say I'd find your old house again?
Chinese: 你刚说你们家老宅在哪来着？

English: Where would I find Vidal's vision shop?
Chinese: 维达尔的幻象店在哪？

English: I managed to find a doctor. But it's not good news...
Chinese: 医生我找到了。但不是好消息……

English: How much did you say a dream crown cost again?
Chinese: 你刚说梦境之冠多少钱来着？

English: How are you doing, Yasmeen? I mean ((you)), not Nadja.
Chinese: 你还好吗，亚斯敏？我是说((你))，不是娜佳。

English: I just wanted to see how you're both getting on.

English: Say, do you happen to have a brother named Youssef?
Chinese: 话说，你是不是有个弟弟叫优素福？

English: Did you say you had a brother named Youssef?

English: That's all for now. Good luck to you both.

English: Not yet. I'll let you know how I get on.

English: That's all. Good luck to you both.

English: He's had to flee Hallowshire due to the famine there, but he's alive and so is his family.
Chinese: 他因为哈洛郡的饥荒逃出来了，但他和家人都还活着。

English: I don't know much. I just happened to run into him.
Chinese: 我知道的不多。只是碰巧遇上他。

English: <<[Awkwardly]>> Um... there, there.
Chinese: <<[尴尬地]>>呃……好了好了，没事了。

English: <<[Offer her a handkerchief to wipe her eyes.]>>
Chinese: <<[递上手帕让她擦擦眼睛。]>>

English: <<[Give her a silent hug.]>>
Chinese: <<[默默抱她一下。]>>

English: I'd send her to the Vision Works. That way, you won't have to worry anymore.
Chinese: 我会把娜佳送去幻象工坊。这样你就不用再操心了。

English: I'd keep Nadja at home, even if it'll be a struggle sometimes.
Chinese: 我会把娜佳留在家里，就算日子会难一些。

English: What if I could pay for a dream crown?
Chinese: 要是我能出钱买梦境之冠呢？

English: @@ The Vision Works is the right place for Nadja. After all, wouldn't she want you to live comfortably?
Chinese: @@ 幻象工坊才是娜佳该去的地方。毕竟，她不是也希望你过得舒坦吗？

English: Very well. It's your decision.
Chinese: 好吧。这是你的决定。

English: Really, I insist. Call it a loan if you like. No interest, pay it back before the world ends.
Chinese: 真的，我坚持。就当借给你。不算利息，在世界末日之前还我就行。

English: I don't have the money with me, but I'll be back. ((Don't)) say yes to Pripp just yet.
Chinese: 我身上没带那么多钱，但我会回来。((先别))答应普里普。

English: I don't have the money with me just now, but I'll be back.
Chinese: 我眼下身上没带钱，但我会回来。

English: Actually, I'm sorry. I don't think I can afford it after all.
Chinese: 其实，抱歉。我好像还是付不起。

English: Yasmeen, I can't accept this from you.
Chinese: 亚斯敏，这个我不能收。

English: Where is this house, exactly?
Chinese: 那栋房子到底在哪？

English: Thank you, Yasmeen.
Chinese: 谢谢你，亚斯敏。

English: Pardon my ignorance, but what ((are)) bottled visions?
Chinese: 恕我孤陋寡闻，瓶装幻象((到底))是什么？

English: Oh. Hello there. Did you say this was [[debug mode]]? It's certainly one of the stranger dreams I've had.
Chinese: 哦。你好啊。你说这是[[调试模式]]？这算我做过的梦里比较怪的一个了。

English: I suppose I can't argue with that.
Chinese: 我想我没法反驳。

English: That wasn't so bad, as dreams go. Be good to Nadja, won't you?
Chinese: 就梦而言，这个不算糟。对娜佳好一点，好吗？

English: <<The clerk trills in a sing-song voice that she's clearly practised hundreds of times.>> ##Hello citizen, and welcome to the [[Royal Vision Works]]! Are you here for yourself or on behalf of someone else?
Chinese: <<办事员用唱诗般的嗓音说出一串显然练过几百遍的话。>>##您好，公民，欢迎来到[[皇家幻象工坊]]！您是为自己来的，还是替别人咨询？

English: Lovely! Rest assured, you're in safe hands. The welfare of our workers is paramount to everyone here, and you won't be pressured into anything. The final decision is yours alone.
Chinese: 好极了！请放心，您会得到妥善照顾。我们工人的福祉是这里所有人的头等大事，没有人会强迫您做任何事。最终决定权只在您自己。

English: Lovely! Now, I must inform you that we can't sign a contract without meeting the candidate in person, or examining them if they're medically incapable. But I'm happy to walk you through the details.
Chinese: 好极了！现在必须说明，见不到候选人本人、或其无法接受医学检查的情况下，我们不能签合同。不过流程细节我很乐意为您讲解。

English: We have a number of positions open, with contracts ranging from three Clockwork-standard months to 12 years. How long were you thinking of staying?
Chinese: 我们有多个岗位开放，合同期限从三个发条标准月到十二年不等。您打算签多久呢？

English: <<She chuckles.>> Don't worry, you're not the first to ask. Lots of older folk still have trouble with the calendar. ##A Clockwork month has sixty days – counting Day Zero, of course.
Chinese: <<她轻笑。>>别担心，这么问的不止您一位。许多老人家到现在还没适应新历法。##一个发条月有六十天——当然，算上第零日。

English: <<The clerk trills in a sing-song voice that she's clearly practised hundreds of times.>> ##Hello your honour, and welcome to the [[Royal Vision Works]]! How can I assist you?
Chinese: <<办事员用唱诗般的嗓音说出一串显然练过几百遍的话。>>##您好长官，欢迎来到[[皇家幻象工坊]]！有何可以为您效劳？

English: <<The clerk trills in a sing-song voice that she's clearly practised hundreds of times.>> ##Hello citizen, and welcome to the [[Royal Vision Works]]! How can I assist you?
Chinese: <<办事员用唱诗般的嗓音说出一串显然练过几百遍的话。>>##您好公民，欢迎来到[[皇家幻象工坊]]！有何可以为您效劳？

English: Can I help you with anything else?
Chinese: 还有别的需要吗？

English: The good doctor is up on the [[top floor]]. I'm sure he'll be more than happy to assist you.
Chinese: 好医生在[[顶楼]]。我相信他一定非常乐意为您效劳。

English: Oh! Well, of course. Would that be for yourself, or someone else?
Chinese: 哦！嗯，当然。请问是您本人，还是替别人咨询？

English: Why, becoming a [[vision worker]]! That is what you're here for, isn't it?
Chinese: 哎呀，当然是来当[[幻象工人]]的呀！您不就是为这个来的吗？

English: All our workers are provided room and board, along with top-notch medical care from the illustrious [[Doctor Pripp]]. Half the proceeds of their work are retained by the institution, and the other half is theirs to keep.
Chinese: 我们所有的工人都提供食宿，还有声名显赫的[[普里普医生]]的一流医疗。劳动所得一半归机构，一半归工人本人。

English: You can have the money paid out twice-monthly to a designated beneficiary, or held safely for you until your contract ends. And of course, all your work will be properly credited under your own name.
Chinese: 钱可以每半月支付给指定受益人，也可以安全地替您存到合同期满。当然，您的劳动成果都会以您本人的名义记录在案。

English: Would you like to read through some example contracts? Or try a sample of our patented sleeping draught?
Chinese: 要不要读几份示例合同？或者尝一小口我们专利的安眠饮？

English: <<She blinks.>> Oh. Then are you here to see someone? I'm afraid I can only admit direct kin, or people named in the worker's directive letter.
Chinese: <<她眨眨眼。>>哦。那您是来探望谁的？恐怕我们只接待直系亲属，或者工人委托信里点名的访客。

English: Um... well, it's like I said. This is the Royal Vision Works. We make bottled visions.
Chinese: 呃……嗯，就像我说的。这里是皇家幻象工坊。我们生产瓶装幻象。

English: <<The clerk smiles coldly.>> If you're not here for any particular reason, I'm afraid I can't help you. I don't really have time for idle hobnobbing.
Chinese: <<办事员冷冷一笑。>>您要是没什么正事，恕我不能接待。我可没工夫闲聊。

English: I'm sorry, [[Doctor Pripp]] is extremely busy at present and is only seeing visitors by appointment. Can I help you with anything else?
Chinese: 很抱歉，[[普里普医生]]眼下事务繁忙，只接待有预约的访客。还有别的需要吗？

English: Now, can I help you with anything else?
Chinese: 那么，还有别的需要吗？

English: Can I help you with anything else?
Chinese: 还有别的需要吗？

English: <<The clerk looks perturbed.>> Oh! My apologies, your honour. Why didn't you say earlier?
Chinese: <<办事员神色慌张。>>哦！失礼了，长官。您怎么不早说？

English: Even so, I'm afraid I will need to see some kind of order from the King. It says so in our letter patent, you see? ##<<She points to an official-looking document proudly displayed upon the wall.>>
Chinese: 即便如此，恐怕我还是得查验某种王命文书。我们的特许状里写着呢，您明白？##<<她指着墙上骄傲展示的一份官样文件。>>

English: Of course, your honour. I ((will)) need to see some kind of order from the King. It says so in our letter patent, you see? ##<<She points to an official-looking document proudly displayed upon the wall.>>
Chinese: 当然可以，长官。但我((确实))得查验某种王命文书。我们的特许状里写着呢，您明白？##<<她指着墙上骄傲展示的一份官样文件。>>

English: && <<The clerk looks uneasy.>> I'm very sorry, your honour, but I simply don't have that latitude. If you don't mind waiting, I'm sure Doctor Pripp will be happy to help you when he's available.
Chinese: && <<办事员面露难色。>>非常抱歉，长官，我真的没有这个权限。您若不介意等待，普里普医生得空时一定乐意为您效劳。

English: <<She remembers herself.>> Oh! And long live the King, of course.
Chinese: <<她回过神来。>>哦！还有，国王万岁，当然了。

English: %% <<The clerk gives you a knowing look.>> Ah, of ((course)), your honour. The good doctor is up on the [[top floor]] – I'm sure he'll be happy to assist you.
Chinese: %% <<办事员心照不宣地看了你一眼。>>啊，((当然))了，长官。好医生就在[[顶楼]]——他一定乐意为您效劳。

English: <<The clerk blinks as you turn away.>> I'm sorry, your ((own)) way in? But visitors aren't allowed... ##Um, excuse me. Citizen? Where are you going?
Chinese: <<你转身要走，办事员直眨眼。>>抱歉，您((自己))的路子？可是访客是不允许的……##呃，请问。公民？您要去哪？

English: <<The clerk blinks as you turn away.>> I'm sorry, your ((own)) way in? But visitors aren't allowed... ##Um, excuse me. Your honour? Where are you going?
Chinese: <<你转身要走，办事员直眨眼。>>抱歉，您((自己))的路子？可是访客是不允许的……##呃，请问。长官？您要去哪？

English: A complaint? From whom? Sorry, who are you exactly?
Chinese: 投诉？谁投诉了？抱歉，您到底是哪位？

English: && <<The clerk interrupts you with practised aplomb.>> ##Let me just stop you there, 'inspector'. We have a ((process)) for this. I'll need a signed and stamped complaint form, otherwise I can't help you.
Chinese: && <<办事员用娴熟的从容打断你。>>##请允许我打断一下，"督察"。这种事我们有((流程))。我需要一份签字盖章的投诉表，否则恕难从命。

English: %% <<The receptionist blinks, caught off-balance by your aura of unwavering bureaucratic assurance.>> ##The DRB? What does that mean? I've never even heard of –
Chinese: %% <<接待员眨眨眼，被你不容置疑的官僚气场打了个措手不及。>>##梦务监管局？那是什么？我从没听说过——

English: I... um, this is all very irregular. Do you have any proof of your – ?
Chinese: 我……呃，这实在不合规矩。您有任何证件可以证明您的——？

English: Excuse me, can I see that paper agai – wait, who's Gertrude?
Chinese: 抱歉，能让我再看一眼那份文件吗——等等，格特鲁德是谁？

English: <<The clerk looks perturbed.>> Sorry, did you say the ((Guild of Machinists)) is involved in this?
Chinese: <<办事员神色慌张。>>抱歉，您是说这件事((机械师公会))也牵涉其中？

English: <<The receptionist is now practically panicking.>> ##Yes, yes, all right! Um, please proceed upstairs to the [[top floor]]. Doctor Pripp will see you immediately.
Chinese: <<接待员几乎要慌了神。>>##好好好，行！呃，请上[[顶楼]]。普里普医生马上就见您。

English: Please proceed upstairs to the [[top floor]]. Doctor Pripp will see you immediately.
Chinese: 请上[[顶楼]]。普里普医生马上就见您。

English: Um... myself?
Chinese: 呃……我自己？

English: Myself.
Chinese: 自己。

English: Someone else.
Chinese: 替别人。

English: Actually, I'm just leaving.
Chinese: 其实，我就要走了。

English: How long is a Clockwork-standard month again?
Chinese: 发条标准月是多久来着？

English: Sorry, what exactly are we talking about?
Chinese: 抱歉，我们说的到底是什么事？

English: Never mind all that. I need to see Doctor Pripp.
Chinese: 这些先不管。我要见普里普医生。

English: Could you tell me again how this works?
Chinese: 能把流程再给我讲一遍吗？

English: I'll have to think about it and let you know.
Chinese: 我得想想再答复你。

English: Where did you say I'd find Doctor Pripp?
Chinese: 你刚说普里普医生在哪来着？

English: I need to speak with Doctor Pripp.
Chinese: 我要和普里普医生谈谈。

English: Actually, I ((would)) like to talk about becoming a worker.
Chinese: 其实，我((确实))想谈谈当工人的事。

English: Thank you, that'll be all.
Chinese: 谢谢，就到这儿吧。

English: I'm not here to talk about becoming a worker.
Chinese: 我不是来谈当工人的。

English: Look, pretend I'm a child. What ((is)) this place?
Chinese: 听着，把我当三岁小孩。这地方((到底))是干什么的？

English: Actually, I'm here to see Doctor Pripp.
Chinese: 其实，我是来找普里普医生的。

English: No samples for me just now, thank you.
Chinese: 样品就先不用了，谢谢。

English: Ma'am, I'm afraid there's been a complaint. I need to see Pripp personally.
Chinese: 女士，恐怕有人投诉了。我必须亲自见普里普。

English: <<[Show Machinist insignia]>> Take me to Pripp, or the King will hear of it.
Chinese: <<[出示机械师徽记]>>带我去见普里普，否则国王会知道的。

English: Never mind. I'll find my own way in.
Chinese: 算了。我自己找路进去。

English: @@ I'm here about a very ((sensitive)) matter. Best for everyone if it stays off the books, no?
Chinese: @@ 我来办一件非常((敏感))的事。不上账本对大家都好，不是吗？

English: @@ I'm with the DRB, ma'am. Now, I'm not at liberty to name the complainant, but we have a duty to take this seriously.
Chinese: @@ 我是梦务监管局的人，女士。投诉人姓名我无权透露，但认真受理是我们的职责。

English: The Dream Regulation Board, ma'am. We're a branch of the Royal Factor's office – well, technically we're part of the Militia, but do I look like I can swing a sword? Anyway –
Chinese: 梦务监管局，女士。我们隶属皇家事务官办公厅——严格说算民兵序列，可您看我像抡得动剑的吗？总之——

English: <<[Flash a piece of paper too quickly for her to examine]>> Sure do, ma'am. Now, this morning the Factor tells me I gotta talk to Pripp and only Pripp. Gertrude," I tells her – "
Chinese: <<[闪过一张纸，快得让她来不及细看]>>没错，女士。今早事务官吩咐我，只能跟普里普一个人谈。格特鲁德"，我跟她说——"

English: Gertrude, I says – that's her name, see, though she's very private about it so don't spread it around – "Gertrude, they ain't gonna let me see him." And she says, "So what? Then we kick it up to the Guild and it's not our problem –  "
Chinese: 格特鲁德，我说——这是她的名字，你瞧，不过这事她很避讳，别到处传——"格特鲁德，他们不让我见他。"她就说了，"那又怎样？报给公会不就不关我们的事了——"

English: Could be, ma'am. See, first it goes through our office, and if we can't make progress we petition the King. Then the King sends in the Militia and oof, what a mess those boys make! So I says, Gertrude –" "
Chinese: 可能是吧，女士。您瞧，事情先过我们办公室，我们办不动就呈报国王。然后国王派民兵来，嚯，那帮家伙一动手可就一团糟了！所以我说，格特鲁德——""
